## Synthwave Grid Background

A retro perspective grid that scrolls under a gradient sky with a striped sun.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/SynthwaveGridBackground/SynthwaveGridBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum SynthwaveGridBackgroundMath {
    /// Where the horizontal lines sit, from 0 at the horizon to 1 at the bottom edge.
    ///
    /// Each line reaches the next one's place as `phase` goes from 0 to 1, so the motion loops.
    static func horizontalLines(phase: Double, count: Int) -> [Double] {
        guard count > 0, phase.isFinite else { return [] }
        let lines = min(count, 128)
        let wrapped = phase - phase.rounded(.down)
        return (0..<lines).map { pow((Double($0) + wrapped) / Double(lines), 2.4) }
    }
}

/// A retro perspective grid scrolling under a gradient sky with a striped sun.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the grid stops moving.
struct SynthwaveGridBackground: View {
    var lineColor: Color = .cyan
    var skyColors: [Color] = [
        Color(red: 0.07, green: 0.03, blue: 0.2),
        Color(red: 0.42, green: 0.08, blue: 0.5),
        Color(red: 0.95, green: 0.25, blue: 0.5),
    ]
    var lineCount = 14
    var speed = 0.5

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { timeline in
            Canvas { context, size in
                draw(in: &context, size: size, phase: reduceMotion ? 0 : timeline.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed)
            }
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    private func draw(in context: inout GraphicsContext, size: CGSize, phase: Double) {
        guard size.width > 0, size.height > 0 else { return }
        let horizon = size.height * 0.58
        let center = size.width / 2

        context.fill(
            Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: CGSize(width: size.width, height: horizon))),
            with: .linearGradient(Gradient(colors: skyColors), startPoint: .zero, endPoint: CGPoint(x: 0, y: horizon))
        )
        drawSun(in: context, center: CGPoint(x: center, y: horizon - size.width * 0.14), radius: size.width * 0.3, horizon: horizon)

        let ground = CGRect(x: 0, y: horizon, width: size.width, height: size.height - horizon)
        context.fill(Path(ground), with: .color(Color(red: 0.05, green: 0.02, blue: 0.14)))

        var grid = Path()
        let spacing = size.width / 4
        for column in -12...12 {
            grid.move(to: CGPoint(x: center + Double(column) * spacing * 0.14, y: horizon))
            grid.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: center + Double(column) * spacing, y: size.height))
        }
        for line in SynthwaveGridBackgroundMath.horizontalLines(phase: phase, count: lineCount) {
            let y = horizon + ground.height * line
            grid.move(to: CGPoint(x: 0, y: y))
            grid.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: size.width, y: y))
        }

        context.stroke(grid, with: .color(lineColor.opacity(0.25)), lineWidth: 5)
        context.stroke(grid, with: .color(lineColor), lineWidth: 1.5)
    }

    private func drawSun(in context: GraphicsContext, center: CGPoint, radius: Double, horizon: Double) {
        var bands = Path()
        var y = center.y - radius
        var gap = 0.0
        // The stripes open up toward the bottom of the sun.
        while y < horizon, radius > 0 {
            let height = max(radius * 0.22 - gap * 0.7, radius * 0.05)
            bands.addRect(CGRect(x: center.x - radius, y: y, width: radius * 2, height: height))
            gap = radius * 0.03 + max(0, y - center.y) * 0.1
            y += height + gap
        }

        var clipped = context
        clipped.clip(to: bands)
        clipped.fill(
            Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(x: center.x - radius, y: center.y - radius, width: radius * 2, height: radius * 2)),
            with: .linearGradient(
                Gradient(colors: [.yellow, .orange, .pink]),
                startPoint: CGPoint(x: center.x, y: center.y - radius),
                endPoint: CGPoint(x: center.x, y: center.y + radius)
            )
        )
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SynthwaveGridBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            SynthwaveGridBackground()

            Text("NIGHT DRIVE")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .black))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .shadow(color: .pink, radius: 12)
                .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
                .padding(.top, 72)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    SynthwaveGridBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Waves Background

Layered waves animated with a custom animatable Shape.

Category: Backgrounds. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Backgrounds/WavesBackground/WavesBackground.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Layered waves, each one an animatable `Shape` driven by a single phase.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the waves hold still.
struct WavesBackground: View {
    /// One wave per color, from back to front.
    var colors: [Color] = [.teal, .cyan, .blue, .indigo]
    var amplitude: Double = 26
    /// Seconds for the slowest wave to complete one cycle.
    var period: Double = 7

    @State private var phase = 0.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    nonisolated private struct WaveLayer: Shape {
        var phase: Double
        var baseline: Double
        var amplitude: Double
        var waves: Double

        var animatableData: Double {
            get { phase }
            set { phase = newValue }
        }

        func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
            var path = Path()
            path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX, y: rect.maxY))

            for x in stride(from: rect.minX, through: rect.maxX + 4, by: 4) {
                let angle = x / max(rect.width, 1) * waves * 2 * .pi
                let swell = sin(angle + phase) + 0.35 * sin(angle * 2 + phase * 2)
                path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: x, y: rect.minY + rect.height * baseline + swell * amplitude))
            }

            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX + 4, y: rect.maxY))
            path.closeSubpath()
            return path
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            ForEach(colors.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                // A whole number of cycles per loop, so the repeat has no visible seam.
                let cycles = Double(index % 3 + 1) * (index.isMultiple(of: 2) ? 1 : -1)

                WaveLayer(
                    phase: phase * cycles + Double(index),
                    baseline: 0.45 + 0.12 * Double(index),
                    amplitude: amplitude * (1 - 0.1 * Double(index)),
                    waves: 1 + 0.5 * Double(index % 2 + 1)
                )
                .fill(colors[index].opacity(0.85))
            }
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea()
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
        .task(id: reduceMotion) { updateMotion() }
    }

    private func updateMotion() {
        if reduceMotion {
            withTransaction(\.disablesAnimations, true) { phase = 0 }
        } else {
            withAnimation(.linear(duration: period).repeatForever(autoreverses: false)) {
                phase = 2 * .pi
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct WavesBackgroundDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.orange, .pink, .purple], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            WavesBackground()

            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: "sun.horizon.fill")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text("High Tide")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
            .padding(.top, 150)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    WavesBackgroundDemo()
}
```

## Elastic Drag Button

A round button that stretches toward the finger and springs back on release.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/ElasticDragButton/ElasticDragButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A round button that stretches toward your finger and springs back on release.
/// A press that does not travel counts as a tap.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the button stays in place and only dims while pressed.
struct ElasticDragButton: View {
    let systemImage: String
    let label: LocalizedStringResource
    var tint: Color = .indigo
    var reach: Double = 80
    let action: () -> Void

    @State private var pull = CGSize.zero
    @State private var stretch = 0.0
    @State private var angle = Angle.zero
    @GestureState private var isPressed = false
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var diameter = 112.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.layoutDirection) private var layoutDirection

    private let tapTolerance = 12.0

    /// Gestures report screen points, but layout mirrors in right-to-left layouts: 1 or -1 converts between them.
    private var forward: CGFloat { layoutDirection == .rightToLeft ? -1 : 1 }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Circle()
                .fill(tint.gradient)
                .scaleEffect(x: 1 + stretch, y: 1 - stretch * 0.45)
                .rotationEffect(angle)
                .shadow(color: tint.opacity(0.45), radius: 18, y: 10)

            Image(systemName: systemImage)
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                .foregroundStyle(ElasticDragButtonContrastingForeground(background: tint))
        }
        .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
        .offset(pull)
        .opacity(isPressed && reduceMotion ? 0.7 : 1)
        .contentShape(.circle)
        .gesture(drag)
        .onChange(of: isPressed) { _, pressed in
            guard !pressed else { return }
            withAnimation(.spring(duration: 0.6, bounce: 0.65)) {
                pull = .zero
                stretch = 0
            }
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)
        .accessibilityAction { action() }
    }

    private var drag: some Gesture {
        DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)
            .updating($isPressed) { _, state, _ in state = true }
            .onChanged { value in
                guard !reduceMotion else { return }
                let distance = hypot(value.translation.width, value.translation.height)
                guard distance > 1 else { return }

                let eased = reach * (1 - exp(-distance / (reach * 2)))
                let width = value.translation.width * forward
                pull = CGSize(
                    width: width * eased / distance,
                    height: value.translation.height * eased / distance
                )
                stretch = eased / reach * 0.4
                angle = .radians(atan2(value.translation.height, width))
            }
            .onEnded { value in
                if hypot(value.translation.width, value.translation.height) < tapTolerance {
                    action()
                }
            }
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct ElasticDragButtonContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ElasticDragButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var taps = 0

    var body: some View {
        ElasticDragButton(systemImage: "hand.point.up.left.fill", label: "Stretch") {
            taps += 1
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text("Pull me")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                Text(taps == 1 ? "1 tap" : "\(taps) taps")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .padding(.top, 72)
        }
        .background(
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.14), .pink.opacity(0.12)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()
        )
    }
}

#Preview {
    ElasticDragButtonDemo()
}
```

## Emoji Reaction Picker

A long-press control that reveals a row of reaction emoji, magnifies the one under the finger and selects it on release.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/EmojiReactionPicker/EmojiReactionPicker.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct EmojiReactionPickerOption: Identifiable, Equatable, Sendable {
    let emoji: String
    let name: LocalizedStringResource

    var id: String { emoji }

    static let defaults = [
        EmojiReactionPickerOption(emoji: "👍", name: "Like"),
        EmojiReactionPickerOption(emoji: "❤️", name: "Love"),
        EmojiReactionPickerOption(emoji: "😂", name: "Haha"),
        EmojiReactionPickerOption(emoji: "😮", name: "Wow"),
        EmojiReactionPickerOption(emoji: "😢", name: "Sad"),
    ]
}

enum EmojiReactionPickerMath {
    /// The cell under a horizontal position, clamped to the row. Nil when there is no row to hit.
    static func index(atX x: CGFloat, cellWidth: CGFloat, spacing: CGFloat, count: Int) -> Int? {
        guard count > 0, cellWidth > 0, x.isFinite else { return nil }
        let position = x / (cellWidth + max(spacing, 0))
        return Int(min(max(position, 0), CGFloat(count - 1)))
    }
}

/// A button that toggles the first reaction on tap and reveals every reaction on long press.
/// Slide along the row to magnify one and lift the finger to pick it.
///
/// The row opens above the button's leading edge. Reduce Motion replaces the magnification
/// with a highlight, and VoiceOver offers each reaction as an action.
struct EmojiReactionPicker: View {
    private enum Press: Equatable {
        case idle
        case active(location: CGPoint?)
    }

    @Binding var selection: EmojiReactionPickerOption?
    var options = EmojiReactionPickerOption.defaults
    var onSelect: (EmojiReactionPickerOption?) -> Void = { _ in }

    @GestureState private var press = Press.idle
    /// Measured from the row, which reads its own size under its text size cap.
    @State private var cellSize = 46.0
    @State private var triggerWidth: CGFloat = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.layoutDirection) private var layoutDirection

    private let spacing = 6.0
    private let padding = 8.0
    private let gap = 12.0
    /// How far from the row the finger can drift before lifting it cancels.
    private let tolerance = 70.0

    private var isOpen: Bool { press != .idle && !options.isEmpty }

    private var highlighted: Int? {
        guard case .active(let location?) = press else { return nil }
        return index(at: location)
    }

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.28, bounce: 0.35)
    }

    var body: some View {
        trigger
            .contentShape(.capsule)
            .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.width } action: { triggerWidth = $0 }
            .onTapGesture(perform: toggle)
            .gesture(longPressAndSlide)
            .overlay(alignment: .topLeading) {
                if isOpen {
                    row
                        .padding(.bottom, gap)
                        // A zero-height frame hangs the row above the button, whatever its height.
                        .frame(height: 0, alignment: .bottom)
                        .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale(scale: 0.5, anchor: .bottomLeading).combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .animation(animation, value: isOpen)
            .animation(animation, value: highlighted)
            .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: highlighted)
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel("Reaction")
            .accessibilityValue(selection?.name ?? "None")
            .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)
            .accessibilityAction(.default, toggle)
            .accessibilityActions {
                ForEach(options) { option in
                    Button(option.name) { choose(option) }
                }
            }
    }

    private var trigger: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            if let selection {
                Text(selection.emoji)
                Text(selection.name)
            } else {
                Image(systemName: "hand.thumbsup")
                Text("React")
            }
        }
        .font(.headline)
        .foregroundStyle(selection == nil ? AnyShapeStyle(.secondary) : AnyShapeStyle(.primary))
        .padding(.horizontal, 18)
        .padding(.vertical, 12)
        .background(.quaternary, in: Capsule())
    }

    private var row: some View {
        EmojiReactionPickerRow(options: options, highlighted: highlighted, spacing: spacing, padding: padding)
            // The row cannot wrap under the finger, so it stops growing.
            .dynamicTypeSize(...DynamicTypeSize.xxxLarge)
            .fixedSize()
            .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.height } action: { cellSize = $0 - padding * 2 }
    }

    private var longPressAndSlide: some Gesture {
        LongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 0.3)
            .sequenced(before: DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0))
            .updating($press) { value, state, _ in
                switch value {
                case .first(true): state = .active(location: nil)
                case .second(true, let drag): state = .active(location: drag?.location)
                default: state = .idle
                }
            }
            .onEnded { value in
                guard case .second(true, let drag?) = value,
                      let index = index(at: drag.location),
                      options.indices.contains(index) else { return }
                choose(options[index])
            }
    }

    /// Positions are relative to the button, and the row's first cell starts at its leading edge.
    private func index(at location: CGPoint) -> Int? {
        let rowHeight = cellSize + padding * 2
        guard location.y > -(gap + rowHeight + tolerance), location.y < cellSize + tolerance else { return nil }
        // Gestures report screen points, but the row mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
        let x = layoutDirection == .rightToLeft ? triggerWidth - location.x : location.x
        return EmojiReactionPickerMath.index(atX: x - padding, cellWidth: cellSize, spacing: spacing, count: options.count)
    }

    private func toggle() {
        guard let first = options.first else { return }
        let new = selection == nil ? first : nil
        selection = new
        onSelect(new)
    }

    private func choose(_ option: EmojiReactionPickerOption) {
        selection = option
        onSelect(option)
    }
}

private struct EmojiReactionPickerRow: View {
    let options: [EmojiReactionPickerOption]
    let highlighted: Int?
    let spacing: Double
    let padding: Double

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var cellSize = 46.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: spacing) {
            ForEach(Array(options.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, option in
                let isHighlighted = index == highlighted

                Text(option.emoji)
                    .font(.title)
                    .frame(width: cellSize, height: cellSize)
                    .background {
                        if isHighlighted && reduceMotion { Circle().fill(.tint.opacity(0.3)) }
                    }
                    .scaleEffect(isHighlighted && !reduceMotion ? 1.55 : 1, anchor: .bottom)
                    .zIndex(isHighlighted ? 1 : 0)
            }
        }
        .padding(padding)
        .background(.regularMaterial, in: Capsule())
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.18), radius: 14, y: 6)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct EmojiReactionPickerDemo: View {
    @State private var reaction: EmojiReactionPickerOption?

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 22, style: .continuous)
                .fill(.linearGradient(colors: [.orange, .pink, .purple], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing))
                .frame(height: 280)
                .overlay {
                    Image(systemName: "sun.haze.fill")
                        .font(.system(.largeTitle, weight: .bold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                }
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Text("Sunset from the rooftop")
                .font(.title3.weight(.semibold))

            EmojiReactionPicker(selection: $reaction)
                .padding(.top, 72)
        }
        .padding(20)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}
```

## Expanding Search Button

A round magnifying glass button that opens into a search field.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/ExpandingSearchButton/ExpandingSearchButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A round magnifying glass button that opens into a search field.
/// Closing it clears the text and dismisses the keyboard.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the field appears without animating.
struct ExpandingSearchButton: View {
    @Binding var text: String
    var prompt: LocalizedStringResource = "Search"
    var onSubmit: () -> Void = {}

    @State private var isExpanded = false
    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var height = 54.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.45, bounce: 0.25)
    }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            Button {
                open()
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "magnifyingglass")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .frame(width: height, height: height)
                    .contentShape(.circle)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel("Search")

            if isExpanded {
                TextField(text: $text) { Text(prompt) }
                    .focused($isFocused)
                    .submitLabel(.search)
                    .onSubmit(onSubmit)
                    .onAppear { isFocused = true }
                    .transition(.opacity)

                Button {
                    close()
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark.circle.fill")
                        .font(.title3)
                        .symbolRenderingMode(.hierarchical)
                        .frame(width: height, height: height)
                        .contentShape(.circle)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityLabel("Close")
                .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: isExpanded ? .infinity : height)
        .background(.regularMaterial, in: .capsule)
        .overlay(Capsule().strokeBorder(.quaternary))
    }

    private func open() {
        if isExpanded {
            isFocused = true
        } else {
            withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded = true }
        }
    }

    private func close() {
        text = ""
        isFocused = false
        withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded = false }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

        let id: String

    }

                }
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
    }
}
```

## Floating Action Menu

A plus button that rotates into a close icon and fans out its actions around it.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/FloatingActionMenu/FloatingActionMenu.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct FloatingActionMenuItem {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let systemImage: String
    var tint: Color = .indigo
    let action: () -> Void
}

enum FloatingActionMenuMath {
    /// The offset of an item on an arc. Angles use screen coordinates: 180 is left and 270 is up.
    static func offset(index: Int, count: Int, radius: Double, startDegrees: Double, endDegrees: Double) -> CGSize {
        guard count > 0, (0..<count).contains(index) else { return .zero }
        let fraction = count == 1 ? 0.5 : Double(index) / Double(count - 1)
        let radians = (startDegrees + (endDegrees - startDegrees) * fraction) * .pi / 180
        let length = max(radius, 0)
        return CGSize(width: cos(radians) * length, height: sin(radians) * length)
    }

    /// The radius, grown when needed so that neighbouring items do not overlap, but not past `limit`.
    static func fittedRadius(_ radius: Double, itemSize: Double, count: Int, startDegrees: Double, endDegrees: Double, limit: Double = .infinity) -> Double {
        guard count > 1 else { return radius }
        let step = abs(endDegrees - startDegrees) / Double(count - 1) * .pi / 180
        let chordPerRadius = 2 * sin(step / 2)
        guard chordPerRadius > 0.01 else { return radius }
        return max(radius, min((itemSize + 6) / chordPerRadius, limit))
    }

    /// The largest radius that keeps every item at least `inset` away from the edges of `container`.
    static func radiusLimit(center: CGPoint, container: CGSize, inset: Double, count: Int, startDegrees: Double, endDegrees: Double) -> Double {
        (0..<count).reduce(.infinity) { limit, index in
            let unit = offset(index: index, count: count, radius: 1, startDegrees: startDegrees, endDegrees: endDegrees)
            return min(
                limit,
                reach(along: unit.width, before: center.x - inset, after: container.width - center.x - inset),
                reach(along: unit.height, before: center.y - inset, after: container.height - center.y - inset)
            )
        }
    }

    private static func reach(along direction: Double, before: Double, after: Double) -> Double {
        if direction < -0.001 { return before / -direction }
        if direction > 0.001 { return after / direction }
        return .infinity
    }
}

/// A plus button that turns into a close icon and fans out its actions around it.
///
/// The fan opens up and to the left by default, for a button in the bottom-trailing corner.
/// With more than four items it widens so they do not overlap, until it reaches the edge of the screen.
/// In the corner of a phone at the default text size, the default fan fits seven actions at 320 points
/// wide and nine at 393. Any more stay on screen but overlap, so use a list for longer menus.
/// With Reduce Motion on, the actions appear in place without moving.
struct FloatingActionMenu: View {
    let items: [FloatingActionMenuItem]
    var tint: Color = .indigo
    var startDegrees = 180.0
    var endDegrees = 270.0

    var body: some View {
        FloatingActionMenuStage(items: items, tint: tint, startDegrees: startDegrees, endDegrees: endDegrees)
            // The buttons only hold icons. The stage reads its sizes under this cap, which keeps the fan on screen.
            .dynamicTypeSize(...DynamicTypeSize.xxxLarge)
    }
}

private struct FloatingActionMenuStage: View {
    let items: [FloatingActionMenuItem]
    let tint: Color
    let startDegrees: Double
    let endDegrees: Double

    @State private var isOpen = false
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title2) private var buttonSize = 60.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title2) private var itemSize = 50.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title2) private var radius = 112.0
    @State private var containerFrame = CGRect.zero
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            ForEach(Array(items.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, item in
                itemButton(item, index: index)
            }

            Button {
                withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.4, bounce: 0.3)) { isOpen.toggle() }
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "plus")
                    .font(.title2.weight(.bold))
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(isOpen ? 135 : 0))
                    .foregroundStyle(FloatingActionMenuContrastingForeground(background: tint))
                    .frame(width: buttonSize, height: buttonSize)
                    .background(tint.gradient, in: Circle())
                    .shadow(color: tint.opacity(0.4), radius: 12, y: 6)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel(isOpen ? "Close menu" : "Open menu")
        }
        .background {
            // Centred on the button and as big as its container, so one frame gives both.
            Color.clear
                .containerRelativeFrame([.horizontal, .vertical])
                .onGeometryChange(for: CGRect.self) { $0.frame(in: .global) } action: { containerFrame = $0 }
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .light), trigger: isOpen)
    }

    private func itemButton(_ item: FloatingActionMenuItem, index: Int) -> some View {
        let offset = FloatingActionMenuMath.offset(
            index: index,
            count: items.count,
            radius: FloatingActionMenuMath.fittedRadius(
                radius,
                itemSize: itemSize,
                count: items.count,
                startDegrees: startDegrees,
                endDegrees: endDegrees,
                limit: FloatingActionMenuMath.radiusLimit(
                    center: CGPoint(x: containerFrame.midX, y: containerFrame.midY),
                    container: containerFrame.size,
                    inset: itemSize / 2 + 8,
                    count: items.count,
                    startDegrees: startDegrees,
                    endDegrees: endDegrees
                )
            ),
            startDegrees: startDegrees,
            endDegrees: endDegrees
        )

        return Button {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.35)) { isOpen = false }
            item.action()
        } label: {
            Image(systemName: item.systemImage)
                .font(.title3.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(FloatingActionMenuContrastingForeground(background: item.tint))
                .frame(width: itemSize, height: itemSize)
                .background(item.tint, in: Circle())
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.18), radius: 8, y: 4)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(item.title)
        .accessibilityHidden(!isOpen)
        .allowsHitTesting(isOpen)
        .scaleEffect(isOpen ? 1 : 0.4)
        .opacity(isOpen ? 1 : 0)
        .offset(isOpen ? offset : .zero)
        .animation(
            reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.42, bounce: 0.32).delay(isOpen ? Double(index) * 0.04 : 0),
            value: isOpen
        )
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct FloatingActionMenuContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct FloatingActionMenuDemo: View {
    @State private var lastAction = "Tap the plus button"

    private var items: [FloatingActionMenuItem] {
        [
            FloatingActionMenuItem(title: "Share", systemImage: "square.and.arrow.up", tint: .blue) { lastAction = "Shared" },
            FloatingActionMenuItem(title: "Photo", systemImage: "camera.fill", tint: .pink) { lastAction = "Photo added" },
            FloatingActionMenuItem(title: "Note", systemImage: "note.text", tint: .orange) { lastAction = "Note added" },
        ]
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .bottomTrailing) {
            Text(lastAction)
                .font(.title3.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)

            FloatingActionMenu(items: items)
                .padding(28)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    FloatingActionMenuDemo()
}
```

## Gradient Border Button

A capsule button whose border is an angular gradient that keeps rotating.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/GradientBorderButton/GradientBorderButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A capsule button whose border is an angular gradient that keeps rotating.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the gradient stays still.
struct GradientBorderButton<Content: View>: View {
    var colors: [Color] = [.pink, .orange, .yellow, .mint, .blue, .purple, .pink]
    var lineWidth: Double = 3
    var period: Double = 3
    let action: () -> Void
    @ViewBuilder let label: () -> Content

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            label()
                .font(.title3.bold())
                .padding(.horizontal, 40)
                .padding(.vertical, 20)
                .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: .capsule)
                .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .overlay {
            TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: nil, paused: reduceMotion)) { context in
                border(at: context.date)
            }
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
    }

    private func border(at date: Date) -> some View {
        let elapsed = date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate.truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: period)
        let gradient = AngularGradient(
            colors: colors,
            center: .center,
            angle: .degrees(reduceMotion ? 0 : elapsed / period * 360)
        )

        return ZStack {
            Capsule()
                .strokeBorder(gradient, lineWidth: lineWidth)
                .blur(radius: 12)
                .opacity(0.8)
            Capsule()
                .strokeBorder(gradient, lineWidth: lineWidth)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct GradientBorderButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var isUpgraded = false

    var body: some View {
        GradientBorderButton {
            isUpgraded.toggle()
        } label: {
            Label(isUpgraded ? "Upgraded" : "Upgrade to Pro", systemImage: "crown.fill")
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color(red: 0.05, green: 0.05, blue: 0.1).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}

#Preview {
    GradientBorderButtonDemo()
}
```

## Hamburger Menu Button

A three-line menu button whose bars animate into a close cross when toggled.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/HamburgerMenuButton/HamburgerMenuButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct HamburgerMenuButtonBar: Equatable {
    let start: CGPoint
    let end: CGPoint
}

/// Three bars that become a cross as `progress` goes from 0 to 1.
nonisolated struct HamburgerMenuButtonShape: Shape {
    var progress: Double

    var animatableData: Double {
        get { progress }
        set { progress = newValue }
    }

    /// The outer bars slide to the middle while turning. The middle bar shrinks away.
    func bars(in rect: CGRect) -> [HamburgerMenuButtonBar] {
        let amount = min(max(progress, 0), 1)
        let halfWidth = rect.width / 2
        let gap = rect.height * 0.32

        func outerBar(side: Double) -> HamburgerMenuButtonBar {
            let y = rect.midY + side * gap * (1 - amount)
            let angle = -side * .pi / 4 * amount
            let dx = cos(angle) * halfWidth
            let dy = sin(angle) * halfWidth
            return HamburgerMenuButtonBar(
                start: CGPoint(x: rect.midX - dx, y: y - dy),
                end: CGPoint(x: rect.midX + dx, y: y + dy)
            )
        }

        var result = [outerBar(side: -1), outerBar(side: 1)]
        if amount < 1 {
            let dx = halfWidth * (1 - amount)
            result.append(HamburgerMenuButtonBar(
                start: CGPoint(x: rect.midX - dx, y: rect.midY),
                end: CGPoint(x: rect.midX + dx, y: rect.midY)
            ))
        }
        return result
    }

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        var path = Path()
        for bar in bars(in: rect) {
            path.move(to: bar.start)
            path.addLine(to: bar.end)
        }
        return path
    }
}

/// A three-line menu button whose bars animate into a close cross.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the icon changes without morphing.
struct HamburgerMenuButton: View {
    @Binding var isOpen: Bool
    var color: Color = .primary
    var openLabel = "Open menu"
    var closeLabel = "Close menu"

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title2) private var size = 24.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.4, bounce: 0.25)) { isOpen.toggle() }
        } label: {
            HamburgerMenuButtonShape(progress: isOpen ? 1 : 0)
                .stroke(color, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: max(size * 0.12, 2), lineCap: .round))
                .frame(width: size, height: size)
                .frame(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44)
                .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(isOpen ? closeLabel : openLabel)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct HamburgerMenuButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var isOpen = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            HStack {
                HamburgerMenuButton(isOpen: $isOpen)
                Text("Inbox")
                    .font(.system(.title2, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)

            if isOpen {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 22) {
                    Label("Inbox", systemImage: "tray.fill")
                    Label("Starred", systemImage: "star.fill")
                    Label("Sent", systemImage: "paperplane.fill")
                    Label("Trash", systemImage: "trash.fill")
                }
                .font(.title3.weight(.medium))
                .padding(28)
                .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .move(edge: .leading).combined(with: .opacity))
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(.top, 12)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
    }
}

#Preview {
    HamburgerMenuButtonDemo()
}
```

## Hold To Confirm Button

A round button that fires only after a long press fills its progress ring, and cancels if released early.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/HoldToConfirmButton/HoldToConfirmButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A round button that only fires after being held while its ring fills.
/// Releasing early drains the ring and cancels.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the ring still fills, because it carries the meaning,
/// but the button does not squeeze. VoiceOver users confirm with a double tap.
struct HoldToConfirmButton: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    var systemImage: String = "checkmark"
    var tint: Color = .red
    var holdDuration: Double = 1.2
    let action: () -> Void

    @State private var progress = 0.0
    @State private var isConfirmed = false
    @State private var holdTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var diameter = 116.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var ringWidth = 8.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var isHolding: Bool { progress > 0 && !isConfirmed }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            ZStack {
                Circle()
                    .stroke(tint.opacity(0.18), lineWidth: ringWidth)
                Circle()
                    .trim(from: 0, to: progress)
                    .stroke(isConfirmed ? Color.green : tint, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: ringWidth, lineCap: .round))
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
                Circle()
                    .fill((isConfirmed ? Color.green : tint).gradient)
                    .padding(ringWidth * 1.75)
                Image(systemName: isConfirmed ? "checkmark" : systemImage)
                    .font(.title.bold())
                    .foregroundStyle(HoldToConfirmButtonContrastingForeground(background: isConfirmed ? .green : tint))
                    .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .symbolEffect(.replace))
            }
            .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
            .scaleEffect(isHolding && !reduceMotion ? 0.92 : 1)
            .contentShape(.circle)
            // The gesture only reports pressing. The task below times the hold,
            // so the long minimum duration here never completes first.
            .onLongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 60, perform: {}, onPressingChanged: { isPressing in
                pressingChanged(isPressing)
            })

            Text(title)
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: isConfirmed) { _, confirmed in confirmed }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityHint("Double tap to confirm")
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isButton)
        .accessibilityAction { confirm() }
    }

    private func pressingChanged(_ isPressing: Bool) {
        guard !isConfirmed else { return }
        holdTask?.cancel()

        if isPressing {
            withAnimation(.linear(duration: holdDuration)) { progress = 1 }
            holdTask = Task {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(holdDuration))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                confirm()
            }
        } else {
            withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.25)) { progress = 0 }
        }
    }

    private func confirm() {
        guard !isConfirmed else { return }
        withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.2)) {
            progress = 1
            isConfirmed = true
        }
        action()

        holdTask = Task {
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.2))
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.3)) {
                progress = 0
                isConfirmed = false
            }
        }
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct HoldToConfirmButtonContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct HoldToConfirmButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var deleted = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        HoldToConfirmButton(title: "Hold to delete", systemImage: "trash.fill") {
            deleted += 1
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text(deleted, format: .number)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .numericText(value: Double(deleted)))
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: deleted)
                Text("Files deleted")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
            .padding(.top, 72)
        }
        .background(Color(uiColor: .systemGroupedBackground).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}
```

## Like Burst Button

A heart button that pops and throws out a burst of small particles when liked.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/LikeBurstButton/LikeBurstButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A heart that pops and throws out a burst of small particles when liked.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the heart simply fills, with no pop or burst.
struct LikeBurstButton: View {
    @Binding var isLiked: Bool
    var color: Color = .pink
    var particleCount: Int = 12

    @State private var burstCount = 0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var heartSize = 72.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            isLiked.toggle()
            if isLiked && !reduceMotion {
                burstCount += 1
            }
        } label: {
            ZStack {
                ForEach(0..<particleCount, id: \.self) { index in
                    LikeBurstButtonSpark(
                        angle: Double(index) / Double(particleCount) * 360,
                        reach: heartSize * (index.isMultiple(of: 2) ? 1.25 : 0.95),
                        size: heartSize * 0.14,
                        color: [color, .orange, .yellow][index % 3],
                        trigger: burstCount
                    )
                }

                Image(systemName: isLiked ? "heart.fill" : "heart")
                    .font(.system(size: heartSize, weight: .semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(isLiked ? color : Color.secondary)
                    .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: 1.0, trigger: burstCount) { content, scale in
                        content.scaleEffect(scale)
                    } keyframes: { _ in
                        KeyframeTrack {
                            CubicKeyframe(0.6, duration: 0.09)
                            SpringKeyframe(1.3, duration: 0.2, spring: .bouncy)
                            SpringKeyframe(1, duration: 0.35, spring: .bouncy)
                        }
                    }
            }
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .light), trigger: burstCount)
        .accessibilityLabel("Like")
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isLiked ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

private struct LikeBurstButtonSparkState {
    var distance = 0.0
    var scale = 0.0
    var opacity = 0.0
}

private struct LikeBurstButtonSpark: View {
    let angle: Double
    let reach: Double
    let size: Double
    let color: Color
    let trigger: Int

    var body: some View {
        Circle()
            .fill(color)
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
            .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: LikeBurstButtonSparkState(), trigger: trigger) { [angle] content, state in
                content
                    .scaleEffect(state.scale)
                    .opacity(state.opacity)
                    .offset(y: -state.distance)
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(angle))
            } keyframes: { _ in
                KeyframeTrack(\.distance) {
                    MoveKeyframe(0)
                    CubicKeyframe(reach, duration: 0.6)
                }
                KeyframeTrack(\.scale) {
                    MoveKeyframe(0.2)
                    SpringKeyframe(1, duration: 0.18, spring: .bouncy)
                    LinearKeyframe(0.1, duration: 0.42)
                }
                KeyframeTrack(\.opacity) {
                    MoveKeyframe(1)
                    LinearKeyframe(1, duration: 0.35)
                    LinearKeyframe(0, duration: 0.25)
                }
            }
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}
```

## Morphing Submit Button

A submit button that morphs into a spinner while it works and then into a checkmark.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/MorphingSubmitButton/MorphingSubmitButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

private enum MorphingSubmitButtonPhase {
    case idle, loading, success
}

/// A submit button that collapses into a spinner while its async action runs,
/// then turns into a checkmark before returning to normal.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the button keeps its shape and only its content crossfades.
struct MorphingSubmitButton: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    var tint: Color = .blue
    var successColor: Color = .green
    var successDuration: Double = 1.2
    let action: @MainActor () async -> Void

    @State private var phase = MorphingSubmitButtonPhase.idle
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var height = 64.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var morph: Animation {
        reduceMotion ? .easeInOut(duration: 0.2) : .spring(duration: 0.5, bounce: 0.3)
    }

    private var isCollapsed: Bool { phase != .idle && !reduceMotion }

    private var accessibilityTitle: LocalizedStringResource {
        switch phase {
        case .idle: title
        case .loading: "Submitting"
        case .success: "Done"
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            submit()
        } label: {
            ZStack {
                Text(title)
                    .font(.title3.bold())
                    .fixedSize()
                    .opacity(phase == .idle ? 1 : 0)

                if phase == .loading {
                    ProgressView()
                        .tint(MorphingSubmitButtonContrastingForeground(background: phase == .success ? successColor : tint))
                        .transition(.opacity)
                }

                if phase == .success {
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                        .font(.title2.bold())
                        .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .foregroundStyle(MorphingSubmitButtonContrastingForeground(background: phase == .success ? successColor : tint))
            .padding(.horizontal, isCollapsed ? 0 : 52)
            .frame(width: isCollapsed ? height : nil, height: height)
            .background(
                phase == .success ? successColor : tint,
                in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: isCollapsed ? height / 2 : 18, style: .continuous)
            )
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: phase) { _, newPhase in newPhase == .success }
        .accessibilityLabel(accessibilityTitle)
    }

    private func submit() {
        guard phase == .idle else { return }
        withAnimation(morph) { phase = .loading }

        Task {
            await action()
            withAnimation(morph) { phase = .success }
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(successDuration))
            withAnimation(morph) { phase = .idle }
        }
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct MorphingSubmitButtonContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct MorphingSubmitButtonDemo: View {
    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 32) {
            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Image(systemName: "paperplane.fill")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .foregroundStyle(.blue)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text("Join the waitlist")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                Text("We will write when your spot opens.")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            MorphingSubmitButton(title: "Submit") {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.4))
            }
            .frame(height: 80)
        }
        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}

}
```

## Play Pause Morph Button

A play button whose triangle morphs into two pause bars by interpolating its path.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/PlayPauseMorphButton/PlayPauseMorphButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A triangle that morphs into two bars as `progress` goes from 0 to 1.
nonisolated struct PlayPauseMorphButtonShape: Shape {
    var progress: Double

    var animatableData: Double {
        get { progress }
        set { progress = newValue }
    }

    private static let iconTop = 0.1
    private static let iconBottom = 0.9
    /// The x where the triangle is cut in two.
    private static let triangleCut = 0.57

    /// The triangle, cut in two, in a unit square. Corners match one to one with `pauseBars`.
    private static let playHalves: [[CGPoint]] = [
        [CGPoint(x: 0.22, y: iconTop), CGPoint(x: triangleCut, y: 0.3), CGPoint(x: triangleCut, y: 0.7), CGPoint(x: 0.22, y: iconBottom)],
        [CGPoint(x: triangleCut, y: 0.3), CGPoint(x: 0.92, y: 0.5), CGPoint(x: 0.92, y: 0.5), CGPoint(x: triangleCut, y: 0.7)],
    ]

    private static let pauseBars: [[CGPoint]] = [
        [CGPoint(x: 0.2, y: iconTop), CGPoint(x: 0.42, y: iconTop), CGPoint(x: 0.42, y: iconBottom), CGPoint(x: 0.2, y: iconBottom)],
        [CGPoint(x: 0.58, y: iconTop), CGPoint(x: 0.8, y: iconTop), CGPoint(x: 0.8, y: iconBottom), CGPoint(x: 0.58, y: iconBottom)],
    ]

    /// The two four-cornered pieces at the current progress, in a unit square.
    func pieces() -> [[CGPoint]] {
        let amount = min(max(progress, 0), 1)
        return zip(Self.playHalves, Self.pauseBars).map { play, pause in
            zip(play, pause).map { from, to in
                CGPoint(x: from.x + (to.x - from.x) * amount, y: from.y + (to.y - from.y) * amount)
            }
        }
    }

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        var path = Path()
        for piece in pieces() {
            path.addLines(piece.map { CGPoint(x: rect.minX + $0.x * rect.width, y: rect.minY + $0.y * rect.height) })
            path.closeSubpath()
        }
        return path
    }
}

/// A play button whose triangle morphs into two pause bars.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the icon changes without morphing.
struct PlayPauseMorphButton: View {
    @Binding var isPlaying: Bool
    var colors: [Color] = [.pink, .purple]

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var size = 92.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    /// The side of the icon as a fraction of the button's.
    private let iconScale = 0.42

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.42, bounce: 0.2)) { isPlaying.toggle() }
        } label: {
            let shape = PlayPauseMorphButtonShape(progress: isPlaying ? 1 : 0)

            ZStack {
                shape.fill(.white)
                // A stroke of the same color softens the corners.
                shape.stroke(.white, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: size * 0.04, lineJoin: .round))
            }
            .frame(width: size * iconScale, height: size * iconScale)
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
            .background(.linearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing), in: Circle())
            .shadow(color: (colors.first ?? .black).opacity(0.4), radius: 18, y: 10)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(isPlaying ? "Pause" : "Play")
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PlayPauseMorphButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var isPlaying = false

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 32) {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text("Midnight Drive")
                    .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                Text(isPlaying ? "Now playing" : "Paused")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            PlayPauseMorphButton(isPlaying: $isPlaying)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}

    PlayPauseMorphButtonDemo()
}
```

## Pressable Button Style

A button style that shrinks and dims on press, then springs back.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/PressableButtonStyle/PressableButtonStyle.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

import SwiftUI

/// Shrinks and dims a button while it is pressed, then springs back.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the button only dims.
struct PressableButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    var pressedScale: CGFloat = 0.94
    var pressedOpacity: Double = 0.8

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed && !reduceMotion ? pressedScale : 1)
            .opacity(configuration.isPressed ? pressedOpacity : 1)
            .animation(.spring(duration: 0.3, bounce: 0.45), value: configuration.isPressed)
    }
}

extension ButtonStyle where Self == PressableButtonStyle {
    static var pressable: PressableButtonStyle { PressableButtonStyle() }
```

## Provider Sign In Button Stack

A stack of full-width sign-in buttons, each with a leading icon slot and its own loading state while authenticating.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/ProviderSignInButtonStack/ProviderSignInButtonStack.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct ProviderSignInButtonStackOption: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let icon: Image
    var background: Color = .indigo
    var foreground: Color = .white
    let authenticate: @MainActor () async -> Void
}

/// A stack of full-width sign-in buttons. Each shows its own spinner while it authenticates,
/// and the others wait until it is done.
///
/// For Sign in with Apple, use the system `SignInWithAppleButton`: Apple's guidelines require it.
struct ProviderSignInButtonStack: View {
    let options: [ProviderSignInButtonStackOption]
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12

    @State private var loadingID: ProviderSignInButtonStackOption.ID?
    @State private var running: Task<Void, Never>?
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var minimumHeight = 54.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var iconSize = 24.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: max(spacing, 0)) {
            ForEach(options) { option in
                button(for: option)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: loadingID)
        .onDisappear {
            running?.cancel()
            running = nil
            loadingID = nil
        }
    }

    private func button(for option: ProviderSignInButtonStackOption) -> some View {
        let isLoading = loadingID == option.id
        let isWaiting = loadingID != nil && !isLoading

        return Button {
            start(option)
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                ZStack {
                    if isLoading {
                        ProgressView().tint(option.foreground)
                    } else {
                        option.icon
                            .resizable()
                            .scaledToFit()
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    }
                }
                .frame(width: iconSize, height: iconSize)

                Text(option.title)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)

                Spacer(minLength: 0)
            }
            .foregroundStyle(option.foreground)
            .padding(.horizontal, 18)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: minimumHeight)
            .background(option.background, in: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
            .opacity(isWaiting ? 0.5 : 1)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .disabled(loadingID != nil)
        .accessibilityLabel(option.title)
        .accessibilityValue(isLoading ? "Signing in" : "")
    }

    private func start(_ option: ProviderSignInButtonStackOption) {
        guard loadingID == nil else { return }
        loadingID = option.id
        let authenticate = option.authenticate

        running = Task {
            await authenticate()
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            loadingID = nil
            running = nil
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ProviderSignInButtonStackDemo: View {
    @State private var status = "Choose how to sign in"

    private var options: [ProviderSignInButtonStackOption] {
        [
            option("passkey", "Continue with Passkey", symbol: "person.badge.key.fill", color: .indigo),
            option("email", "Continue with Email", symbol: "envelope.fill", color: .teal),
            option("phone", "Continue with Phone", symbol: "phone.fill", color: .pink),
        ]
    }

    private func option(_ id: String, _ title: LocalizedStringResource, symbol: String, color: Color) -> ProviderSignInButtonStackOption {
        ProviderSignInButtonStackOption(id: id, title: title, icon: Image(systemName: symbol), background: color) {
            do {
                try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.4))
            } catch {
                return
            }
            status = "Signed in with \(id)"
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 28) {
            Image(systemName: "lock.shield.fill")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.indigo)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Text(status)
                .font(.system(.title3, design: .rounded, weight: .semibold))
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

            ProviderSignInButtonStack(options: options)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}

    ProviderSignInButtonStackDemo()
}
```

## Pulse Ring Button

A round button with rings that keep radiating out from behind it.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/PulseRingButton/PulseRingButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

private enum PulseRingButtonPhase {
    case rest, expanded
}

/// A round button with rings that keep radiating out from behind it.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, a single still halo replaces the rings.
struct PulseRingButton: View {
    let systemImage: String
    let label: LocalizedStringResource
    var tint: Color = .red
    var ringCount: Int = 3
    var ringDuration: Double = 1.6
    var stagger: Double = 0.35
    let action: () -> Void

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var diameter = 104.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Group {
                if reduceMotion {
                    Circle()
                        .fill(tint.opacity(0.2))
                        .scaleEffect(1.35)
                } else {
                    ForEach(0..<ringCount, id: \.self) { index in
                        ring(at: index)
                    }
                }
            }
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Button(action: action) {
                Image(systemName: systemImage)
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                    .foregroundStyle(PulseRingButtonContrastingForeground(background: tint))
                    .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
                    .background(tint.gradient, in: .circle)
                    .contentShape(.circle)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
        }
        .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
    }

    /// Every ring waits before growing and again before resetting, and the two
    /// delays add up to the same total, so all rings keep the same period.
    private func ring(at index: Int) -> some View {
        let startDelay = Double(index) * stagger
        let endDelay = Double(ringCount - 1 - index) * stagger

        return Circle()
            .fill(tint)
            .phaseAnimator([PulseRingButtonPhase.rest, .expanded]) { content, phase in
                content
                    .scaleEffect(phase == .expanded ? 2.5 : 1)
                    .opacity(phase == .expanded ? 0 : 0.55)
            } animation: { phase in
                phase == .expanded
                    ? .easeOut(duration: ringDuration).delay(startDelay)
                    : .linear(duration: 0.01).delay(endDelay)
            }
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct PulseRingButtonContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PulseRingButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var isRecording = true

    var body: some View {
        PulseRingButton(systemImage: isRecording ? "mic.fill" : "mic.slash.fill", label: "Record") {
            isRecording.toggle()
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text(isRecording ? "Listening" : "Muted")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                Text("Tap to toggle the microphone")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.65))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.top, 72)
        }
        .background(Color(red: 0.1, green: 0.05, blue: 0.08).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}

}
```

## Shimmer Button

A gradient capsule button with a band of light that sweeps across it in a loop.

Category: Buttons. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Buttons/ShimmerButton/ShimmerButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A gradient capsule button with a band of light that sweeps across it in a loop.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the sweep is removed and the button stays still.
struct ShimmerButton: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    var systemImage: String?
    var colors: [Color] = [.indigo, .purple]
    var sweepDuration: Double = 1.1
    var pause: Double = 0.9
    let action: () -> Void

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                if let systemImage {
                    Image(systemName: systemImage)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                }
                Text(title)
            }
            .font(.title3.bold())
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.horizontal, 40)
            .padding(.vertical, 20)
            .background(LinearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing))
            .overlay {
                if !reduceMotion {
                    sweep
                }
            }
            .clipShape(.capsule)
            .contentShape(.capsule)
            .shadow(color: (colors.first ?? .clear).opacity(0.5), radius: 18, y: 8)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }

    private var sweep: some View {
        LinearGradient(colors: [.clear, .white.opacity(0.65), .clear], startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing)
            .scaleEffect(x: 0.4, y: 2.5)
            .rotationEffect(.degrees(20))
            .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: -1.1, repeating: true) { content, position in
                content.visualEffect { effect, proxy in
                    effect.offset(x: position * proxy.size.width)
                }
            } keyframes: { _ in
                KeyframeTrack {
                    LinearKeyframe(1.1, duration: sweepDuration)
                    LinearKeyframe(1.1, duration: pause)
                }
            }
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7))
            }

            ShimmerButton(title: "Start free trial", systemImage: "sparkles") {}
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
```
