## Chat Auto Scroll List

A message list that stays on the newest message as messages arrive, and stops following when the user scrolls up to read.

Category: Chat. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Chat/ChatAutoScrollList/ChatAutoScrollList.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A message list that stays on the newest message, and stops following when you scroll up.
///
/// While you read older messages, a button brings you back to the latest. With Reduce
/// Motion on, the list jumps instead of scrolling.
struct ChatAutoScrollList<Item: Identifiable, Row: View>: View where Item.ID: Sendable {
    let items: [Item]
    var spacing: CGFloat
    @ViewBuilder let row: (Item) -> Row

    @State private var position = ScrollPosition(idType: Item.ID.self)
    @State private var follow = ChatAutoScrollListFollowState()
    @State private var isUserScrolling = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    init(items: [Item], spacing: CGFloat = 8, @ViewBuilder row: @escaping (Item) -> Row) {
        self.items = items
        self.spacing = spacing
        self.row = row
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVStack(spacing: max(spacing, 0)) {
                ForEach(items) { row($0) }
            }
            .scrollTargetLayout()
            .padding()
        }
        .scrollPosition($position)
        .defaultScrollAnchor(.bottom, for: .initialOffset)
        .onScrollPhaseChange { _, phase in
            isUserScrolling = phase == .tracking || phase == .interacting || phase == .decelerating
        }
        .onScrollGeometryChange(for: Bool.self) { geometry in
            ChatAutoScrollListLogic.isAtBottom(
                visibleMaxY: geometry.visibleRect.maxY,
                contentHeight: geometry.contentSize.height
            )
        } action: { _, isAtBottom in
            follow.scrolled(isAtBottom: isAtBottom, isUserDriven: isUserScrolling)
        }
        .onChange(of: items.last?.id) { _, newID in
            guard let newID else { return }
            follow.messageArrived()
            if follow.isFollowing { scroll(to: newID) }
        }
        .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
            ZStack {
                if !follow.isFollowing {
                    jumpButton.transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: follow)
        }
    }

    private var jumpButton: some View {
        Button {
            follow.jumpedToLatest()
            if let id = items.last?.id { scroll(to: id) }
        } label: {
            Label(follow.hasNewMessages ? "New messages" : "Latest", systemImage: "arrow.down")
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .padding(.vertical, 10)
                .background(.regularMaterial, in: .capsule)
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.15), radius: 8, y: 3)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .padding(.bottom, 12)
    }

    private func scroll(to id: Item.ID) {
        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy) {
            position.scrollTo(id: id, anchor: .bottom)
        }
    }
}

/// Whether the list follows new messages.
///
/// Only the user can stop following. Otherwise the moment a new message makes the list
/// taller, or an animated scroll is on its way down, would count as having left the bottom.
struct ChatAutoScrollListFollowState: Equatable {
    private(set) var isFollowing = true
    private(set) var hasNewMessages = false

    mutating func messageArrived() {
        if !isFollowing { hasNewMessages = true }
    }

    mutating func scrolled(isAtBottom: Bool, isUserDriven: Bool) {
        if isAtBottom {
            jumpedToLatest()
        } else if isUserDriven {
            isFollowing = false
        }
    }

    mutating func jumpedToLatest() {
        isFollowing = true
        hasNewMessages = false
    }
}

enum ChatAutoScrollListLogic {
    static func isAtBottom(visibleMaxY: CGFloat, contentHeight: CGFloat, tolerance: CGFloat = 32) -> Bool {
        visibleMaxY >= contentHeight - max(tolerance, 0)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct ChatAutoScrollListDemoMessage: Identifiable {
    let id: Int
    let text: String
    var isMine: Bool { id.isMultiple(of: 3) }
}

struct ChatAutoScrollListDemo: View {
    private static let initialCount = 12
    private static let lines = [
        "Did the build finish?",
        "Almost, the last tests are running now.",
        "Great. Scroll up and the list stops following.",
        "And when you come back to the bottom?",
        "It starts following the new messages again, without you doing anything.",
        "Nice.",
    ]

    @State private var messages = (0..<initialCount).map { ChatAutoScrollListDemoMessage(id: $0, text: lines[$0 % lines.count]) }
    @State private var nextID = initialCount
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ChatAutoScrollList(items: messages) { message in
                Text(message.text)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 14)
                    .padding(.vertical, 9)
                    .foregroundStyle(message.isMine ? Color.white : Color.primary)
                    .background(message.isMine ? AnyShapeStyle(.indigo) : AnyShapeStyle(.thinMaterial), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: message.isMine ? .trailing : .leading)
            }

            Button("Add message", systemImage: "plus.bubble") { addMessage() }
                .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                .tint(.indigo)
                .padding()
        }
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.14), .teal.opacity(0.1)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
        .task(id: reduceMotion) {
            guard !reduceMotion else { return }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.8))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                addMessage()
            }
        }
    }

    private func addMessage() {
        messages.append(.init(id: nextID, text: Self.lines[nextID % Self.lines.count]))
        nextID += 1
        if messages.count > 60 { messages.removeFirst(30) }
    }
}

#Preview {
    ChatAutoScrollListDemo()
}
```

## Chat Bubble Shape

A message bubble with a tail, whose corners adapt to grouped consecutive messages.

Category: Chat. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Chat/ChatBubbleShape/ChatBubbleShape.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated enum ChatBubbleShapeSide: Sendable {
    case leading, trailing
}

/// Where a message sits inside a run of messages from the same sender.
nonisolated enum ChatBubbleShapePosition: Sendable {
    case single, first, middle, last
}

/// A message bubble with a tail, whose corners tighten where messages are grouped.
///
/// The tail is drawn just outside the shape's rect, so leave about 8 points beside it.
/// Corners and tail animate when a bubble's position changes.
nonisolated struct ChatBubbleShape: Shape {
    var side: ChatBubbleShapeSide = .trailing
    private var radii: RectangleCornerRadii
    private var tail: CGFloat

    private let tailWidth: CGFloat = 7

    init(
        side: ChatBubbleShapeSide = .trailing,
        position: ChatBubbleShapePosition = .single,
        radius: CGFloat = 18,
        tightRadius: CGFloat = 5
    ) {
        self.side = side
        radii = ChatBubbleShapeLogic.radii(for: position, radius: radius, tightRadius: tightRadius)
        tail = ChatBubbleShapeLogic.hasTail(position) ? 1 : 0
    }

    var animatableData: AnimatablePair<RectangleCornerRadii.AnimatableData, CGFloat> {
        get { AnimatablePair(radii.animatableData, tail) }
        set {
            radii.animatableData = newValue.first
            tail = newValue.second
        }
    }

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        guard rect.width > 0, rect.height > 0 else { return Path() }

        let path = outline(width: rect.width, height: rect.height)
        let placed = side == .trailing
            ? path
            : path.applying(CGAffineTransform(scaleX: -1, y: 1).translatedBy(x: -rect.width, y: 0))
        return placed.offsetBy(dx: rect.minX, dy: rect.minY)
    }

    /// One closed outline, with the tail on the right. The left side is its mirror image.
    private func outline(width: CGFloat, height: CGFloat) -> Path {
        let limit = min(width, height) / 2
        let topLeft = min(max(radii.topLeading, 0), limit)
        let topRight = min(max(radii.topTrailing, 0), limit)
        let bottomRight = min(max(radii.bottomTrailing, 0), limit)
        let bottomLeft = min(max(radii.bottomLeading, 0), limit)

        // The bottom right corner is two curves that meet at `tip`. With no tail they
        // form an ordinary rounded corner, and the tail pulls them out to a point.
        let cornerStart = CGPoint(x: width, y: height - bottomRight)
        let cornerEnd = CGPoint(x: width - bottomRight, y: height)
        let corner = CGPoint(x: width, y: height)
        let firstControl = midpoint(cornerStart, corner)
        let secondControl = midpoint(corner, cornerEnd)
        let roundedTip = midpoint(firstControl, secondControl)

        var path = Path()
        path.move(to: CGPoint(x: topLeft, y: 0))
        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: width - topRight, y: 0))
        path.addArc(tangent1End: CGPoint(x: width, y: 0), tangent2End: CGPoint(x: width, y: topRight), radius: topRight)
        path.addLine(to: cornerStart)
        path.addQuadCurve(
            to: blend(roundedTip, CGPoint(x: width + tailWidth, y: height), tail),
            control: blend(firstControl, CGPoint(x: width, y: height - 2), tail)
        )
        path.addQuadCurve(
            to: cornerEnd,
            control: blend(secondControl, CGPoint(x: width - 2, y: height - 1), tail)
        )
        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: bottomLeft, y: height))
        path.addArc(tangent1End: CGPoint(x: 0, y: height), tangent2End: CGPoint(x: 0, y: height - bottomLeft), radius: bottomLeft)
        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: 0, y: topLeft))
        path.addArc(tangent1End: .zero, tangent2End: CGPoint(x: topLeft, y: 0), radius: topLeft)
        path.closeSubpath()
        return path
    }

    private func midpoint(_ a: CGPoint, _ b: CGPoint) -> CGPoint {
        blend(a, b, 0.5)
    }

    private func blend(_ a: CGPoint, _ b: CGPoint, _ amount: CGFloat) -> CGPoint {
        CGPoint(x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * amount, y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * amount)
    }
}

nonisolated enum ChatBubbleShapeLogic {
    static func hasTail(_ position: ChatBubbleShapePosition) -> Bool {
        position == .single || position == .last
    }

    /// The corners, as if the tail were on the right.
    static func radii(for position: ChatBubbleShapePosition, radius: CGFloat, tightRadius: CGFloat) -> RectangleCornerRadii {
        let tightTop = position == .middle || position == .last
        let tightBottom = position == .first || position == .middle
        return RectangleCornerRadii(
            topLeading: radius,
            bottomLeading: radius,
            bottomTrailing: tightBottom ? tightRadius : radius,
            topTrailing: tightTop ? tightRadius : radius
        )
    }

    /// Works out each message's position from who sent it.
    static func positions<Sender: Equatable>(for senders: [Sender]) -> [ChatBubbleShapePosition] {
        senders.indices.map { index in
            let joinsPrevious = index > senders.startIndex && senders[index - 1] == senders[index]
            let joinsNext = index + 1 < senders.endIndex && senders[index + 1] == senders[index]
            switch (joinsPrevious, joinsNext) {
            case (false, false): return .single
            case (false, true): return .first
            case (true, true): return .middle
            case (true, false): return .last
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ChatBubbleShapeDemo: View {
    @State private var visibleCount = ChatBubbleShapeDemo.messages.count
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private static let messages: [(isMine: Bool, text: String)] = [
        (false, "Are you coming tonight?"),
        (true, "Yes!"),
        (true, "Running a little late"),
        (true, "Save me a seat"),
        (false, "Of course"),
        (false, "Front row, near the stage"),
        (true, "You are the best"),
    ]

    private var visible: ArraySlice<(isMine: Bool, text: String)> {
        Self.messages.prefix(visibleCount)
    }

    var body: some View {
        let positions = ChatBubbleShapeLogic.positions(for: visible.map(\.isMine))

        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                ForEach(Array(visible.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, message in
                    bubble(message.text, isMine: message.isMine, position: positions[index])
                        .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale(scale: 0.8, anchor: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
        .defaultScrollAnchor(.bottom)
        .task(id: reduceMotion) {
            guard !reduceMotion else {
                visibleCount = Self.messages.count
                return
            }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                for count in 1...Self.messages.count {
                    guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                    withAnimation(.snappy(duration: 0.3)) { visibleCount = count }
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.45))
                }
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))
            }
        }
    }

    private func bubble(_ text: String, isMine: Bool, position: ChatBubbleShapePosition) -> some View {
        Text(text)
            .padding(.horizontal, 14)
            .padding(.vertical, 9)
            .foregroundStyle(isMine ? Color.white : Color.primary)
            .background(
                isMine ? AnyShapeStyle(.blue) : AnyShapeStyle(.quaternary),
                in: ChatBubbleShape(side: isMine ? .trailing : .leading, position: position)
            )
            .padding(.horizontal, 8)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: isMine ? .trailing : .leading)
            .padding(.top, position == .single || position == .first ? 14 : 2)
    }
}

#Preview {
    ChatBubbleShapeDemo()
}
```

## Keyboard Tracking Input Bar

A composer bar pinned below its content that rises with the keyboard and grows as the user types more lines.

Category: Chat. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Chat/KeyboardTrackingInputBar/KeyboardTrackingInputBar.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A composer pinned below its content that rises with the keyboard and grows as you type.
///
/// `safeAreaInset` makes the content leave room for the bar and moves the bar with the
/// keyboard, so nothing here needs to measure it.
struct KeyboardTrackingInputBar<Content: View>: View {
    @Binding var text: String
    var placeholder: LocalizedStringResource
    var tint: Color
    var onSend: (String) -> Void
    @ViewBuilder let content: Content

    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var sendSize = 34.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    init(
        text: Binding<String>,
        placeholder: LocalizedStringResource = "Message",
        tint: Color = .blue,
        onSend: @escaping (String) -> Void,
        @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content
    ) {
        _text = text
        self.placeholder = placeholder
        self.tint = tint
        self.onSend = onSend
        self.content = content()
    }

    private var message: String {
        text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
    }

    var body: some View {
        content.safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom, spacing: 0) {
            HStack(alignment: .bottom, spacing: 8) {
                TextField(placeholder, text: $text, axis: .vertical)
                    .lineLimit(1...5)
                    .focused($isFocused)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 14)
                    .padding(.vertical, 8)
                    .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 20))
                    .overlay {
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 20).strokeBorder(.quaternary)
                    }
                    .accessibilityLabel(placeholder)

                Button(action: send) {
                    Image(systemName: "arrow.up")
                        .font(.body.weight(.bold))
                        .foregroundStyle(KeyboardTrackingInputBarContrastingForeground(background: tint))
                        .frame(width: sendSize, height: sendSize)
                        .background(message.isEmpty ? AnyShapeStyle(.gray.opacity(0.4)) : AnyShapeStyle(tint), in: .circle)
                        .frame(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44)
                        .contentShape(.rect)
                }
                .disabled(message.isEmpty)
                .accessibilityLabel("Send")
                .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: message.isEmpty)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
            .background(.bar)
        }
    }

    private func send() {
        let sent = message
        guard !sent.isEmpty else { return }
        text = ""
        onSend(sent)
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct KeyboardTrackingInputBarContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct KeyboardTrackingInputBarDemoMessage: Identifiable {
    let id = UUID()
    let text: String
}

struct KeyboardTrackingInputBarDemo: View {
    @State private var draft = ""
    @State private var messages = [
        KeyboardTrackingInputBarDemoMessage(text: "Tap the field and the bar rides up on the keyboard."),
        KeyboardTrackingInputBarDemoMessage(text: "Long messages make it grow, up to five lines."),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        KeyboardTrackingInputBar(text: $draft, onSend: { sent in
            messages.append(.init(text: sent))
        }, content: {
            ScrollView {
                LazyVStack(alignment: .trailing, spacing: 8) {
                    ForEach(messages) { message in
                        Text(message.text)
                            .padding(.horizontal, 14)
                            .padding(.vertical, 9)
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                            .background(.blue, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
                    }
                }
                .padding()
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .trailing)
            }
            .defaultScrollAnchor(.bottom)
            .scrollDismissesKeyboard(.interactively)
        })
    }
}

#Preview {
    KeyboardTrackingInputBarDemo()
}
```

## Nested Comment Thread

Threaded comments with indentation, connector lines and collapsible replies.

Category: Chat. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Chat/NestedCommentThread/NestedCommentThread.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct NestedCommentThreadComment: Identifiable, Hashable {
    let id: String
    let author: String
    let text: String
    var age: String = ""
    var replies: [NestedCommentThreadComment] = []
}

/// Threaded comments with indentation, connector lines and collapsible replies.
///
/// Put it in a `ScrollView`. Indentation stops growing past a few levels, sooner with
/// accessibility text sizes, so deep threads keep room for their text.
struct NestedCommentThread: View {
    let comments: [NestedCommentThreadComment]
    var tint: Color = .indigo

    @State private var collapsed: Set<String> = []
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .subheadline) private var avatarSize = 34.0
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let verticalPadding = 8.0
    private var maximumLevels: Int { dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize ? 2 : 5 }

    var body: some View {
        LazyVStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(NestedCommentThreadLogic.rows(for: comments, collapsed: collapsed)) { row in
                rowView(row).transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
    }

    private func rowView(_ row: NestedCommentThreadLogic.Row) -> some View {
        let guides = Array(row.guides.suffix(maximumLevels))
        let leading = CGFloat(guides.count) * avatarSize
        let showsStem = !row.comment.replies.isEmpty && !collapsed.contains(row.comment.id)

        return HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 10) {
            avatar(for: row.comment)
            content(for: row.comment)
        }
        .padding(.vertical, verticalPadding)
        .padding(.leading, leading)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(alignment: .leading) {
            HStack(spacing: 0) {
                ForEach(Array(guides.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, continues in
                    NestedCommentThreadGuide(
                        continues: continues,
                        elbowY: index == guides.count - 1 ? verticalPadding + avatarSize / 2 : nil
                    )
                    .stroke(.quaternary, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1.5, lineCap: .round))
                    .frame(width: avatarSize)
                }
            }
        }
        .background(alignment: .topLeading) {
            if showsStem {
                Rectangle()
                    .fill(.quaternary)
                    .frame(width: 1.5)
                    .padding(.top, verticalPadding + avatarSize)
                    .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
                    .offset(x: leading + avatarSize / 2 - 0.75)
            }
        }
    }

    private func avatar(for comment: NestedCommentThreadComment) -> some View {
        Circle()
            .fill(tint.gradient)
            .frame(width: avatarSize, height: avatarSize)
            .overlay {
                Text(comment.author.prefix(1))
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.bold))
                    .foregroundStyle(NestedCommentThreadContrastingForeground(background: tint))
            }
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    private func content(for comment: NestedCommentThreadComment) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    Text(comment.author).font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                    Text(comment.age).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
                Text(comment.text).font(.subheadline)
            }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)

            if !comment.replies.isEmpty {
                toggle(for: comment)
            }
        }
    }

    private func toggle(for comment: NestedCommentThreadComment) -> some View {
        let isCollapsed = collapsed.contains(comment.id)
        let count = NestedCommentThreadLogic.replyCount(of: comment)
        let title = "\(isCollapsed ? "Show" : "Hide") \(count) \(count == 1 ? "reply" : "replies")"

        return Button {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy) {
                if isCollapsed {
                    collapsed.remove(comment.id)
                } else {
                    collapsed.insert(comment.id)
                }
            }
        } label: {
            Text(title)
                .font(.caption.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(tint)
                .frame(minHeight: 28)
                // The padding widens what answers to a touch, and the same padding taken
                // back keeps the thread as compact as it was.
                .padding(.vertical, 8)
                .contentShape(.rect)
                .padding(.vertical, -8)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel("\(title) to \(comment.author)")
    }
}

/// One indentation column: a straight line, and for a comment's own level an elbow into it.
nonisolated private struct NestedCommentThreadGuide: Shape {
    let continues: Bool
    let elbowY: CGFloat?

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        var path = Path()
        if let elbowY {
            let radius = min(10, rect.width / 2)
            path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.midX, y: rect.minY))
            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.midX, y: max(rect.minY, elbowY - radius)))
            path.addQuadCurve(to: CGPoint(x: rect.midX + radius, y: elbowY), control: CGPoint(x: rect.midX, y: elbowY))
            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX, y: elbowY))
        }
        if continues {
            path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.midX, y: rect.minY))
            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.midX, y: rect.maxY))
        }
        return path
    }
}

/// Turns the tree into the flat list of visible rows, apart from the view so it can be tested.
enum NestedCommentThreadLogic {
    struct Row: Identifiable, Equatable {
        let comment: NestedCommentThreadComment
        /// One entry per indentation level: whether its line continues below this row.
        let guides: [Bool]

        var id: String { comment.id }
    }

    static func rows(for comments: [NestedCommentThreadComment], collapsed: Set<String>) -> [Row] {
        var result: [Row] = []

        func visit(_ list: [NestedCommentThreadComment], guides: [Bool], isTopLevel: Bool) {
            for (index, comment) in list.enumerated() {
                let rowGuides = isTopLevel ? [] : guides + [index < list.count - 1]
                result.append(Row(comment: comment, guides: rowGuides))
                if !collapsed.contains(comment.id) {
                    visit(comment.replies, guides: rowGuides, isTopLevel: false)
                }
            }
        }

        visit(comments, guides: [], isTopLevel: true)
        return result
    }

    /// Every reply below a comment, however deep.
    static func replyCount(of comment: NestedCommentThreadComment) -> Int {
        comment.replies.reduce(comment.replies.count) { $0 + replyCount(of: $1) }
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct NestedCommentThreadContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct NestedCommentThreadDemo: View {
    private let comments = [
        NestedCommentThreadComment(id: "1", author: "Marta", text: "Should we ship this behind a flag first?", age: "2h", replies: [
            NestedCommentThreadComment(id: "2", author: "Luis", text: "Yes, at least for the first week.", age: "1h", replies: [
                NestedCommentThreadComment(id: "3", author: "Ana", text: "Agreed. I can watch the metrics.", age: "40m"),
            ]),
            NestedCommentThreadComment(id: "4", author: "Noa", text: "I will set up the flag today.", age: "32m"),
        ]),
        NestedCommentThreadComment(id: "5", author: "Diego", text: "The new empty state looks great.", age: "25m", replies: [
            NestedCommentThreadComment(id: "6", author: "Iris", text: "Thanks! It took a few tries.", age: "12m"),
        ]),
        NestedCommentThreadComment(id: "7", author: "Sara", text: "Can someone review the copy before Friday?", age: "5m"),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
                Text("Discussion")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())

                NestedCommentThread(comments: comments)
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    NestedCommentThreadDemo()
}
```

## Tapback Reaction Bubble

A message you press and hold to react to, with a bar of reactions above it and the chosen one kept as a badge on its corner.

Category: Chat. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Chat/TapbackReactionBubble/TapbackReactionBubble.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated enum TapbackReactionBubbleLogic {
    /// The reaction a message has after one is chosen: choosing the one it had takes it away.
    static func toggled(_ current: String?, choosing reaction: String) -> String? {
        current == reaction ? nil : reaction
    }

    /// How long a reaction of the bar waits before it pops in, so they arrive in a quick wave
    /// that a long bar does not stretch.
    static func delay(for index: Int, step: Double = 0.03, limit: Double = 0.18) -> Double {
        min(Double(max(index, 0)) * step, limit)
    }
}

/// A message you press and hold to react to: it lifts, a bar of reactions opens above it, and the
/// one you choose stays on its corner as a badge. Choose it again to take it away.
///
/// The caller owns `isPicking`, so it can close the bar from outside and dim the other messages.
/// VoiceOver offers each reaction as an action of the message. With Reduce Motion on, nothing
/// scales: the bar and the badge fade.
struct TapbackReactionBubble<Content: View>: View {
    @Binding var reaction: String?
    @Binding var isPicking: Bool
    var reactions = ["❤️", "👍", "👎", "😂", "‼️", "❓"]
    /// The side of the screen the message sits on. The bar grows from that side and the badge
    /// goes to the other corner, toward the middle of the screen.
    var side = HorizontalAlignment.leading
    @ViewBuilder var content: () -> Content

    private let gap: CGFloat = 8
    private let badgeOverhang = 0.65

    @State private var isBarShown = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        // Plain values for the alignment guides, which may not capture a generic view: Xcode 26 rejects it.
        let gap = gap
        let overhang = badgeOverhang
        let isLeading = side == .leading

        content()
            .overlay(alignment: Alignment(horizontal: side == .leading ? .trailing : .leading, vertical: .top)) {
                // The guides go on a container that is always there: on a view that comes and goes
                // with a transition they are not read.
                ZStack {
                    if let reaction {
                        badge(reaction)
                    }
                }
                // Most of the badge hangs outside the corner, so it does not cover the message.
                .alignmentGuide(.top) { $0.height * overhang }
                .alignmentGuide(isLeading ? .trailing : .leading) { $0.width * (isLeading ? 1 - overhang : overhang) }
            }
            .scaleEffect(isPicking && !reduceMotion ? 1.04 : 1)
            .overlay(alignment: Alignment(horizontal: side, vertical: .top)) {
                ZStack {
                    if isPicking {
                        bar
                            .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale(scale: 0.5, anchor: .bottom).combined(with: .opacity))
                    }
                }
                // The bottom of the bar sits a gap above the top of the message.
                .alignmentGuide(.top) { $0[.bottom] + gap }
            }
            .zIndex(isPicking ? 1 : 0)
            .onLongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 0.4) {
                isPicking = true
            }
            .animation(reduceMotion ? .easeInOut(duration: 0.2) : .spring(duration: 0.35, bounce: 0.3), value: isPicking)
            .animation(reduceMotion ? .easeInOut(duration: 0.2) : .spring(duration: 0.35, bounce: 0.5), value: reaction)
            .sensoryFeedback(trigger: isPicking) { _, isPicking in
                isPicking ? .impact(weight: .medium) : nil
            }
            .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: reaction)
            .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
            .accessibilityValue(reaction.map { "Reacted with \($0)" } ?? "")
            .accessibilityActions {
                ForEach(reactions, id: \.self) { option in
                    Button(option == reaction ? "Remove \(option)" : "React with \(option)") {
                        choose(option)
                    }
                }
            }
    }

    private func badge(_ reaction: String) -> some View {
        Text(reaction)
            .font(.footnote)
            .padding(6)
            .background(.regularMaterial, in: .circle)
            .overlay { Circle().strokeBorder(.background, lineWidth: 2) }
            .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale(scale: 0.2).combined(with: .opacity))
            .id(reaction)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    private var bar: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 4) {
            ForEach(Array(reactions.enumerated()), id: \.element) { index, option in
                Button {
                    choose(option)
                } label: {
                    Text(option)
                        .font(.title2)
                        .frame(minWidth: 40, minHeight: 40)
                        .background(option == reaction ? AnyShapeStyle(.tint.opacity(0.25)) : AnyShapeStyle(.clear), in: .circle)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .scaleEffect(isBarShown || reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.4)
                .animation(.spring(duration: 0.25, bounce: 0.45).delay(TapbackReactionBubbleLogic.delay(for: index)), value: isBarShown)
                .accessibilityLabel(option == reaction ? "Remove \(option)" : "React with \(option)")
            }
        }
        .padding(6)
        .background(.regularMaterial, in: .capsule)
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.18), radius: 12, y: 4)
        .fixedSize()
        .onAppear { isBarShown = true }
        .onDisappear { isBarShown = false }
    }

    private func choose(_ option: String) {
        reaction = TapbackReactionBubbleLogic.toggled(reaction, choosing: option)
        isPicking = false
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct TapbackReactionBubbleDemoMessage: Identifiable {
    let id: Int
    let text: String
    let isMine: Bool
}

struct TapbackReactionBubbleDemo: View {
    private let messages = [
        TapbackReactionBubbleDemoMessage(id: 0, text: "Are we still on for the hike on Saturday?", isMine: false),
        TapbackReactionBubbleDemoMessage(id: 1, text: "Yes! I’ll bring the snacks.", isMine: true),
        TapbackReactionBubbleDemoMessage(id: 2, text: "Perfect. Meet at the trailhead at eight?", isMine: false),
        TapbackReactionBubbleDemoMessage(id: 3, text: "Eight it is.", isMine: true),
    ]

    @State private var reactions: [Int: String] = [1: "❤️"]
    @State private var picking: Int?

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 18) {
            Text("Press and hold a message")
                .font(.footnote)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .padding(.bottom, 4)

            ForEach(messages) { message in
                let isOther = picking != nil && picking != message.id

                TapbackReactionBubble(
                    reaction: Binding { reactions[message.id] } set: { reactions[message.id] = $0 },
                    isPicking: Binding { picking == message.id } set: { picking = $0 ? message.id : nil },
                    side: message.isMine ? .trailing : .leading
                ) {
                    Text(message.text)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 14)
                        .padding(.vertical, 10)
                        .foregroundStyle(message.isMine ? .white : .primary)
                        .background(message.isMine ? AnyShapeStyle(.blue) : AnyShapeStyle(.fill.tertiary), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 20))
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: 280, alignment: message.isMine ? .trailing : .leading)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: message.isMine ? .trailing : .leading)
                .opacity(isOther ? 0.3 : 1)
                .allowsHitTesting(!isOther)
                .zIndex(picking == message.id ? 1 : 0)
            }

            Spacer()
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        .padding(.top, 80)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background {
            // Catches the taps outside the open message, which close its bar.
            Color(.systemBackground)
                .ignoresSafeArea()
                .onTapGesture { picking = nil }
        }
        .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.25), value: picking)
    }
}

#Preview {
    TapbackReactionBubbleDemo()
}
```

## Add To Cart Fly Button

An add-to-cart button that sends a copy of the product image arcing into the cart badge.

Category: Commerce. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Commerce/AddToCartFlyButton/AddToCartFlyButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A product image and an add button that sends a copy of the image arcing into the cart.
///
/// Measure your cart icon in the `.global` space and pass its frame as `cartFrame`. The
/// count goes up when the copy lands. With Reduce Motion on, or with no `cartFrame`, the
/// count goes up at once and nothing flies.
struct AddToCartFlyButton: View {
    let image: Image
    @Binding var count: Int
    var cartFrame: CGRect?
    var title: LocalizedStringResource = "Add to Cart"
    var imageLabel: LocalizedStringResource = "Product"
    var tint: Color = .indigo
    var onAdd: () -> Void = {}

    @State private var flights: [AddToCartFlyButtonLaunch] = []
    @State private var sourceFrame = CGRect.zero
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let maximumFlights = 6

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            image
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .foregroundStyle(tint)
                .padding(36)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .frame(height: 260)
                .background(tint.opacity(0.12), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28))
                .accessibilityLabel(imageLabel)
                .onGeometryChange(for: CGRect.self) { $0.frame(in: .global) } action: { sourceFrame = $0 }
                .overlay {
                    ForEach(flights) { flight in
                        AddToCartFlyButtonFlight(image: image, destination: flight.destination, tint: tint) {
                            land(flight.id)
                        }
                    }
                }

            Button(action: add) {
                Label(title, systemImage: "cart.badge.plus")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .tint(tint)
        }
    }

    private func add() {
        guard !reduceMotion, flights.count < maximumFlights, let cartFrame, sourceFrame != .zero else {
            increment()
            return
        }
        let destination = CGSize(width: cartFrame.midX - sourceFrame.midX, height: cartFrame.midY - sourceFrame.midY)
        flights.append(AddToCartFlyButtonLaunch(destination: destination))
    }

    private func land(_ id: UUID) {
        guard let index = flights.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }) else { return }
        flights.remove(at: index)
        increment()
    }

    private func increment() {
        count = count == .max ? count : count + 1
        onAdd()
    }
}

private struct AddToCartFlyButtonLaunch: Identifiable {
    let id = UUID()
    let destination: CGSize
}

/// The flying copy. It lands even if its view goes away mid-flight, so no item is lost.
private struct AddToCartFlyButtonFlight: View {
    let image: Image
    let destination: CGSize
    let tint: Color
    let onLand: () -> Void

    @State private var progress = 0.0

    private let duration = 0.65

    var body: some View {
        image
            .resizable()
            .scaledToFit()
            .foregroundStyle(tint)
            .padding(14)
            .frame(width: 84, height: 84)
            .background(.background, in: .circle)
            .overlay { Circle().strokeBorder(tint.opacity(0.3)) }
            .modifier(AddToCartFlyButtonArc(progress: progress, destination: destination))
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
            .task {
                withAnimation(.easeIn(duration: duration)) { progress = 1 }
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(duration))
                onLand()
            }
    }
}

/// Moves a view along the arc and shrinks it as it travels.
private struct AddToCartFlyButtonArc: GeometryEffect {
    var progress: Double
    let destination: CGSize

    var animatableData: Double {
        get { progress }
        set { progress = newValue }
    }

    func effectValue(size: CGSize) -> ProjectionTransform {
        let offset = AddToCartFlyButtonLogic.arcOffset(progress: progress, destination: destination, lift: 120)
        let scale = 1 - 0.75 * CGFloat(min(max(progress, 0), 1))
        let transform = CGAffineTransform(translationX: offset.width + size.width / 2, y: offset.height + size.height / 2)
            .scaledBy(x: scale, y: scale)
            .translatedBy(x: -size.width / 2, y: -size.height / 2)
        return ProjectionTransform(transform)
    }
}

enum AddToCartFlyButtonLogic {
    /// A point on a curve from zero to `destination` that first rises by about `lift`.
    static func arcOffset(progress: Double, destination: CGSize, lift: CGFloat) -> CGSize {
        let t = CGFloat(min(max(progress, 0), 1))
        let controlX = destination.width * 0.35
        let controlY = min(destination.height, 0) - lift
        return CGSize(
            width: 2 * (1 - t) * t * controlX + t * t * destination.width,
            height: 2 * (1 - t) * t * controlY + t * t * destination.height
        )
    }
}

/// A cart icon with a count badge that bumps when the count changes.
struct AddToCartFlyButtonCart: View {
    let count: Int
    var tint: Color = .indigo

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Image(systemName: "cart.fill")
            .font(.title2)
            .foregroundStyle(tint)
            .padding(8)
            .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
                if count > 0 {
                    Text(count, format: .number)
                        .font(.caption2.weight(.bold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .numericText(value: Double(count)))
                        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: count)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 5)
                        .frame(minWidth: 18, minHeight: 18)
                        .background(.red, in: .capsule)
                }
            }
            .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: 1.0, trigger: reduceMotion ? 0 : count) { [reduceMotion] view, scale in
                view.scaleEffect(reduceMotion ? 1 : scale)
            } keyframes: { _ in
                SpringKeyframe(1.3, duration: 0.14)
                SpringKeyframe(1, duration: 0.3)
            }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel("Cart")
            .accessibilityValue(count == 1 ? "1 item" : "\(count) items")
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo
```

## Add To Cart Stepper

An add button that morphs into a quantity stepper and collapses back to the button when the quantity returns to zero.

Category: Commerce. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Commerce/AddToCartStepper/AddToCartStepper.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum AddToCartStepperMath {
    /// The highest quantity allowed. Zero is valid, and means nothing can be added.
    static func limit(maximum: Int) -> Int {
        min(max(maximum, 0), 1_000_000)
    }
}

/// An add button that morphs into a quantity stepper, and back again at zero.
///
/// The capsule is one background around content that changes, so it resizes by itself
/// and nothing has to match geometry. VoiceOver can also adjust the count directly.
struct AddToCartStepper: View {
    @Binding var quantity: Int
    var maximum: Int = 99
    var title: LocalizedStringResource = "Add"
    var tint: Color = .indigo

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var buttonSize = 44.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var countWidth = 34.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var limit: Int { AddToCartStepperMath.limit(maximum: maximum) }
    private var current: Int { min(max(quantity, 0), limit) }
    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .bouncy(duration: 0.35) }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            if quantity <= 0 {
                addButton.transition(.opacity)
            } else {
                stepButton(systemImage: quantity == 1 ? "trash" : "minus", label: "Decrease quantity", change: -1)
                    .transition(.opacity)
                countLabel.transition(.opacity)
                stepButton(systemImage: "plus", label: "Increase quantity", change: 1)
                    .disabled(quantity >= limit)
                    .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
        .foregroundStyle(AddToCartStepperContrastingForeground(background: tint))
        .background(tint.gradient, in: .capsule)
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: quantity)
    }

    private var addButton: some View {
        Button {
            set(1)
        } label: {
            Label(title, systemImage: "plus")
                .font(.headline)
                .padding(.horizontal, 22)
                .frame(minHeight: buttonSize)
                .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .disabled(limit == 0)
        .accessibilityLabel("\(title) to cart")
    }

    private func stepButton(systemImage: String, label: String, change: Int) -> some View {
        Button {
            set(current + change)
        } label: {
            Image(systemName: systemImage)
                .font(.headline)
                .frame(width: buttonSize, height: buttonSize)
                .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .symbolEffect(.replace))
                .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }

    private var countLabel: some View {
        Text(quantity, format: .number)
            .font(.headline.monospacedDigit())
            .lineLimit(1)
            .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)
            .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .numericText(value: Double(quantity)))
            .frame(minWidth: countWidth)
            .accessibilityLabel("Quantity")
            .accessibilityValue(quantity.formatted())
            .accessibilityAdjustableAction { direction in
                switch direction {
                case .increment: set(current + 1)
                case .decrement: set(current - 1)
                @unknown default: break
                }
            }
    }

    private func set(_ newValue: Int) {
        withAnimation(animation) { quantity = min(max(newValue, 0), limit) }
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct AddToCartStepperContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct AddToCartStepperDemo: View {
    @State private var quantity = 0

    private var subtotal: String {
        (Double(quantity) * 3.5).formatted(.currency(code: "EUR"))
    }

    var body: some View {
        ViewThatFits(in: .vertical) {
            content
            ScrollView { content }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.orange.opacity(0.16), .indigo.opacity(0.12)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }

    private var content: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 24) {
            Image(systemName: "cup.and.saucer.fill")
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .frame(height: 110)
                .foregroundStyle(.linearGradient(colors: [.orange, .pink], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            VStack(spacing: 4) {
                Text("Flat white")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                Text("Double shot, velvety milk")
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            AddToCartStepper(quantity: $quantity)
                .frame(minHeight: 44)

            Text("Subtotal \(subtotal)")
                .font(.title3.weight(.semibold))
                .opacity(quantity > 0 ? 1 : 0)
        }
        .padding(24)
    }
}

#Preview {
    AddToCartStepperDemo()
}
```

## Billing Period Toggle

A monthly and yearly switch where the price rolls to its new value and a savings badge appears.

Category: Commerce. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Commerce/BillingPeriodToggle/BillingPeriodToggle.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum BillingPeriodToggleOption: String, CaseIterable, Hashable {
    case monthly = "Monthly"
    case yearly = "Yearly"
}

enum BillingPeriodTogglePricing {
    /// The whole percent saved by paying yearly, or nil when there is no saving to show.
    static func savingsPercent(monthly: Double, yearly: Double) -> Int? {
        let fullYear = monthly * 12
        guard fullYear.isFinite, yearly.isFinite, fullYear > 0, yearly >= 0, yearly < fullYear else { return nil }

        let percent = Int(((1 - yearly / fullYear) * 100).rounded())
        return percent > 0 ? percent : nil
    }
}

/// A monthly and yearly switch: the price rolls to its new value and a savings badge appears.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, everything changes at once.
struct BillingPeriodToggle: View {
    @Binding var period: BillingPeriodToggleOption
    var monthlyPrice: Double = 12
    var yearlyPrice: Double = 99
    var currencyCode: String = "USD"
    var tint: Color = .indigo

    @Namespace private var namespace
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize

    private var pricePerMonth: Double {
        period == .monthly ? monthlyPrice : yearlyPrice / 12
    }

    private var savings: Int? {
        BillingPeriodTogglePricing.savingsPercent(monthly: monthlyPrice, yearly: yearlyPrice)
    }

    private var rowLayout: AnyLayout {
        dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize
            ? AnyLayout(VStackLayout(spacing: 6))
            : AnyLayout(HStackLayout(spacing: 6))
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 18) {
            segments
            price
            footnote
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.45, bounce: 0.2), value: period)
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: period)
    }

    private var segments: some View {
        rowLayout {
            ForEach(BillingPeriodToggleOption.allCases, id: \.self) { option in
                let isSelected = option == period

                Button {
                    period = option
                } label: {
                    Text(option.rawValue)
                        .font(.headline)
                        .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? Color.white : Color.primary)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                        .padding(.vertical, 12)
                        .background {
                            if isSelected {
                                Capsule()
                                    .fill(tint.gradient)
                                    .matchedGeometryEffect(id: "selection", in: namespace)
                            }
                        }
                        .contentShape(.capsule)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
            }
        }
        .padding(4)
        .background(.quaternary, in: .capsule)
    }

    private var price: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline, spacing: 4) {
            Text(pricePerMonth, format: .currency(code: currencyCode))
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .monospacedDigit()
                .contentTransition(.numericText(value: pricePerMonth))

            Text("per month")
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
    }

    private var footnote: some View {
        rowLayout {
            Text(period == .monthly ? "Billed every month" : "Billed once a year")
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

            if period == .yearly, let savings {
                Text("Save \(savings)%")
                    .font(.caption.bold())
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .padding(.horizontal, 10)
                    .padding(.vertical, 4)
                    .background(Color.green.gradient, in: .capsule)
                    .transition(.scale(scale: 0.5).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
        }
        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct BillingPeriodToggleDemo: View {
    @State private var period = BillingPeriodToggleOption.monthly

    private let features = ["Unlimited projects", "Sync across devices", "Priority support"]

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 28) {
                VStack(spacing: 8) {
                    Image(systemName: "sparkles")
                        .font(.largeTitle)
                        .foregroundStyle(.indigo)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)

                    Text("Go Pro")
                        .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

                    Text("Everything you need, billed your way.")
                        .font(.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                }

                BillingPeriodToggle(period: $period)
                    .padding(20)
                    .background(.regularMaterial, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28))

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(features, id: \.self) { feature in
                        Label(feature, systemImage: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                            .symbolRenderingMode(.hierarchical)
                            .foregroundStyle(.indigo)
                    }
                }
                .font(.body)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .padding(.horizontal, 8)
            }
            .padding(24)
        }
        .defaultScrollAnchor(.center, for: .alignment)
        .background(
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.18), .pink.opacity(0.12)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()
        )
    }
}
```

## Pricing Tier Cards

Snapping horizontal pricing cards with the recommended plan highlighted and enlarged.

Category: Commerce. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Commerce/PricingTierCards/PricingTierCards.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct PricingTierCardsTier: Identifiable, Hashable {
    let name: String
    var price: String
    var period: String
    var features: [String]
    var isRecommended = false

    var id: String { name }
}

/// Horizontal pricing cards that snap into place, with the recommended plan highlighted and larger.
///
/// It opens centered on the recommended plan. Place it in a vertical `ScrollView`
/// so tall cards stay reachable at the largest text sizes.
struct PricingTierCards: View {
    let tiers: [PricingTierCardsTier]
    @Binding var selection: PricingTierCardsTier.ID?
    var tint: Color = .indigo

    @State private var centeredID: PricingTierCardsTier.ID?
    @State private var containerWidth: CGFloat = 0

    private var cardWidth: CGFloat {
        min(max(containerWidth - 72, 220), 300)
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView(.horizontal) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                ForEach(tiers) { tier in
                    card(for: tier)
                        .frame(width: cardWidth)
                        .scaleEffect(tier.isRecommended ? 1 : 0.92)
                        .zIndex(tier.isRecommended ? 1 : 0)
                }
            }
            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            .scrollTargetLayout()
            .padding(.vertical, 24)
        }
        .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
        .contentMargins(.horizontal, max((containerWidth - cardWidth) / 2, 16), for: .scrollContent)
        .scrollTargetBehavior(.viewAligned)
        .scrollPosition(id: $centeredID)
        .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.width } action: { containerWidth = $0 }
        .task(id: containerWidth) {
            guard containerWidth > 0, centeredID == nil else { return }
            centeredID = (tiers.first(where: \.isRecommended) ?? tiers.first)?.id
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: selection)
    }

    private func card(for tier: PricingTierCardsTier) -> some View {
        let isSelected = selection == tier.id
        let secondary = tier.isRecommended ? Color.white.opacity(0.85) : Color.secondary

        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
            HStack {
                Text(tier.name)
                    .font(.title3.bold())

                Spacer(minLength: 8)

                if tier.isRecommended {
                    Text("Popular")
                        .font(.caption.bold())
                        .padding(.horizontal, 10)
                        .padding(.vertical, 4)
                        .background(.white.opacity(0.22), in: .capsule)
                }
            }

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text(tier.price)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

                Text(tier.period)
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(secondary)
            }

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
                ForEach(Array(tier.features.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { _, feature in
                    Label(feature, systemImage: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                }
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)

            Button {
                selection = tier.id
            } label: {
                Text(isSelected ? "\(tier.name) selected" : "Choose \(tier.name)")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(tier.isRecommended ? tint : Color.white)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .padding(.vertical, 12)
                    .background(tier.isRecommended ? Color.white : tint, in: .capsule)
                    .contentShape(.capsule)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
        }
        .foregroundStyle(tier.isRecommended ? Color.white : Color.primary)
        .padding(20)
        .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(
            tier.isRecommended ? AnyShapeStyle(tint.gradient) : AnyShapeStyle(.regularMaterial),
            in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28)
        )
        .shadow(color: tier.isRecommended ? tint.opacity(0.4) : .clear, radius: 18, y: 10)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PricingTierCardsDemo: View {
    @State private var selection: PricingTierCardsTier.ID?

    private let tiers = [
        PricingTierCardsTier(name: "Free", price: "$0", period: "forever", features: ["3 projects", "Community help"]),
        PricingTierCardsTier(
            name: "Pro",
            price: "$12",
            period: "per month",
            features: ["Unlimited projects", "Sync across devices", "Priority support"],
            isRecommended: true
        ),
        PricingTierCardsTier(name: "Team", price: "$29", period: "per seat", features: ["Everything in Pro", "Shared spaces", "Admin tools"]),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 8) {
                Text("Pick your plan")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

                Text("Swipe to compare")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                PricingTierCards(tiers: tiers, selection: $selection)
            }
            .padding(.vertical, 24)
        }
        .defaultScrollAnchor(.center, for: .alignment)
        .background(
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.2), .cyan.opacity(0.14)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()
        )
    }
}
```

## Trial Timeline Paywall

A paywall that shows what happens on each day of the free trial, with the plans and the button to start it.

Category: Commerce. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Commerce/TrialTimelinePaywall/TrialTimelinePaywall.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated enum TrialTimelinePaywallLogic {
    /// The days of a trial worth showing, counted from today: today, the day of the reminder and
    /// the day the trial ends. A trial too short for a reminder has none, and no trial is just today.
    static func days(trialDays: Int, reminderLead: Int = 2) -> [Int] {
        guard trialDays > 0 else { return [0] }
        let reminder = trialDays - reminderLead
        return reminderLead > 0 && reminder > 0 ? [0, reminder, trialDays] : [0, trialDays]
    }

    static func date(afterDays days: Int, from start: Date, calendar: Calendar = .current) -> Date {
        calendar.date(byAdding: .day, value: days, to: start) ?? start
    }
}

struct TrialTimelinePaywallPlan: Identifiable, Equatable {
    var id: String
    var title: LocalizedStringResource
    /// The price as it should be read, such as StoreKit's `displayPrice` and its period.
    var price: String
    var badge: LocalizedStringResource?
    /// How long its free trial lasts. Zero when it has none.
    var trialDays = 0
}

/// A paywall that shows what happens on each day of the free trial before asking to start it.
///
/// It draws the plans and the timeline and reports the taps: buying and restoring are up to you,
/// with StoreKit or whatever you use. The reminder step is a promise, so schedule that
/// notification, or set `reminderLead` to 0 to leave the step out.
struct TrialTimelinePaywall: View {
    var title: LocalizedStringResource = "How your free trial works"
    let plans: [TrialTimelinePaywallPlan]
    @Binding var selection: TrialTimelinePaywallPlan.ID
    /// How many days before the trial ends the reminder is sent.
    var reminderLead = 2
    var startDate = Date.now
    var isPurchasing = false
    var onContinue: (TrialTimelinePaywallPlan) -> Void
    var onRestore: () -> Void

    private let margin: CGFloat = 24
    private let cornerRadius: CGFloat = 16
    private let lineWidth: CGFloat = 6

    @State private var hasAppeared = false
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var markSize = 34.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var plan: TrialTimelinePaywallPlan? {
        plans.first { $0.id == selection } ?? plans.first
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 28) {
                Text(title)
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)

                if let plan {
                    timeline(for: plan)
                }

                VStack(spacing: 10) {
                    ForEach(plans) { plan in
                        card(for: plan)
                    }
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, margin)
            .padding(.top, 32)
            .padding(.bottom, margin)
            .frame(maxWidth: 520, alignment: .leading)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        }
        .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
        .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) {
            if let plan {
                footer(for: plan)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: selection)
        .onAppear { hasAppeared = true }
    }

    // MARK: Timeline

    private func timeline(for plan: TrialTimelinePaywallPlan) -> some View {
        let days = TrialTimelinePaywallLogic.days(trialDays: plan.trialDays, reminderLead: reminderLead)

        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(Array(days.enumerated()), id: \.element) { index, day in
                step(day: day, plan: plan, isLast: index == days.count - 1)
                    .opacity(hasAppeared ? 1 : 0)
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeOut(duration: 0.4).delay(Double(index) * 0.15), value: hasAppeared)
                    .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
    }

    private func step(day: Int, plan: TrialTimelinePaywallPlan, isLast: Bool) -> some View {
        let isCharge = day == plan.trialDays

        return HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 16) {
            Image(systemName: day == 0 && !isCharge ? "lock.open.fill" : isCharge ? "star.fill" : "bell.fill")
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .frame(width: markSize, height: markSize)
                .background(.tint, in: .circle)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline) {
                    Text(day == 0 ? "Today" : "Day \(day)")
                        .font(.headline)
                    if day > 0 {
                        Text(TrialTimelinePaywallLogic.date(afterDays: day, from: startDate), format: .dateTime.month(.abbreviated).day())
                            .font(.subheadline)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                }
                Text(text(day: day, plan: plan))
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            }
            .padding(.top, 6)
            .padding(.bottom, isLast ? 0 : 22)
        }
        .background(alignment: .topLeading) {
            // The line that joins this step to the next one. After the last step it fades away.
            Capsule()
                .fill(isLast ? AnyShapeStyle(LinearGradient(colors: [.accentColor.opacity(0.3), .clear], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)) : AnyShapeStyle(.tint.opacity(0.3)))
                .frame(width: lineWidth)
                .frame(maxHeight: isLast ? markSize * 2 : .infinity, alignment: .top)
                .padding(.leading, (markSize - lineWidth) / 2)
                .padding(.top, markSize / 2)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
        .padding(.bottom, isLast ? markSize : 0)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
    }

    private func text(day: Int, plan: TrialTimelinePaywallPlan) -> String {
        if day == plan.trialDays {
            return plan.trialDays > 0
                ? "Your subscription starts and you are charged \(plan.price). Cancel any time before."
                : "Your subscription starts and you are charged \(plan.price)."
        }
        return day == 0
            ? "You get full access to everything, free."
            : "We remind you that your trial is about to end."
    }

    // MARK: Plans

    private func card(for plan: TrialTimelinePaywallPlan) -> some View {
        let isSelected = plan.id == self.plan?.id

        return Button {
            selection = plan.id
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Image(systemName: isSelected ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "circle")
                    .font(.title3)
                    .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? AnyShapeStyle(.tint) : AnyShapeStyle(.tertiary))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    HStack {
                        Text(plan.title)
                            .font(.headline)
                        if let badge = plan.badge {
                            Text(badge)
                                .font(.caption.weight(.semibold))
                                .foregroundStyle(.tint)
                                .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                                .padding(.vertical, 3)
                                .background(.tint.opacity(0.15), in: .capsule)
                        }
                    }
                    Text(plan.trialDays > 0 ? "\(plan.trialDays) days free, then \(plan.price)" : plan.price)
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }

                Spacer(minLength: 0)
            }
            .padding(16)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .background(.fill.quaternary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
            .overlay {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius)
                    .strokeBorder(.tint, lineWidth: isSelected ? 2 : 0)
            }
            .contentShape(.rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }

    private func footer(for plan: TrialTimelinePaywallPlan) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 10) {
            Button {
                onContinue(plan)
            } label: {
                Text(plan.trialDays > 0 ? "Start \(plan.trialDays)-Day Free Trial" : "Subscribe")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .opacity(isPurchasing ? 0 : 1)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                    .overlay {
                        if isPurchasing {
                            ProgressView()
                                .controlSize(.regular)
                                .tint(.white)
                        }
                    }
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .controlSize(.large)
            // Not `disabled`, which would take the color away from under the spinner.
            .allowsHitTesting(!isPurchasing)
            .accessibilityValue(isPurchasing ? "In progress" : "")

            Button(action: onRestore) {
                // A line of text is too short to hit. The padding widens what answers to a
                // touch, and the same padding taken back keeps the layout as it was.
                Text("Restore Purchases")
                    .padding(.vertical, 14)
                    .contentShape(.rect)
                    .padding(.vertical, -14)
            }
            .font(.footnote)
            .disabled(isPurchasing)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, margin)
        .padding(.vertical, 12)
        .frame(maxWidth: 520)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .background(.bar)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct TrialTimelinePaywallDemo: View {
    private let plans = [
        TrialTimelinePaywallPlan(id: "yearly", title: "Yearly", price: "$39.99 a year", badge: "Save 44%", trialDays: 7),

        }
```

## Animated Radio Button

A radio button whose inner dot springs in and whose ring pulses once when selected.

Category: Controls. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Controls/AnimatedRadioButton/AnimatedRadioButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A radio button whose dot springs in and whose ring pulses once when selected.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the dot appears at once and there is no pulse.
struct AnimatedRadioButton: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let isSelected: Bool
    var tint: Color = .indigo
    let action: () -> Void

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var size = 26.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                indicator

                Text(title)
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.leading)

                Spacer(minLength: 0)
            }
            // The whole row is the touch target, at the height recommended for one.
            .frame(minHeight: 44)
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }

    private var indicator: some View {
        ZStack {
            Circle()
                .strokeBorder(isSelected ? tint : Color.secondary, lineWidth: 2)

            Circle()
                .fill(tint)
                .padding(size * 0.22)
                .scaleEffect(isSelected ? 1 : 0.01)
                .opacity(isSelected ? 1 : 0)
        }
        .frame(width: size, height: size)
        .background {
            Circle()
                .stroke(tint, lineWidth: 2)
                .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: 0.0, trigger: isSelected) { [reduceMotion] ring, progress in
                    let isPulsing = isSelected && !reduceMotion && progress > 0 && progress < 1

                    ring
                        .scaleEffect(1 + progress * 0.9)
                        .opacity(isPulsing ? 1 - progress : 0)
                } keyframes: { _ in
                    // Each run starts from the last value, so the ring has to jump back.
                    MoveKeyframe(0)
                    CubicKeyframe(1, duration: 0.5)
                }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.35, bounce: 0.55), value: isSelected)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct AnimatedRadioButtonDemo: View {
    private let options: [LocalizedStringResource] = ["Standard delivery", "Express delivery", "Pick up in store"]

    @State private var selection = 0
    @State private var isAutoPlaying = true
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
                Text("How should we send it?")
                    .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

                VStack(spacing: 4) {
                    ForEach(options.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                        AnimatedRadioButton(title: options[index], isSelected: selection == index) {
                            isAutoPlaying = false
                            selection = index
                        }
                    }
                }
                .padding(24)
                .background(.regularMaterial, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28))
            }
            .padding(24)
        }
        .defaultScrollAnchor(.center, for: .alignment)
        .background(
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.2), .mint.opacity(0.14)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()
        )
        .task(id: reduceMotion) {
            guard !reduceMotion else { return }

            while isAutoPlaying {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.1))
                guard !Task.isCancelled, isAutoPlaying else { return }
                selection = (selection + 1) % options.count
            }
        }
    }
}

    AnimatedRadioButtonDemo()
}
```
