## Photo Filter Presets

A row of preset thumbnails that apply mono, warm, cool and high contrast looks to a photo using SwiftUI modifiers.

Category: Images. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Images/PhotoFilterPresets/PhotoFilterPresets.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct PhotoFilterPreset: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable {
    let name: String
    var saturation = 1.0
    var contrast = 1.0
    var brightness = 0.0
    var hue = 0.0
    var tint = Color.white

    var id: String { name }

    static let original = PhotoFilterPreset(name: "Original")
    static let all = [
        original,
        PhotoFilterPreset(name: "Mono", saturation: 0, contrast: 1.15),
        PhotoFilterPreset(name: "Warm", saturation: 1.15, tint: Color(red: 1, green: 0.86, blue: 0.68)),
        PhotoFilterPreset(name: "Cool", saturation: 0.95, tint: Color(red: 0.7, green: 0.86, blue: 1)),
        PhotoFilterPreset(name: "Punch", saturation: 1.6, contrast: 1.3),
        PhotoFilterPreset(name: "Fade", saturation: 0.65, contrast: 0.8, brightness: 0.08),
    ]
}

extension View {
    func filtered(by preset: PhotoFilterPreset) -> some View {
        colorMultiply(preset.tint)
            .saturation(preset.saturation)
            .contrast(preset.contrast)
            .brightness(preset.brightness)
            .hueRotation(.degrees(preset.hue))
    }
}

/// A photo with a row of preset thumbnails that apply a look using SwiftUI modifiers.
///
/// The row scrolls sideways and its tiles grow with Dynamic Type. With Reduce Motion on, a new
/// look appears without a crossfade.
struct PhotoFilterPresets: View {
    let image: Image
    @Binding var selection: PhotoFilterPreset
    var presets = PhotoFilterPreset.all

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .caption) private var tileSize = 72.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            image
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .filtered(by: selection)
                .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 24))
                .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .accessibilityLabel("Photo with the \(selection.name) look")

            ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                HStack(spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(presets) { preset in
                        tile(preset)
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
            }
            .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
            .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: selection)
    }

    private func tile(_ preset: PhotoFilterPreset) -> some View {
        let isSelected = preset == selection

        return Button {
            selection = preset
        } label: {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Color.clear
                    .frame(width: tileSize, height: tileSize)
                    .overlay {
                        image
                            .resizable()
                            .scaledToFill()
                            .filtered(by: preset)
                    }
                    .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 14))
                    .overlay {
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14)
                            .stroke(isSelected ? Color.accentColor : .clear, lineWidth: 3)
                    }

                Text(preset.name)
                    .font(.caption.weight(isSelected ? .semibold : .regular))
                    .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? Color.primary : Color.secondary)
                    .lineLimit(1)
            }
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(preset.name)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PhotoFilterPresetsDemo: View {
    @State private var selection = PhotoFilterPreset.original

    private let photo = demoPhoto()

    var body: some View {
        PhotoFilterPresets(image: photo, selection: $selection)
            .padding(.vertical, 16)
    }
}

private func demoPhoto() -> Image {
    let size = CGSize(width: 900, height: 1125)
    return Image(size: size, label: Text("Flower field")) { context in
        context.fill(
            Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)),
            with: .linearGradient(Gradient(colors: [.cyan, .white]), startPoint: .zero, endPoint: CGPoint(x: 0, y: 620))
        )
        context.fill(Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(x: 610, y: 110, width: 170, height: 170)), with: .color(.yellow))
        context.fill(
            Path(CGRect(x: 0, y: 620, width: 900, height: 505)),
            with: .linearGradient(Gradient(colors: [.green, Color(red: 0, green: 0.35, blue: 0.2)]), startPoint: CGPoint(x: 0, y: 620), endPoint: CGPoint(x: 0, y: 1125))
        )

        let colors: [Color] = [.pink, .red, .orange, .purple]
        for index in 0..<36 {
            let x = CGFloat(index * 257 % 860) + 10
            let y = 660 + CGFloat(index * 131 % 430)
            let side = 30 + CGFloat(index % 4) * 14
            context.fill(Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(x: x, y: y, width: side, height: side)), with: .color(colors[index % colors.count]))
        }
    }
}

    PhotoFilterPresetsDemo()
}
```

## Photo Lightbox

A full-screen photo pager where each page zooms independently and the viewer closes on a swipe down.

Category: Images. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Images/PhotoLightbox/PhotoLightbox.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum PhotoLightboxMath {
    /// `photo` is the photo's size at fit. A side that still fits the container cannot pan.
    static func clampedOffset(_ offset: CGSize, zoom: CGFloat, photo: CGSize, in size: CGSize) -> CGSize {
        let limit = CGSize(width: max((photo.width * zoom - size.width) / 2, 0), height: max((photo.height * zoom - size.height) / 2, 0))
        return CGSize(
            width: min(max(offset.width, -limit.width), limit.width),
            height: min(max(offset.height, -limit.height), limit.height)
        )
    }

    static func clampedZoom(_ zoom: CGFloat, maxZoom: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        min(max(zoom, 1), max(maxZoom, 1))
    }

    /// The nearest valid page, or 0 for an empty pager.
    static func clampedPage(_ page: Int, count: Int) -> Int {
        min(max(page, 0), max(count - 1, 0))
    }
}

/// A full-screen photo pager. Each page zooms on its own, and a swipe down closes the viewer.
///
/// Present it above your content, for example in a `ZStack`. Pinch or double tap to zoom. Paging
/// and the swipe down stop while the current photo is zoomed, so a drag pans it instead.
/// Changing `photos` returns every page to fit.
struct PhotoLightbox: View {
    let photos: [Image]
    @Binding var selection: Int
    var maxZoom: CGFloat = 4
    var onClose: () -> Void

    @State private var zooms: [Int: CGFloat] = [:]
    @GestureState private var pullDown: CGFloat = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var isCurrentZoomed: Bool { (zooms[selection] ?? 1) > 1 }
    private var pullProgress: CGFloat { min(pullDown / 320, 1) }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .top) {
            Color.black
                .opacity(1 - pullProgress * 0.7)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            TabView(selection: $selection) {
                ForEach(photos.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                    PhotoLightboxPage(
                        photo: photos[index],
                        zoom: Binding(get: { zooms[index] ?? 1 }, set: { zooms[index] = $0 }),
                        maxZoom: maxZoom
                    )
                    .tag(index)
                }
            }
            .tabViewStyle(.page(indexDisplayMode: .never))
            .ignoresSafeArea()
            .scaleEffect(1 - pullProgress * 0.2)
            .offset(y: pullDown)
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: pullDown == 0)
            .simultaneousGesture(closeGesture, including: isCurrentZoomed ? .subviews : .all)

            header
                .opacity(pullDown == 0 ? 1 : 0)
        }
        .preferredColorScheme(.dark)
        .accessibilityAction(.escape) { onClose() }
        .onChange(of: photos.count, initial: true) { _, count in
            let page = PhotoLightboxMath.clampedPage(selection, count: count)
            if page != selection { selection = page }
        }
        // Zoom is kept by position, so a photo that moves into another's place must not inherit its zoom.
        .onChange(of: photos) { zooms.removeAll() }
    }

    private var header: some View {
        HStack {
            if !photos.isEmpty {
                Text("\(PhotoLightboxMath.clampedPage(selection, count: photos.count) + 1) of \(photos.count)")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .monospacedDigit()
            }
            Spacer()
            Button(action: onClose) {
                Image(systemName: "xmark")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .frame(width: 44, height: 44)
                    .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: .circle)
            }
            .accessibilityLabel("Close")
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
    }

    private var closeGesture: some Gesture {
        DragGesture(minimumDistance: 14)
            .updating($pullDown) { value, state, _ in
                if state != 0 || abs(value.translation.height) > abs(value.translation.width) {
                    state = max(value.translation.height, 0)
                }
            }
            .onEnded { value in
                guard abs(value.translation.height) > abs(value.translation.width),
                      value.predictedEndTranslation.height > 200 else { return }
                onClose()
            }
    }
}

private struct PhotoLightboxPage: View {
    let photo: Image
    @Binding var zoom: CGFloat
    let maxZoom: CGFloat

    @State private var offset = CGSize.zero
    @State private var fittedSize = CGSize.zero
    @GestureState private var pinch: CGFloat = 1
    @GestureState private var pan = CGSize.zero
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geometry in
            let size = geometry.size
            let liveZoom = PhotoLightboxMath.clampedZoom(zoom * pinch, maxZoom: maxZoom)
            let moved = CGSize(width: offset.width + pan.width, height: offset.height + pan.height)

            photo
                .resizable()
                .scaledToFit()
                .onGeometryChange(for: CGSize.self) { $0.size } action: { fittedSize = $0 }
                .frame(width: size.width, height: size.height)
                .scaleEffect(liveZoom)
                .offset(PhotoLightboxMath.clampedOffset(moved, zoom: liveZoom, photo: fittedSize, in: size))
                .frame(width: size.width, height: size.height)
                .contentShape(.rect)
                .gesture(TapGesture(count: 2).onEnded { toggleZoom() })
                .simultaneousGesture(pinchGesture(in: size))
                .gesture(panGesture(in: size), including: zoom > 1 ? .all : .subviews)
                .accessibilityAction(named: zoom > 1 ? "Zoom out" : "Zoom in") { toggleZoom() }
        }
        // A photo back at fit starts its next zoom from the center, also when the viewer resets the zoom.
        .onChange(of: zoom) { _, zoom in
            if zoom <= 1 { offset = .zero }
        }
        // A photo is not mirrored in right-to-left layouts, so neither is the geometry that moves it.
        .environment(\.layoutDirection, .leftToRight)
    }

    private func pinchGesture(in size: CGSize) -> some Gesture {
        MagnifyGesture()
            .updating($pinch) { value, state, _ in
                state = value.magnification
            }
            .onEnded { value in
                zoom = PhotoLightboxMath.clampedZoom(zoom * value.magnification, maxZoom: maxZoom)
                offset = PhotoLightboxMath.clampedOffset(offset, zoom: zoom, photo: fittedSize, in: size)
            }
    }

    private func panGesture(in size: CGSize) -> some Gesture {
        DragGesture()
            .updating($pan) { value, state, _ in
                state = value.translation
            }
            .onEnded { value in
                let moved = CGSize(width: offset.width + value.translation.width, height: offset.height + value.translation.height)
                offset = PhotoLightboxMath.clampedOffset(moved, zoom: zoom, photo: fittedSize, in: size)
            }
    }

    private func toggleZoom() {
        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.4, bounce: 0.15)) {
            zoom = zoom > 1 ? 1 : PhotoLightboxMath.clampedZoom(2.5, maxZoom: maxZoom)
            offset = .zero
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PhotoLightboxDemo: View {
    @State private var selection = 0
    @State private var isOpen = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let photos = [
        demoPhoto([.indigo, .pink, .orange], hill: .purple, label: "Sunset"),
        demoPhoto([.cyan, .teal, .white], hill: .green, label: "Spring valley"),
        demoPhoto([.black, .indigo, .blue], hill: .black, label: "Night sky"),
        demoPhoto([.orange, .yellow, .white], hill: .brown, label: "Desert"),
    ]

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.25)
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            ScrollView {
                LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 12), GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 12)], spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(photos.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                        thumbnail(index)
                    }
                }
                .padding(16)
            }

            if isOpen {
                PhotoLightbox(photos: photos, selection: $selection) {
                    withAnimation(animation) { isOpen = false }
                }
                .transition(.opacity)
            }
        }
    }

    private func thumbnail(_ index: Int) -> some View {
        Button {
            selection = index
            withAnimation(animation) { isOpen = true }
        } label: {
            Color.clear
                .aspectRatio(3 / 4, contentMode: .fit)
                .overlay {
                    photos[index]
                        .resizable()
                        .scaledToFill()
                }
                .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 18))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel("Open photo \(index + 1)")
    }
}

private func demoPhoto(_ sky: [Color], hill: Color, label: String) -> Image {
    let size = CGSize(width: 900, height: 1200)
    return Image(size: size, label: Text(label)) { context in
        context.fill(
            Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)),
            with: .linearGradient(Gradient(colors: sky), startPoint: .zero, endPoint: CGPoint(x: 0, y: size.height))
        )
        context.fill(Path(ellipseIn: CGRect(x: 540, y: 220, width: 200, height: 200)), with: .color(.white.opacity(0.85)))

        var ridge = Path()
        ridge.move(to: CGPoint(x: 0, y: size.height))
        ridge.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: 0, y: 760))
        ridge.addCurve(to: CGPoint(x: size.width, y: 660), control1: CGPoint(x: 300, y: 480), control2: CGPoint(x: 600, y: 1020))
        ridge.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: size.width, y: size.height))
        ridge.closeSubpath()
        context.fill(ridge, with: .color(hill))
    }
}

}
```

## Photo Multi Select Grid

A photo grid where a long press enters a multi-select mode that shows checkmarks on the chosen photos.

Category: Images. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Images/PhotoMultiSelectGrid/PhotoMultiSelectGrid.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct PhotoMultiSelectGridPhoto: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let image: Image
    let label: LocalizedStringResource
}

/// A photo grid where a long press enters a multi-select mode with checkmarks.
///
/// In that mode a tap toggles a photo. Out of it, a tap calls `onOpen`. Photos that disappear
/// also leave the selection. With Reduce Motion on, photos change state without animating.
struct PhotoMultiSelectGrid: View {
    let photos: [PhotoMultiSelectGridPhoto]
    @Binding var selection: Set<String>
    @Binding var isSelecting: Bool
    var onOpen: (PhotoMultiSelectGridPhoto) -> Void = { _ in }

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.25)
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: 110), spacing: 4)], spacing: 4) {
                ForEach(photos) { photo in
                    cell(photo)
                }
            }
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: selection)
        .onChange(of: photos.map(\.id)) { _, ids in
            selection.formIntersection(ids)
        }
    }

    private func cell(_ photo: PhotoMultiSelectGridPhoto) -> some View {
        let isChosen = selection.contains(photo.id)

        return Color.clear
            .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
            .overlay {
                photo.image
                    .resizable()
                    .scaledToFill()
            }
            .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: isChosen ? 14 : 0))
            .scaleEffect(isChosen ? 0.86 : 1)
            .overlay(alignment: .bottomTrailing) {
                if isSelecting {
                    checkmark(isChosen: isChosen)
                }
            }
            .contentShape(.rect)
            .onTapGesture { handleTap(photo) }
            .onLongPressGesture(minimumDuration: 0.35) { enterSelection(with: photo) }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel(photo.label)
            .accessibilityValue(isSelecting ? (isChosen ? "Selected" : "Not selected") : "")
            .accessibilityAddTraits(isChosen ? [.isButton, .isImage, .isSelected] : [.isButton, .isImage])
            .accessibilityAction { handleTap(photo) }
            .accessibilityActions {
                if !isSelecting {
                    Button("Select") { enterSelection(with: photo) }
                }
            }
    }

    private func checkmark(isChosen: Bool) -> some View {
        Image(systemName: isChosen ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "circle")
            .font(.title2)
            .symbolRenderingMode(.palette)
            .foregroundStyle(.white, isChosen ? Color.accentColor : Color.black.opacity(0.25))
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.3), radius: 3)
            .padding(8)
            .transition(.opacity)
    }

    private func handleTap(_ photo: PhotoMultiSelectGridPhoto) {
        guard isSelecting else {
            onOpen(photo)
            return
        }
        withAnimation(animation) {
            if selection.remove(photo.id) == nil {
                selection.insert(photo.id)
            }
        }
    }

    private func enterSelection(with photo: PhotoMultiSelectGridPhoto) {
        guard !isSelecting else { return }
        withAnimation(animation) {
            isSelecting = true
            selection.insert(photo.id)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PhotoMultiSelectGridDemo: View {
    @State private var selection: Set<String> = []
    @State private var isSelecting = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let photos = (1...15).map { number in
        PhotoMultiSelectGridPhoto(id: "\(number)", image: demoPhoto(number), label: "Photo \(number)")
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            HStack {
                Text(isSelecting ? "\(selection.count) selected" : "Long press a photo")
                    .font(.title3.bold())
                    .monospacedDigit()
                Spacer()
                if isSelecting {
                    Button("Done") {
                        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.25)) {
                            isSelecting = false
                            selection = []
                        }
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.bordered)
                }
            }
            .frame(minHeight: 44)
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)

            PhotoMultiSelectGrid(photos: photos, selection: $selection, isSelecting: $isSelecting)
        }
    }
}

private func demoPhoto(_ number: Int) -> Image {
    let palettes: [[Color]] = [
        [.indigo, .pink], [.teal, .green], [.orange, .yellow], [.purple, .blue], [.red, .orange],
    ]
    let symbols = ["mountain.2.fill", "leaf.fill", "sun.max.fill", "moon.stars.fill", "flame.fill"]
    let colors = palettes[number % palettes.count]
    let symbol = symbols[number % symbols.count]
    let size = CGSize(width: 300, height: 300)

    return Image(size: size, label: Text("Photo \(number)")) { context in
        context.fill(
            Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)),
            with: .linearGradient(Gradient(colors: colors), startPoint: .zero, endPoint: CGPoint(x: 300, y: 300))
        )
        var icon = context.resolve(Image(systemName: symbol))
        icon.shading = .color(.white.opacity(0.85))
        context.draw(icon, in: CGRect(x: 90, y: 90, width: 120, height: 120))
    }
}

}
```

## Scattered Photo Board

Photos scattered at slight angles on a board that can be dragged around and brought to the front on touch.

Category: Images. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Images/ScatteredPhotoBoard/ScatteredPhotoBoard.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct ScatteredPhotoBoardPhoto: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let image: Image
    let caption: String
}

enum ScatteredPhotoBoardLayout {
    /// A repeatable pseudo-random number from -0.5 to 0.5.
    private static func noise(_ index: Int, salt: Double) -> Double {
        let value = sin(Double(index % 10_000) * 12.9898 + salt) * 43_758.5453
        return value - value.rounded(.down) - 0.5
    }

    static func angle(index: Int) -> Double {
        noise(index, salt: 7) * 18
    }

    /// Keeps a card's center inside the board, or in its middle if the card does not fit.
    static func clamped(_ point: CGPoint, card: CGSize, board: CGSize) -> CGPoint {
        func clamp(_ value: CGFloat, side: CGFloat, length: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
            guard length > side else { return length / 2 }
            return min(max(value, side / 2), length - side / 2)
        }
        return CGPoint(x: clamp(point.x, side: card.width, length: board.width), y: clamp(point.y, side: card.height, length: board.height))
    }

    /// The offset from `home` to keep after a drag: where the card stopped, not how far the finger went.
    static func settledOffset(home: CGPoint, saved: CGSize, translation: CGSize, card: CGSize, board: CGSize) -> CGSize {
        let end = clamped(
            CGPoint(x: home.x + saved.width + translation.width, y: home.y + saved.height + translation.height),
            card: card,
            board: board
        )
        return CGSize(width: end.x - home.x, height: end.y - home.y)
    }

    /// A slightly jittered grid position, so the same photos always land in the same place.
    static func center(index: Int, count: Int, card: CGSize, board: CGSize) -> CGPoint {
        guard count > 0 else { return CGPoint(x: board.width / 2, y: board.height / 2) }
        let columns = max(Int(Double(min(count, 10_000)).squareRoot().rounded(.up)), 1)
        let rows = count / columns + (count.isMultiple(of: columns) ? 0 : 1)
        let cell = CGSize(width: board.width / CGFloat(columns), height: board.height / CGFloat(rows))

        let point = CGPoint(
            x: (CGFloat(index % columns) + 0.5 + noise(index, salt: 1) * 0.35) * cell.width,
            y: (CGFloat(index / columns) + 0.5 + noise(index, salt: 3) * 0.35) * cell.height
        )
        return clamped(point, card: card, board: board)
    }
}

/// Photos scattered at slight angles on a board. Touching one brings it to the front, and it can
/// be dragged anywhere on the board.
///
/// VoiceOver reads each caption and offers an action to bring the photo to the front. With
/// Reduce Motion on, a card does not lift while dragged.
struct ScatteredPhotoBoard: View {
    private struct ActiveDrag {
        let id: String
        let translation: CGSize
    }

    let photos: [ScatteredPhotoBoardPhoto]
    var cardWidth: CGFloat = 150

    @State private var offsets: [String: CGSize] = [:]
    @State private var stacking: [String] = []
    @GestureState private var drag: ActiveDrag?
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.layoutDirection) private var layoutDirection

    private let space = "ScatteredPhotoBoard"

    private var cardSize: CGSize {
        let width = max(cardWidth, 1)
        return CGSize(width: width, height: width * 1.2)
    }

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geometry in
            ZStack {
                ForEach(Array(photos.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, photo in
                    card(photo, index: index, board: geometry.size)
                        .position(position(of: photo, index: index, board: geometry.size))
                        .zIndex(depth(of: photo, index: index))
                }
            }
            .frame(width: geometry.size.width, height: geometry.size.height)
            .coordinateSpace(.named(space))
        }
    }

    private func card(_ photo: ScatteredPhotoBoardPhoto, index: Int, board: CGSize) -> some View {
        let isDragged = drag?.id == photo.id
        let lifted = isDragged && !reduceMotion

        return VStack(spacing: 6) {
            Color.clear
                .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
                .overlay {
                    photo.image
                        .resizable()
                        .scaledToFill()
                }
                .clipped()
            Text(photo.caption)
                .font(.caption.weight(.medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.black.opacity(0.75))
                .lineLimit(1)
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
        }
        .padding(8)
        .frame(width: cardSize.width)
        .background(.white, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 4))
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(lifted ? 0.4 : 0.25), radius: lifted ? 16 : 6, y: lifted ? 10 : 3)
        .contentShape(.rect)
        .gesture(dragGesture(for: photo, index: index, board: board))
        .scaleEffect(lifted ? 1.06 : 1)
        .rotationEffect(.degrees(lifted ? 0 : ScatteredPhotoBoardLayout.angle(index: index)))
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.25), value: isDragged)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(photo.caption)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isImage)
        .accessibilityAction(named: "Bring to front") { bringToFront(photo) }
    }

    private func dragGesture(for photo: ScatteredPhotoBoardPhoto, index: Int, board: CGSize) -> some Gesture {
        DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0, coordinateSpace: .named(space))
            .updating($drag) { value, state, _ in
                state = ActiveDrag(id: photo.id, translation: layoutTranslation(value.translation))
            }
            .onChanged { _ in bringToFront(photo) }
            .onEnded { value in
                offsets[photo.id] = ScatteredPhotoBoardLayout.settledOffset(
                    home: ScatteredPhotoBoardLayout.center(index: index, count: photos.count, card: cardSize, board: board),
                    saved: offsets[photo.id] ?? .zero,
                    translation: layoutTranslation(value.translation),
                    card: cardSize,
                    board: board
                )
            }
    }

    /// Gestures report screen points, but layout mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
    private func layoutTranslation(_ translation: CGSize) -> CGSize {
        layoutDirection == .rightToLeft ? CGSize(width: -translation.width, height: translation.height) : translation
    }

    private func position(of photo: ScatteredPhotoBoardPhoto, index: Int, board: CGSize) -> CGPoint {
        let home = ScatteredPhotoBoardLayout.center(index: index, count: photos.count, card: cardSize, board: board)
        let saved = offsets[photo.id] ?? .zero
        let live = drag?.id == photo.id ? drag?.translation ?? .zero : .zero
        return ScatteredPhotoBoardLayout.clamped(
            CGPoint(x: home.x + saved.width + live.width, y: home.y + saved.height + live.height),
            card: cardSize,
            board: board
        )
    }

    private func depth(of photo: ScatteredPhotoBoardPhoto, index: Int) -> Double {
        guard let rank = stacking.firstIndex(of: photo.id) else { return Double(index) }
        return Double(photos.count + rank)
    }

    private func bringToFront(_ photo: ScatteredPhotoBoardPhoto) {
        guard stacking.last != photo.id else { return }
        stacking.removeAll { $0 == photo.id }
        stacking.append(photo.id)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ScatteredPhotoBoardDemo: View {
    private let photos = [
        demoPhoto("Lisbon", [.orange, .pink], "sun.max.fill"),
        demoPhoto("Oslo", [.cyan, .blue], "snowflake"),
        demoPhoto("Kyoto", [.pink, .purple], "leaf.fill"),
        demoPhoto("Quito", [.green, .teal], "mountain.2.fill"),
        demoPhoto("Cairo", [.yellow, .orange], "sparkles"),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ScatteredPhotoBoard(photos: photos)
            .background {
                LinearGradient(
                    colors: [Color(red: 0.72, green: 0.55, blue: 0.38), Color(red: 0.55, green: 0.39, blue: 0.25)],
                    startPoint: .top,
                    endPoint: .bottom
                )
                .ignoresSafeArea()
            }
    }
}

private func demoPhoto(_ caption: String, _ colors: [Color], _ symbol: String) -> ScatteredPhotoBoardPhoto {
    let size = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)
    let image = Image(size: size, label: Text(caption)) { context in
        context.fill(
            Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)),
            with: .linearGradient(Gradient(colors: colors), startPoint: .zero, endPoint: CGPoint(x: 400, y: 400))
        )
        var icon = context.resolve(Image(systemName: symbol))
        icon.shading = .color(.white.opacity(0.9))
        context.draw(icon, in: CGRect(x: 120, y: 120, width: 160, height: 160))
    }
    return ScatteredPhotoBoardPhoto(id: caption, image: image, caption: caption)
}

#Preview {
    ScatteredPhotoBoardDemo()
}
```

## Color Swatch Picker

A grid of selectable color swatches where the chosen one grows a ring.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/ColorSwatchPicker/ColorSwatchPicker.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct ColorSwatchPickerOption: Hashable, Identifiable {
    let name: String
    let color: Color

    var id: String { name }
}

/// A grid of color swatches where the selected one grows a ring.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the ring fades in without growing.
struct ColorSwatchPicker: View {
    let options: [ColorSwatchPickerOption]
    @Binding var selection: ColorSwatchPickerOption

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var swatchSize = 48.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: swatchSize), spacing: 12)], spacing: 12) {
            ForEach(options) { option in
                swatch(option)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? .easeOut(duration: 0.15) : .spring(duration: 0.35, bounce: 0.5), value: selection)
    }

    private func swatch(_ option: ColorSwatchPickerOption) -> some View {
        let isSelected = option == selection

        return Button {
            selection = option
        } label: {
            ZStack {
                Circle()
                    .strokeBorder(option.color, lineWidth: 3)
                    .scaleEffect(isSelected || reduceMotion ? 1 : 0.5)
                    .opacity(isSelected ? 1 : 0)

                Circle()
                    .fill(option.color.gradient)
                    .padding(isSelected ? 8 : 4)
            }
            .frame(width: swatchSize, height: swatchSize)
            .contentShape(.circle)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(option.name)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ColorSwatchPickerDemo: View {
    private static let options = [
        ColorSwatchPickerOption(name: "Coral", color: .red),
        ColorSwatchPickerOption(name: "Amber", color: .orange),
```

## Masked Text Field

A text field that formats input as the user types, such as 12/34 or a phone number, using a mask.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/MaskedTextField/MaskedTextField.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Applies a mask where `#` takes a digit, `A` takes a letter and anything else is written as is.
nonisolated enum MaskedTextFieldFormatter {
    private static func accepts(_ character: Character, slot: Character) -> Bool? {
        switch slot {
        case "#": character.isWholeNumber
        case "A": character.isLetter
        default: nil
        }
    }

    private static func isLiteral(_ slot: Character) -> Bool {
        slot != "#" && slot != "A"
    }

    /// The part of a run of literals that has to be there to read it back: `+34` for `+34 `, so a
    /// pasted number without the separator is recognized. A run like `1 (` has to be there whole,
    /// because without its separators it is just a `1` the user could be typing.
    private static func readBackPrefix(of literals: Substring) -> Substring {
        let isData: (Character) -> Bool = { $0.isWholeNumber || $0.isLetter }
        guard let end = literals.lastIndex(where: isData), !literals[...end].allSatisfy(isData) else { return literals }
        return literals[...end]
    }

    /// Literals are added only when a character follows them, so backspace can always delete.
    /// A run of literals is read back only when its prefix is there complete, so a typed `3` is
    /// not taken for the `3` of a `+34 ` prefix.
    static func format(_ input: String, mask: String) -> String {
        guard !mask.isEmpty else { return input }

        var result = ""
        var pendingLiterals = ""
        var remaining = Substring(input)

        var slots = Substring(mask)

        while let slot = slots.first {
            guard !remaining.isEmpty else { return result }

            if isLiteral(slot) {
                let literals = slots.prefix(while: isLiteral)
                slots.removeFirst(literals.count)
                pendingLiterals += literals
                let prefix = readBackPrefix(of: literals)
                if remaining.hasPrefix(prefix) { remaining.removeFirst(prefix.count) }
                continue
            }

            slots.removeFirst()
            while let next = remaining.first, accepts(next, slot: slot) == false {
                remaining.removeFirst()
            }
            guard let character = remaining.first else { return result }

            result += pendingLiterals
            pendingLiterals = ""
            result.append(character)
            remaining.removeFirst()
        }
        return result
    }

    static func isComplete(_ text: String, mask: String) -> Bool {
        !mask.isEmpty && format(text, mask: mask).count == mask.count
    }
}

/// A text field that formats its input as the user types, such as `12/34` or a phone number.
///
/// Editing in the middle of the text moves the cursor to the end, because the field rewrites its
/// text. With Reduce Motion on, the completion checkmark appears without animating.
struct MaskedTextField: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    @Binding var text: String
    let mask: String
    var prompt: LocalizedStringResource? = nil
    var systemImage: String? = nil
    var keyboard: UIKeyboardType = .numberPad

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var isComplete: Bool { MaskedTextFieldFormatter.isComplete(text, mask: mask) }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                if let systemImage {
                    Image(systemName: systemImage)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                }

                TextField(text: $text, prompt: prompt.map { Text($0) } ?? Text(verbatim: mask)) { Text(title) }
                    .keyboardType(keyboard)
                    .textInputAutocapitalization(.never)
                    .autocorrectionDisabled()
                    .monospacedDigit()
                    .accessibilityLabel(title)
                    .accessibilityHint(isComplete ? "Complete" : "")

                if isComplete {
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
                        .foregroundStyle(.green)
                        .transition(.opacity)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                }
            }
            .padding(14)
            .background(Color(uiColor: .secondarySystemGroupedBackground), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 14))
            .overlay {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14)
                    .stroke(isComplete ? Color.green : .clear, lineWidth: 1.5)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.25), value: isComplete)
        .onChange(of: text, initial: true) { _, newValue in
            let formatted = MaskedTextFieldFormatter.format(newValue, mask: mask)
            if formatted != newValue { text = formatted }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct MaskedTextFieldDemo: View {
    @State private var card = ""
    @State private var expiry = ""
    @State private var phone = ""

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
                Text("Payment details")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())

                MaskedTextField(title: "Card number", text: $card, mask: "#### #### #### ####", systemImage: "creditcard.fill")
                MaskedTextField(title: "Expiry date", text: $expiry, mask: "##/##", prompt: "MM/YY", systemImage: "calendar")
                MaskedTextField(title: "Phone", text: $phone, mask: "(###) ###-####", systemImage: "phone.fill")
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
        .background(Color(uiColor: .systemGroupedBackground))
    }
}
```

## Multi Step Form

A multi-step form with a progress bar that moves forward only when the current step is valid.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/MultiStepForm/MultiStepForm.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// One page of a `MultiStepForm`. `isValid` decides whether the person can continue.
struct MultiStepFormStep: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let isValid: Bool
    let content: AnyView

    init<Content: View>(id: String, title: LocalizedStringResource, isValid: Bool = true, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content) {
        self.id = id
        self.title = title
        self.isValid = isValid
        self.content = AnyView(content())
    }
}

/// Where the person is in the form, kept apart from the view so it is easy to test.
struct MultiStepFormProgress: Equatable {
    private(set) var index = 0
    private(set) var isFinished = false

    /// Returns `true` only for the call that completes the last step.
    mutating func advance(stepCount: Int, isCurrentStepValid: Bool) -> Bool {
        guard stepCount > 0, isCurrentStepValid, !isFinished else { return false }
        guard index < stepCount - 1 else {
            isFinished = true
            return true
        }
        index += 1
        return false
    }

    mutating func goBack() {
        isFinished = false
        index = max(0, index - 1)
    }

    /// Keeps the position valid when the steps change while the form is on screen.
    mutating func clamp(stepCount: Int) {
        index = min(index, max(0, stepCount - 1))
    }
}

/// A form split into steps, with a progress bar on top. "Continue" stays disabled
/// until the current step is valid, and there is no swipe that could skip it.
struct MultiStepForm: View {
    let steps: [MultiStepFormStep]
    var finishTitle = "Finish"
    var onFinish: () -> Void = {}

    @State private var progress = MultiStepFormProgress()
    @State private var isMovingForward = true
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.35) }

    private var transition: AnyTransition {
        guard !reduceMotion else { return .opacity }
        return .asymmetric(
            insertion: .move(edge: isMovingForward ? .trailing : .leading).combined(with: .opacity),
            removal: .move(edge: isMovingForward ? .leading : .trailing).combined(with: .opacity)
        )
    }

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if steps.indices.contains(progress.index) {
                form(step: steps[progress.index])
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: steps.count) { _, count in progress.clamp(stepCount: count) }
    }

    private func form(step: MultiStepFormStep) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
            progressBar

            ScrollView {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
                    header(step: step)
                    step.content
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                .padding(.vertical, 2)
            }
            .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
            .id(step.id)
            .transition(transition)
            .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)

            ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
                HStack(spacing: 12) { buttons(step: step) }
                VStack(spacing: 12) { buttons(step: step) }
            }
            .controlSize(.large)
        }
    }

    private var progressBar: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 6) {
            ForEach(steps.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                Capsule()
                    .fill(index <= progress.index ? AnyShapeStyle(.tint) : AnyShapeStyle(.quaternary))
                    .frame(height: 6)
            }
        }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    private func header(step: MultiStepFormStep) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text("Step \(progress.index + 1) of \(steps.count)")
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

            Text(step.title)
                .font(.title.bold())
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func buttons(step: MultiStepFormStep) -> some View {
        if progress.index > 0 {
            Button("Back") {
                isMovingForward = false
                withAnimation(animation) { progress.goBack() }
            }
            .buttonStyle(.bordered)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        }

        Button(progress.index == steps.count - 1 ? finishTitle : "Continue") {
            isMovingForward = true
            var next = progress
            let didFinish = next.advance(stepCount: steps.count, isCurrentStepValid: step.isValid)
            withAnimation(animation) { progress = next }
            if didFinish { onFinish() }
        }
        .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .disabled(!step.isValid || progress.isFinished)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct MultiStepFormDemo: View {
    private static let plans = ["Free plan", "Pro plan", "Team plan"]
    private static let days = ["Monday", "Wednesday", "Friday"]

    @State private var plan: String?
    @State private var reminderDays: Set<String> = []
    @State private var acceptsTerms = false
    @State private var isDone = false
    @State private var run = 0

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            if isDone {
                ContentUnavailableView {
                    Label("You are all set", systemImage: "checkmark.seal.fill")
                } actions: {
                    Button("Start over") {
                        plan = nil
                        reminderDays = []
                        acceptsTerms = false
                        run += 1
                        isDone = false
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                }
            } else {
                MultiStepForm(steps: steps) { isDone = true }
                    .id(run)
                    .padding(24)
            }
        }
        .tint(.indigo)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.12), .cyan.opacity(0.08)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }

    private var steps: [MultiStepFormStep] {
        [
            MultiStepFormStep(id: "plan", title: "Choose a plan", isValid: plan != nil) {
                VStack(spacing: 10) {
                    ForEach(Self.plans, id: \.self) { name in
                        row(name, isSelected: plan == name) { plan = name }
                    }
                }
            },
            MultiStepFormStep(id: "days", title: "Pick reminder days", isValid: !reminderDays.isEmpty) {
                VStack(spacing: 10) {
                    ForEach(Self.days, id: \.self) { day in
                        row(day, isSelected: reminderDays.contains(day)) {
                            if reminderDays.remove(day) == nil { reminderDays.insert(day) }
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
            MultiStepFormStep(id: "terms", title: "One last thing", isValid: acceptsTerms) {
                Toggle("Accept the terms", isOn: $acceptsTerms)
                    .padding()
                    .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
            },
        ]
    }

    private func row(_ title: String, isSelected: Bool, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack {
                Text(title).font(.headline)
                Spacer()
                Image(systemName: isSelected ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "circle")
                    .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? AnyShapeStyle(.tint) : AnyShapeStyle(.tertiary))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            .padding()
            .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

#Preview {
    MultiStepFormDemo()
}
```

## OTP Code Field

A one-time code field with one box per digit, backed by a single hidden text field.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/OTPCodeField/OTPCodeField.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum OTPCodeFieldInput {
    /// Keeps only ASCII digits, up to `length`. Handles pasted text such as "123-456".
    static func sanitized(_ input: String, length: Int) -> String {
        String(input.filter { $0.isASCII && $0.isNumber }.prefix(max(length, 0)))
    }
}

/// A one-time code entry with a box per digit, backed by a single invisible `TextField`.
///
/// The field stays behind the boxes rather than hidden, so VoiceOver, paste and code
/// autofill reach it. With Reduce Motion on, digits appear without a pop.
struct OTPCodeField: View {
    @Binding var code: String
    var length: Int = 6
    var title: LocalizedStringResource = "Verification code"
    var tint: Color = .indigo
    var onComplete: ((String) -> Void)? = nil

    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var boxHeight = 58.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            ForEach(0..<length, id: \.self) { index in
                digitBox(at: index)
            }
        }
        .background {
            TextField(text: $code) { Text(title) }
                .textContentType(.oneTimeCode)
                .keyboardType(.numberPad)
                .focused($isFocused)
                .foregroundStyle(.clear)
                .tint(.clear)
        }
        .contentShape(.rect)
        .onTapGesture { isFocused = true }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.3, bounce: 0.5), value: code)
        .onChange(of: code) { oldValue, newValue in
            let clean = OTPCodeFieldInput.sanitized(newValue, length: length)
            if clean != newValue { code = clean }
            if clean.count == length, clean != OTPCodeFieldInput.sanitized(oldValue, length: length) {
                onComplete?(clean)
            }
        }
    }

    private func digitBox(at index: Int) -> some View {
        let digits = Array(code)
        let digit = index < digits.count ? String(digits[index]) : nil
        let isActive = isFocused && index == digits.count

        return RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14)
            .fill(.regularMaterial)
            .strokeBorder(isActive ? tint : Color.secondary.opacity(0.3), lineWidth: isActive ? 2 : 1)
            .frame(height: boxHeight)
            .overlay {
                if let digit {
                    Text(digit)
                        .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .semibold))
                        .monospacedDigit()
                        .transition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .scale(scale: 0.4).combined(with: .opacity))
                        .accessibilityRepresentation { EmptyView() }
                }
            }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct OTPCodeFieldDemo: View {
    @State private var code = ""
    @State private var isVerified = false

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.3), .cyan.opacity(0.2)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 24) {
                Image(systemName: isVerified ? "checkmark.shield.fill" : "lock.shield.fill")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .imageScale(.large)
                    .foregroundStyle(isVerified ? Color.green : Color.indigo)
                    .contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Text(isVerified ? "You are in" : "Check your messages")
                    .font(.title2.bold())

                OTPCodeField(code: $code, title: "Code") { _ in
                    withAnimation { isVerified = true }
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 24)
        }
        .ignoresSafeArea(.keyboard)
        .onChange(of: code) { _, newValue in
            if newValue.count < 6 { isVerified = false }
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    OTPCodeFieldDemo()
}
```

## Passcode Keypad

A number pad with a dot per digit that shakes and empties when the passcode is wrong.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/PasscodeKeypad/PasscodeKeypad.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated enum PasscodeKeypadLogic {
    static let rows = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], [7, 8, 9]]

    /// `code` with one more digit, or as it was when it is already `length` long.
    static func adding(_ digit: Int, to code: String, length: Int) -> String {
        guard (0...9).contains(digit), code.count < length else { return code }
        return code + String(digit)
    }

    /// How far to the side the dots are while they shake: `progress` goes from 0 to 1, and the
    /// swings get shorter until the dots are back in place.
    static func shake(at progress: Double, amplitude: Double = 12, swings: Double = 3) -> Double {
        guard progress > 0, progress < 1 else { return 0 }
        return sin(progress * swings * 2 * .pi) * amplitude * (1 - progress)
    }
}

/// A number pad with a dot per digit, for a passcode kept in the app.
///
/// `onComplete` gets the code when its last digit is entered. Return `false` to reject it: the
/// dots turn red, shake and empty, with a haptic and a VoiceOver announcement. The digits are
/// never shown or read aloud. With Reduce Motion on, the dots turn red without shaking.
struct PasscodeKeypad: View {
    var title = "Enter Passcode"
    var length = 6
    var onComplete: (String) -> Bool

    private let rejectionSeconds = 0.5
    private let keySpacing: CGFloat = 20

    @State private var code = ""
    @State private var failures = 0
    @State private var isRejected = false
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var keySize = 78.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var dotSize = 14.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 32) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.title3.weight(.medium))

            dots

            keys
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: code)
        .sensoryFeedback(.error, trigger: failures)
        .task(id: failures) {
            guard failures > 0 else { return }
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(rejectionSeconds))
            code = ""
            isRejected = false
        }
    }

    private var dots: some View {
        HStack(spacing: dotSize) {
            ForEach(0..<max(length, 0), id: \.self) { index in
                Circle()
                    .fill(index < code.count ? AnyShapeStyle(isRejected ? .red : .primary) : AnyShapeStyle(.clear))
                    .strokeBorder(isRejected ? AnyShapeStyle(.red) : AnyShapeStyle(.primary), lineWidth: 1.5)
                    .frame(width: dotSize, height: dotSize)
            }
        }
        .keyframeAnimator(initialValue: 0.0, trigger: reduceMotion ? 0 : failures) { view, progress in
            view.offset(x: PasscodeKeypadLogic.shake(at: progress))
        } keyframes: { _ in
            LinearKeyframe(1, duration: rejectionSeconds)
        }
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityValue("\(code.count) of \(length) digits entered")
    }

    private var keys: some View {
        Grid(horizontalSpacing: keySpacing, verticalSpacing: keySpacing) {
            ForEach(PasscodeKeypadLogic.rows, id: \.self) { row in
                GridRow {
                    ForEach(row, id: \.self) { digit in
                        key(digit)
                    }
                }
            }
            GridRow {
                Color.clear
                    .gridCellUnsizedAxes([.horizontal, .vertical])
                key(0)
                Button {
                    code = String(code.dropLast())
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "delete.backward")
                        .font(.title2)
                        .frame(maxWidth: keySize, maxHeight: keySize)
                        .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
                        .contentShape(.circle)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .disabled(code.isEmpty || isRejected)
                .accessibilityLabel("Delete")
            }
        }
        // A number pad keeps 1, 2, 3 from left to right in every language, like a phone's.
        .environment(\.layoutDirection, .leftToRight)
    }

    private func key(_ digit: Int) -> some View {
        Button {
            press(digit)
        } label: {
            Text(verbatim: String(digit))
                .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .medium))
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.5)
                .frame(maxWidth: keySize, maxHeight: keySize)
                .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
        }
        .buttonStyle(PasscodeKeypadKeyStyle())
    }

    private func press(_ digit: Int) {
        guard !isRejected, code.count < length else { return }
        code = PasscodeKeypadLogic.adding(digit, to: code, length: length)
        guard code.count == length, !onComplete(code) else { return }

        isRejected = true
        failures += 1
        AccessibilityNotification.Announcement("Wrong passcode").post()
    }
}

private struct PasscodeKeypadKeyStyle: ButtonStyle {
    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .background(configuration.isPressed ? AnyShapeStyle(.fill) : AnyShapeStyle(.fill.tertiary), in: .circle)
            .contentShape(.circle)
            .animation(configuration.isPressed ? nil : .easeOut(duration: 0.3), value: configuration.isPressed)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PasscodeKeypadDemo: View {
    private let passcode = "2580"

    @State private var isUnlocked = false

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 24) {
            Image(systemName: isUnlocked ? "lock.open.fill" : "lock.fill")
                .font(.largeTitle)
                .foregroundStyle(isUnlocked ? .green : .secondary)
                .contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            if isUnlocked {
                Text("Unlocked")
                    .font(.title2.bold())
                Button("Lock Again") {
                    isUnlocked = false
                }
                .buttonStyle(.bordered)
            } else {
                PasscodeKeypad(length: passcode.count) { code in
                    guard code == passcode else { return false }
                    Task {
                        try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.35))
                        isUnlocked = true
                    }
                    return true
                }

                Text("The passcode is \(passcode)")
                    .font(.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground))
    }
}
```

## Password Strength Field

A password field with a strength meter and a checklist of rules that tick off as they are met.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/PasswordStrengthField/PasswordStrengthField.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// One requirement of the password, shown as a line of the checklist.
struct PasswordStrengthFieldRule: Identifiable, Sendable {
    let id: String
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let isMet: @Sendable (String) -> Bool

    static let defaults: [PasswordStrengthFieldRule] = [
        .init(id: "length", title: "At least 8 characters") { $0.count >= 8 },
        .init(id: "case", title: "Upper and lower case letters") { $0.contains(where: \.isUppercase) && $0.contains(where: \.isLowercase) },
        .init(id: "digit", title: "A number") { $0.contains(where: \.isNumber) },
        .init(id: "symbol", title: "A symbol") { $0.contains { $0.isPunctuation || $0.isSymbol } },
    ]
}

/// Turns the rules into a strength level, from 0 (empty) to `levels`.
enum PasswordStrengthFieldMeter {
    static let levels = 4

    static func level(for password: String, rules: [PasswordStrengthFieldRule]) -> Int {
        guard !password.isEmpty, !rules.isEmpty else { return 0 }
        let met = rules.filter { $0.isMet(password) }.count
        let scaled = Double(met) / Double(rules.count) * Double(levels)
        return max(1, min(levels, Int(scaled.rounded(.up))))
    }
}

/// A password field with a strength meter and a checklist of rules that tick off as they are met.
struct PasswordStrengthField: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    @Binding var password: String
    var rules = PasswordStrengthFieldRule.defaults

    @State private var isRevealed = false
    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let fieldCornerRadius: CGFloat = 14

    private var level: Int { PasswordStrengthFieldMeter.level(for: password, rules: rules) }

    private var levelName: String {
        switch level {
        case 0: "Empty"
        case 1: "Weak"
        case 2: "Fair"
        case 3: "Good"
        default: "Strong"
        }
    }

    private var levelColor: Color {
        switch level {
        case 1: .red
        case 2: .orange
        case 3: .yellow
        default: .green
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            field

            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                ForEach(1...PasswordStrengthFieldMeter.levels, id: \.self) { segment in
                    Capsule()
                        .fill(segment <= level ? AnyShapeStyle(levelColor) : AnyShapeStyle(.quaternary))
                        .frame(height: 6)
                }

                Text(levelName)
                    .font(.caption.weight(.semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .fixedSize()
                    .padding(.leading, 6)
            }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel("Password strength")
            .accessibilityValue(levelName)

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                ForEach(rules) { rule in
                    checklistRow(rule)
                }
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.25), value: password)
    }

    private var field: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 10) {
            Group {
                if isRevealed {
                    TextField(text: $password) { Text(title) }
                } else {
                    SecureField(text: $password) { Text(title) }
                }
            }
            .focused($isFocused)
            .textContentType(.newPassword)
            .textInputAutocapitalization(.never)
            .autocorrectionDisabled()
            .accessibilityLabel(title)

            Button {
                isRevealed.toggle()
                isFocused = true
            } label: {
                // The icon is too small to hit. The padding widens what answers to a touch,
                // and the same padding taken back keeps the field as it was.
                Image(systemName: isRevealed ? "eye.slash" : "eye")
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .padding(15)
                    .contentShape(.rect)
                    .padding(-15)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel(isRevealed ? "Hide password" : "Show password")
        }
        .padding(14)
        .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: fieldCornerRadius, style: .continuous))
        .overlay {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: fieldCornerRadius, style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(isFocused ? AnyShapeStyle(.tint) : AnyShapeStyle(.quaternary), lineWidth: 1.5)
        }
    }

    private func checklistRow(_ rule: PasswordStrengthFieldRule) -> some View {
        let isMet = rule.isMet(password)
        return Label {
            Text(rule.title)
        } icon: {
            Image(systemName: isMet ? "checkmark.circle.fill" : "circle")
                .foregroundStyle(isMet ? .green : .secondary)
                .contentTransition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .symbolEffect(.replace))
        }
        .font(.subheadline)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(rule.title)
        .accessibilityValue(isMet ? "Met" : "Not met")
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PasswordStrengthFieldDemo: View {
    @State private var password = ""

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 22) {
                Text("Create your account")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())

                PasswordStrengthField(title: "Password", password: $password)
            }
            .padding(24)
        }
        .tint(.indigo)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.14), .pink.opacity(0.08)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }
}

#Preview {
    PasswordStrengthFieldDemo()
}
```

## Rich Text Editor

A text editor with a bar to make the selection bold, italic, underlined, struck through or highlighted.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 26.0. Path: Components/Inputs/RichTextEditor/RichTextEditor.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated enum RichTextEditorLogic {
    /// How many words a text has, whatever its formatting.
    static func wordCount(of text: AttributedString) -> Int {
        String(text.characters).split { $0.isWhitespace || $0.isNewline }.count
    }

    /// The highlight a tap leaves: the color tapped, or none when the text already had it.
    static func toggled<Value: Equatable>(_ current: Value?, choosing value: Value) -> Value? {
        current == value ? nil : value
    }
}

/// A text editor with a bar to make the selection bold, italic, underlined, struck through or
/// highlighted, on the rich text editing that iOS 26 added to `TextEditor`.
///
/// It edits an `AttributedString`. With no selection, the bar changes what is typed next, and
/// each button shows whether its format is on at the cursor.
@available(iOS 26, *)
struct RichTextEditor: View {
    @Binding var text: AttributedString
    var highlights: [Color] = [.yellow, .green, .pink]

    private let buttonSize: CGFloat = 44

    @State private var selection = AttributedTextSelection()
    @Environment(\.fontResolutionContext) private var fontResolutionContext

    private var typing: AttributeContainer { selection.typingAttributes(in: text) }
    private var font: Font.Resolved { (typing.font ?? .body).resolve(in: fontResolutionContext) }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            TextEditor(text: $text, selection: $selection)
                .padding(.horizontal, 12)

            Divider()

            ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                HStack(spacing: 6) {
                    // Each button reads its state once, so every run of the selection ends the same.
                    let isBold = font.isBold
                    let isItalic = font.isItalic
                    let isUnderlined = typing.underlineStyle != nil
                    let isStruck = typing.strikethroughStyle != nil

                    toggle("Bold", symbol: "bold", isOn: isBold) { attributes in
                        attributes.font = (attributes.font ?? .body).bold(!isBold)
                    }
                    toggle("Italic", symbol: "italic", isOn: isItalic) { attributes in
                        attributes.font = (attributes.font ?? .body).italic(!isItalic)
                    }
                    toggle("Underline", symbol: "underline", isOn: isUnderlined) { attributes in
                        attributes.underlineStyle = isUnderlined ? nil : .single
                    }
                    toggle("Strikethrough", symbol: "strikethrough", isOn: isStruck) { attributes in
                        attributes.strikethroughStyle = isStruck ? nil : .single
                    }

                    Divider()
                        .frame(height: 24)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 4)

                    ForEach(highlights, id: \.self) { color in
                        Button {
                            let highlight = RichTextEditorLogic.toggled(typing.backgroundColor, choosing: color.opacity(0.4))
                            apply { $0.backgroundColor = highlight }
                        } label: {
                            Image(systemName: "highlighter")
                                .frame(width: buttonSize, height: buttonSize)
                                .background(color.opacity(0.4), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 10))
                        }
                        .accessibilityLabel("Highlight in \(color.description)")
                    }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 12)
                .padding(.vertical, 8)
            }
            .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
        }
    }

    /// Changes every run of the selection on its own attributes, so a run keeps what makes it
    /// different, like the size of a title. With no selection it changes what is typed next.
    private func apply(_ change: (inout AttributeContainer) -> Void) {
        guard case .ranges(let ranges) = selection.indices(in: text), !ranges.isEmpty else {
            text.transformAttributes(in: &selection, body: change)
            return
        }
        // Indices do not survive a change, so the selection is kept as offsets and put back.
        let offsets = ranges.ranges.map { range in
            (
                text.characters.distance(from: text.startIndex, to: range.lowerBound),
                text.characters.distance(from: text.startIndex, to: range.upperBound)
            )
        }
        for (lower, upper) in offsets {
            let range = text.index(text.startIndex, offsetByCharacters: lower)..<text.index(text.startIndex, offsetByCharacters: upper)
            for run in Array(text[range].runs) {
                var attributes = run.attributes
                change(&attributes)
                text[run.range].setAttributes(attributes)
            }
        }
        var selected = RangeSet<AttributedString.Index>()
        for (lower, upper) in offsets {
            selected.insert(contentsOf: text.index(text.startIndex, offsetByCharacters: lower)..<text.index(text.startIndex, offsetByCharacters: upper))
        }
        selection = AttributedTextSelection(ranges: selected)
    }

    private func toggle(_ title: String, symbol: String, isOn: Bool, change: @escaping (inout AttributeContainer) -> Void) -> some View {
        Button {
            apply(change)
        } label: {
            Image(systemName: symbol)
                .font(.body.weight(.semibold))
                .frame(width: buttonSize, height: buttonSize)
                .foregroundStyle(isOn ? AnyShapeStyle(.white) : AnyShapeStyle(.primary))
                .background(isOn ? AnyShapeStyle(.tint) : AnyShapeStyle(.fill.tertiary), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 10))
        }
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isOn ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct RichTextEditorDemo: View {
    @State private var text: AttributedString = {
        var title = AttributedString("Trip notes\n")
        title.font = .title2.bold()
        var body = AttributedString("Book the night train before Friday. ")
        var important = AttributedString("Seats sell out fast.")
        important.backgroundColor = Color.yellow.opacity(0.4)
        body.append(important)
        return title + body
    }()

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            RichTextEditor(text: $text)

            Text("\(RichTextEditorLogic.wordCount(of: text)) words")
                .font(.footnote)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                .padding(.bottom, 8)
        }
        .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
        .padding(16)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: 420)
        .frame(maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground))
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, *)
#Preview {
    RichTextEditorDemo()
}
```

## Search Field With Suggestions

A search field that lists matching suggestions as the user types and fills the field when one is chosen.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/SearchFieldWithSuggestions/SearchFieldWithSuggestions.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Picks the suggestions to show for what has been typed so far.
enum SearchFieldWithSuggestionsFilter {
    /// Ignores case and accents, lists prefix matches first and drops duplicates.
    /// Returns nothing for an empty query, or once the text is already a full suggestion.
    static func matches(for query: String, in suggestions: [String], limit: Int = 6) -> [String] {
        let needle = normalized(query)
        guard !needle.isEmpty, limit > 0 else { return [] }
        guard !suggestions.contains(where: { normalized($0) == needle }) else { return [] }

        var seen = Set<String>()
        let unique = suggestions.filter { seen.insert(normalized($0)).inserted }
        let prefix = unique.filter { normalized($0).hasPrefix(needle) }
        let inside = unique.filter { normalized($0).contains(needle) && !normalized($0).hasPrefix(needle) }
        return Array((prefix + inside).prefix(limit))
    }

    private static func normalized(_ text: String) -> String {
        text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            .folding(options: [.caseInsensitive, .diacriticInsensitive], locale: nil)
    }
}

/// Lists matching suggestions under a search field as the person types.
/// Choosing one fills the field.
struct SearchFieldWithSuggestions: ViewModifier {
    @Binding var text: String
    let suggestions: [String]
    var placement: SearchFieldPlacement = .automatic
    var prompt = "Search"
    var limit = 6

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .searchable(text: $text, placement: placement, prompt: prompt)
            .searchSuggestions {
                ForEach(SearchFieldWithSuggestionsFilter.matches(for: text, in: suggestions, limit: limit), id: \.self) { suggestion in
                    Label(suggestion, systemImage: "magnifyingglass")
                        .searchCompletion(suggestion)
                }
            }
    }
}

extension View {
    /// Needs a navigation container, such as `NavigationStack`, to show the field.
    func searchFieldWithSuggestions(
        text: Binding<String>,
        suggestions: [String],
        placement: SearchFieldPlacement = .automatic,
        prompt: String = "Search",
        limit: Int = 6
    ) -> some View {
        modifier(SearchFieldWithSuggestions(text: text, suggestions: suggestions, placement: placement, prompt: prompt, limit: limit))
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SearchFieldWithSuggestionsDemo: View {
    private static let cities = ["Madrid", "Málaga", "Marseille", "Melbourne", "Lisbon", "London", "Seoul", "Oslo", "Kyoto"]

    @State private var text = ""
    @FocusState private var isSearching: Bool

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                Image(systemName: "globe.europe.africa.fill")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .foregroundStyle(.teal.gradient)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
                Text(text.isEmpty ? "Where to?" : "Results for \(text)")
                    .font(.title2.bold())
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
            .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.teal.opacity(0.14), .blue.opacity(0.08)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
            .navigationTitle("Cities")
            .searchFieldWithSuggestions(
                text: $text,
                suggestions: Self.cities,
                placement: .navigationBarDrawer(displayMode: .always),
                prompt: "Search cities"
            )
            .searchFocused($isSearching)
            .task {
                // The field must be on screen before it can take focus.
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.4))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                isSearching = true
            }
        }
    }
}

    SearchFieldWithSuggestionsDemo()
}
```
