## Tag Input Field

A field that turns what you type into removable tags, which wrap onto as many lines as they need.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/TagInputField/TagInputField.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated enum TagInputFieldLogic {
    /// An invisible character the field always keeps before the typed text. Deleting it is how a
    /// backspace in an empty field is noticed, which `TextField` does not report.
    static let marker = "\u{200B}"
    static let separators: Set<Character> = [",", "\n"]

    /// `tags` with the new ones at the end, trimmed, leaving out the empty and the repeated.
    static func adding(_ new: [String], to tags: [String]) -> [String] {
        new.reduce(into: tags) { tags, candidate in
            let tag = candidate.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            guard !tag.isEmpty, !tags.contains(where: { $0.caseInsensitiveCompare(tag) == .orderedSame }) else { return }
            tags.append(tag)
        }
    }

    /// What the field does when its text goes from `old` to `new`: the tags it leaves and the text it keeps.
    ///
    /// A separator turns what comes before it into tags, so pasting "red, green" adds two.
    /// A backspace with nothing typed removes the last tag.
    static func typing(_ new: String, after old: String, tags: [String]) -> (tags: [String], text: String) {
        if old == marker, new.isEmpty { return (Array(tags.dropLast()), marker) }

        let typed = new.replacingOccurrences(of: marker, with: "")
        let pieces = typed.split(omittingEmptySubsequences: false) { separators.contains($0) }.map(String.init)
        // Text that only lacks a separator is left as it is, wherever its marker sits: rewriting the
        // field while keys are still arriving loses some of them.
        if pieces.count == 1, new.count == typed.count + 1 { return (tags, new) }

        let rest = String((pieces.last ?? "").drop { $0 == " " })
        return (adding(Array(pieces.dropLast()), to: tags), marker + rest)
    }

    /// Where each view goes: one after another, on a new line when one does not fit.
    /// The last one is the text field, which takes what is left of its line.
    static func frames(sizes: [CGSize], width: CGFloat, spacing: CGFloat, fieldMinWidth: CGFloat) -> [CGRect] {
        var frames: [CGRect] = []
        var x: CGFloat = 0
        var y: CGFloat = 0
        var lineHeight: CGFloat = 0

        for (index, size) in sizes.enumerated() {
            let isField = index == sizes.count - 1
            var size = CGSize(width: isField ? fieldMinWidth : min(size.width, width), height: size.height)
            if x > 0, x + size.width > width {
                x = 0
                y += lineHeight + spacing
                lineHeight = 0
            }
            if isField, width.isFinite { size.width = max(width - x, fieldMinWidth) }

            frames.append(CGRect(origin: CGPoint(x: x, y: y), size: size))
            x += size.width + spacing
            lineHeight = max(lineHeight, size.height)
        }
        return frames
    }
}

/// A field that turns what you type into tags: press return or type a comma to add one, tap its
/// cross to remove it, or press delete in the empty field to remove the last one.
///
/// The tags wrap onto as many lines as they need and the field follows them. Repeated tags are
/// left out. VoiceOver reads each tag with a Remove action. Keyboard options such as
/// `autocorrectionDisabled` reach the field when set on this view.
struct TagInputField: View {
    @Binding var tags: [String]
    var prompt = "Add a tag"

    private let cornerRadius: CGFloat = 14

    @State private var text = TagInputFieldLogic.marker
    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TagInputFieldFlow {
            ForEach(tags, id: \.self) { tag in
                chip(tag)
            }

            TextField("", text: $text)
                .focused($isFocused)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .padding(.vertical, 6)
                .background(alignment: .leading) {
                    // The marker keeps the field from ever being empty, so it cannot show a prompt of its own.
                    if text == TagInputFieldLogic.marker {
                        Text(prompt)
                            .font(.subheadline)
                            .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
                            .lineLimit(1)
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    }
                }
                .accessibilityLabel(prompt)
                .onSubmit {
                    apply(TagInputFieldLogic.typing(text + ",", after: text, tags: tags))
                    isFocused = true
                }
        }
        .padding(10)
        .background(.fill.quaternary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
        .overlay {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius)
                .strokeBorder(.tint, lineWidth: isFocused ? 2 : 0)
        }
        .contentShape(.rect)
        .onTapGesture { isFocused = true }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.25), value: tags)
        .onChange(of: text) { old, new in
            apply(TagInputFieldLogic.typing(new, after: old, tags: tags))
        }
    }

    private func chip(_ tag: String) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 2) {
            Text(tag)
                .lineLimit(1)

            Button {
                tags.removeAll { $0 == tag }
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "xmark")
                    .font(.caption2.weight(.bold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .frame(minWidth: 24, minHeight: 20)
                    // Too small to hit. The padding widens what answers to a touch, and the
                    // same padding taken back keeps the tag as compact as it was.
                    .padding(.horizontal, 10)
                    .padding(.vertical, 12)
                    .contentShape(.rect)
                    .padding(.horizontal, -10)
                    .padding(.vertical, -12)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
        }
        .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
        .padding(.leading, 12)
        .padding(.trailing, 4)
        .padding(.vertical, 6)
        .background(.tint.opacity(0.16), in: .capsule)
        .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale(scale: 0.6).combined(with: .opacity))
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(tag)
        .accessibilityAction(named: "Remove") {
            tags.removeAll { $0 == tag }
        }
    }

    private func apply(_ result: (tags: [String], text: String)) {
        if result.tags != tags { tags = result.tags }
        if result.text != text { text = result.text }
    }
}

private nonisolated struct TagInputFieldFlow: Layout {
    var spacing: CGFloat = 8
    var fieldMinWidth: CGFloat = 96

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let frames = frames(of: subviews, in: proposal.width ?? .infinity)
        return CGSize(width: proposal.width ?? (frames.map(\.maxX).max() ?? 0), height: frames.map(\.maxY).max() ?? 0)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        for (subview, frame) in zip(subviews, frames(of: subviews, in: bounds.width)) {
            subview.place(at: CGPoint(x: bounds.minX + frame.minX, y: bounds.minY + frame.minY), proposal: ProposedViewSize(frame.size))
        }
    }

    private func frames(of subviews: Subviews, in width: CGFloat) -> [CGRect] {
        TagInputFieldLogic.frames(sizes: subviews.map { $0.sizeThatFits(.unspecified) }, width: width, spacing: spacing, fieldMinWidth: fieldMinWidth)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct TagInputFieldDemo: View {
    private let suggestions = ["spicy", "gluten-free", "30 minutes", "one pot"]

    @State private var tags = ["vegan", "dinner", "weeknight"]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text("Recipe tags")
                    .font(.title2.bold())
                Text("Press return or type a comma to add one")
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            TagInputField(tags: $tags)
                .textInputAutocapitalization(.never)
                .autocorrectionDisabled()

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
                Text("Suggested")
                    .font(.footnote.weight(.semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                    HStack {
                        ForEach(suggestions.filter { !tags.contains($0) }, id: \.self) { suggestion in
                            Button {
                                tags = TagInputFieldLogic.adding([suggestion], to: tags)
                            } label: {
                                Label(suggestion, systemImage: "plus")
                                    .font(.subheadline)
                            }
                            .buttonStyle(.bordered)
                            .buttonBorderShape(.capsule)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
            }
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground))
        .tint(.teal)
    }
}
```

## Validated Text Field

A text field that checks its value when it loses focus and shows its error only after that.

Category: Inputs. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Inputs/ValidatedTextField/ValidatedTextField.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Decides when the error is shown, so the field never complains while someone is typing.
struct ValidatedTextFieldFeedback: Equatable {
    private(set) var message: String?

    /// The only moment an error can appear.
    mutating func fieldLostFocus(text: String, validate: (String) -> String?) {
        message = validate(text)
    }

    /// While typing, an error can only go away, as soon as the text is fixed.
    mutating func textChanged(text: String, validate: (String) -> String?) {
        if message != nil, validate(text) == nil { message = nil }
    }
}

/// A text field that checks its value when it loses focus and shows its error only after that.
struct ValidatedTextField: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    @Binding var text: String
    /// Returns the message to show, or `nil` when the value is fine.
    let validate: (String) -> String?

    @State private var feedback = ValidatedTextFieldFeedback()
    @FocusState private var isFocused: Bool
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var borderStyle: AnyShapeStyle {
        if feedback.message != nil { return AnyShapeStyle(.red) }
        return isFocused ? AnyShapeStyle(.tint) : AnyShapeStyle(.quaternary)
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            Text(title)
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            TextField("", text: $text)
                .focused($isFocused)
                .padding(14)
                .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous))
                .overlay {
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
                        .strokeBorder(borderStyle, lineWidth: 1.5)
                }
                .accessibilityLabel(title)
                .accessibilityHint(feedback.message ?? "")

            if let message = feedback.message {
                Label(message, systemImage: "exclamationmark.circle.fill")
                    .font(.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(.red)
                    .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .opacity.combined(with: .move(edge: .top)))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.25), value: feedback)
        .onChange(of: isFocused) { _, focused in
            guard !focused else { return }
            feedback.fieldLostFocus(text: text, validate: validate)
            if let message = feedback.message {
                AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(message).post()
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: text) { _, newValue in
            feedback.textChanged(text: newValue, validate: validate)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ValidatedTextFieldDemo: View {
    @State private var email = ""
    @State private var name = ""

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
                Text("Your details")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())

                ValidatedTextField(title: "Email", text: $email) { value in
                    value.contains("@") && value.contains(".") ? nil : "Enter a valid email address."
                }
                .keyboardType(.emailAddress)
                .textInputAutocapitalization(.never)
                .autocorrectionDisabled()

                ValidatedTextField(title: "Name", text: $name) { value in
                    value.isEmpty ? "Tell us your name." : nil
                }
            }
            .padding(24)
        }
        .tint(.indigo)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.12), .orange.opacity(0.08)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }
}
```

## Model Availability Gate

A view that shows its content when the on-device model can answer, and otherwise explains why not and what the person can do.

Category: Intelligence. Minimum: iOS 26.0. Path: Components/Intelligence/ModelAvailabilityGate/ModelAvailabilityGate.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import FoundationModels
import SwiftUI

/// Shows its content when the on-device model can answer. Otherwise it explains
/// why not and what the person can do.
///
/// The system does not notify changes in availability, so the view checks again
/// when the app becomes active and every few seconds while the model downloads.
@available(iOS 26, *)
struct ModelAvailabilityGate<Content: View>: View {
    /// Leave it `nil` to read the real model. Pass a value to force a state.
    var availability: SystemLanguageModel.Availability? = nil
    @ViewBuilder var content: () -> Content

    @State private var liveAvailability = SystemLanguageModel.default.availability
    @Environment(\.scenePhase) private var scenePhase

    var body: some View {
        Group {
            switch availability ?? liveAvailability {
            case .available:
                content()
            case .unavailable(let reason):
                // A long explanation at the largest text sizes stays reachable.
                ViewThatFits(in: .vertical) {
                    explanation(for: reason)
                    ScrollView { explanation(for: reason) }
                }
            }
        }
        .task(id: scenePhase) {
            guard availability == nil else { return }
            liveAvailability = SystemLanguageModel.default.availability
            while liveAvailability == .unavailable(.modelNotReady) {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(3))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                liveAvailability = SystemLanguageModel.default.availability
            }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func explanation(for reason: SystemLanguageModel.Availability.UnavailableReason) -> some View {
        switch reason {
        case .deviceNotEligible:
            ContentUnavailableView(
                "Not available on this device",
                systemImage: "iphone.slash",
                description: Text("This feature needs a device that supports Apple Intelligence. Everything else in the app keeps working.")
            )
        case .appleIntelligenceNotEnabled:
            ContentUnavailableView(
                "Apple Intelligence is off",
                systemImage: "sparkles",
                description: Text("Open the Settings app, turn on Apple Intelligence, then come back to use this feature.")
            )
        case .modelNotReady:
            ContentUnavailableView {
                Label("Getting the model ready", systemImage: "arrow.down.circle")
            } description: {
                Text("The model is still downloading. This screen updates by itself when it finishes.")
            } actions: {
                ProgressView()
                    .accessibilityLabel("Preparing the model")
            }
        @unknown default:
            ContentUnavailableView(
                "Not available right now",
                systemImage: "exclamationmark.circle",
                description: Text("The on-device model cannot answer at the moment. Try again later.")
            )
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct ModelAvailabilityGateDemo: View {
    private enum Sample: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
        case ready = "Ready"
        case device = "Device"
        case off = "Off"
        case preparing = "Preparing"

        var id: Self { self }

        var availability: SystemLanguageModel.Availability {
            switch self {
            case .ready: .available
            case .device: .unavailable(.deviceNotEligible)
            case .off: .unavailable(.appleIntelligenceNotEnabled)
            case .preparing: .unavailable(.modelNotReady)
            }
        }
    }

    @State private var sample = Sample.device
    @State private var autoPlays = true
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var pickerSelection: Binding<Sample> {
        Binding(get: { sample }, set: { newValue in
            autoPlays = false
            sample = newValue
        })
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            ZStack {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 28, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(.background)
                    .shadow(color: .indigo.opacity(0.18), radius: 22, y: 10)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                ModelAvailabilityGate(availability: sample.availability) {
                    VStack(spacing: 14) {
                        Image(systemName: "sparkles")
                            .font(.largeTitle)
                            .foregroundStyle(.indigo.gradient)
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                        Text("The model is ready")
                            .font(.title2.bold())
                        Text("Your feature appears here.")
                            .font(.body)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                    .padding()
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                }
                .id(sample)
                .transition(.opacity)
            }

            Picker("Availability", selection: pickerSelection) {
                ForEach(Sample.allCases) { Text($0.rawValue).tag($0) }
            }
            .pickerStyle(.segmented)
        }
        .padding(20)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.14), .teal.opacity(0.1)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
        .task(id: autoPlays && !reduceMotion) {
            guard autoPlays, !reduceMotion else { return }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.2))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                let all = Sample.allCases
                let next = ((all.firstIndex(of: sample) ?? 0) + 1) % all.count
                withAnimation(.smooth(duration: 0.3)) { sample = all[next] }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## On Device Streaming Answer

An answer that fills in as the on-device model streams it, with no network request.

Category: Intelligence. Minimum: iOS 26.0. Path: Components/Intelligence/OnDeviceStreamingAnswer/OnDeviceStreamingAnswer.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import FoundationModels
import SwiftUI

/// An answer that fills in while the on-device model writes it, with no network request.
///
/// Changing `prompt` cancels the answer in progress and starts a new one.
/// An empty prompt shows `placeholder`.
@available(iOS 26, *)
struct OnDeviceStreamingAnswer: View {
    private enum Phase: Equatable {
        case idle, streaming, finished, failed
    }

    private struct ModelUnavailable: Error {}

    let prompt: String
    var instructions = "Answer in two short, friendly sentences."
    var placeholder = "Ask something to see the answer here."
    /// Replaces the model with your own text stream, for previews and for tests.
    /// Each element is the whole text so far.
    var sampleStream: (@MainActor (String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<String, Error>)? = nil
    /// Plays instead of an error when the model is unavailable or fails.
    /// Each element is the whole text so far.
    var fallbackStream: (@MainActor (String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<String, Error>)? = nil
    var failureMessage = "The on-device model couldn't answer right now. Please try again later."

    @State private var text = ""
    @State private var phase = Phase.idle
    @State private var answeredPrompt: String?
    @State private var preparedSession: LanguageModelSession?
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var trimmedPrompt: String {
        prompt.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
    }

    private var isStreaming: Bool { phase == .streaming }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 12) {
            Label(isStreaming ? "Writing on your device" : "On-device answer", systemImage: "sparkles")
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.tint)
                .symbolEffect(.pulse, isActive: isStreaming && !reduceMotion)

            content
                .font(.body)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        }
        .padding(18)
        .background(.regularMaterial, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 20, style: .continuous))
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeOut(duration: 0.18), value: text)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel("On-device answer")
        .accessibilityValue(accessibilityValue)
        .task {
            guard sampleStream == nil, SystemLanguageModel.default.isAvailable else { return }
            let session = LanguageModelSession(instructions: instructions)
            session.prewarm()
            preparedSession = session
        }
        .task(id: trimmedPrompt) { await answer() }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var content: some View {
        switch phase {
        case .idle:
            Text(placeholder).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        case .streaming:
            Text("\(Text(text))\(Text(" ▍").foregroundStyle(.tint))")
        case .finished:
            Text(text).textSelection(.enabled)
        case .failed:
            Text(failureMessage).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
    }

    private var accessibilityValue: String {
        switch phase {
        case .idle: placeholder
        case .streaming: "Writing"
        case .finished: text
        case .failed: failureMessage
        }
    }

    private func answer() async {
        // `.task` runs again when the view reappears. A finished answer stays.
        guard trimmedPrompt != answeredPrompt else { return }
        answeredPrompt = nil
        text = ""
        guard !trimmedPrompt.isEmpty else {
            phase = .idle
            return
        }
        phase = .streaming

        do {
            if let sampleStream {
                for try await partial in sampleStream(trimmedPrompt) { text = partial }
            } else {
                try await streamFromModel()
            }
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            phase = .finished
            answeredPrompt = trimmedPrompt
            AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(text).post()
        } catch {
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            phase = .failed
        }
    }

    private func streamFromModel() async throws {
        do {
            guard SystemLanguageModel.default.isAvailable else { throw ModelUnavailable() }
            // Every answer gets its own session, so old turns never fill its context window.
            let session = preparedSession ?? LanguageModelSession(instructions: instructions)
            preparedSession = nil
            for try await snapshot in session.streamResponse(to: trimmedPrompt) { text = snapshot.content }
        } catch {
            guard let fallbackStream, !Task.isCancelled else { throw error }
            for try await partial in fallbackStream(trimmedPrompt) { text = partial }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 26, *)
struct OnDeviceStreamingAnswerDemo: View {
    private static let questions: [(question: String, answer: String)] = [
        ("Why is the sky blue?", "Air scatters blue light far more than red light. That scattered blue reaches your eyes from every direction, so the whole sky glows."),
        ("Why is the sea salty?", "Rain slowly dissolves minerals from rocks and rivers carry them to the sea. The water evaporates, but the salt stays behind."),
    ]

    @State private var prompt = ""
    @State private var isPlayingSample = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 18) {
                Text("Ask the device")
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())

                ForEach(Self.questions, id: \.question) { item in
                    Button(item.question) { prompt = item.question }
                        .buttonStyle(.bordered)
                        .tint(.indigo)
                }

                OnDeviceStreamingAnswer(prompt: prompt, fallbackStream: sample)
                    .tint(.indigo)

                if isPlayingSample {
                    Text("The on-device model can't answer here, so this demo plays sample text.")
                        .font(.footnote)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
            .padding(24)
        }
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.16), .mint.opacity(0.12)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }

    private func sample(_ prompt: String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<String, Error> {
        isPlayingSample = true
        let answer = Self.questions.first { $0.question == prompt }?.answer ?? ""
        let instant = reduceMotion
        return AsyncThrowingStream { continuation in
            let task = Task {
                guard !instant else {
                    continuation.yield(answer)
                    continuation.finish()
                    return
                }
                var written = ""
                for word in answer.split(separator: " ") {
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(90))
                    guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                    written += written.isEmpty ? String(word) : " \(word)"
                    continuation.yield(written)
                }
                continuation.finish()
            }
            continuation.onTermination = { _ in task.cancel() }
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 26, *)
#Preview {
    OnDeviceStreamingAnswerDemo()
}
```

## Structured Output Form

A form whose fields the on-device model fills in from a free-form note as a typed Generable value.

Category: Intelligence. Minimum: iOS 27.0. Path: Components/Intelligence/StructuredOutputForm/StructuredOutputForm.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import FoundationModels
import SwiftUI

@available(iOS 27, *)
@Generable
enum StructuredOutputFormCategory: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
    case food, travel, shopping, other

    var id: Self { self }
}

/// What the model must produce. `@Guide` tells it what each field means.
@available(iOS 27, *)
@Generable(description: "An expense extracted from a short note")
struct StructuredOutputFormExpense {
    @Guide(description: "Who was paid, in a few words")
    var merchant: String
    @Guide(description: "The amount paid, as a number without a currency symbol")
    var amount: Double
    var category: StructuredOutputFormCategory
    @Guide(description: "What the expense was for, in at most six words")
    var purpose: String
}

/// The editable values of the form. Empty until the model or the person fills them.
@available(iOS 27, *)
struct StructuredOutputFormDraft: Equatable, Sendable {
    var merchant = ""
    var amount: Double?
    var category = StructuredOutputFormCategory.other
    var purpose = ""
}

/// A form whose fields the on-device model fills in from a free-form note, as a typed value.
@available(iOS 27, *)
struct StructuredOutputForm: View {
    @Binding var note: String
    @Binding var draft: StructuredOutputFormDraft
    /// Replaces the model with your own stream, for previews and for tests.
    var sampleStream: (@MainActor (String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<StructuredOutputFormDraft, Error>)? = nil
    /// Plays instead of an error when the model is unavailable or fails.
    var fallbackStream: (@MainActor (String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<StructuredOutputFormDraft, Error>)? = nil
    var failureMessage = "The on-device model couldn't fill in the form right now. Please try again later."

    @State private var fillTask: Task<Void, Never>?
    @State private var isFilling = false
    @State private var didFail = false

    private var currencyCode: String { Locale.current.currency?.identifier ?? "USD" }

    private struct ModelUnavailable: Error {}

    private var hasNote: Bool {
        !note.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty
    }

    var body: some View {
        Form {
            Section("Your note") {
                TextField("Note", text: $note, axis: .vertical)
                    .lineLimit(2...5)
                    .accessibilityLabel("Note")

                Button {
                    guard !isFilling else { return }
                    isFilling = true
                    fillTask = Task { await fill() }
                } label: {
                    HStack {
                        Label(isFilling ? "Filling in" : "Fill in the form", systemImage: "sparkles")
                        if isFilling {
                            Spacer()
                            ProgressView().accessibilityHidden(true)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .disabled(isFilling || !hasNote)
            }

            Section("Expense") {
                LabeledContent("Merchant") {
                    TextField("Merchant", text: $draft.merchant).multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                }
                LabeledContent("Amount") {
                    TextField("Amount", value: $draft.amount, format: .currency(code: currencyCode))
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                        .keyboardType(.decimalPad)
                }
                Picker("Category", selection: $draft.category) {
                    ForEach(StructuredOutputFormCategory.allCases) { Text($0.rawValue.capitalized).tag($0) }
                }
                LabeledContent("Purpose") {
                    TextField("Purpose", text: $draft.purpose).multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                }
            }
            .disabled(isFilling)

            if didFail {
                Section {
                    Label(failureMessage, systemImage: "exclamationmark.triangle")
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }
            }
        }
        .onDisappear { fillTask?.cancel() }
    }

    private func fill() async {
        didFail = false
        defer { isFilling = false }

        let previous = draft
        draft = StructuredOutputFormDraft()

        do {
            if let sampleStream {
                for try await partial in sampleStream(note) { draft = partial }
            } else {
                try await fillFromModel()
            }
        } catch {
            draft = previous
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            didFail = true
        }
    }

    private func fillFromModel() async throws {
        do {
            guard SystemLanguageModel.default.isAvailable else { throw ModelUnavailable() }
            let session = LanguageModelSession(instructions: "Extract an expense from the note. Do not invent values.")
            let stream = session.streamResponse(
                to: note,
                generating: StructuredOutputFormExpense.self,
                contextOptions: ContextOptions(includeSchemaInPrompt: true)
            )
            for try await snapshot in stream { apply(snapshot.content) }
        } catch {
            guard let fallbackStream, !Task.isCancelled else { throw error }
            draft = StructuredOutputFormDraft()
            for try await partial in fallbackStream(note) { draft = partial }
        }
    }

    /// Fields arrive one by one, so a field stays as it is until its value exists.
    private func apply(_ partial: StructuredOutputFormExpense.PartiallyGenerated) {
        draft.merchant = partial.merchant ?? draft.merchant
        draft.amount = partial.amount ?? draft.amount
        draft.category = partial.category ?? draft.category
        draft.purpose = partial.purpose ?? draft.purpose
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

@available(iOS 27, *)
struct StructuredOutputFormDemo: View {
    @State private var note = "Lunch with Ana at Casa Lucio, 48.50 for the team offsite"
    @State private var draft = StructuredOutputFormDraft()
    @State private var isPlayingSample = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            StructuredOutputForm(note: $note, draft: $draft, fallbackStream: sample)

            if isPlayingSample {
                Text("The on-device model can't answer here, so this demo plays sample values.")
                    .font(.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .padding()
            }
        }
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground))
        .tint(.indigo)
    }

    private func sample(_ note: String) -> AsyncThrowingStream<StructuredOutputFormDraft, Error> {
        isPlayingSample = true
        let steps: [StructuredOutputFormDraft] = [
            .init(merchant: "Casa Lucio"),
            .init(merchant: "Casa Lucio", amount: 48.5),
            .init(merchant: "Casa Lucio", amount: 48.5, category: .food),
            .init(merchant: "Casa Lucio", amount: 48.5, category: .food, purpose: "Team offsite lunch"),
        ]
        let instant = reduceMotion
        return AsyncThrowingStream { continuation in
            let task = Task {
                for step in instant ? Array(steps.suffix(1)) : steps {
                    if !instant {
                        try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(550))
                        guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                    }
                    continuation.yield(step)
                }
                continuation.finish()
            }
            continuation.onTermination = { _ in task.cancel() }
        }
    }
}

@available(iOS 27, *)
#Preview {
    StructuredOutputFormDemo()
}
```

## Adaptive Columns Grid

A grid whose column count is computed from the available width, so it gives more columns on iPad and fewer on iPhone.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/AdaptiveColumnsGrid/AdaptiveColumnsGrid.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// How many columns fit in a width.
enum AdaptiveColumnsGridMath {
    /// Always at least 1, and never more than `maxColumns`.
    static func columnCount(width: CGFloat, minColumnWidth: CGFloat, spacing: CGFloat, maxColumns: Int) -> Int {
        let limit = max(1, min(maxColumns, 1_000))
        guard width.isFinite, width > 0, minColumnWidth.isFinite, minColumnWidth > 0 else { return 1 }
        let gap = spacing.isFinite ? max(0, spacing) : 0
        let fitting = ((width + gap) / (minColumnWidth + gap)).rounded(.down)
        return max(1, min(limit, Int(min(fitting, 1_000))))
    }
}

/// A grid that computes its column count from the width it gets: fewer columns on
/// iPhone, more on iPad, with an upper limit that `.adaptive` grid items do not offer.
struct AdaptiveColumnsGrid<Data: RandomAccessCollection, Content: View>: View where Data.Element: Identifiable {
    let data: Data
    var minColumnWidth: CGFloat = 150
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12
    var maxColumns = 6
    @ViewBuilder let content: (Data.Element) -> Content

    @State private var width: CGFloat = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var gap: CGFloat { spacing.isFinite ? max(0, spacing) : 0 }

    private var columnCount: Int {
        AdaptiveColumnsGridMath.columnCount(width: width, minColumnWidth: minColumnWidth, spacing: gap, maxColumns: maxColumns)
    }

    var body: some View {
        LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: gap), count: columnCount), spacing: gap) {
            ForEach(data) { element in
                content(element)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self, of: { $0.size.width }, action: { newWidth in
            // The first measurement is not a change the person should see animate.
            var transaction = Transaction()
            transaction.disablesAnimations = width == 0
            withTransaction(transaction) { width = newWidth }
        })
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.4), value: columnCount)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct AdaptiveColumnsGridDemo: View {
    private struct Tile: Identifiable {
        let id: Int
        var color: Color { [.indigo, .teal, .pink, .orange, .mint, .purple][id % 6] }
    }

    private enum Size: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
        case narrow = "Narrow", medium = "Medium", wide = "Wide"

        var id: Self { self }
        var width: CGFloat {
            switch self {
            case .narrow: 170
            case .medium: 270
            case .wide: 362
            }
        }
    }

    @State private var size = Size.narrow
    /// Only for this demo: it plays by itself until someone touches it.
    @State private var isAutoPlaying = true
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var selection: Binding<Size> {
        Binding(get: { size }, set: { newValue in
            isAutoPlaying = false
            size = newValue
        })
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                Picker("Width", selection: selection) {
                    ForEach(Size.allCases) { Text($0.rawValue).tag($0) }
                }
                .pickerStyle(.segmented)

                AdaptiveColumnsGrid(data: (0..<12).map(Tile.init), minColumnWidth: 80, spacing: 10) { tile in
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
                        .fill(tile.color.gradient)
                        .frame(height: 72)
                        .overlay {
                            Text("\(tile.id + 1)")
                                .font(.headline)
                                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        }
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: size.width)
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
        .simultaneousGesture(DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0).onChanged { _ in isAutoPlaying = false })
        .task(id: isAutoPlaying && !reduceMotion) {
            guard isAutoPlaying, !reduceMotion else { return }
            while isAutoPlaying {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.1))
                guard !Task.isCancelled, isAutoPlaying else { return }
                let all = Size.allCases
                let next = ((all.firstIndex(of: size) ?? 0) + 1) % all.count
                withAnimation(.smooth(duration: 0.4)) { size = all[next] }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Any Layout Adaptive Switch

A group that animates between a row and a column when its available width changes.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/AnyLayoutAdaptiveSwitch/AnyLayoutAdaptiveSwitch.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A group that lays out its content in a row when there is room, and animates to a
/// column when the width drops below `threshold` or the text gets very large.
struct AnyLayoutAdaptiveSwitch<Content: View>: View {
    var threshold: CGFloat = 340
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12
    @ViewBuilder let content: () -> Content

    @State private var availableWidth = CGFloat.infinity
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var usesColumn: Bool {
        dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize || availableWidth < threshold
    }

    var body: some View {
        let layout = usesColumn ? AnyLayout(VStackLayout(spacing: spacing)) : AnyLayout(HStackLayout(spacing: spacing))

        layout { content() }
            // Reads the width offered by the parent, not the size of the row or column,
            // so that switching layout cannot change the measurement and loop.
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self, of: { $0.size.width }, action: { newWidth in
                // The first measurement is not a change the person should see animate.
                var transaction = Transaction()
                transaction.disablesAnimations = availableWidth == .infinity
                withTransaction(transaction) { availableWidth = newWidth }
            })
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.45), value: usesColumn)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct AnyLayoutAdaptiveSwitchDemo: View {
    @State private var isWide = true
    @State private var autoPlays = true
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var wideBinding: Binding<Bool> {
        Binding(get: { isWide }, set: { newValue in
            autoPlays = false
            isWide = newValue
        })
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 28) {
            Toggle("Wide container", isOn: wideBinding)
                .font(.headline)

            AnyLayoutAdaptiveSwitch(threshold: 300) {
                tile("Photos", systemImage: "photo.fill", color: .pink)
                tile("Music", systemImage: "music.note", color: .orange)
                tile("Maps", systemImage: "map.fill", color: .teal)
            }
            .padding(14)
            .background(.quaternary.opacity(0.5), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 24, style: .continuous))
            .frame(maxWidth: isWide ? 362 : 200)

            }
            .padding(20)
        }
        .tint(.indigo)
        .task(id: autoPlays && !reduceMotion) {
            guard autoPlays, !reduceMotion else { return }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.3))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                withAnimation(.smooth(duration: 0.45)) { isWide.toggle() }
            }
        }
    }

    private func tile(_ title: String, systemImage: String, color: Color) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 8) {
            Image(systemName: systemImage)
                .font(.title2)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            Text(title)
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 92)
        .background(color.gradient, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
    }
}
```

## Bento Grid Layout

A custom Layout that packs tiles of varied spans into a bento grid.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/BentoGridLayout/BentoGridLayout.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated struct BentoGridLayoutSpan: Equatable, Sendable {
    var columns = 1
    var rows = 1
}

nonisolated enum BentoGridLayoutMath {
    /// Packs each tile, in order, into the first free slot, reading the grid top to bottom and left to right.
    static func frames(
        spans: [BentoGridLayoutSpan],
        columns: Int,
        width: CGFloat,
        rowHeight: CGFloat,
        spacing: CGFloat
    ) -> [CGRect] {
        guard columns > 0 else { return [] }
        let columnWidth = (width - spacing * CGFloat(columns - 1)) / CGFloat(columns)
        var taken = Set<SIMD2<Int>>()

        func cells(column: Int, row: Int, span: BentoGridLayoutSpan) -> [SIMD2<Int>] {
            (column..<column + span.columns).flatMap { x in
                (row..<row + span.rows).map { y in SIMD2(x, y) }
            }
        }

        func firstFreeSlot(for span: BentoGridLayoutSpan) -> (column: Int, row: Int) {
            var row = 0
            while true {
                for column in 0...(columns - span.columns) where taken.isDisjoint(with: cells(column: column, row: row, span: span)) {
                    return (column, row)
                }
                row += 1
            }
        }

        return spans.map { requested in
            let span = BentoGridLayoutSpan(columns: min(max(requested.columns, 1), columns), rows: max(requested.rows, 1))
            let slot = firstFreeSlot(for: span)
            taken.formUnion(cells(column: slot.column, row: slot.row, span: span))
            return CGRect(
                x: CGFloat(slot.column) * (columnWidth + spacing),
                y: CGFloat(slot.row) * (rowHeight + spacing),
                width: CGFloat(span.columns) * columnWidth + CGFloat(span.columns - 1) * spacing,
                height: CGFloat(span.rows) * rowHeight + CGFloat(span.rows - 1) * spacing
            )
        }
    }
}

nonisolated private struct BentoGridLayoutSpanKey: LayoutValueKey {
    static let defaultValue = BentoGridLayoutSpan()
}

extension View {
    /// How many columns and rows this tile takes inside a `BentoGridLayout`.
    func bentoGridSpan(columns: Int = 1, rows: Int = 1) -> some View {
        layoutValue(key: BentoGridLayoutSpanKey.self, value: BentoGridLayoutSpan(columns: columns, rows: rows))
    }
}

/// A grid that packs tiles of varied spans, leaving as few holes as it can.
struct BentoGridLayout: Layout {
    var columns = 4
    var rowHeight: CGFloat = 110
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let width = proposal.width ?? CGFloat(columns) * (rowHeight + spacing) - spacing
        let height = frames(for: subviews, width: width).map(\.maxY).max() ?? 0
        return CGSize(width: width, height: height)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        for (subview, frame) in zip(subviews, frames(for: subviews, width: bounds.width)) {
            subview.place(
                at: CGPoint(x: bounds.minX + frame.minX, y: bounds.minY + frame.minY),
                proposal: ProposedViewSize(frame.size)
            )
        }
    }

    private func frames(for subviews: Subviews, width: CGFloat) -> [CGRect] {
        BentoGridLayoutMath.frames(
            spans: subviews.map { $0[BentoGridLayoutSpanKey.self] },
            columns: columns,
            width: width,
            rowHeight: rowHeight,
            spacing: spacing
        )
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct DemoTile: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let symbol: String
    let colors: [Color]
}

struct BentoGridLayoutDemo: View {
    private let tiles = [
        DemoTile(id: "Sleep", symbol: "moon.fill", colors: [.indigo, .purple]),
        DemoTile(id: "Steps", symbol: "figure.walk", colors: [.green, .teal]),
        DemoTile(id: "Heart", symbol: "heart.fill", colors: [.pink, .red]),
        DemoTile(id: "Water", symbol: "drop.fill", colors: [.cyan, .blue]),
        DemoTile(id: "Sun", symbol: "sun.max.fill", colors: [.yellow, .orange]),
        DemoTile(id: "Focus", symbol: "brain.head.profile", colors: [.purple, .pink]),
        DemoTile(id: "Rest", symbol: "bed.double.fill", colors: [.teal, .indigo]),
    ]

    private let arrangements: [[(columns: Int, rows: Int)]] = [
        [(2, 2), (2, 1), (1, 1), (1, 1), (4, 1), (2, 2), (2, 2)],
        [(4, 1), (1, 2), (3, 2), (2, 1), (2, 1), (2, 1), (2, 1)],
        [(1, 2), (3, 1), (2, 1), (1, 1), (2, 2), (2, 1), (2, 1)],
    ]

    @State private var arrangement = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            Text("Today")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)

            BentoGridLayout(rowHeight: 104) {
                ForEach(Array(tiles.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, tile in
                    let span = arrangements[arrangement][index]
                    tileView(tile)
                        .bentoGridSpan(columns: span.columns, rows: span.rows)

            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)

                    arrangement = (arrangement + 1) % arrangements.count

        }
        .padding(16)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.1), .pink.opacity(0.08)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }

                .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .padding(12)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: tile.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 22))
    }
}
```

## Flow Tags Layout

A custom Layout that wraps tags onto as many lines as they need.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/FlowTagsLayout/FlowTagsLayout.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated enum FlowTagsLayoutMath {
    /// Groups widths into lines. A tag wider than `maxWidth` gets a line of its own.
    static func lines(widths: [CGFloat], maxWidth: CGFloat, spacing: CGFloat) -> [Range<Int>] {
        var lines: [Range<Int>] = []
        var start = 0
        var used: CGFloat = 0

        for (index, width) in widths.enumerated() {
            if index == start {
                used = width
            } else if used + spacing + width > maxWidth {
                lines.append(start..<index)
                start = index
                used = width
            } else {
                used += spacing + width
            }
        }

        if start < widths.count {
            lines.append(start..<widths.count)
        }
        return lines
    }
}

/// A layout that wraps its views onto as many lines as they need.
struct FlowTagsLayout: Layout {
    var spacing: CGFloat = 8
    var lineSpacing: CGFloat = 8

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        let sizes = measuredSizes(of: subviews, maxWidth: proposal.width ?? .infinity)
        let lines = FlowTagsLayoutMath.lines(widths: sizes.map(\.width), maxWidth: proposal.width ?? .infinity, spacing: spacing)
        let widest = lines.map { lineWidth($0, sizes: sizes) }.max() ?? 0
        let height = lines.reduce(0) { $0 + lineHeight($1, sizes: sizes) } + CGFloat(max(lines.count - 1, 0)) * lineSpacing
        return CGSize(width: proposal.width ?? widest, height: height)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        let sizes = measuredSizes(of: subviews, maxWidth: bounds.width)
        var y = bounds.minY

        for line in FlowTagsLayoutMath.lines(widths: sizes.map(\.width), maxWidth: bounds.width, spacing: spacing) {
            let height = lineHeight(line, sizes: sizes)
            var x = bounds.minX

            for index in line {
                subviews[index].place(
                    at: CGPoint(x: x, y: y + height / 2),
                    anchor: .leading,
                    proposal: ProposedViewSize(width: min(sizes[index].width, bounds.width), height: nil)
                )
                x += sizes[index].width + spacing
            }
            y += height + lineSpacing
        }
    }

    /// A view wider than the layout is measured at the width it gets, so its wrapped height counts.
    private func measuredSizes(of subviews: Subviews, maxWidth: CGFloat) -> [CGSize] {
        subviews.map { subview in
            let ideal = subview.sizeThatFits(.unspecified)
            return ideal.width > maxWidth ? subview.sizeThatFits(ProposedViewSize(width: maxWidth, height: nil)) : ideal
        }
    }

    private func lineWidth(_ line: Range<Int>, sizes: [CGSize]) -> CGFloat {
        sizes[line].reduce(0) { $0 + $1.width } + CGFloat(line.count - 1) * spacing
    }

    private func lineHeight(_ line: Range<Int>, sizes: [CGSize]) -> CGFloat {
        sizes[line].map(\.height).max() ?? 0
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct FlowTagsLayoutDemo: View {
    private static let extras = ["Typography", "Motion", "Haptics", "Color", "Icons"]

    @State private var tags = ["Swift", "Design", "Photography", "Travel", "Coffee", "Running", "Music", "Architecture", "Film", "Cooking", "Books", "Cycling"]
    @State private var added = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.4) }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
            Text("Your interests")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

            FlowTagsLayout(spacing: 10, lineSpacing: 12) {
                ForEach(tags, id: \.self) { tag in
                    Text(tag)
                        .font(.system(.body, design: .rounded, weight: .medium))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                        .padding(.vertical, 10)
                        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo, .pink], startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing), in: .capsule)
                        .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)

            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                Button("Remove", systemImage: "minus") {
                    withAnimation(animation) {
                        tags.removeFirst()
                        added = max(added - 1, 0)
                    }
                }
                .disabled(tags.isEmpty)

                Button("Add", systemImage: "plus") {
                    withAnimation(animation) {
                        tags.insert(Self.extras[added], at: 0)
                        added += 1
                    }
                }
                .disabled(added == Self.extras.count)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .controlSize(.large)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.14), .pink.opacity(0.14)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }
}
```

## Kanban Board

Columns of cards that the user drags from one column to another.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/KanbanBoard/KanbanBoard.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct KanbanBoardCard: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable {
    let id: String
    var title: String
}

struct KanbanBoardColumn: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable {
    let id: String
    var title: String
    var cards: [KanbanBoardCard]
}

enum KanbanBoardMove {
    /// Moves a card to the end of another column. Returns `false`, changing nothing,
    /// when the card or the column does not exist or the card is already there.
    static func apply(cardID: String, toColumn columnID: String, in columns: inout [KanbanBoardColumn]) -> Bool {
        guard let target = columns.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == columnID }),
              let source = columns.firstIndex(where: { $0.cards.contains { $0.id == cardID } }),
              source != target,
              let position = columns[source].cards.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == cardID })
        else { return false }

        let card = columns[source].cards.remove(at: position)
        columns[target].cards.append(card)
        return true
    }
}

/// Columns of cards that move from one column to another by dragging, with a
/// context menu and VoiceOver actions for anyone who cannot drag.
///
/// The drag payload is the card's `id` as plain text, so a copied file does not
/// need a custom type in Info.plist. Text that matches no card is ignored.
struct KanbanBoard: View {
    @Binding var columns: [KanbanBoardColumn]

    @ScaledMetric private var columnWidth: CGFloat
    @State private var targetedColumnID: String?
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let cardCornerRadius: CGFloat = 12

    init(columns: Binding<[KanbanBoardColumn]>, columnWidth: CGFloat = 220) {
        _columns = columns
        _columnWidth = ScaledMetric(wrappedValue: columnWidth, relativeTo: .body)
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView([.horizontal, .vertical]) {
            HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 12) {
                ForEach(columns) { column in
                    columnView(column)
                }
            }
            .padding()
        }
    }

    private func columnView(_ column: KanbanBoardColumn) -> some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
            HStack {
                Text(column.title).font(.headline)
                Spacer()
                Text("\(column.cards.count)")
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .accessibilityLabel("\(column.cards.count) cards")
            }
            .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)

            ForEach(column.cards) { card in
                cardView(card, in: column)
            }

            if column.cards.isEmpty {
                Text("Drop cards here")
                    .font(.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 60)
            }
        }
        .padding(12)
        .frame(width: max(120, columnWidth), alignment: .topLeading)
        .background(
            targetedColumnID == column.id ? AnyShapeStyle(.tint.opacity(0.22)) : AnyShapeStyle(.quaternary.opacity(0.5)),
            in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18, style: .continuous)
        )
        .dropDestination(for: String.self) { cardIDs, _ in
            var didMove = false
            withAnimation(moveAnimation) {
                for cardID in cardIDs {
                    if KanbanBoardMove.apply(cardID: cardID, toColumn: column.id, in: &columns) { didMove = true }
                }
            }
            return didMove
        } isTargeted: { isTargeted in
            if isTargeted {
                targetedColumnID = column.id
            } else if targetedColumnID == column.id {
                targetedColumnID = nil
            }
        }
    }

    private func cardView(_ card: KanbanBoardCard, in column: KanbanBoardColumn) -> some View {
        cardLabel(card)
            .draggable(card.id) { cardLabel(card).frame(width: max(120, columnWidth) - 24) }
            .contextMenu { moveButtons(card, from: column) }
            .accessibilityActions { moveButtons(card, from: column) }
    }

    private func cardLabel(_ card: KanbanBoardCard) -> some View {
        Text(card.title)
            .font(.subheadline)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .padding(12)
            .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: cardCornerRadius, style: .continuous))
            .contentShape(.dragPreview, .rect(cornerRadius: cardCornerRadius, style: .continuous))
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func moveButtons(_ card: KanbanBoardCard, from source: KanbanBoardColumn) -> some View {
        ForEach(columns.filter { $0.id != source.id }) { destination in
            Button("Move to \(destination.title)") {
                withAnimation(moveAnimation) {
                    _ = KanbanBoardMove.apply(cardID: card.id, toColumn: destination.id, in: &columns)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var moveAnimation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.3) }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct KanbanBoardDemo: View {
    @State private var columns = [
        KanbanBoardColumn(id: "todo", title: "To do", cards: [
            KanbanBoardCard(id: "1", title: "Sketch the onboarding"),
            KanbanBoardCard(id: "2", title: "Write release notes"),
            KanbanBoardCard(id: "3", title: "Fix the login crash"),
        ]),
        KanbanBoardColumn(id: "doing", title: "Doing", cards: [
            KanbanBoardCard(id: "4", title: "Record the previews"),
        ]),
        KanbanBoardColumn(id: "done", title: "Done", cards: []),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        KanbanBoard(columns: $columns, columnWidth: 180)
            .tint(.indigo)
            .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.14), .teal.opacity(0.1)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }
}

#Preview {
    KanbanBoardDemo()
}
```

## Masonry Layout

A custom layout that places items of different heights into the shortest of several columns, like a Pinterest board.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/MasonryLayout/MasonryLayout.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// The placement math, with no views, so it can be tested.
nonisolated enum MasonryLayoutMath {
    struct Placement: Equatable {
        let column: Int
        let y: CGFloat
    }

    static func columnWidth(totalWidth: CGFloat, columns: Int, spacing: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        guard columns > 0, totalWidth.isFinite else { return 0 }
        return max(0, (totalWidth - spacing * CGFloat(columns - 1)) / CGFloat(columns))
    }

    /// Puts each item in the shortest column so far, the leftmost one on a tie.
    /// Returns one placement per height, and the height of the tallest column.
    static func place(heights: [CGFloat], columns: Int, spacing: CGFloat) -> (placements: [Placement], totalHeight: CGFloat) {
        var tops = Array(repeating: CGFloat.zero, count: max(1, columns))
        var placements: [Placement] = []

        for height in heights {
            let column = tops.indices.min { tops[$0] < tops[$1] } ?? 0
            placements.append(Placement(column: column, y: tops[column]))
            tops[column] += max(0, height) + spacing
        }

        return (placements, heights.isEmpty ? 0 : max(0, (tops.max() ?? spacing) - spacing))
    }
}

/// A layout that places items of different heights into the shortest of several
/// columns, like a Pinterest board. Put it inside a `ScrollView` when it can grow.
struct MasonryLayout: Layout {
    var columns = 2
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12

    /// More columns than this makes no sense on any screen.
    private var columnCount: Int { min(max(1, columns), 64) }
    private var gap: CGFloat { spacing.isFinite ? max(0, spacing) : 0 }

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout Void) -> CGSize {
        let width = totalWidth(for: proposal, subviews: subviews)
        let columnWidth = MasonryLayoutMath.columnWidth(totalWidth: width, columns: columnCount, spacing: gap)
        let result = MasonryLayoutMath.place(heights: heights(of: subviews, columnWidth: columnWidth), columns: columnCount, spacing: gap)
        return CGSize(width: width, height: result.totalHeight)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout Void) {
        let columnWidth = MasonryLayoutMath.columnWidth(totalWidth: bounds.width, columns: columnCount, spacing: gap)
        let result = MasonryLayoutMath.place(heights: heights(of: subviews, columnWidth: columnWidth), columns: columnCount, spacing: gap)

        for (subview, placement) in zip(subviews, result.placements) {
            subview.place(
                at: CGPoint(x: bounds.minX + CGFloat(placement.column) * (columnWidth + gap), y: bounds.minY + placement.y),
                anchor: .topLeading,
                proposal: ProposedViewSize(width: columnWidth, height: nil)
            )
        }
    }

    private func heights(of subviews: Subviews, columnWidth: CGFloat) -> [CGFloat] {
        subviews.map { $0.sizeThatFits(ProposedViewSize(width: columnWidth, height: nil)).height }
    }

    /// With no width to fill, for example in a horizontal scroll view, uses the widest item.
    private func totalWidth(for proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews) -> CGFloat {
        if let width = proposal.width, width.isFinite { return max(0, width) }
        let widest = subviews.map { $0.sizeThatFits(.unspecified).width }.max() ?? 0
        return widest * CGFloat(columnCount) + gap * CGFloat(columnCount - 1)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct MasonryLayoutDemo: View {
    private static let notes: [(title: String, height: CGFloat, color: Color)] = [
        ("Sunrise", 150, .orange), ("Moss", 96, .green), ("Tide", 190, .teal), ("Ember", 120, .red),
        ("Dusk", 170, .purple), ("Fern", 110, .mint), ("Harbor", 140, .blue), ("Clay", 200, .brown),
        ("Lilac", 104, .indigo), ("Peach", 160, .pink), ("Sage", 130, .cyan), ("Slate", 118, .gray),
    ]

    @State private var columns = 2
    /// Only for this demo: it plays by itself until someone touches it.
    @State private var isAutoPlaying = true
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var columnsBinding: Binding<Int> {
        Binding(get: { columns }, set: { newValue in
            isAutoPlaying = false
            columns = newValue
        })
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 18) {
                Picker("Columns", selection: columnsBinding) {
                    ForEach(2...3, id: \.self) { Text("\($0) columns").tag($0) }
                }
                .pickerStyle(.segmented)

                MasonryLayout(columns: columns, spacing: 10) {
                    ForEach(Self.notes, id: \.title) { note in
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous)
                            .fill(note.color.gradient)
                            .frame(height: note.height)
                            .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                                Text(note.title)
                                    .font(.subheadline.bold())
                                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                                    .padding(12)
                            }
                    }
                }
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
        .simultaneousGesture(DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0).onChanged { _ in isAutoPlaying = false })
        .task(id: isAutoPlaying && !reduceMotion) {
            guard isAutoPlaying, !reduceMotion else { return }
            while isAutoPlaying {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.3))
                guard !Task.isCancelled, isAutoPlaying else { return }
                withAnimation(.smooth(duration: 0.5)) { columns = columns == 2 ? 3 : 2 }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Morphing Layout Switch

A switch that moves items between a list and a grid in one lazy grid, keeping the state of each cell.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/MorphingLayoutSwitch/MorphingLayoutSwitch.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Shows the same items as a list or as a grid. One grid changes its number of
/// columns, so every item glides to its new place and keeps its state.
///
/// `content` also receives `isGrid`, so a cell can change its own design.
struct MorphingLayoutSwitch<Data: RandomAccessCollection, Content: View>: View where Data.Element: Identifiable {
    let data: Data
    let isGrid: Bool
    var columns = 2
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12
    @ViewBuilder let content: (Data.Element, Bool) -> Content

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var gridColumns: [GridItem] {
        Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: spacing), count: isGrid ? min(max(1, columns), 64) : 1)
    }

    var body: some View {
        LazyVGrid(columns: gridColumns, spacing: spacing) {
            ForEach(data) { element in
                content(element, isGrid)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.5), value: isGrid)
    }
}

        Album(id: "Night", systemImage: "moon.stars.fill", color: .purple),

                }
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
        .tint(.indigo)

        .padding(16)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: isGrid ? 140 : 70)
        .background(album.color.gradient, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18, style: .continuous))
    }
```

## Radial Layout

A custom Layout that spreads views around a circle and animates as the count changes.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/RadialLayout/RadialLayout.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated enum RadialLayoutMath {
    /// Evenly spaced angles, the first one at `start`.
    static func angles(count: Int, start: Angle = .degrees(-90)) -> [Angle] {
        guard count > 0 else { return [] }
        let step = 360.0 / Double(count)
        return (0..<count).map { .degrees(start.degrees + Double($0) * step) }
    }

    static func point(at angle: Angle, center: CGPoint, radius: CGFloat) -> CGPoint {
        CGPoint(
            x: center.x + radius * cos(angle.radians),
            y: center.y + radius * sin(angle.radians)
        )
    }
}

/// A layout that spreads its views around a circle.
///
/// Change the number of views inside `withAnimation` and the others glide to their new places.
/// Leave `radius` as `nil` to fill the space it is given.
struct RadialLayout: Layout {
    var radius: CGFloat?
    var startAngle: Angle = .degrees(-90)

    func sizeThatFits(proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) -> CGSize {
        if let radius {
            let side = 2 * radius + largestSide(of: subviews)
            return CGSize(width: side, height: side)
        }
        let size = proposal.replacingUnspecifiedDimensions(by: CGSize(width: 280, height: 280))
        let side = min(size.width, size.height)
        return CGSize(width: side, height: side)
    }

    func placeSubviews(in bounds: CGRect, proposal: ProposedViewSize, subviews: Subviews, cache: inout ()) {
        let center = CGPoint(x: bounds.midX, y: bounds.midY)
        let circleRadius = radius ?? max(min(bounds.width, bounds.height) / 2 - largestSide(of: subviews) / 2, 0)

        for (subview, angle) in zip(subviews, RadialLayoutMath.angles(count: subviews.count, start: startAngle)) {
            subview.place(
                at: RadialLayoutMath.point(at: angle, center: center, radius: circleRadius),
                anchor: .center,
                proposal: .unspecified
            )
        }
    }

    private func largestSide(of subviews: Subviews) -> CGFloat {
        subviews.map {
            let size = $0.sizeThatFits(.unspecified)
            return max(size.width, size.height)
        }.max() ?? 0
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct DemoApp: Identifiable {
    var id: String { name }
    let name: String
    let symbol: String
    let color: Color
}

struct RadialLayoutDemo: View {
    private static let all = [
        DemoApp(name: "Music", symbol: "music.note", color: .pink),
        DemoApp(name: "Photos", symbol: "photo.fill", color: .orange),
        DemoApp(name: "Maps", symbol: "map.fill", color: .green),
        DemoApp(name: "Mail", symbol: "envelope.fill", color: .blue),
        DemoApp(name: "Notes", symbol: "note.text", color: .yellow),
        DemoApp(name: "Weather", symbol: "cloud.sun.fill", color: .cyan),
        DemoApp(name: "Health", symbol: "heart.fill", color: .red),
        DemoApp(name: "Clock", symbol: "clock.fill", color: .purple),
        DemoApp(name: "Camera", symbol: "camera.fill", color: .teal),
    ]

    @State private var count = 5
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title2) private var iconSize = 64.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 40) {
            ZStack {
                RadialLayout {
                    ForEach(Self.all.prefix(count)) { app in
                        Image(systemName: app.symbol)
                            .font(.title2)
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                            .frame(width: iconSize, height: iconSize)
                            .background(app.color.gradient, in: .circle)
                            .accessibilityLabel(app.name)
                            .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
                    }
                }

                Text("\(count)")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    .contentTransition(.numericText(value: Double(count)))
                    .accessibilityLabel("\(count) apps")
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: 340, maxHeight: 340)

            HStack(spacing: 14) {
                Button("Remove", systemImage: "minus") { change(by: -1) }
                    .disabled(count == 1)
                Button("Add", systemImage: "plus") { change(by: 1) }
                    .disabled(count == Self.all.count)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .controlSize(.large)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.18), .teal.opacity(0.14)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }

    private func change(by amount: Int) {
        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .bouncy(duration: 0.55)) { count += amount }
    }
}
```

## Readable Width Container

A wrapper that caps its content to a comfortable reading width and centers it on large iPad screens.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/ReadableWidthContainer/ReadableWidthContainer.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

import SwiftUI

/// Caps its content to a comfortable reading width and centers it on wide screens.
/// The limit grows with Dynamic Type, so lines keep about the same number of words.
struct ReadableWidthContainer<Content: View>: View {
    @ScaledMetric private var maxWidth: CGFloat
    private let content: Content

    init(maxWidth: CGFloat = 640, @ViewBuilder content: () -> Content) {
        _maxWidth = ScaledMetric(wrappedValue: maxWidth.isFinite ? max(0, maxWidth) : 640, relativeTo: .body)
        self.content = content()
    }

    var body: some View {
        content
            .frame(maxWidth: maxWidth, alignment: .leading)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }
}
```

## Subview Card Container

A custom container that styles each child of its ViewBuilder as a card.

Category: Layouts. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Layouts/SubviewCardContainer/SubviewCardContainer.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

extension ContainerValues {
    @Entry var subviewCardTint: Color = .accentColor
}

extension View {
    /// The color of the card this view gets inside a `SubviewCardContainer`.
    func subviewCardTint(_ color: Color) -> some View {
        containerValue(\.subviewCardTint, color)
    }
}

/// A container that turns every child of its `@ViewBuilder` into a tinted card.
///
/// `ForEach(subviews:)` sees each resolved child, so it works the same for
/// static views and for children that come from a `ForEach` or an `if`.
struct SubviewCardContainer<Content: View>: View {
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12
    @ViewBuilder var content: Content

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: spacing) {
            ForEach(subviews: content) { subview in
                let tint = subview.containerValues.subviewCardTint

                subview
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    .padding(16)
                    .padding(.leading, 6)
                    .background(tint.opacity(0.16), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
                    .overlay(alignment: .leading) {
                        Capsule()
                            .fill(tint.gradient)
                            .frame(width: 5)
                            .padding(.vertical, 12)
                            .padding(.leading, 8)
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    }
                    .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale(scale: 0.9).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SubviewCardContainerDemo: View {
    private static let colors: [Color] = [.pink, .orange, .teal, .purple, .green]

    @State private var reminders = 1
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
```
