## Double Tap Seek Overlay

Double tapping the left or right half of a video skips back or forward with a ripple and a seconds label.

Category: Media. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Media/DoubleTapSeekOverlay/DoubleTapSeekOverlay.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum DoubleTapSeekOverlaySide: Sendable {
    case backward, forward
}

struct DoubleTapSeekOverlayRequest: Equatable {
    let id = UUID()
    let side: DoubleTapSeekOverlaySide
}

/// Adds up repeated double taps on one side, like "+10 s" then "+20 s".
struct DoubleTapSeekOverlayTally: Equatable {
    private(set) var side: DoubleTapSeekOverlaySide?
    private(set) var seconds = 0.0

    static func side(forX x: CGFloat, width: CGFloat) -> DoubleTapSeekOverlaySide {
        x < width / 2 ? .backward : .forward
    }

    mutating func record(_ newSide: DoubleTapSeekOverlaySide, interval: Double) {
        seconds = side == newSide ? seconds + interval : interval
        side = newSide
    }

    mutating func reset() {
        self = DoubleTapSeekOverlayTally()
    }
}

/// Double tap the left or right half of a video to skip back or forward.
///
/// `onSeek` receives the seconds to move, negative when going back. Put buttons in `controls`,
/// which sits above the seek gesture: a double tap on one runs it and does not seek, while one
/// left inside `video` would do both. VoiceOver users get the same skips as named actions.
/// With Reduce Motion on, the ripple is left out.
struct DoubleTapSeekOverlay<Video: View, Controls: View>: View {
    var interval = 10.0
    let onSeek: (Double) -> Void
    /// Skips without a touch, for demos. Each new value is one skip.
    var programmaticSeek: DoubleTapSeekOverlayRequest? = nil
    @ViewBuilder var video: () -> Video
    @ViewBuilder var controls: () -> Controls

    @State private var tally = DoubleTapSeekOverlayTally()
    @State private var tapCount = 0
    @State private var tapLocation = CGPoint.zero
    @State private var videoSize = CGSize.zero
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.layoutDirection) private var layoutDirection

    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .easeOut(duration: 0.2) }
    private var intervalText: String { interval.formatted() }

    var body: some View {
        video()
            .contentShape(.rect)
            .onGeometryChange(for: CGSize.self) { $0.size } action: { videoSize = $0 }
            // Simultaneous, so a tap handler inside the video still runs.
            .simultaneousGesture(
                SpatialTapGesture(count: 2).onEnded { value in
                    tapLocation = value.location
                    seek(DoubleTapSeekOverlayTally.side(forX: value.location.x, width: videoSize.width))
                }
            )
            .overlay {
                GeometryReader { proxy in
                    ZStack {
                        Color.clear
                            .allowsHitTesting(false)
                            .accessibilityElement()
                            .accessibilityLabel("Seek area")
                            .accessibilityAction(named: "Skip back \(intervalText) seconds") { seek(.backward) }
                            .accessibilityAction(named: "Skip forward \(intervalText) seconds") { seek(.forward) }

                        if let side = tally.side {
                            feedback(side, in: proxy.size).transition(.opacity)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            .overlay { controls() }
            .onChange(of: programmaticSeek) { _, request in
                guard let request else { return }
                tapLocation = CGPoint(x: videoSize.width * (request.side == .forward ? 0.75 : 0.25), y: videoSize.height / 2)
                seek(request.side)
            }
            .task(id: tapCount) {
                guard tapCount > 0 else { return }
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.9))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                withAnimation(animation) { tally.reset() }
            }
    }

    private func feedback(_ side: DoubleTapSeekOverlaySide, in size: CGSize) -> some View {
        let halfWidth = size.width / 2
        let isForward = side == .forward
        let rippleCenter = CGPoint(x: isForward ? tapLocation.x - halfWidth : tapLocation.x, y: tapLocation.y)

        return ZStack {
            Color.black.opacity(0.22)

            if !reduceMotion {
                DoubleTapSeekOverlayRipple(center: rippleCenter, diameter: max(size.width, size.height))
                    .id(tapCount)
            }

            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Image(systemName: isForward ? "forward.fill" : "backward.fill").font(.title2)
                Text("\(isForward ? "+" : "-")\(tally.seconds.formatted()) s")
                    .font(.headline.monospacedDigit())
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .environment(\.layoutDirection, layoutDirection)
        }
        .frame(width: max(halfWidth, 0), height: max(size.height, 0))
        .clipped()
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: isForward ? .trailing : .leading)
        // Playback keeps its sides in right-to-left layouts: back stays on the left, where the taps are counted.
        .environment(\.layoutDirection, .leftToRight)
        .allowsHitTesting(false)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    private func seek(_ side: DoubleTapSeekOverlaySide) {
        guard interval > 0 else { return }
        withAnimation(animation) { tally.record(side, interval: interval) }
        tapCount &+= 1
        onSeek(side == .backward ? -interval : interval)
    }
}

extension DoubleTapSeekOverlay where Controls == EmptyView {
    init(interval: Double = 10.0, onSeek: @escaping (Double) -> Void, programmaticSeek: DoubleTapSeekOverlayRequest? = nil, @ViewBuilder video: @escaping () -> Video) {
        self.init(interval: interval, onSeek: onSeek, programmaticSeek: programmaticSeek, video: video, controls: { EmptyView() })
    }
}

private struct DoubleTapSeekOverlayRipple: View {
    let center: CGPoint
    let diameter: CGFloat

    @State private var isExpanded = false

    var body: some View {
        Circle()
            .fill(.white.opacity(0.35))
            .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
            .scaleEffect(isExpanded ? 1 : 0.1)
            .opacity(isExpanded ? 0 : 1)
            .position(center)
            .onAppear {
                withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.55)) { isExpanded = true }
            }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct DoubleTapSeekOverlayDemo: View {
    private let duration = 180.0

    @State private var position = 60.0
    @State private var seekRequest: DoubleTapSeekOverlayRequest?
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color.black.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 18) {
                Text("Double tap either side")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.8))

                DoubleTapSeekOverlay(onSeek: { position = min(max(position + $0, 0), duration) }, programmaticSeek: seekRequest) {
                    videoPlaceholder
                }
                .aspectRatio(16 / 9, contentMode: .fit)
                .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 16))

                ProgressView(value: position, total: duration)
                    .tint(.red)
                    .accessibilityLabel("Playback position")

                Text(Duration.seconds(position).formatted(.time(pattern: .minuteSecond)))
                    .font(.title3.monospacedDigit())
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
        }
        .task(id: reduceMotion) {
            guard !reduceMotion else { return }
            await playSeeks()
        }
    }

    // Only the demo plays by itself, because a real double tap needs a finger.
    private func playSeeks() async {
        let steps: [(side: DoubleTapSeekOverlaySide, delay: Double)] = [(.forward, 0.7), (.forward, 0.45), (.backward, 1.5), (.backward, 0.45)]
        while !Task.isCancelled {
            for step in steps {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(step.delay))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                seekRequest = DoubleTapSeekOverlayRequest(side: step.side)
            }
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.2))
        }
    }

    private var videoPlaceholder: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 20.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { context in
            let time = reduceMotion ? 0 : context.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate
            LinearGradient(
                colors: [.indigo, .purple, .orange],
                startPoint: UnitPoint(x: 0.5 + sin(time * 0.7) * 0.5, y: 0),
                endPoint: UnitPoint(x: 0.5 - sin(time * 0.7) * 0.5, y: 1)
            )
        }
        .overlay {
            Image(systemName: "film")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, weight: .light))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.45))
        }
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

#Preview {
    DoubleTapSeekOverlayDemo()
}
```

## Expanding Mini Player

A mini player bar that morphs into a full player when it is tapped or pulled up.

Category: Media. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Media/ExpandingMiniPlayer/ExpandingMiniPlayer.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A mini player over your content that grows into a full player when tapped or pulled up.
///
/// Pull the full player down, or use its close button, to shrink it again.
/// With Reduce Motion on, the two states swap without morphing.
struct ExpandingMiniPlayer<Content: View, Artwork: View>: View {
    private enum MorphID: Hashable { case background, artwork }

    let title: String
    let subtitle: String
    @Binding var isPlaying: Bool
    /// From 0 to 1.
    var progress = 0.0
    var onPrevious: () -> Void = {}
    var onNext: () -> Void = {}
    @ViewBuilder var content: () -> Content
    @ViewBuilder var artwork: () -> Artwork

    @State private var isExpanded = false
    @GestureState private var dragOffset: CGFloat = 0
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .subheadline) private var barHeight = 64.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .subheadline) private var miniArtworkSize = 46.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let minTouchTarget: CGFloat = 44
    private let miniBarSpacing: CGFloat = 12

    private var safeProgress: Double { progress.isFinite ? min(max(progress, 0), 1) : 0 }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .bottom) {
            content()
                .safeAreaPadding(.bottom, barHeight + 16)
                .accessibilityHidden(isExpanded)

            if isExpanded {
                fullPlayer.zIndex(1)
            } else {
                miniBar
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.3, bounce: 0.1), value: dragOffset)
    }

    // MARK: Mini player

    private var miniBar: some View {
        HStack(spacing: miniBarSpacing) {
            Button { setExpanded(true) } label: {
                HStack(spacing: miniBarSpacing) {
                    artwork()
                        .frame(width: miniArtworkSize, height: miniArtworkSize)
                        .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 10))
                        .matchedGeometryEffect(id: MorphID.artwork, in: namespace)

                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 1) {
                        Text(title).font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                        Text(subtitle).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }
                    .lineLimit(1)

                    Spacer(minLength: 0)
                }
                .contentShape(.rect)
            }
            .accessibilityLabel("Open player")
            .accessibilityValue("\(title), \(subtitle)")

            playButton(font: .title3)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .padding(.horizontal, 10)
        .frame(minHeight: barHeight)
        .background {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 18)
                .fill(.regularMaterial)
                .matchedGeometryEffect(id: MorphID.background, in: namespace)
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.18), radius: 12, y: 4)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 12)
        .padding(.bottom, 8)
        .offset(y: min(dragOffset, 0) * 0.25)
        .simultaneousGesture(dragGesture)
    }

    // MARK: Full player

    private var fullPlayer: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 24) {
            Button { setExpanded(false) } label: {
                Image(systemName: "chevron.compact.down")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: minTouchTarget)
                    .contentShape(.rect)
            }
            .accessibilityLabel("Close player")

            Color.clear
                .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
                .overlay { artwork() }
                .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 28))
                .matchedGeometryEffect(id: MorphID.artwork, in: namespace)
                .frame(maxWidth: 360)
                .layoutPriority(-1)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text(title).font(.title2.bold())
                Text(subtitle).font(.body).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .lineLimit(2)
            .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

            ProgressView(value: safeProgress)
                .accessibilityLabel("Playback position")

            HStack(spacing: 44) {
                transportButton("backward.fill", label: "Previous", action: onPrevious)
                playButton(font: .largeTitle)
                transportButton("forward.fill", label: "Next", action: onNext)
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .padding(.horizontal, 28)
        .padding(.top, 8)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background {
            Rectangle()
                .fill(.thickMaterial)
                .matchedGeometryEffect(id: MorphID.background, in: namespace)
                .ignoresSafeArea()
        }
        .contentShape(.rect)
        .gesture(dragGesture)
        .offset(y: max(dragOffset, 0))
        .accessibilityAction(.escape) { setExpanded(false) }
    }

    // MARK: Parts

    private func playButton(font: Font) -> some View {
        Button { isPlaying.toggle() } label: {
            Image(systemName: isPlaying ? "pause.fill" : "play.fill")
                .font(font)
                .frame(minWidth: minTouchTarget, minHeight: minTouchTarget)
                .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .accessibilityLabel(isPlaying ? "Pause" : "Play")
    }

    private func transportButton(_ systemImage: String, label: String, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: systemImage)
                .font(.title)
                .frame(minWidth: minTouchTarget, minHeight: minTouchTarget)
                .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }

    private var dragGesture: some Gesture {
        DragGesture(minimumDistance: 12)
            .updating($dragOffset) { value, offset, _ in
                offset = value.translation.height
            }
            .onEnded { value in
                let distance = value.translation.height
                let predicted = value.predictedEndTranslation.height
                if isExpanded {
                    if distance > 120 || predicted > 320 { setExpanded(false) }
                } else if distance < -40 || predicted < -160 {
                    setExpanded(true)
                }
            }
    }

    private func setExpanded(_ expanded: Bool) {
        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.5, bounce: 0.15)) {
            isExpanded = expanded
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ExpandingMiniPlayerDemo: View {
    private let songs = ["Midnight Drive", "Paper Planes", "Slow Tides", "Golden Hour", "Neon Rain", "Open Road", "Quiet Storm", "First Light"]

    @State private var isPlaying = false
    @State private var progress = 0.2
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var coverSize = 48.0

    var body: some View {
        ExpandingMiniPlayer(
            title: "Midnight Drive",
            subtitle: "The Night Owls",
            isPlaying: $isPlaying,
            progress: progress
        ) {
            NavigationStack {
                List(songs, id: \.self) { song in
                    HStack(spacing: 14) {
                        cover.frame(width: coverSize, height: coverSize)
                            .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 10))
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                        Text(song).font(.body)
                    }
                }
                .navigationTitle("Library")
            }
        } artwork: {
            cover
        }
        .task(id: isPlaying) {
            guard isPlaying else { return }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(100))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                progress = progress >= 1 ? 0 : progress + 0.004
            }
        }
    }

    private var cover: some View {
        LinearGradient(colors: [.purple, .pink, .orange], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
            .overlay {
                Image(systemName: "music.note")
                    .resizable()
                    .scaledToFit()
                    .padding(14)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9))
            }
    }
}

#Preview {
    ExpandingMiniPlayerDemo()
}
```

## Shutter Capture Button

A camera shutter whose inner shape shrinks on press and flashes a ring on capture, with a photo and video toggle.

Category: Media. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Media/ShutterCaptureButton/ShutterCaptureButton.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum ShutterCaptureButtonMode: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable, Sendable {
    case photo = "Photo"
    case video = "Video"

    var id: Self { self }
}

/// A camera shutter with a photo and video toggle.
///
/// In photo mode a tap calls `onCapture` and flashes a ring. In video mode a tap
/// toggles `isRecording`. With Reduce Motion on, the shape changes without moving.
struct ShutterCaptureButton: View {
    @Binding var mode: ShutterCaptureButtonMode
    @Binding var isRecording: Bool
    var onCapture: () -> Void = {}

    @State private var captureCount = 0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var scaledSize = 80.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var size: CGFloat { min(scaledSize, 120) }
    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.25) }

    private var label: String {
        switch mode {
        case .photo: "Take photo"
        case .video: isRecording ? "Stop recording" : "Start recording"
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            HStack(spacing: 28) {
                ForEach(ShutterCaptureButtonMode.allCases) { option in
                    Button {
                        withAnimation(animation) { mode = option }
                    } label: {
                        // A word is too small to hit. The padding widens what answers to a
                        // touch, and the same padding taken back keeps the layout as it was.
                        Text(option.rawValue)
                            .padding(13)
                            .contentShape(.rect)
                            .padding(-13)
                    }
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(mode == option ? Color.yellow : Color.white)
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(mode == option ? .isSelected : [])
                }
            }
            .disabled(isRecording)
            .opacity(isRecording ? 0.4 : 1)

            Button(action: shutterTapped) {
                ZStack {
                    Circle().strokeBorder(.white, lineWidth: 4)

                    if captureCount > 0, !reduceMotion {
                        ShutterCaptureButtonFlash().id(captureCount)
                    }
                }
                .frame(width: size, height: size)
                .contentShape(.circle)
            }
            .buttonStyle(ShutterCaptureButtonStyle(mode: mode, isRecording: isRecording, size: size, reduceMotion: reduceMotion))
            .accessibilityLabel(label)
            .sensoryFeedback(.impact(flexibility: .rigid), trigger: captureCount)
            .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: isRecording)
        }
    }

    private func shutterTapped() {
        switch mode {
        case .photo:
            captureCount &+= 1
            onCapture()
        case .video:
            withAnimation(animation) { isRecording.toggle() }
        }
    }
}

/// Draws the inner shape: it shrinks while pressed and becomes a square while recording.
private struct ShutterCaptureButtonStyle: ButtonStyle {
    let mode: ShutterCaptureButtonMode
    let isRecording: Bool
    let size: CGFloat
    let reduceMotion: Bool

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        let innerSize = size * (isRecording ? 0.42 : 0.82)

        return configuration.label
            .background {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: isRecording ? 8 : innerSize / 2)
                    .fill(mode == .video ? Color.red : Color.white)
                    .frame(width: innerSize, height: innerSize)
                    .scaleEffect(configuration.isPressed && !reduceMotion ? 0.86 : 1)
                    .opacity(configuration.isPressed && reduceMotion ? 0.7 : 1)
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.15), value: configuration.isPressed)
            }
    }
}

private struct ShutterCaptureButtonFlash: View {
    @State private var isExpanded = false

    var body: some View {
        Circle()
            .stroke(.white, lineWidth: 3)
            .scaleEffect(isExpanded ? 1.4 : 1)
            .opacity(isExpanded ? 0 : 0.9)
            .onAppear {
                withAnimation(.easeOut(duration: 0.4)) { isExpanded = true }
            }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ShutterCaptureButtonDemo: View {
    @State private var mode = ShutterCaptureButtonMode.photo
    @State private var isRecording = false
    @State private var photos = 0

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color.black.ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 24) {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 24)
                    .fill(LinearGradient(colors: [.teal, .indigo, .purple], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
                    .overlay {
                        Image(systemName: "mountain.2.fill")
                            .font(.largeTitle)
                            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7))
                    }
                    .overlay(alignment: .top) {
                        Text(isRecording ? "Recording" : "\(photos) photos")
                            .font(.footnote.weight(.semibold).monospacedDigit())
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                            .padding(.horizontal, 12)
                            .padding(.vertical, 6)
                            .background(isRecording ? Color.red : Color.black.opacity(0.4), in: .capsule)
                            .padding(14)
                    }
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                ShutterCaptureButton(mode: $mode, isRecording: $isRecording) { photos += 1 }
            }
            .padding(16)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    ShutterCaptureButtonDemo()
}
```

## Spinning Vinyl Art

Circular album art on a vinyl disc that spins while playing and eases to a stop when paused.

Category: Media. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Media/SpinningVinylArt/SpinningVinylArt.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// The disc's angle over time. Speed ramps linearly after each change, so nothing jumps.
struct SpinningVinylArtSpin: Equatable {
    private var startAngle = 0.0
    private var startSpeed = 0.0
    private var targetSpeed = 0.0
    private var changedAt = Date.distantPast
    var ramp: TimeInterval = 0.9

    init(ramp: TimeInterval = 0.9) {
        self.ramp = ramp
    }

    func angle(at date: Date) -> Double {
        let elapsed = max(date.timeIntervalSince(changedAt), 0)
        let rampTime = max(ramp, 0)
        let duringRamp = min(elapsed, rampTime)
        let change = rampTime > 0 ? (targetSpeed - startSpeed) / rampTime : 0
        return startAngle + startSpeed * duringRamp + change * duringRamp * duringRamp / 2
            + targetSpeed * max(elapsed - rampTime, 0)
    }

    func speed(at date: Date) -> Double {
        let rampTime = max(ramp, 0)
        guard rampTime > 0 else { return targetSpeed }
        let fraction = min(max(date.timeIntervalSince(changedAt), 0) / rampTime, 1)
        return startSpeed + (targetSpeed - startSpeed) * fraction
    }

    mutating func setSpeed(_ speed: Double, at date: Date) {
        startAngle = angle(at: date).truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 360)
        startSpeed = self.speed(at: date)
        targetSpeed = speed
        changedAt = date
    }
}

/// Circular album art that spins while playing and eases to a stop when paused.
///
/// Pass any view as the art, usually `Image("cover").resizable().scaledToFill()`.
/// With Reduce Motion on, the disc stays still.
struct SpinningVinylArt<Artwork: View>: View {
    let isPlaying: Bool
    /// Revolutions per minute. A 33 rpm record is slow enough to read the label.
    var rpm = 33.0
    var accessibilityName = "Album art"
    @ViewBuilder var artwork: () -> Artwork

    @State private var spin = SpinningVinylArtSpin()
    @State private var isEasing = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var degreesPerSecond: Double { rpm.isFinite ? min(max(rpm, -1_000), 1_000) * 6 : 0 }

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 60.0, paused: reduceMotion || !(isPlaying || isEasing))) { context in
            disc.rotationEffect(.degrees(reduceMotion ? 0 : spin.angle(at: context.date)))
        }
        .overlay {
            Circle()
                .fill(AngularGradient(colors: [.clear, .white.opacity(0.22), .clear, .white.opacity(0.16), .clear], center: .center))
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
        .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel(accessibilityName)
        .task(id: [isPlaying, reduceMotion]) {
            guard !reduceMotion else { return }
            spin.setSpeed(isPlaying ? degreesPerSecond : 0, at: .now)
            isEasing = !isPlaying
            guard !isPlaying else { return }
            try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(max(spin.ramp, 0) + 0.05))
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            isEasing = false
        }
        .onChange(of: degreesPerSecond) {
            guard isPlaying, !reduceMotion else { return }
            spin.setSpeed(degreesPerSecond, at: .now)
        }
    }

    private var disc: some View {
        GeometryReader { proxy in
            let side = max(min(proxy.size.width, proxy.size.height), 0)

            ZStack {
                Circle().fill(Color(white: 0.08))

                ForEach(1..<8, id: \.self) { ring in
                    Circle()
                        .stroke(.white.opacity(0.06), lineWidth: 1)
                        .padding(side * CGFloat(ring) * 0.028)
                }

                artwork()
                    .frame(width: side * 0.6, height: side * 0.6)
                    .clipShape(.circle)

                Circle()
                    .fill(Color(white: 0.08))
                    .frame(width: side * 0.05, height: side * 0.05)
            }
            .frame(width: side, height: side)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SpinningVinylArtDemo: View {
    @State private var isPlaying = true
    /// Only for this demo: it plays by itself until someone touches it.
    @State private var isAutoPlaying = true
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.black, .indigo], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 36) {
                SpinningVinylArt(isPlaying: isPlaying) {
                    LinearGradient(colors: [.orange, .pink, .purple], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                        .overlay {
                            Image(systemName: "music.quarternote.3")
                                .font(.largeTitle)
                                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        }
                }
                .padding(.horizontal, 28)

                Button {
                    isPlaying.toggle()
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: isPlaying ? "pause.circle.fill" : "play.circle.fill")
                        .font(.system(.largeTitle, weight: .regular))
                        .imageScale(.large)
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                }
                .accessibilityLabel(isPlaying ? "Pause" : "Play")
            }
        }
        .simultaneousGesture(DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0).onChanged { _ in isAutoPlaying = false })
        .task(id: reduceMotion) {
            guard !reduceMotion else { return }
            while isAutoPlaying {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(isPlaying ? 2.2 : 1.4))
                guard !Task.isCancelled, isAutoPlaying else { return }
                isPlaying.toggle()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Video Player Chrome

Custom controls over any video view that show on tap, hide after a few seconds and include a scrubber.

Category: Media. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Media/VideoPlayerChrome/VideoPlayerChrome.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Custom controls over any video view. A tap shows them and they hide after a few seconds of playback.
///
/// Pass `VideoPlayer(player: player)`, or your own player layer, as the video, and drive
/// `isPlaying` and `currentTime` from it. With VoiceOver on, the controls never hide.
struct VideoPlayerChrome<Video: View>: View {
    private struct HideKey: Hashable {
        let isVisible, isPlaying, isScrubbing: Bool
        let activity: Int
    }

    let title: String
    let duration: TimeInterval
    @Binding var currentTime: TimeInterval
    @Binding var isPlaying: Bool
    var hideDelay: TimeInterval = 3
    @ViewBuilder var video: () -> Video

    @State private var isVisible = true
    @State private var isScrubbing = false
    @State private var activity = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.accessibilityVoiceOverEnabled) private var voiceOverEnabled

    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.25) }
    private var showsChrome: Bool { isVisible || voiceOverEnabled }
    private var safeDuration: TimeInterval { duration.isFinite ? min(max(duration, 0), 360_000) : 0 }
    private var position: TimeInterval { currentTime.isFinite ? min(max(currentTime, 0), safeDuration) : 0 }

    private var hideKey: HideKey {
        HideKey(isVisible: isVisible, isPlaying: isPlaying, isScrubbing: isScrubbing, activity: activity)
    }

    var body: some View {
        video()
            .overlay {
                ZStack {
                    Color.clear
                        .contentShape(.rect)
                        .onTapGesture {
                            withAnimation(animation) { isVisible.toggle() }
                        }
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)

                    if showsChrome {
                        chrome.transition(.opacity)
                    }
                }
            }
            .task(id: hideKey) {
                guard isVisible, isPlaying, !isScrubbing, !voiceOverEnabled else { return }
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(max(hideDelay, 0)))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                withAnimation(animation) { isVisible = false }
            }
    }

    private var chrome: some View {
        VStack {
            Text(title)
                .font(.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .lineLimit(2)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)

            Spacer(minLength: 8)

            HStack(spacing: 44) {
                transportButton("gobackward.10", label: "Back 10 seconds") { seek(by: -10) }

                transportButton(isPlaying ? "pause.fill" : "play.fill", label: isPlaying ? "Pause" : "Play", font: .largeTitle) {
                    isPlaying.toggle()
                    activity &+= 1
                }

                transportButton("goforward.10", label: "Forward 10 seconds") { seek(by: 10) }
            }

            Spacer(minLength: 8)

            scrubber
        }
        .padding(16)
        .background {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.black.opacity(0.6), .clear, .black.opacity(0.6)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()
                .allowsHitTesting(false)
        }
    }

    private var scrubber: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 2) {
            Slider(
                value: Binding(get: { position }, set: { currentTime = $0 }),
                in: 0...max(safeDuration, 1),
                onEditingChanged: { isScrubbing = $0 }
            )
            .tint(.white)
            .disabled(safeDuration == 0)
            .accessibilityLabel("Playback position")
            .accessibilityValue("\(timeText(position)) of \(timeText(safeDuration))")

            HStack {
                Text(timeText(position))
                Spacer()
                Text(timeText(safeDuration))
            }
            .font(.caption.monospacedDigit())
            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
    }

    private func transportButton(
        _ systemImage: String,
        label: String,
        font: Font = .title2,
        action: @escaping () -> Void
    ) -> some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: systemImage)
                .font(font)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .frame(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44)
                .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }

    private func seek(by delta: TimeInterval) {
        currentTime = min(max(position + delta, 0), safeDuration)
        activity &+= 1
    }

    private func timeText(_ seconds: TimeInterval) -> String {
        Duration.seconds(max(seconds, 0)).formatted(.time(pattern: .minuteSecond))
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct VideoPlayerChromeDemo: View {
    private let duration: TimeInterval = 120

    @State private var currentTime: TimeInterval = 34
    @State private var isPlaying = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VideoPlayerChrome(title: "Sunset Over the Bay", duration: duration, currentTime: $currentTime, isPlaying: $isPlaying) {
            TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 20.0, paused: reduceMotion || !isPlaying)) { context in
                let time = context.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate
                LinearGradient(
                    colors: [.orange, .pink, .indigo],
                    startPoint: UnitPoint(x: 0.5 + sin(time * 0.6) * 0.5, y: 0),
                    endPoint: UnitPoint(x: 0.5 - sin(time * 0.6) * 0.5, y: 1)
                )
                .ignoresSafeArea()
            }
            .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
        .task(id: isPlaying) {
            guard isPlaying else { return }
            while currentTime < duration {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.25))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                currentTime += 0.25
            }
            isPlaying = false
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    VideoPlayerChromeDemo()
}
```

## Video Poster To Player

A poster with a play button that opens into the playing video in the same frame through a growing circle.

Category: Media. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Media/VideoPosterToPlayer/VideoPosterToPlayer.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A poster with a play button that opens into the playing video, in the same frame.
///
/// Pass any views: usually `Image("poster").resizable().scaledToFill()` and
/// `VideoPlayer(player: player)`. Start and stop your player from `isPlaying`.
/// With Reduce Motion on, the video fades in instead of opening from the button.
struct VideoPosterToPlayer<Poster: View, Player: View>: View {
    @Binding var isPlaying: Bool
    var aspectRatio: CGFloat = 16.0 / 9.0
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 22
    @ViewBuilder var poster: () -> Poster
    @ViewBuilder var player: () -> Player

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var buttonSize = 72.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.6) }

    var body: some View {
        Color.clear
            .aspectRatio(aspectRatio.isFinite && aspectRatio > 0 ? aspectRatio : 16.0 / 9.0, contentMode: .fit)
            .overlay { poster().accessibilityHidden(true) }
            .overlay {
                if isPlaying {
                    player().transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : AnyTransition(VideoPosterToPlayerReveal()))
                }
            }
            .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
                if isPlaying {
                    Button {
                        withAnimation(animation) { isPlaying = false }
                    } label: {
                        Image(systemName: "xmark")
                            .font(.footnote.bold())
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                            .frame(width: 36, height: 36)
                            .background(.black.opacity(0.5), in: .circle)
                            // The padding is part of the button, so all of it answers to a touch.
                            .padding(10)
                            .contentShape(.rect)
                    }
                    .accessibilityLabel("Close video")
                    .transition(.opacity)
                }
            }
            .overlay {
                if !isPlaying {
                    Button {
                        withAnimation(animation) { isPlaying = true }
                    } label: {
                        Image(systemName: "play.fill")
                            .font(.title)
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                            .frame(width: buttonSize, height: buttonSize)
                            .background(.ultraThinMaterial, in: .circle)
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .accessibilityLabel("Play video")
                    .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale(scale: 1.8).combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
    }
}

/// Reveals the player through a circle that grows from the center until it covers the frame.
private struct VideoPosterToPlayerReveal: Transition {
    func body(content: Content, phase: TransitionPhase) -> some View {
        content.mask {
            GeometryReader { proxy in
                let diameter = hypot(proxy.size.width, proxy.size.height)

                Circle()
                    .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
                    .scaleEffect(phase.isIdentity ? 1 : 0.05)
                    .position(x: proxy.size.width / 2, y: proxy.size.height / 2)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Waveform Scrubber

An audio waveform of bars that you drag to seek and that fills as playback moves on.

Category: Media. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Media/WaveformScrubber/WaveformScrubber.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum WaveformScrubberMath {
    /// The playback position for a touch at `x`, from 0 to 1.
    static func progress(forX x: CGFloat, width: CGFloat) -> Double {
        guard width > 0, x.isFinite else { return 0 }
        return Double(min(max(x / width, 0), 1))
    }

    /// Averages the samples into `count` bars, each from 0 to 1.
    static func bars(from samples: [Double], count: Int) -> [Double] {
        guard count > 0, !samples.isEmpty else { return [] }
        return (0..<count).map { index in
            let start = index * samples.count / count
            let end = max((index + 1) * samples.count / count, start + 1)
            let bucket = samples[start..<min(end, samples.count)]
            let total = bucket.reduce(0) { $0 + ($1.isFinite ? min(max($1, 0), 1) : 0) }
            return total / Double(bucket.count)
        }
    }

    /// How many bars of this width and spacing fit in `width`.
    static func barCount(width: CGFloat, barWidth: CGFloat, spacing: CGFloat) -> Int {
        let pitch = barWidth + max(spacing, 0)
        guard width > 0, barWidth > 0, pitch > 0, (width / pitch).isFinite else { return 0 }
        return Int(min(width / pitch, 2_000))
    }
}

/// An audio waveform of bars. Drag it to seek. It fills as `progress` moves on.
///
/// `samples` are loudness values from 0 to 1. With Reduce Motion on, the bars don't grow during a drag.
struct WaveformScrubber: View {
    let samples: [Double]
    @Binding var progress: Double
    var tint: Color = .accentColor
    var barWidth: CGFloat = 3
    var spacing: CGFloat = 2
    var onScrubbingChanged: (Bool) -> Void = { _ in }

    @GestureState private var isDragging = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var safeProgress: Double { progress.isFinite ? min(max(progress, 0), 1) : 0 }

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { proxy in
            canvas
                .contentShape(.rect)
                .gesture(
                    DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)
                        .updating($isDragging) { _, state, _ in state = true }
                        .onChanged { progress = WaveformScrubberMath.progress(forX: $0.location.x, width: proxy.size.width) }
                )
        }
        .scaleEffect(y: isDragging && !reduceMotion ? 1.12 : 1)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.2), value: isDragging)
        .onChange(of: isDragging) { _, dragging in onScrubbingChanged(dragging) }
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel("Playback position")
        .accessibilityValue(safeProgress.formatted(.percent.precision(.fractionLength(0))))
        .accessibilityAdjustableAction { direction in
            switch direction {
            case .increment: progress = min(safeProgress + 0.05, 1)
            case .decrement: progress = max(safeProgress - 0.05, 0)
            @unknown default: break
            }
        }
    }

    private var canvas: some View {
        Canvas { context, size in
            let count = WaveformScrubberMath.barCount(width: size.width, barWidth: barWidth, spacing: spacing)
            let bars = WaveformScrubberMath.bars(from: samples, count: count)
            guard !bars.isEmpty else { return }

            var path = Path()
            for (index, level) in bars.enumerated() {
                let height = max(size.height * level, barWidth)
                let rect = CGRect(
                    x: CGFloat(index) * (barWidth + max(spacing, 0)),
                    y: (size.height - height) / 2,
                    width: barWidth,
                    height: height
                )
                path.addRoundedRect(in: rect, cornerSize: CGSize(width: barWidth / 2, height: barWidth / 2))
            }

            context.fill(path, with: .color(.secondary.opacity(0.35)))

            var played = context
            played.clip(to: Path(CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: size.width * safeProgress, height: size.height)))
            played.fill(path, with: .color(tint))
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct WaveformScrubberDemo: View {
    private static let samples = (0..<160).map { index in
        let time = Double(index)
        return min(abs(sin(time * 0.31)) * 0.55 + abs(sin(time * 0.083)) * 0.45, 1)
    }

    @State private var progress = 0.08
    @State private var isPlaying = false
    @State private var isScrubbing = false

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.black, Color(red: 0.12, green: 0.1, blue: 0.3)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            WaveformScrubber(samples: Self.samples, progress: $progress, tint: .mint, onScrubbingChanged: { isScrubbing = $0 })
                .frame(height: 130)
                .padding(.horizontal, 20)
                .environment(\.colorScheme, .dark)
        }
        .overlay(alignment: .top) {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                Text("Morning Voice Note").font(.title2.bold())
                Text(progress.formatted(.percent.precision(.fractionLength(0))))
                    .font(.headline.monospacedDigit())
                    .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.7))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(.top, 60)
        }
        .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
            Button {
                isPlaying.toggle()
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: isPlaying ? "pause.circle.fill" : "play.circle.fill")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .imageScale(.large)
                    .foregroundStyle(.mint)
            }
            .accessibilityLabel(isPlaying ? "Pause" : "Play")
            .padding(.bottom, 60)
        }
        .task(id: isPlaying) {
            guard isPlaying else { return }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                if !isScrubbing { progress = progress >= 1 ? 0 : min(progress + 0.0035, 1) }
            }
        }
    }
}

    WaveformScrubberDemo()
}
```

## Coach Mark Tour

A guided tour that dims the screen and spotlights a sequence of views with a step card next to each one.

Category: Menus. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Menus/CoachMarkTour/CoachMarkTour.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct CoachMarkTourStep: Identifiable {
    /// Matches the id passed to `coachMarkTourTarget(_:)`.
    let id: String
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let message: LocalizedStringResource
}

/// Where the tour is. `advance` and `finish` report the end only once.
struct CoachMarkTourProgress: Equatable {
    private(set) var index = 0
    private(set) var isFinished = false

    /// Moves to the next step. Returns `true` when this call finished the tour.
    mutating func advance(stepCount: Int) -> Bool {
        guard !isFinished else { return false }
        if index + 1 < stepCount {
            index += 1
            return false
        }
        return finish()
    }

    /// Ends the tour. Returns `true` only the first time.
    mutating func finish() -> Bool {
        guard !isFinished else { return false }
        isFinished = true
        return true
    }

    /// Keeps the index valid when the list of steps shrinks.
    mutating func clamp(stepCount: Int) {
        index = max(min(index, stepCount - 1), 0)
    }

    mutating func restart() {
        self = CoachMarkTourProgress()
    }
}

private struct CoachMarkTourAnchorKey: PreferenceKey {
    static var defaultValue: [String: Anchor<CGRect>] { [:] }

    static func reduce(value: inout [String: Anchor<CGRect>], nextValue: () -> [String: Anchor<CGRect>]) {
        value.merge(nextValue()) { $1 }
    }
}

extension View {
    /// Marks this view as the target of the tour step with the same id.
    func coachMarkTourTarget(_ id: String) -> some View {
        anchorPreference(key: CoachMarkTourAnchorKey.self, value: .bounds) { [id: $0] }
    }

    /// Runs a guided tour over this view. Apply it to a container of all the targets.
    func coachMarkTour(
        steps: [CoachMarkTourStep],
        isPresented: Binding<Bool>,
        onFinish: @escaping () -> Void = {}
    ) -> some View {
        modifier(CoachMarkTourModifier(steps: steps, isPresented: isPresented, onFinish: onFinish))
    }
}

private struct CoachMarkTourModifier: ViewModifier {
    let steps: [CoachMarkTourStep]
    @Binding var isPresented: Bool
    let onFinish: () -> Void

    @State private var progress = CoachMarkTourProgress()
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.45) }

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .overlayPreferenceValue(CoachMarkTourAnchorKey.self) { anchors in
                GeometryReader { outer in
                    if isPresented, !progress.isFinished, steps.indices.contains(progress.index) {
                        let step = steps[progress.index]

                        GeometryReader { proxy in
                            let hole = anchors[step.id].map { proxy[$0].insetBy(dx: -8, dy: -8) }
                            overlay(step: step, hole: hole, screen: proxy.size, insets: outer.safeAreaInsets)
                        }
                        .ignoresSafeArea()
                        .transition(.opacity)
                    }
                }
            }
            .onChange(of: steps.count) { _, count in progress.clamp(stepCount: count) }
            .onChange(of: isPresented) { _, presented in
                if presented { progress.restart() }
            }
            .onChange(of: isPresented && steps.isEmpty, initial: true) { _, hasNothingToShow in
                guard hasNothingToShow else { return }
                progress.restart()
                skip()
            }
    }

    private func overlay(step: CoachMarkTourStep, hole: CGRect?, screen: CGSize, insets: EdgeInsets) -> some View {
        let holeRect = hole ?? CGRect(x: screen.width / 2, y: screen.height / 2, width: 0, height: 0)
        let placeBelow = screen.height - holeRect.maxY >= holeRect.minY
        let available = max(
            placeBelow ? screen.height - holeRect.maxY - insets.bottom - 24 : holeRect.minY - insets.top - 24,
            120
        )

        return ZStack(alignment: placeBelow ? .top : .bottom) {
            CoachMarkTourDim(hole: holeRect)
                .fill(.black.opacity(0.65), style: FillStyle(eoFill: true))
                .contentShape(.rect)
                .onTapGesture(perform: next)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            ViewThatFits(in: .vertical) {
                card(step)
                ScrollView { card(step) }
            }
            .frame(maxHeight: available)
            .padding(.horizontal, 20)
            .padding(placeBelow ? .top : .bottom, placeBelow ? holeRect.maxY + 12 : screen.height - holeRect.minY + 12)
        }
    }

    private func card(_ step: CoachMarkTourStep) -> some View {
        let isLast = progress.index + 1 >= steps.count

        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
            Text(step.title).font(.headline)
            Text(step.message).font(.subheadline).foregroundStyle(.secondary)

            HStack {
                Button(action: skip) {
                    // A line of text is too short to hit. The padding widens what answers to
                    // a touch, and the same padding taken back keeps the layout as it was.
                    Text("Skip tour")
                        .padding(.vertical, 13)
                        .contentShape(.rect)
                        .padding(.vertical, -13)
                }
                .font(.subheadline)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                Spacer()

                Text("\(progress.index + 1) of \(steps.count)")
                    .font(.caption.monospacedDigit())
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                Button(isLast ? "Done" : "Next", action: next)
                    .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                    .accessibilityLabel(isLast ? "Finish tour" : "Next step")
            }
            .padding(.top, 6)
        }
        .padding(16)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        .background(.regularMaterial, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isModal)
    }

    private func next() {
        var updated = progress
        let finished = updated.advance(stepCount: steps.count)
        withAnimation(animation) {
            progress = updated
            if finished { isPresented = false }
        }
        if finished { onFinish() }
    }

    private func skip() {
        var updated = progress
        let finished = updated.finish()
        withAnimation(animation) {
            progress = updated
            if finished { isPresented = false }
        }
        if finished { onFinish() }
    }
}

/// The dimming layer with a rounded hole around the target. Its hole animates between steps.
nonisolated private struct CoachMarkTourDim: Shape {
    var hole: CGRect

    var animatableData: CGRect.AnimatableData {
        get { hole.animatableData }
        set { hole.animatableData = newValue }
    }

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        var path = Path(rect)
        path.addRoundedRect(in: hole, cornerSize: CGSize(width: 14, height: 14))
        return path
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct CoachMarkTourDemo: View {
    private let steps = [
        CoachMarkTourStep(id: "profile", title: "Your profile", message: "Change your photo and settings here."),
        CoachMarkTourStep(id: "search", title: "Search", message: "Find any note in a moment."),
        CoachMarkTourStep(id: "card", title: "Today", message: "Your plan for the day lives on this card."),
        CoachMarkTourStep(id: "add", title: "Add a note", message: "Tap here to write something new."),

                Spacer()

            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(24)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .background(.indigo.gradient, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 26))
```

## Command Palette

A searchable sheet of commands with shortcut hints and live filtering as you type.

Category: Menus. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Menus/CommandPalette/CommandPalette.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct CommandPaletteCommand: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: String
    let section: String
    let systemImage: String
    /// A hint only, such as "⌘N".
    var shortcut: String?
    /// Extra words that find this command, such as synonyms.
    var keywords: [String] = []
    let action: () -> Void
}

struct CommandPaletteGroup: Identifiable {
    let title: String
    let commands: [CommandPaletteCommand]

    var id: String { title }
}

enum CommandPaletteFilter {
    /// Commands matching the query, grouped by section in the order they first appear.
    static func groups(_ commands: [CommandPaletteCommand], query: String) -> [CommandPaletteGroup] {
        let trimmed = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        let matches = commands.filter { command in
            trimmed.isEmpty || ([command.title, command.section] + command.keywords)
                .contains { $0.localizedStandardContains(trimmed) }
        }

        var titles: [String] = []
        var bySection: [String: [CommandPaletteCommand]] = [:]
        for command in matches {
            if bySection[command.section] == nil { titles.append(command.section) }
            bySection[command.section, default: []].append(command)
        }
        return titles.map { CommandPaletteGroup(title: $0, commands: bySection[$0] ?? []) }
    }

    /// The command at the top of the list for a query, which Return runs. Nothing for an empty query.
    static func firstMatch(in commands: [CommandPaletteCommand], query: String) -> CommandPaletteCommand? {
        guard !query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty else { return nil }
        return groups(commands, query: query).first?.commands.first
    }
}

/// A searchable list of commands, filtered as you type. Show it in a sheet.
///
/// The search field takes focus when it appears, and Return runs the first match.
/// Running a command closes the sheet first.
struct CommandPalette: View {
    let commands: [CommandPaletteCommand]

    @State private var query = ""
    @State private var isSearching = false
    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var iconSize = 32.0

    private var groups: [CommandPaletteGroup] {
        CommandPaletteFilter.groups(commands, query: query)
    }

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            List(groups) { group in
                Section(group.title) {
                    ForEach(group.commands, content: row)
                }
            }
            .overlay {
                if groups.isEmpty {
                    ContentUnavailableView.search(text: query)
                }
            }
            .navigationTitle("Commands")
            .navigationBarTitleDisplayMode(.inline)
            .searchable(
                text: $query,
                isPresented: $isSearching,
                placement: .navigationBarDrawer(displayMode: .always),
                prompt: "Type a command"
            )
            // Return runs the first match, as in a command palette on a keyboard.
            .onSubmit(of: .search) {
                if let first = CommandPaletteFilter.firstMatch(in: commands, query: query) { run(first) }
            }
            .toolbar {
                ToolbarItem(placement: .cancellationAction) {
                    Button("Close") { dismiss() }
                }
            }
        }
        .task { isSearching = true }
    }

    private func row(_ command: CommandPaletteCommand) -> some View {
        Button {
            run(command)
        } label: {
            ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
                HStack(spacing: 12) {
                    titleLabel(command)
                    Spacer(minLength: 12)
                    shortcutChip(command.shortcut)
                }
                titleLabel(command)
            }
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(command.title)
    }

    private func run(_ command: CommandPaletteCommand) {
        dismiss()
        command.action()
    }

    private func titleLabel(_ command: CommandPaletteCommand) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: command.systemImage)
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.tint)
                .frame(width: iconSize, height: iconSize)
                .background(.tint.opacity(0.14), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 8))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Text(command.title).font(.body)
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func shortcutChip(_ shortcut: String?) -> some View {
        if let shortcut {
            Text(shortcut)
                .font(.caption.monospaced())
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .padding(.horizontal, 7)
                .padding(.vertical, 3)
                .background(.fill.tertiary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 6))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct CommandPaletteDemo: View {
    @State private var isOpen = false
    @State private var lastCommand = "Nothing yet"

    private var commands: [CommandPaletteCommand] {
        [
            command("New Note", section: "Create", image: "square.and.pencil", shortcut: "⌘N"),
            command("New Folder", section: "Create", image: "folder.badge.plus", shortcut: "⇧⌘N"),
            command("Share Note", section: "Actions", image: "square.and.arrow.up", shortcut: "⌘S"),
            command("Duplicate", section: "Actions", image: "plus.square.on.square", shortcut: "⌘D"),
            command("Delete", section: "Actions", image: "trash", shortcut: "⌫"),
            command("Settings", section: "Go to", image: "gearshape", shortcut: "⌘,"),
            command("Trash", section: "Go to", image: "trash.circle"),
            command("Help", section: "Go to", image: "questionmark.circle", shortcut: "⌘?"),
        ]
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo, .blue], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 22) {
                Text(lastCommand)
                    .font(.title2.bold())
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

                Button {
                    isOpen = true
                } label: {
                    Label("Open commands", systemImage: "command")
                        .font(.headline)
                        .padding(.horizontal, 18)
                        .padding(.vertical, 12)
                        .background(.white, in: .capsule)
                        .foregroundStyle(.indigo)
                }
            }
            .padding(24)
        }
        .sheet(isPresented: $isOpen) {
            CommandPalette(commands: commands)
        }
    }

    private func command(_ title: String, section: String, image: String, shortcut: String? = nil) -> CommandPaletteCommand {
        CommandPaletteCommand(id: title, title: title, section: section, systemImage: image, shortcut: shortcut) {
            lastCommand = title
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    CommandPaletteDemo()
}
```

## Context Menu Preview Card

A card that lifts a richer preview above its menu when you press and hold it.

Category: Menus. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Menus/ContextMenuPreviewCard/ContextMenuPreviewCard.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A card that lifts a richer preview above its menu when long pressed.
///
/// The system animates the lift and simplifies it for Reduce Motion. VoiceOver
/// users find the menu items in the actions rotor. Give the preview a fixed size.
struct ContextMenuPreviewCard<Card: View, Preview: View, MenuItems: View>: View {
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 22

    @ViewBuilder var preview: () -> Preview
    @ViewBuilder var menuItems: () -> MenuItems

        card()
            .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
            .contentShape(.contextMenuPreview, .rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
            .contextMenu(menuItems: menuItems, preview: preview)
    }
}
```

## Dropdown Select Menu

A custom dropdown field whose list of options grows out of it and collapses on selection.

Category: Menus. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Menus/DropdownSelectMenu/DropdownSelectMenu.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A field whose list of options grows out of it and collapses on selection.
///
/// The list floats over the views below, so use it in a stack where it can overlap
/// them. It raises itself with `zIndex` while open, and a tap outside closes it.
struct DropdownSelectMenu<Option: Hashable>: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let options: [Option]
    @Binding var selection: Option?
    var placeholder = "Choose"
    let label: (Option) -> String

    @State private var isOpen = false
    @State private var fieldHeight: CGFloat = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? { reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.28) }
    private let cornerRadius: CGFloat = 14
    private let contentPadding: CGFloat = 14
    private let maxListHeight: CGFloat = 280

    private var listTop: CGFloat { fieldHeight + 6 }
    /// The top edge of the list, as a point of the padded box the transition scales.
    private var listAnchor: UnitPoint { UnitPoint(x: 0.5, y: listTop / (listTop + maxListHeight)) }

    var body: some View {
        field
            .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.height } action: { fieldHeight = $0 }
            .overlay(alignment: .top) {
                if isOpen {
                    // An overlay is offered the size of the field, which would squeeze the list
                    // into one row. This offers it its own height, and starts it under the field.
                    optionsList
                        .frame(height: maxListHeight, alignment: .top)
                        .padding(.top, listTop)
                        .transition(reduceMotion ? .opacity : .scale(scale: 0.9, anchor: listAnchor).combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .background {
                if isOpen {
                    Color.clear
                        .frame(width: 4000, height: 4000)
                        .contentShape(.rect)
                        .onTapGesture { setOpen(false) }
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                }
            }
            .zIndex(isOpen ? 1 : 0)
    }

    private var field: some View {
        Button {
            setOpen(!isOpen)
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 10) {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                    Text(title).font(.caption).foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    Text(selection.map(label) ?? placeholder)
                        .font(.body)
                        .foregroundStyle(selection == nil ? .secondary : .primary)
                }

                Spacer(minLength: 0)

                Image(systemName: "chevron.down")
                    .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(isOpen ? 180 : 0))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, contentPadding)
            .padding(.vertical, 10)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
            .overlay {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius).strokeBorder(.separator)
            }
            .contentShape(.rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityValue(selection.map(label) ?? placeholder)
        .accessibilityHint(isOpen ? "Closes the list" : "Opens the list")
    }

    private var optionsList: some View {
        ViewThatFits(in: .vertical) {
            optionStack
            ScrollView { optionStack }
        }
        .background(.regularMaterial, in: .rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
        .overlay {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius).strokeBorder(.separator)
        }
        .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
        .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.14), radius: 14, y: 6)
    }

    private var optionStack: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            if options.isEmpty {
                Text("No options")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .padding(contentPadding)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            }

            ForEach(options, id: \.self) { option in
                Button {
                    selection = option
                    setOpen(false)
                } label: {
                    HStack {
                        Text(label(option)).font(.body)
                        Spacer(minLength: 8)
                        if option == selection {
                            Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                                .font(.subheadline.weight(.bold))
                                .foregroundStyle(.tint)
                                .accessibilityHidden(true)
                        }
                    }
                    .padding(.horizontal, contentPadding)
                    .frame(minHeight: 46)
                    .contentShape(.rect)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityAddTraits(option == selection ? .isSelected : [])
            }
        }
    }

    private func setOpen(_ open: Bool) {
        withAnimation(animation) { isOpen = open }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct DropdownSelectMenuDemo: View {
    @State private var shipping: String? = "Standard"
    @State private var country: String?
    @State private var notes = "Tap a field to open it"

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: [.blue.opacity(0.18), .purple.opacity(0.18)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
                Text("Checkout").font(.largeTitle.bold())

                DropdownSelectMenu(
                    title: "Shipping",
                    options: ["Standard", "Express", "Overnight", "Pickup"],
                    selection: $shipping,
                    label: { $0 }
                )

                DropdownSelectMenu(
                    title: "Country",
                    options: ["France", "Italy", "Portugal", "Spain"],
                    selection: $country,
                    placeholder: "Select a country",
                    label: { $0 }
                )

                Text(notes)
                    .font(.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)

                Spacer()
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
        .onChange(of: shipping) { _, new in notes = "Delivery: \(new ?? "none")" }
    }
}

#Preview {
    DropdownSelectMenuDemo()
}
```
