## Side Drawer

A side menu that slides in and pushes the content away, with drag to open and close.

Category: Navigation. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Navigation/SideDrawer/SideDrawer.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A side menu that pushes the content away. Drag sideways or tap the content to close it.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the menu opens and closes without sliding.
struct SideDrawer<MenuContent: View, Content: View>: View {
    @Binding var isOpen: Bool
    var menuWidth: CGFloat = 280
    @ViewBuilder var menu: MenuContent
    @ViewBuilder var content: Content

    @State private var dragTranslation: CGFloat = 0
    @GestureState private var isDragging = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.layoutDirection) private var layoutDirection

    /// Gestures report screen points, but layout mirrors in right-to-left layouts: 1 or -1 converts between them.
    private var forward: CGFloat { layoutDirection == .rightToLeft ? -1 : 1 }

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.45, bounce: 0.15)
    }

    private var pushOffset: CGFloat {
        min(max((isOpen ? menuWidth : 0) + dragTranslation, 0), menuWidth)
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
            menu
                .frame(width: menuWidth)
                .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
                .offset(x: pushOffset - menuWidth)
                .accessibilityHidden(!isOpen)

            content
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                .accessibilityHidden(isOpen)
                .overlay {
                    if isOpen {
                        Button {
                            isOpen = false
                        } label: {
                            Color.clear.contentShape(.rect)
                        }
                        .buttonStyle(.plain)
                        .accessibilityLabel("Close menu")
                    }
                }
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(pushOffset > 0 ? 0.3 : 0), radius: 20)
                .offset(x: pushOffset)
        }
        .gesture(dragGesture)
        .animation(animation, value: isOpen)
        .onChange(of: isDragging) { _, dragging in
            if !dragging { withAnimation(animation) { dragTranslation = 0 } }
        }
    }

    private var dragGesture: some Gesture {
        DragGesture(minimumDistance: 20)
            .updating($isDragging) { _, state, _ in state = true }
            .onChanged { dragTranslation = $0.translation.width * forward }
            .onEnded { value in
                let projected = (isOpen ? menuWidth : 0) + value.predictedEndTranslation.width * forward
                withAnimation(animation) {
                    isOpen = projected > menuWidth / 2
                    dragTranslation = 0
                }
            }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SideDrawerDemo: View {
    private let destinations = [
        ("Inbox", "tray.fill"),
        ("Starred", "star.fill"),
        ("Archive", "archivebox.fill"),
        ("Settings", "gearshape.fill"),
    ]

    @State private var isOpen = false
    @State private var current = "tray.fill"

    var body: some View {
        SideDrawer(isOpen: $isOpen) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                Text("Workspace")
                    .font(.title2.bold())
                    .padding(.bottom, 20)

                ForEach(destinations, id: \.0) { name, symbol in
                    Button {
                        current = symbol
                        isOpen = false
                    } label: {
                        // The whole row answers to a touch, not only its text.
                        Label(name, systemImage: symbol)
                            .font(.headline)
                            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44, alignment: .leading)
                            .contentShape(.rect)
                    }
                }

                Spacer()
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .padding(.top, 40)
            .padding(.horizontal, 28)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
        } content: {
            ZStack(alignment: .topLeading) {
                LinearGradient(colors: [.orange, .pink], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                    .ignoresSafeArea()

                Image(systemName: current)
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .imageScale(.large)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Button {
                    isOpen = true
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "line.3.horizontal")
                        .font(.title2.bold())
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .padding(14)
                        .background(.white.opacity(0.2), in: .circle)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityLabel("Menu")
                .padding(20)
            }
        }
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo, .black], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}

#Preview {
    SideDrawerDemo()
}
```

## Tab Navigation State Preserve

A tab bar where each tab keeps its own navigation path in one store, so switching back restores your place.

Category: Navigation. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Navigation/TabNavigationStatePreserve/TabNavigationStatePreserve.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Keeps one navigation path per tab outside the tabs, so each can be read, reset or restored.
@MainActor
@Observable
final class TabNavigationStatePreserveStore<TabID: Hashable> {
    private(set) var selection: TabID
    private var paths: [TabID: NavigationPath] = [:]

    init(selection: TabID) {
        self.selection = selection
    }

    func path(for tab: TabID) -> NavigationPath {
        paths[tab] ?? NavigationPath()
    }

    func setPath(_ path: NavigationPath, for tab: TabID) {
        paths[tab] = path
    }

    func depth(of tab: TabID) -> Int {
        path(for: tab).count
    }

    func popToRoot(_ tab: TabID) {
        paths[tab] = NavigationPath()
    }

    /// Switches tab. Choosing the tab you are already on takes it back to its root.
    func select(_ tab: TabID) {
        if tab == selection {
            popToRoot(tab)
        } else {
            selection = tab
        }
    }
}

struct TabNavigationStatePreserveItem<TabID: Hashable>: Identifiable {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let systemImage: String
    let tab: TabID

    var id: TabID { tab }
}

/// A tab bar where every tab keeps its own navigation stack.
///
/// Switching away and back restores the screen you left. Tapping the current tab pops
/// it to the root, on the iOS versions where `TabView` reports a repeated selection.
struct TabNavigationStatePreserve<TabID: Hashable, Route: Hashable, Root: View, Screen: View>: View {
    let store: TabNavigationStatePreserveStore<TabID>
    let tabs: [TabNavigationStatePreserveItem<TabID>]
    @ViewBuilder let root: (TabID) -> Root
    @ViewBuilder let screen: (Route) -> Screen

    var body: some View {
        TabView(selection: selection) {
            ForEach(tabs) { item in
                // The initializer that takes the title needs iOS 26 for a localizable one.
                Tab(value: item.tab) {
                    NavigationStack(path: path(for: item.tab)) {
                        root(item.tab)
                            .navigationDestination(for: Route.self, destination: screen)
                    }
                } label: {
                    Label { Text(item.title) } icon: { Image(systemName: item.systemImage) }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var selection: Binding<TabID> {
        Binding(get: { store.selection }, set: { store.select($0) })
    }

    private func path(for tab: TabID) -> Binding<NavigationPath> {
        Binding(get: { store.path(for: tab) }, set: { store.setPath($0, for: tab) })
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private enum TabNavigationStatePreserveDemoTab: Hashable {
    case home, library
}

private struct TabNavigationStatePreserveDemoPage: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let link: String
    let route: Int
    let colors: [Color]
    let depth: Int

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 18) {
                Text("Level \(depth)")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

                NavigationLink(link, value: route)
                    .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                    .tint(.white.opacity(0.25))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
        .navigationTitle(title)
        // Before iOS 26 the bar is clear over a page that does not scroll, and its items take the page's color.
        .toolbarBackground(.visible, for: .tabBar)
    }
}

struct TabNavigationStatePreserveDemo: View {
    @State private var store = TabNavigationStatePreserveStore(selection: TabNavigationStatePreserveDemoTab.home)

    private let tabs = [
        TabNavigationStatePreserveItem(title: "Home", systemImage: "house.fill", tab: TabNavigationStatePreserveDemoTab.home),
        TabNavigationStatePreserveItem(title: "Library", systemImage: "books.vertical.fill", tab: .library),
    ]

    private func colors(for tab: TabNavigationStatePreserveDemoTab) -> [Color] {
        tab == .home ? [.orange, .pink] : [.teal, .indigo]
    }

    var body: some View {
        TabNavigationStatePreserve(store: store, tabs: tabs) { tab in
            TabNavigationStatePreserveDemoPage(
                title: tab == .home ? "Kitchen" : "Shelves",
                link: tab == .home ? "Recipes" : "Albums",
                route: 1,
                colors: colors(for: tab),
                depth: 0
            )
        } screen: { (level: Int) in
            TabNavigationStatePreserveDemoPage(
                title: "Page \(level)",
                link: "Deeper",
                route: level + 1,
                colors: colors(for: store.selection),
                depth: level
            )
        }
    }
}

}
```

## Two Pane Split Layout

A list and its detail that sit side by side on iPad and share one navigation stack on iPhone, on NavigationSplitView.

Category: Navigation. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Navigation/TwoPaneSplitLayout/TwoPaneSplitLayout.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A list and its detail, side by side when there is room and pushed on one stack when not,
/// on the system's `NavigationSplitView`.
///
/// The system keeps the selection when an iPad rotates or a window is resized, and adds what a
/// split view is expected to have: the button that hides the list, the swipe back on iPhone
/// and the keyboard. The list selects with its own selection, so VoiceOver reads the selected row.
struct TwoPaneSplitLayout<Item: Identifiable & Hashable, Row: View, Detail: View>: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let items: [Item]
    @Binding var selection: Item?
    var listWidth: CGFloat = 320
    @ViewBuilder let row: (Item) -> Row
    @ViewBuilder let detail: (Item) -> Detail

    var body: some View {
        NavigationSplitView {
            List(items, selection: $selection) { item in
                NavigationLink(value: item) {
                    row(item)
                }
            }
            .navigationTitle(title)
            .navigationSplitViewColumnWidth(ideal: max(listWidth, 0))
        } detail: {
            if let selection {
                detail(selection)
            } else {
                ContentUnavailableView("Nothing selected", systemImage: "sidebar.left")
            }
        }
        .navigationSplitViewStyle(.balanced)
    }
}
```

## Vertical Timeline

A vertical timeline with a connector line and done, current and upcoming steps.

Category: Patterns. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Patterns/VerticalTimeline/VerticalTimeline.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct VerticalTimelineStep: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let detail: LocalizedStringResource
}

enum VerticalTimelineStatus: Equatable {
    case done, current, upcoming

    /// A `currentIndex` past the end means everything is done, and a negative one that nothing has started.
    static func of(index: Int, currentIndex: Int) -> VerticalTimelineStatus {
        if index < currentIndex { return .done }
        return index == currentIndex ? .current : .upcoming
    }

    var spokenName: String {
        switch self {
        case .done: "Done"
        case .current: "In progress"
        case .upcoming: "Upcoming"
        }
    }
}

/// A vertical list of steps joined by a line, each done, in progress or still to come.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the current step does not pulse and changes are not animated.
struct VerticalTimeline: View {
    let steps: [VerticalTimelineStep]
    let currentIndex: Int
    var tint: Color = .indigo

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(Array(steps.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, step in
                row(
                    step,
                    status: .of(index: index, currentIndex: currentIndex),
                    isLast: index == steps.count - 1
                )
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.4), value: currentIndex)
    }

    private func row(_ step: VerticalTimelineStep, status: VerticalTimelineStatus, isLast: Bool) -> some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 14) {
            VStack(spacing: 0) {
                VerticalTimelineMarker(status: status, tint: tint)

                if !isLast {
                    Rectangle()
                        .fill(status == .done ? AnyShapeStyle(tint) : AnyShapeStyle(.quaternary))
                        .frame(width: 2)
                        .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
                }
            }

            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 3) {
                Text(step.title)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(status == .upcoming ? .secondary : .primary)

                Text(step.detail)
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            .padding(.bottom, isLast ? 0 : 26)

            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel("\(step.title). \(step.detail)")
        .accessibilityValue(status.spokenName)
    }
}

private struct VerticalTimelineMarker: View {
    let status: VerticalTimelineStatus
    let tint: Color

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var size = 26.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            switch status {
            case .done:
                Circle().fill(tint)
                Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                    .font(.caption.weight(.heavy))
                    .foregroundStyle(VerticalTimelineContrastingForeground(background: tint))
            case .current:
                halo
                Circle().fill(tint.opacity(0.18))
                Circle().strokeBorder(tint, lineWidth: 2)
                Circle().fill(tint).frame(width: size * 0.38, height: size * 0.38)
            case .upcoming:
                Circle().strokeBorder(.tertiary, lineWidth: 2)
            }
        }
        .frame(width: size, height: size)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var halo: some View {
        if !reduceMotion {
            Circle()
                .fill(tint.opacity(0.35))
                .phaseAnimator([false, true]) { circle, isExpanded in
                    circle
                        .scaleEffect(isExpanded ? 1.7 : 1)
                        .opacity(isExpanded ? 0 : 1)
                } animation: { isExpanded in
                    isExpanded ? .easeOut(duration: 1.1) : nil
                }
        }
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct VerticalTimelineContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct VerticalTimelineDemo: View {
    private let steps = [
        VerticalTimelineStep(id: "placed", title: "Order placed", detail: "Monday, 09:24"),
        VerticalTimelineStep(id: "packed", title: "Packed", detail: "Warehouse in Valencia"),
        VerticalTimelineStep(id: "shipped", title: "Shipped", detail: "On its way with your courier"),
        VerticalTimelineStep(id: "out", title: "Out for delivery", detail: "Arriving before 14:00"),
        VerticalTimelineStep(id: "delivered", title: "Delivered", detail: "Leave at the front door"),
    ]

    @State private var currentIndex = 2
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    Text("Track order")
                        .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    Text("Order number 2048")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                }

                VerticalTimeline(steps: steps, currentIndex: currentIndex)
                    .padding(22)
                    .background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 24))
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
        .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
        .task(id: reduceMotion) {
            guard !reduceMotion else { return }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                currentIndex = currentIndex >= steps.count ? 0 : currentIndex + 1
            }
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    VerticalTimelineDemo()
}
```

## Country Picker

A searchable list of countries with flags and dial codes that opens on the current region.

Category: Pickers. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Pickers/CountryPicker/CountryPicker.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct CountryPickerCountry: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable {
    let code: String
    let name: String
    let dialCode: String

    var id: String { code }
    var flag: String { CountryPickerData.flag(for: code) }
}

/// A searchable list of countries with flags and dial codes. Use it inside a `NavigationStack`.
///
/// It opens on the selected country, or on the region of the device if there is none.
struct CountryPicker: View {
    @Binding var selection: String?
    var countries: [CountryPickerCountry] = CountryPickerData.all

    @State private var query = ""

    private var results: [CountryPickerCountry] {
        CountryPickerData.filter(countries, query: query)
    }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollViewReader { proxy in
            List(results) { country in
                row(for: country)
                    .id(country.code)
            }
            .overlay {
                if results.isEmpty {
                    ContentUnavailableView.search(text: query)
                }
            }
            .searchable(text: $query, prompt: "Country or dial code")
            .task {
                if let start = selection ?? Locale.current.region?.identifier {
                    proxy.scrollTo(start, anchor: .center)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func row(for country: CountryPickerCountry) -> some View {
        Button {
            selection = country.code
        } label: {
            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                Text(country.flag)
                    .font(.title2)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Text(country.name)
                    .foregroundStyle(.primary)

                Spacer(minLength: 8)

                Text(country.dialCode)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .monospacedDigit()

                Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                    .fontWeight(.semibold)
                    .foregroundStyle(.tint)
                    .opacity(selection == country.code ? 1 : 0)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)
            }
        }
        .accessibilityAddTraits(selection == country.code ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}

enum CountryPickerData {
    /// Every country in the table below that the system knows, named in the current language.
    static let all = countries(locale: .current)

    static func countries(locale: Locale) -> [CountryPickerCountry] {
        Locale.Region.isoRegions
            .compactMap { region -> CountryPickerCountry? in
                guard let dialCode = dialCodes[region.identifier] else { return nil }
                let name = locale.localizedString(forRegionCode: region.identifier) ?? region.identifier
                return CountryPickerCountry(code: region.identifier, name: name, dialCode: dialCode)
            }
            .sorted { $0.name.localizedStandardCompare($1.name) == .orderedAscending }
    }

    /// Matches names and region codes anywhere, and dial codes from their start.
    static func filter(_ countries: [CountryPickerCountry], query: String) -> [CountryPickerCountry] {
        let text = query.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !text.isEmpty else { return countries }

        let digits = text.hasPrefix("+") ? String(text.dropFirst()) : text
        return countries.filter { country in
            country.name.localizedStandardContains(text)
                || country.code.caseInsensitiveCompare(text) == .orderedSame
                || (!digits.isEmpty && country.dialCode.dropFirst().hasPrefix(digits))
        }
    }

    /// Two letters become the two regional indicator symbols that draw a flag.
    static func flag(for code: String) -> String {
        let letters = code.uppercased().unicodeScalars
        guard letters.count == 2, letters.allSatisfy({ ("A"..."Z").contains($0) }) else { return "" }
        var flag = String.UnicodeScalarView()
        flag.append(contentsOf: letters.compactMap { Unicode.Scalar(127_397 + $0.value) })
        return String(flag)
    }

    /// Parses entries such as `ES34` into `["ES": "+34"]`. Apple has no API for dial codes.
    static func parseDialCodes(_ table: String) -> [String: String] {
        let pairs = table.split(whereSeparator: \.isWhitespace).compactMap { entry -> (String, String)? in
            let digits = entry.dropFirst(2)
            guard entry.count > 2, digits.allSatisfy(\.isNumber) else { return nil }
            return (String(entry.prefix(2)), "+" + digits)
        }
        return Dictionary(pairs) { first, _ in first }
    }

    private static let dialCodes = parseDialCodes("""
        AD376 AE971 AF93 AG1268 AI1264 AL355 AM374 AO244 AR54 AS1684 AT43 AU61 AW297 AX358 AZ994
        BA387 BB1246 BD880 BE32 BF226 BG359 BH973 BI257 BJ229 BL590 BM1441 BN673 BO591 BQ599 BR55
        BS1242 BT975 BW267 BY375 BZ501 CA1 CC61 CD243 CF236 CG242 CH41 CI225 CK682 CL56 CM237 CN86
        CO57 CR506 CU53 CV238 CW599 CX61 CY357 CZ420 DE49 DJ253 DK45 DM1767 DO1809 DZ213 EC593 EE372
        EG20 EH212 ER291 ES34 ET251 FI358 FJ679 FK500 FM691 FO298 FR33 GA241 GB44 GD1473 GE995 GF594
        GG44 GH233 GI350 GL299 GM220 GN224 GP590 GQ240 GR30 GT502 GU1671 GW245 GY592 HK852 HN504 HR385
        HT509 HU36 ID62 IE353 IL972 IM44 IN91 IO246 IQ964 IR98 IS354 IT39 JE44 JM1876 JO962 JP81
        KE254 KG996 KH855 KI686 KM269 KN1869 KP850 KR82 KW965 KY1345 KZ7 LA856 LB961 LC1758 LI423
        LK94 LR231 LS266 LT370 LU352 LV371 LY218 MA212 MC377 MD373 ME382 MF590 MG261 MH692 MK389
        ML223 MM95 MN976 MO853 MP1670 MQ596 MR222 MS1664 MT356 MU230 MV960 MW265 MX52 MY60 MZ258
        NA264 NC687 NE227 NF672 NG234 NI505 NL31 NO47 NP977 NR674 NU683 NZ64 OM968 PA507 PE51 PF689
        PG675 PH63 PK92 PL48 PM508 PR1787 PS970 PT351 PW680 PY595 QA974 RE262 RO40 RS381 RU7 RW250
        SA966 SB677 SC248 SD249 SE46 SG65 SH290 SI386 SJ47 SK421 SL232 SM378 SN221 SO252 SR597 SS211
        ST239 SV503 SX1721 SY963 SZ268 TC1649 TD235 TG228 TH66 TJ992 TK690 TL670 TM993 TN216 TO676
        TR90 TT1868 TV688 TW886 TZ255 UA380 UG256 US1 UY598 UZ998 VA39 VC1784 VE58 VG1284 VI1340
        VN84 VU678 WF681 WS685 XK383 YE967 YT262 ZA27 ZM260 ZW263
        """)
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct CountryPickerDemo: View {
    @State private var selection = Locale.current.region?.identifier

    private var chosen: CountryPickerCountry? {
        CountryPickerData.all.first { $0.code == selection }
    }

    var body: some View {

    }
```

## Emoji Picker

A grid of emoji grouped by category, with tabs that jump between sections and a row of recent picks.

Category: Pickers. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Pickers/EmojiPicker/EmojiPicker.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct EmojiPickerCategory: Identifiable, Hashable, Sendable {
    let id: String
    let title: String
    let tabLabel: String
    let systemImage: String
    let emoji: [String]

    init(title: String, tabLabel: String, systemImage: String, emoji: String) {
        id = tabLabel
        self.title = title
        self.tabLabel = tabLabel
        self.systemImage = systemImage
        self.emoji = emoji.map(String.init)
    }

    static let standard = [
        EmojiPickerCategory(title: "Smileys & People", tabLabel: "Smileys", systemImage: "face.smiling", emoji: "😀😃😄😁😆😅😂🤣😊😇🙂😉😍🥰😘😋😜🤪😎🤩🥳😏😔😢😭😤😡🤯😱🤔🤗😴👍👎👏🙌🙏💪👋✌️"),
        EmojiPickerCategory(title: "Animals & Nature", tabLabel: "Animals", systemImage: "pawprint", emoji: "🐶🐱🐭🐹🐰🦊🐻🐼🐨🐯🦁🐮🐷🐸🐵🐔🐧🐦🦆🦉🦋🐝🐢🐙🐬🐳🌸🌻🌳🌵🍀🍁🌈⭐️🔥💧"),
        EmojiPickerCategory(title: "Food & Drink", tabLabel: "Food", systemImage: "fork.knife", emoji: "🍎🍊🍋🍌🍉🍇🍓🍒🍑🥭🍍🥥🥑🍅🌽🥕🥐🥖🧀🍳🍔🍟🍕🌮🍣🍜🍰🧁🍫🍩🍪☕️🍵🍺🍷🥂"),
        EmojiPickerCategory(title: "Travel & Places", tabLabel: "Travel", systemImage: "airplane", emoji: "🚗🚕🚌🏎️🚓🚑🚒🚲🛵🚂✈️🚀🛸🚁⛵️🚢🗺️🏖️🏝️🏔️⛺️🏠🏰🗼🗽🎡🌋🌅🌃"),
        EmojiPickerCategory(title: "Everyday Objects", tabLabel: "Objects", systemImage: "lightbulb", emoji: "⌚️📱💻⌨️🖥️📷🎥📺📻⏰🔦💡📚✏️📎✂️🔑🔒🔨🧰🎁🎈🎉🎨🎸🎧🎮⚽️🏀🎾"),
        EmojiPickerCategory(title: "Signs & Symbols", tabLabel: "Symbols", systemImage: "heart", emoji: "❤️🧡💛💚💙💜🖤🤍💔💕💯✅❌⭕️❗️❓⚠️♻️🔔🎵➕➖➡️⬅️⬆️⬇️🔁"),
        EmojiPickerCategory(title: "World Flags", tabLabel: "Flags", systemImage: "flag", emoji: "🏁🚩🏳️🏴🏳️‍🌈🇪🇸🇫🇷🇩🇪🇮🇹🇵🇹🇬🇧🇮🇪🇺🇸🇨🇦🇲🇽🇧🇷🇦🇷🇯🇵🇰🇷🇨🇳🇮🇳🇦🇺🇿🇦"),
    ]
}

/// A grid of emoji grouped by category, with tabs and a row of the ones used last.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, tabs jump to their section without animating.
struct EmojiPicker: View {
    @Binding var recents: [String]
    var categories: [EmojiPickerCategory] = EmojiPickerCategory.standard
    var recentLimit = 12
    let onSelect: (String) -> Void

    @State private var activeID: String?
    /// The tab that was tapped stays chosen until the grid moves again. A short section near
    /// the end cannot reach the top, and would lose its tab to the one above it.
    @State private var tappedID: String?
    @State private var isJumping = false
    /// A scroll view reader cannot jump to a section the lazy stack has not built yet. This can.
    @State private var position = ScrollPosition(idType: String.self)
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var cellSize = 44.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let edgePadding: CGFloat = 12

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.35)
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            if !recents.isEmpty {
                recentRow
            }

            tabBar
            Divider()
            grid
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: recents)
    }

    private var recentRow: some View {
        ScrollView(.horizontal) {
            HStack(spacing: 4) {
                ForEach(recents, id: \.self, content: emojiButton)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, edgePadding)
        }
        .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
        .padding(.vertical, 6)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .contain)
        .accessibilityLabel("Recent")
    }

    private var tabBar: some View {
        ScrollView(.horizontal) {
            HStack(spacing: 2) {
                ForEach(categories) { category in
                    let isActive = category.id == (tappedID ?? activeID ?? categories.first?.id)

                    Button {
                        tappedID = category.id
                        isJumping = true
                        withAnimation(animation, completionCriteria: .logicallyComplete) {
                            position.scrollTo(id: category.id, anchor: .top)
                        } completion: {
                            isJumping = false
                        }
                    } label: {
                        Image(systemName: category.systemImage)
                            .font(.title3)
                            .foregroundStyle(isActive ? Color.accentColor : Color.secondary)
                            .frame(minWidth: cellSize, minHeight: cellSize)
                            .background(isActive ? Color.accentColor.opacity(0.15) : .clear, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 12))
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                    .accessibilityLabel(category.tabLabel)
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(isActive ? .isSelected : [])
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, edgePadding)
            .padding(.vertical, 6)
        }
        .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
    }

    private var grid: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 18) {
                ForEach(categories) { category in
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                        Text(category.title)
                            .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                            .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)

                        LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: max(cellSize, 1)), spacing: 4)], spacing: 4) {
                            ForEach(category.emoji, id: \.self, content: emojiButton)
                        }
                    }
                    .id(category.id)
                }
            }
            .scrollTargetLayout()
            .padding(edgePadding)
        }
        .scrollPosition($position, anchor: .top)
        .onScrollPhaseChange { _, phase in
            if phase == .interacting || (phase == .animating && !isJumping) { tappedID = nil }
        }
        .onScrollTargetVisibilityChange(idType: String.self, threshold: 0.01) { ids in
            if let first = categories.first(where: { ids.contains($0.id) }) {
                activeID = first.id
            }
        }
    }

    private func emojiButton(_ emoji: String) -> some View {
        Button {
            recents = EmojiPickerRecents.adding(emoji, to: recents, limit: recentLimit)
            onSelect(emoji)
        } label: {
            Text(emoji)
                .font(.title)
                .frame(minWidth: cellSize, minHeight: cellSize)
                .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
    }
}

enum EmojiPickerRecents {
    /// Puts the emoji first, without repeating it, and keeps at most `limit` of them.
    static func adding(_ emoji: String, to recents: [String], limit: Int) -> [String] {
        Array(([emoji] + recents.filter { $0 != emoji }).prefix(max(limit, 0)))
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct EmojiPickerDemo: View {
    @State private var recents: [String] = []
    @State private var chosen = "😀"
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            ZStack {
                LinearGradient(colors: [.yellow, .orange, .pink], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                    .ignoresSafeArea(edges: .top)

                Text(chosen)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded))
                    .scaleEffect(2.4)
                    .contentTransition(.opacity)
                    .id(chosen)
                    .transition(reduceMotion ? .identity : .scale(scale: 0.6).combined(with: .opacity))
            }
            .frame(height: 170)
            .accessibilityHidden(true)

            EmojiPicker(recents: $recents) { emoji in
                withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .bouncy) { chosen = emoji }
            }
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    EmojiPickerDemo()
}
```

## Inline Date Picker Disclosure

A date row that opens in place into a calendar and closes again once a day is chosen.

Category: Pickers. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Pickers/InlineDatePickerDisclosure/InlineDatePickerDisclosure.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A date row that opens in place into a calendar and closes again once a day is chosen.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the calendar appears and disappears without animating.
struct InlineDatePickerDisclosure: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    @Binding var date: Date
    var range: ClosedRange<Date> = Date.distantPast...Date.distantFuture

    @State private var isExpanded = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.35)
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            Button {
                withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded.toggle() }
            } label: {
                row
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel(title)
            .accessibilityValue(date.formatted(date: .long, time: .omitted))
            .accessibilityHint(isExpanded ? "Hides the calendar" : "Shows the calendar")

            if isExpanded {
                Divider()

                DatePicker(selection: $date, in: range, displayedComponents: .date) { Text(title) }
                    .datePickerStyle(.graphical)
                    .labelsHidden()
                    .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                    .transition(.opacity.combined(with: .move(edge: .top)))
            }
        }
        .clipped()
        .onChange(of: date) { oldValue, newValue in
            if isExpanded, InlineDatePickerDisclosureRule.closes(from: oldValue, to: newValue, in: .current) {
                withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded = false }
            }
        }
    }

    private var row: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 12) {
            Image(systemName: "calendar")
                .foregroundStyle(.tint)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            // At the largest text sizes the date moves under the title.
            ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
                HStack {
                    labels
                }
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                    labels
                }
            }

            Image(systemName: "chevron.down")
                .font(.footnote.weight(.bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(isExpanded ? 180 : 0))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
        .padding()
        .contentShape(.rect)
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private var labels: some View {
        Text(title)
            .font(.body.weight(.medium))
            .lineLimit(1)
            .fixedSize()

        Spacer(minLength: 8)

        Text(date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .omitted))
            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            .monospacedDigit()
            .lineLimit(1)
            .fixedSize()
    }
}

enum InlineDatePickerDisclosureRule {
    /// Paging through months does not change the date, so only a different day closes the calendar.
    static func closes(from oldValue: Date, to newValue: Date, in calendar: Calendar) -> Bool {
        !calendar.isDate(oldValue, inSameDayAs: newValue)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct InlineDatePickerDisclosureDemo: View {
    @State private var departure = Date.now
    @State private var comeback = Date.now.addingTimeInterval(4 * 86_400)

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 20) {
                Text("Your trip")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

                VStack(spacing: 14) {
                    InlineDatePickerDisclosure(title: "Departure", date: $departure)
                        .background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 20))

                    InlineDatePickerDisclosure(title: "Return", date: $comeback)
                        .background(.background.secondary, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 20))
                }
                .tint(.indigo)
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    InlineDatePickerDisclosureDemo()
}
```

## Multi Photo Picker Tray

A photo picker limited to a maximum count, with a tray of chosen thumbnails that can be removed.

Category: Pickers. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Pickers/MultiPhotoPickerTray/MultiPhotoPickerTray.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import PhotosUI
import SwiftUI

/// A photo picker limited to `maxCount` photos, with a tray of thumbnails that can be removed.
///
/// `thumbnail` draws each photo. `MultiPhotoPickerTrayThumbnail` loads one from the library.
struct MultiPhotoPickerTray<Thumbnail: View>: View {
    @Binding var selection: [PhotosPickerItem]
    var maxCount: Int = 5
    @ViewBuilder var thumbnail: (PhotosPickerItem) -> Thumbnail

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body) private var tileSize: CGFloat = 92
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var limit: Int { max(1, maxCount) }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 14) {
            ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
                HStack {
                    counter
                    Spacer()
                    picker
                }
                VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
                    counter
                    picker
                }
            }

            ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                HStack(spacing: 10) {
                    if selection.isEmpty {
                        emptyTile
                    }
                    ForEach(Array(selection.enumerated()), id: \.element) { index, item in
                        tile(for: item, position: index + 1)
                            .transition(.scale(scale: 0.6).combined(with: .opacity))
                    }
                }
                .padding(.vertical, 2)
            }
            .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.3), value: selection)
    }

    private var counter: some View {
        Text("\(selection.count) of \(limit) photos")
            .font(.subheadline.weight(.medium))
            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            .contentTransition(.numericText())
    }

    private var picker: some View {
        PhotosPicker(
            selection: $selection,
            maxSelectionCount: limit,
            selectionBehavior: .ordered,
            matching: .images
        ) {
            Label("Choose Photos", systemImage: "photo.badge.plus")
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
        }
    }

    private var emptyTile: some View {
        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous)
            .strokeBorder(.tertiary, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1.5, dash: [6, 5]))
            .frame(width: tileSize, height: tileSize)
            .overlay {
                Image(systemName: "photo.on.rectangle.angled")
                    .font(.title2)
                    .foregroundStyle(.tertiary)
            }
            .accessibilityElement()
            .accessibilityLabel("No photos selected")
    }

    private func tile(for item: PhotosPickerItem, position: Int) -> some View {
        thumbnail(item)
            .frame(width: tileSize, height: tileSize)
            .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 16, style: .continuous))
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel("Photo \(position)")
            .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
                Button {
                    selection.removeAll { $0 == item }
                } label: {
                    Image(systemName: "xmark.circle.fill")
                        .font(.title3)
                        .symbolRenderingMode(.palette)
                        .foregroundStyle(.white, .black.opacity(0.55))
                        .frame(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44, alignment: .topTrailing)
                        .padding(4)
                        .contentShape(.rect)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .accessibilityLabel("Remove photo \(position)")
            }
    }
}

/// Loads a picked photo as a small thumbnail.
struct MultiPhotoPickerTrayThumbnail: View {
    let item: PhotosPickerItem

    @State private var image: Image?
    @State private var didFail = false

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Rectangle().fill(.quaternary)
            if let image {
                image
                    .resizable()
                    .scaledToFill()
            } else if didFail {
                Image(systemName: "exclamationmark.triangle")
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .accessibilityLabel("Photo could not be loaded")
            } else {
                ProgressView()
            }
        }
        .task(id: item) {
            image = nil
            didFail = false
            let data = try? await item.loadTransferable(type: Data.self)
            let thumbnail = await data.flatMap { UIImage(data: $0) }?.byPreparingThumbnail(ofSize: CGSize(width: 300, height: 300))
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            guard let thumbnail else {
                didFail = true
                return
            }
            image = Image(uiImage: thumbnail)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct MultiPhotoPickerTrayDemo: View {
    @State private var selection: [PhotosPickerItem] = (0..<4).map {
        PhotosPickerItem(itemIdentifier: "demo-\($0)")
    }

    private let placeholders: [(symbol: String, colors: [Color])] = [
        ("mountain.2.fill", [.indigo, .cyan]),
        ("sun.max.fill", [.orange, .pink]),
        ("leaf.fill", [.green, .teal]),
        ("moon.stars.fill", [.purple, .blue]),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
                Text("New Album")
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                Text("Pick up to five photos to share.")
                    .font(.body)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            MultiPhotoPickerTray(selection: $selection, maxCount: 5) { item in
                if let placeholder = placeholder(for: item) {
                    ZStack {
                        LinearGradient(colors: placeholder.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                        Image(systemName: placeholder.symbol)
                            .font(.title)
                            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9))
                    }
                } else {
                    MultiPhotoPickerTrayThumbnail(item: item)
                }
            }
            .padding(18)
            .background(.background, in: .rect(cornerRadius: 24, style: .continuous))

            Spacer()
        }
        .padding(20)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground))
    }

    private func placeholder(for item: PhotosPickerItem) -> (symbol: String, colors: [Color])? {
        guard
            let identifier = item.itemIdentifier,
            identifier.hasPrefix("demo-"),
            let index = Int(identifier.dropFirst(5)),
            placeholders.indices.contains(index)
        else { return nil }
        return placeholders[index]
    }
}
```

## Time Slot Grid Picker

A grid of time slots where unavailable times are disabled and the chosen slot is highlighted.

Category: Pickers. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Pickers/TimeSlotGridPicker/TimeSlotGridPicker.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A grid of time slots. Unavailable times are disabled and the chosen one is highlighted.
struct TimeSlotGridPicker: View {
    let slots: [Date]
    var unavailable: Set<Date> = []
    @Binding var selection: Date?
    var format: Date.FormatStyle = .dateTime.hour().minute()
    var tint: Color = .indigo

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .subheadline) private var minimumWidth: CGFloat = 96
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var orderedSlots: [Date] { Array(Set(slots)).sorted() }

    var body: some View {
        LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum: minimumWidth), spacing: 10)], spacing: 10) {
            ForEach(orderedSlots, id: \.self) { slot in
                cell(for: slot)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.25), value: selection)
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: selection)
    }

    private func cell(for slot: Date) -> some View {
        let isAvailable = !unavailable.contains(slot)
        let isSelected = isAvailable && selection == slot

        return Button {
            selection = slot
        } label: {
            Text(slot.formatted(format))
                .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold).monospacedDigit())
                .strikethrough(!isAvailable)
                .lineLimit(1)
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
                .padding(.vertical, 13)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .foregroundStyle(isSelected ? AnyShapeStyle(.white) : isAvailable ? AnyShapeStyle(.primary) : AnyShapeStyle(.tertiary))
                .background {
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
                        .fill(isSelected ? AnyShapeStyle(tint) : isAvailable ? AnyShapeStyle(.quaternary) : AnyShapeStyle(.clear))
                }
                .overlay {
                    if !isAvailable {
                        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
                            .strokeBorder(.quaternary)
                    }
                }
                .contentShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 14))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .disabled(!isAvailable)
        .accessibilityValue(isAvailable ? "" : "Unavailable")
        .accessibilityAddTraits(isSelected ? .isSelected : [])
    }
}
```

## Wheel Picker

A vertical wheel that picks one value from a list, with rows turning in 3D as they leave the center.

Category: Pickers. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Pickers/WheelPicker/WheelPicker.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A vertical wheel that picks one value. Rows turn away in 3D as they leave the center.
///
/// `values` must be unique. With Reduce Motion on, rows stay flat and only fade.
struct WheelPicker<Value: Hashable>: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let values: [Value]
    @Binding var selection: Value
    var visibleRows: Int = 5
    var text: (Value) -> String

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title3) private var rowHeight: CGFloat = 44
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @State private var scrolledValue: Value?

    private let wheelSpace = "WheelPicker"

    var body: some View {
        let height = rowHeight * CGFloat(max(1, min(visibleRows, 15)))
        let row = rowHeight
        let tilts = !reduceMotion
        // A local copy: the effect below runs off the main actor and cannot capture the view.
        let space = wheelSpace

        ScrollView(.vertical) {
            LazyVStack(spacing: 0) {
                ForEach(values, id: \.self) { value in
                    Text(text(value))
                        .font(.title3.weight(.semibold).monospacedDigit())
                        .lineLimit(1)
                        .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                        .frame(height: row)
                        .contentShape(.rect)
                        .onTapGesture { selection = value }
                        .visualEffect { content, proxy in
                            let position = WheelPickerMath.position(midY: proxy.frame(in: .named(space)).midY, height: height)
                            return content
                                .rotation3DEffect(.degrees(tilts ? position * -62 : 0), axis: (1, 0, 0), perspective: 0.55)
                                .scaleEffect(tilts ? 1 - abs(position) * 0.12 : 1)
                                .opacity(1 - abs(position) * 0.72)
                        }
                }
            }
            .scrollTargetLayout()
        }
        .contentMargins(.vertical, (height - row) / 2, for: .scrollContent)
        .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
        .scrollTargetBehavior(.viewAligned)
        .scrollPosition(id: $scrolledValue, anchor: .center)
        .frame(height: height)
        // The frame of the wheel itself. The scroll view's own space starts after its content
        // margin, which put the middle of the effect two rows below the selected one.
        .coordinateSpace(.named(wheelSpace))
        .background {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous)
                .fill(.quaternary)
                .frame(height: row)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
        }
        .onAppear { scrolledValue = selection }
        .onChange(of: scrolledValue) { _, value in
            if let value, value != selection {
                selection = value
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: selection) { _, value in
            if value != scrolledValue {
                withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy) { scrolledValue = value }
            }
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: selection)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityValue(text(selection))
        .accessibilityAdjustableAction { direction in
            let step = direction == .increment ? 1 : -1
            if let index = WheelPickerMath.adjustedIndex(current: values.firstIndex(of: selection), step: step, count: values.count) {
                selection = values[index]
            }
        }
    }
}

nonisolated enum WheelPickerMath {
    /// How far a row is from the center of the wheel: 0 at the center, -1 at the top, 1 at the bottom.
    static func position(midY: Double, height: Double) -> Double {
        guard height > 0, midY.isFinite else { return 0 }
        let halfHeight = height / 2
        return min(max((midY - halfHeight) / halfHeight, -1), 1)
    }

    /// The index one step away, stopping at both ends. Nil when there is nothing to pick.
    static func adjustedIndex(current: Int?, step: Int, count: Int) -> Int? {
        guard count > 0 else { return nil }
        guard let current else { return 0 }
        return min(max(current + step, 0), count - 1)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct WheelPickerDemo: View {
    @State private var hour = 7
    @State private var minute = 30

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 28) {
            VStack(spacing: 4) {
                Text("Wake Up")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                Text(formatted(hour) + ":" + formatted(minute))
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold).monospacedDigit())
                    .contentTransition(.numericText())
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: hour)
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: minute)
            }

            HStack(spacing: 12) {
                WheelPicker(title: "Hour", values: Array(0..<24), selection: $hour, text: formatted)
                WheelPicker(title: "Minute", values: Array(stride(from: 0, to: 60, by: 5)), selection: $minute, text: formatted)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 24)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground))
    }

    private func formatted(_ value: Int) -> String {
        value < 10 ? "0\(value)" : "\(value)"
    }
}

#Preview {
    WheelPickerDemo()
}
```

## Bubble Wrap Pop

A sheet of bubbles that pop with a quick shrink and stay flat until reset.

Category: Playful. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Playful/BubbleWrapPop/BubbleWrapPop.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A sheet of bubbles that pop with a quick shrink and stay flat until `popped` is cleared.
struct BubbleWrapPop: View {
    @Binding var popped: Set<Int>
    var columns: Int = 6
    var count: Int = 48
    var tint: Color = .cyan

    var body: some View {
        let grid = Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 8), count: min(max(columns, 1), 16))

        LazyVGrid(columns: grid, spacing: 8) {
            ForEach(0..<min(max(count, 0), 600), id: \.self) { index in
                BubbleWrapPopBubble(index: index, tint: tint, isPopped: popped.contains(index)) {
                    popped.insert(index)
                }
            }
        }
        .sensoryFeedback(trigger: popped.count) { old, new in
            new > old ? .impact(flexibility: .soft, intensity: 0.8) : nil
        }
    }
}

private struct BubbleWrapPopBubble: View {
    let index: Int
    let tint: Color
    let isPopped: Bool
    let action: () -> Void

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Circle()
                .fill(
                    RadialGradient(
                        colors: isPopped ? [tint.opacity(0.12), tint.opacity(0.2)] : [.white.opacity(0.9), tint.opacity(0.55), tint.opacity(0.85)],
                        center: UnitPoint(x: 0.35, y: 0.3),
                        startRadius: 1,
                        endRadius: 44
                    )
                )
                .overlay {
                    Circle().strokeBorder(.white.opacity(isPopped ? 0.15 : 0.5), lineWidth: 1)
                }
                .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
                .scaleEffect(isPopped ? 0.78 : 1)
                .shadow(color: tint.opacity(isPopped ? 0 : 0.35), radius: 3, y: 2)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .disabled(isPopped)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(response: 0.18, dampingFraction: 0.45), value: isPopped)
        .accessibilityLabel("Bubble \(index + 1)")
        .accessibilityValue(isPopped ? "Popped" : "Not popped")
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct BubbleWrapPopDemo: View {
    @State private var popped: Set<Int> = []

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                VStack(spacing: 4) {
                    Text("Bubble Wrap")
                        .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    Text("\(popped.count) of 48 popped")
                        .font(.headline.monospacedDigit())
                        .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                        .contentTransition(.numericText())
                }

                BubbleWrapPop(popped: $popped)

                Button("Reset") {
                    withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth) { popped = [] }
                }
                .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                .tint(.cyan)
                .disabled(popped.isEmpty)
            }
            .padding(20)
        }
    }
}
```

## Spin Wheel Roulette

A prize wheel that spins with friction and lands on a random slice.

Category: Playful. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Playful/SpinWheelRoulette/SpinWheelRoulette.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A prize wheel that spins with friction and lands on a random slice.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the wheel moves straight to the result.
struct SpinWheelRoulette: View {
    let slices: [String]
    var onResult: (String) -> Void = { _ in }

    @State private var rotation = 0.0
    @State private var isSpinning = false
    @State private var lastResult: String?
    @State private var finishedSpins = 0
    @State private var lastSpinSlices: [String]?

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var hubSize: CGFloat = 78
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let palette: [Color] = [.pink, .orange, .yellow, .green, .teal, .blue, .indigo, .purple]

    /// The wheel keeps the slices of the last spin until the next one, so the result always matches it.
    private var drawnSlices: [String] { lastSpinSlices ?? slices }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            wheel
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(rotation))
                .accessibilityElement()
                .accessibilityLabel("Prize wheel")
                .accessibilityValue(drawnSlices.joined(separator: ", "))

            Circle()
                .strokeBorder(.white.opacity(0.9), lineWidth: 6)
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.25), radius: 10, y: 4)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            VStack {
                Image(systemName: "arrowtriangle.down.fill")
                    .font(.largeTitle)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.4), radius: 3, y: 2)
                    .offset(y: -16)
                Spacer()
            }
            .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Button(action: spin) {
                Text("Spin")
                    .font(.headline.weight(.heavy))
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .padding(8)
                    .frame(width: hubSize, height: hubSize)
                    .background(.black.gradient, in: .circle)
                    .overlay { Circle().strokeBorder(.white, lineWidth: 3) }
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .disabled(isSpinning || slices.isEmpty)
            .accessibilityValue(lastResult ?? "")
        }
        .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
        .sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: finishedSpins)
    }

    private var wheel: some View {
        Canvas { [drawnSlices] context, size in
            let radius = min(size.width, size.height) / 2
            guard radius > 0, !drawnSlices.isEmpty else { return }

            let center = CGPoint(x: size.width / 2, y: size.height / 2)
            let slice = SpinWheelRouletteMath.sliceAngle(count: drawnSlices.count)

            for (index, label) in drawnSlices.enumerated() {
                let start = Double(index) * slice - 90
                var wedge = Path()
                if drawnSlices.count == 1 {
                    wedge.addEllipse(in: CGRect(x: center.x - radius, y: center.y - radius, width: radius * 2, height: radius * 2))
                } else {
                    wedge.move(to: center)
                    wedge.addArc(center: center, radius: radius, startAngle: .degrees(start), endAngle: .degrees(start + slice), clockwise: false)
                    wedge.closeSubpath()
                }
                context.fill(wedge, with: .color(palette[index % palette.count].opacity(0.92)))
                context.stroke(wedge, with: .color(.white.opacity(0.75)), lineWidth: 1.5)

                var labelContext = context
                labelContext.translateBy(x: center.x, y: center.y)
                labelContext.rotate(by: .degrees(start + slice / 2))
                labelContext.draw(
                    Text(label).font(.subheadline.weight(.bold)).foregroundStyle(.white),
                    in: CGRect(x: radius * 0.34, y: -radius * 0.1, width: radius * 0.62, height: radius * 0.2)
                )
            }
        }
        .clipShape(.circle)
    }

    private func spin() {
        guard !isSpinning, !slices.isEmpty else { return }

        let winner = Int.random(in: slices.indices)
        let label = slices[winner]
        let target = SpinWheelRouletteMath.targetRotation(
            from: rotation,
            winner: winner,
            count: slices.count,
            jitter: .random(in: -0.35...0.35)
        )
        isSpinning = true
        lastSpinSlices = slices

        if reduceMotion {
            rotation = target
            finish(with: label)
        } else {
            withAnimation(.timingCurve(0.12, 0.75, 0.12, 1, duration: 3.2), completionCriteria: .removed) {
                rotation = target
            } completion: {
                finish(with: label)
            }
        }
    }

    private func finish(with label: String) {
        isSpinning = false
        lastResult = label
        finishedSpins += 1
        AccessibilityNotification.Announcement("Landed on \(label)").post()
        onResult(label)
    }
}

enum SpinWheelRouletteMath {
    static func sliceAngle(count: Int) -> Double {
        count > 0 ? 360 / Double(count) : 360
    }

    /// The rotation that brings `winner` under the pointer after `turns` whole turns, always moving forward.
    /// `jitter` moves the landing point inside the slice, as a fraction of it.
    static func targetRotation(from current: Double, winner: Int, count: Int, turns: Int = 5, jitter: Double = 0) -> Double {
        let resting = -(Double(winner) + 0.5 + jitter) * sliceAngle(count: count)
        return current + Double(max(turns, 0)) * 360 + normalized(resting - current)
    }

    /// The slice under the pointer at the top of the wheel for a rotation in degrees.
    static func winner(rotation: Double, count: Int) -> Int? {
        guard count > 0, rotation.isFinite else { return nil }
        return min(Int(normalized(-rotation) / sliceAngle(count: count)), count - 1)
    }

    private static func normalized(_ degrees: Double) -> Double {
        let remainder = degrees.truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 360)
        return remainder < 0 ? remainder + 360 : remainder
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SpinWheelRouletteDemo: View {
    @State private var result: String?

    private let slices = ["10% off", "Free tea", "Retry", "Gift", "25% off", "Bonus", "Sticker", "Jackpot"]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 28) {
            Text("Spin to Win")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)

            SpinWheelRoulette(slices: slices) { result = $0 }
                .padding(.horizontal, 24)

            Text(result.map { "You got: \($0)" } ?? "Tap the wheel to try your luck")
                .font(.title3.weight(.semibold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9))
                .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                .padding(.horizontal, 24)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo, .black], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }
}

#Preview {
    SpinWheelRouletteDemo()
}
```

## Stories Viewer

A full-screen story pager with segmented progress bars, tap to move and hold to pause.

Category: Profiles. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Profiles/StoriesViewer/StoriesViewer.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct StoriesViewerStory: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let image: Image
    var title: String
    var caption: String
    /// What the image shows, for VoiceOver. Leave it nil when the image is decoration.
    var imageLabel: String?
}

/// A full-screen story pager with segmented progress bars.
///
/// Tap the left or right half to move, and hold to pause. Stories do not advance by themselves
/// with Reduce Motion or VoiceOver on: the tap areas still work.
struct StoriesViewer: View {
    let stories: [StoriesViewerStory]
    var duration: TimeInterval = 4
    var onClose: (() -> Void)?
    var onFinish: () -> Void = {}

    @State private var playback = StoriesViewerPlayback()
    @State private var isPressing = false
    @State private var pressStart: Date?

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.accessibilityVoiceOverEnabled) private var voiceOverEnabled

    private let holdThreshold: TimeInterval = 0.25

    private var advancesByItself: Bool { !reduceMotion && !voiceOverEnabled }

    private var isRunning: Bool {
        advancesByItself && !isPressing && !playback.isFinished && !stories.isEmpty
    }

    private var current: StoriesViewerStory? {
        stories.indices.contains(playback.index) ? stories[playback.index] : stories.last
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color.black.ignoresSafeArea()

            if let current {
                Color.clear
                    .overlay { storyImage(current) }
                    .clipped()
                    .ignoresSafeArea()
                    .id(current.id)
                    .transition(.opacity)

                tapAreas

                VStack(spacing: 0) {
                    header(for: current)
                    Spacer(minLength: 24)
                    caption(for: current)
                }
                .opacity(isPressing ? 0 : 1)
                .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2).delay(isPressing ? holdThreshold : 0), value: isPressing)
            }
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .task(id: StoriesViewerSchedule(isRunning: isRunning, count: stories.count, duration: duration)) {
            guard isRunning else { return }
            var last = Date.now
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(33))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                let now = Date.now
                let elapsed = now.timeIntervalSince(last)
                last = now
                update { $0.tick(elapsed: elapsed, duration: duration, count: stories.count) }
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: stories.count) { _, count in
            playback.clamp(count: count)
        }
        .onChange(of: playback.isFinished) { _, isFinished in
            if isFinished { onFinish() }
        }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func storyImage(_ story: StoriesViewerStory) -> some View {
        let image = story.image.resizable().scaledToFill()

        if let label = story.imageLabel {
            image.accessibilityLabel(label)
        } else {
            image.accessibilityRepresentation { EmptyView() }
        }
    }

    private var tapAreas: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 0) {
            tapArea("Previous story") {
                update { $0.previous(count: stories.count) }
            }
            tapArea("Next story") {
                update { $0.next(count: stories.count) }
            }
        }
    }

    private func tapArea(_ label: String, action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View {
        Button {
            let wasHold = pressStart.map { Date.now.timeIntervalSince($0) >= holdThreshold } ?? false
            pressStart = nil
            if !wasHold {
                action()
            }
        } label: {
            Color.clear.frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        }
        .buttonStyle(StoriesViewerTapAreaStyle { isPressed in
            if isPressed { pressStart = .now }
            isPressing = isPressed
        })
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
    }

    private func header(for story: StoriesViewerStory) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 10) {
            HStack(spacing: 4) {
                ForEach(stories.indices, id: \.self) { segment in
                    Capsule()
                        .fill(.white.opacity(0.32))
                        .overlay {
                            Capsule()
                                .fill(.white)
                                .scaleEffect(x: fill(for: segment), anchor: .leading)
                        }
                        .frame(height: 3)
                }
            }
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel("Story")
            .accessibilityValue("\(min(playback.index + 1, stories.count)) of \(stories.count)")

            HStack {
                Text(story.title)
                    .font(.headline)
                    .lineLimit(2)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
                    .allowsHitTesting(false)
                Spacer()
                if let onClose {
                    Button(action: onClose) {
                        Image(systemName: "xmark")
                            .font(.headline)
                            .frame(minWidth: 44, minHeight: 44)
                            .contentShape(.rect)
                    }
                    .accessibilityLabel("Close")
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 12)
        .padding(.top, 8)
    }

    private func caption(for story: StoriesViewerStory) -> some View {
        Text(story.caption)
            .font(.title3.weight(.semibold))
            .lineLimit(8)
            .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.45), radius: 6, y: 2)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .padding(.horizontal, 20)
            .padding(.bottom, 24)
            .allowsHitTesting(false)
    }

    private func fill(for segment: Int) -> Double {
        if !advancesByItself, segment == playback.index { return 1 }
        return playback.fill(for: segment)
    }

    private func update(_ change: (inout StoriesViewerPlayback) -> Void) {
        var updated = playback
        change(&updated)
        if updated.index == playback.index {
            playback = updated
        } else {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.2)) { playback = updated }
        }
    }
}

private struct StoriesViewerSchedule: Equatable {
    let isRunning: Bool
    let count: Int
    let duration: TimeInterval
}

/// Reports touches, including ones the system cancels, so a hold can never get stuck.
private struct StoriesViewerTapAreaStyle: ButtonStyle {
    let onPressChange: (Bool) -> Void

    func makeBody(configuration: Configuration) -> some View {
        configuration.label
            .contentShape(.rect)
            .onChange(of: configuration.isPressed) { _, isPressed in
                onPressChange(isPressed)
            }
    }
}

struct StoriesViewerPlayback: Equatable {
    private(set) var index = 0
    private(set) var progress = 0.0
    private(set) var isFinished = false

    mutating func tick(elapsed: TimeInterval, duration: TimeInterval, count: Int) {
        guard count > 0, !isFinished, elapsed > 0 else { return }
        progress += elapsed / max(duration, 0.1)
        if progress >= 1 {
            next(count: count)
        }
    }

    mutating func next(count: Int) {
        guard count > 0, !isFinished else { return }
        if index + 1 < count {
            index += 1
            progress = 0
        } else {
            progress = 1
            isFinished = true
        }
    }

    mutating func previous(count: Int) {
        guard count > 0 else { return }
        isFinished = false
        index = max(index - 1, 0)
        progress = 0
    }

    /// Keeps the position valid when the list of stories changes, and moves on if new ones arrive after the end.
    mutating func clamp(count: Int) {
        if isFinished, index + 1 < count {
            isFinished = false
            index += 1
            progress = 0
            return
        }
        guard index >= count else { return }
        index = max(count - 1, 0)
        progress = 0
    }

    /// How full a segment's bar is, from 0 to 1.
    func fill(for segment: Int) -> Double {
        if segment < index { return 1 }
        return segment == index ? min(max(progress, 0), 1) : 0
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct StoriesViewerDemo: View {
    @State private var run = 0

    private let stories = [
        StoriesViewerStory(
            id: "dawn",
            image: placeholder(colors: [.orange, .pink, .purple], symbol: "sunrise.fill"),
            title: "Morning hike",
            caption: "First light over the ridge.",
            imageLabel: "A sunrise on a pink and purple sky"
        ),
        StoriesViewerStory(
            id: "forest",
            image: placeholder(colors: [.teal, .green, .black], symbol: "tree.fill"),
            title: "Into the woods",
            caption: "Three hours of pure green.",
            imageLabel: "A tree on a dark green background"
        ),
        StoriesViewerStory(
            id: "night",
            image: placeholder(colors: [.indigo, .blue, .black], symbol: "moon.stars.fill"),
            title: "Camp",
            caption: "And then the stars came out.",
            imageLabel: "A moon and stars on a night sky"
        ),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        StoriesViewer(stories: stories, duration: 3, onFinish: { run += 1 })
            .id(run)
    }

    private static func placeholder(colors: [Color], symbol: String) -> Image {
        let size = CGSize(width: 402, height: 874)
        return Image(size: size, opaque: true) { context in
            context.fill(
                Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)),
                with: .linearGradient(Gradient(colors: colors), startPoint: .zero, endPoint: CGPoint(x: size.width, y: size.height))
            )

            var icon = context.resolve(Image(systemName: symbol))
            icon.shading = .color(.white.opacity(0.35))
            let scale = 200 / max(icon.size.width, icon.size.height, 1)
            let iconSize = CGSize(width: icon.size.width * scale, height: icon.size.height * scale)
            context.draw(icon, in: CGRect(
                x: (size.width - iconSize.width) / 2,
                y: (size.height - iconSize.height) / 2,
                width: iconSize.width,
                height: iconSize.height
            ))
        }
    }
}
```

## Story Ring Avatar

An avatar with a gradient ring that spins while there are unseen stories.

Category: Profiles. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Profiles/StoryRingAvatar/StoryRingAvatar.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// An avatar with a gradient ring that spins while there are unseen stories.
///
/// `placeholder` shows while the image loads or when there is no URL. With Reduce Motion on,
/// the ring stays still.
struct StoryRingAvatar<Placeholder: View>: View {
    let name: String
    var url: URL?
    var hasUnseenStories: Bool = true
    var size: CGFloat = 72
    var colors: [Color] = [.yellow, .orange, .pink, .purple, .yellow]
    @ViewBuilder var placeholder: () -> Placeholder

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var spins: Bool { hasUnseenStories && !reduceMotion }

    var body: some View {
        let diameter = max(size, 0)
        let ringWidth = diameter * 0.05
        let photoSize = max(diameter - ringWidth * 4, 0)

        ZStack {
            Circle()
                .strokeBorder(.quaternary, lineWidth: max(ringWidth * 0.5, 1))

            TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30.0, paused: !spins)) { timeline in
                Circle()
                    .strokeBorder(AngularGradient(colors: colors, center: .center), lineWidth: ringWidth)
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(spins ? angle(at: timeline.date) : 0))
            }
            .opacity(hasUnseenStories ? 1 : 0)

            AsyncImage(url: url) { phase in
                if let image = phase.image {
                    image
                        .resizable()
                        .scaledToFill()
                } else {
                    placeholder()
                }
            }
            .frame(width: photoSize, height: photoSize)
            .clipShape(.circle)
        }
        .frame(width: diameter, height: diameter)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: hasUnseenStories)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel(name)
        .accessibilityValue(hasUnseenStories ? "New stories" : "No new stories")
    }

    private func angle(at date: Date) -> Double {
        (date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * 90).truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: 360)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct StoryRingAvatarDemo: View {
```
