## Activity Rings

Concentric gradient rings that close as daily goals are reached.

Category: Progress. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Progress/ActivityRings/ActivityRings.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct ActivityRingsRing {
    var title: String
    var progress: Double
    var colors: [Color]
}

/// Concentric gradient rings that close as their goals are reached.
struct ActivityRings: View {
    let rings: [ActivityRingsRing]
    var diameter: CGFloat = 240
    var lineWidth: CGFloat = 28
    var gap: CGFloat = 5

    var body: some View {
        let size = max(diameter, 0)
        let stroke = max(lineWidth, 0)
        let pitch = stroke + max(gap, 0)
        let visible = ActivityRingsMath.visibleCount(ringCount: rings.count, diameter: size, lineWidth: stroke, gap: max(gap, 0))

        ZStack {
            ForEach(0..<visible, id: \.self) { index in
                ActivityRingsTrack(ring: rings[index], diameter: size, lineWidth: stroke, inset: CGFloat(index) * pitch)
            }
        }
        .frame(width: size, height: size)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel("Activity rings")
        .accessibilityValue(summary)
    }

    private var summary: String {
        rings.map { ring in
            let percent = ActivityRingsMath.clamped(ring.progress).formatted(.percent.precision(.fractionLength(0)))
            return "\(ring.title) \(percent)"
        }
        .joined(separator: ", ")
    }
}

private struct ActivityRingsTrack: View {
    let ring: ActivityRingsRing
    let diameter: CGFloat
    let lineWidth: CGFloat
    let inset: CGFloat

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var colors: [Color] { ring.colors.isEmpty ? [.accentColor] : ring.colors }
    private var progress: Double { ActivityRingsMath.clamped(ring.progress) }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Circle()
                .inset(by: inset + lineWidth / 2)
                .stroke((colors.first ?? .accentColor).opacity(0.2), lineWidth: lineWidth)

            Circle()
                .inset(by: inset + lineWidth / 2)
                .trim(from: 0, to: progress)
                .stroke(
                    AngularGradient(colors: colors, center: .center),
                    style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: lineWidth, lineCap: .round)
                )
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))

            Circle()
                .fill(colors.first ?? .accentColor)
                .frame(width: lineWidth, height: lineWidth)
                .offset(y: -(diameter / 2 - inset - lineWidth / 2))
                .opacity(progress > 0 ? 1 : 0)
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 1.1, bounce: 0.2), value: progress)
    }
}

enum ActivityRingsMath {
    static func clamped(_ progress: Double) -> Double {
        progress.isFinite ? min(max(progress, 0), 1) : 0
    }

    /// How many rings fit inside the diameter, so inner rings never turn inside out.
    static func visibleCount(ringCount: Int, diameter: Double, lineWidth: Double, gap: Double) -> Int {
        let pitch = lineWidth + gap
        guard ringCount > 0, diameter > 0, pitch > 0, pitch.isFinite, diameter.isFinite else { return 0 }
        // The innermost ring needs no gap after it, which is why one gap is added back.
        return Int(min(Double(ringCount), ((diameter / 2 + gap) / pitch).rounded(.down)))
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ActivityRingsDemo: View {
    @State private var fill = 0.0

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let goals: [(title: String, value: Double, goal: Double, unit: String, colors: [Color])] = [
        ("Move", 520, 600, "kcal", [.red, .pink]),
        ("Exercise", 22, 30, "min", [.green, .mint]),
        ("Stand", 11, 12, "h", [.cyan, .blue]),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 40) {
            ActivityRings(rings: goals.map { goal in
                ActivityRingsRing(title: goal.title, progress: goal.value / goal.goal * fill, colors: goal.colors)
            })

            VStack(spacing: 14) {
                ForEach(goals, id: \.title) { goal in
                    HStack {
                        Circle()
                            .fill(LinearGradient(colors: goal.colors, startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
                            .frame(width: 12, height: 12)
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                        Text(goal.title)
                            .font(.headline)
                        Spacer()
                        Text("\(Int(goal.value * fill)) / \(Int(goal.goal)) \(goal.unit)")
                            .font(.body.monospacedDigit())
                            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.75))
                    }
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 44)
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(.black)
        .task(id: reduceMotion) {
            guard !reduceMotion else {
                fill = 1
                return
            }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                fill = 1
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2.4))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                fill = 0
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.1))
            }
        }
    }
}

    ActivityRingsDemo()
}
```

## Circular Progress Ring

An animated gradient ring that shows progress with a percentage in the middle.

Category: Progress. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Progress/CircularProgressRing/CircularProgressRing.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// The clamping and the text of the ring, apart from the view so they can be tested.
enum CircularProgressRingMath {
    static func clamped(_ value: Double) -> Double {
        value.isNaN ? 0 : min(max(value, 0), 1)
    }

    /// Only a finished ring reads 100: 99.6% rounds down to 99.
    static func wholePercent(_ value: Double) -> Int {
        let fraction = clamped(value)
        let percent = Int((fraction * 100).rounded())
        return percent == 100 && fraction < 1 ? 99 : percent
    }

    static func percentText(_ value: Double, locale: Locale = .autoupdatingCurrent) -> String {
        wholePercent(value).formatted(.percent.locale(locale))
    }
}

/// An animated ring with a gradient and the percentage in the middle. Give it a frame to size it.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the ring and the number change without animating.
struct CircularProgressRing: View {
    var progress: Double
    var colors: [Color] = [.cyan, .blue, .purple]
    var lineWidth: CGFloat = 18
    var font: Font = .system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold)
    var label: LocalizedStringKey = "Progress"

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var value: Double { CircularProgressRingMath.clamped(progress) }
    private var percentText: String { CircularProgressRingMath.percentText(progress) }
    private var strokeStyle: StrokeStyle { StrokeStyle(lineWidth: lineWidth, lineCap: .round) }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Circle()
                .stroke(.quaternary, lineWidth: lineWidth)

            ZStack {
                Circle()
                    .trim(from: 0, to: value)
                    .stroke(AngularGradient(colors: colors, center: .center), style: strokeStyle)

                // The round cap at the start falls on the gradient's seam, so paint it with the first color.
                Circle()
                    .trim(from: 0, to: value > 0 ? 0.001 : 0)
                    .stroke(colors.first ?? .blue, style: strokeStyle)
            }
            .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))

            Text(percentText)
                .font(font)
                .monospacedDigit()
                .contentTransition(.numericText(value: value))
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.4)
                .lineLimit(1)
                .padding(lineWidth + 4)
        }
        .padding(lineWidth / 2)
        .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.7), value: value)
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
        .accessibilityValue(percentText)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct CircularProgressRingDemo: View {
    @State private var progress = 0.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var percentSize = 60

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 40) {
            Text("Uploading photos")
                .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

            CircularProgressRing(
                progress: progress,
                lineWidth: 26,
                font: .system(size: percentSize, weight: .bold, design: .rounded),
                label: "Upload"
            )
            .frame(width: 280)

            HStack(spacing: 28) {
                CircularProgressRing(progress: 0.32, colors: [.pink, .orange], lineWidth: 8, font: .headline, label: "Move")
                CircularProgressRing(progress: 0.68, colors: [.green, .mint], lineWidth: 8, font: .headline, label: "Exercise")
                CircularProgressRing(progress: 0.91, colors: [.teal, .blue], lineWidth: 8, font: .headline, label: "Stand")
            }
            .frame(height: 88)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .task {
            let values = [0.25, 0.6, 0.85, 1, 0]
            var index = 0
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                progress = values[index]
                index = (index + 1) % values.count
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.9))
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Countdown Ring

A ring that empties and a number that counts down to a date.

Category: Progress. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Progress/CountdownRing/CountdownRing.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// The time math of the ring, apart from the view so it can be tested.
enum CountdownRingMath {
    static func remaining(now: Date, endDate: Date, duration: TimeInterval) -> TimeInterval {
        min(max(endDate.timeIntervalSince(now), 0), max(duration, 0))
    }

    static func fraction(remaining: TimeInterval, duration: TimeInterval) -> Double {
        guard duration > 0 else { return 0 }
        return min(max(remaining / duration, 0), 1)
    }

    /// Rounds up, so the number only reaches 0 when the time is really over.
    static func wholeSeconds(remaining: TimeInterval) -> Int {
        Int(max(remaining, 0).rounded(.up))
    }

    /// `45` below a minute, `1:05` from then on.
    static func text(seconds: Int, locale: Locale = .autoupdatingCurrent) -> String {
        guard seconds >= 60 else {
            return seconds.formatted(.number.locale(locale))
        }
        return Duration.seconds(seconds).formatted(.time(pattern: .minuteSecond).locale(locale))
    }
}

/// A ring that empties and a number that counts down to `endDate`. Give it a frame to size it.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the ring moves once per second instead of continuously.
struct CountdownRing: View {
    var endDate: Date
    var duration: TimeInterval
    var colors: [Color] = [.orange, .pink]
    var lineWidth: CGFloat = 18
    var font: Font = .system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold)
    var onFinish: (() -> Void)? = nil

    @State private var isFinished = false
    @State private var notifiedEndDate: Date?
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: reduceMotion ? 0.25 : 1.0 / 30.0, paused: isFinished)) { context in
            let remaining = CountdownRingMath.remaining(
                now: isFinished ? endDate : context.date,
                endDate: endDate,
                duration: duration
            )
            let seconds = CountdownRingMath.wholeSeconds(remaining: remaining)
            let fraction = CountdownRingMath.fraction(
                remaining: reduceMotion ? TimeInterval(seconds) : remaining,
                duration: duration
            )

            ZStack {
                Circle()
                    .stroke(.quaternary, lineWidth: lineWidth)

                Circle()
                    .trim(from: 0, to: fraction)
                    .stroke(
                        LinearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom),
                        style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: lineWidth, lineCap: .round)
                    )
                    .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))

                Text(CountdownRingMath.text(seconds: seconds))
                    .font(font)
                    .monospacedDigit()
                    .contentTransition(.numericText(value: Double(seconds)))
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: seconds)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.4)
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .padding(lineWidth + 4)
            }
            .padding(lineWidth / 2)
            .accessibilityElement()
            .accessibilityLabel("Time remaining")
            .accessibilityValue("\(seconds) seconds")
        }
        .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
        .task(id: endDate) {
            isFinished = false
            let delay = endDate.timeIntervalSinceNow
            if delay > 0 {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(delay))
            }
            guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
            isFinished = true
            guard notifiedEndDate != endDate else { return }
            notifiedEndDate = endDate
            onFinish?()
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct CountdownRingDemo: View {
    @State private var endDate = Date.now.addingTimeInterval(3)
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var numberSize = 96

    private let duration: TimeInterval = 3

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 36) {
            Text("Get ready")
                .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

            CountdownRing(
                endDate: endDate,
                duration: duration,
                lineWidth: 26,
                font: .system(size: numberSize, weight: .bold, design: .rounded)
            )
            .frame(width: 280)

            Text("Your next set starts soon")
                .font(.body)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .task {
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(duration + 0.8))
                endDate = Date.now.addingTimeInterval(duration)
            }
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    CountdownRingDemo()
}
```

## Download Pill Progress

A capsule button that turns into a progress ring while downloading, then into a checkmark.

Category: Progress. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Progress/DownloadPillProgress/DownloadPillProgress.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum DownloadPillProgressState: Equatable {
    case idle
    case downloading(Double)
    case finished
}

/// A capsule button that shrinks into a progress ring while downloading, then shows a checkmark.
struct DownloadPillProgress: View {
    var title: LocalizedStringResource = "Download"
    let state: DownloadPillProgressState
    var tint: Color = .blue
    let action: () -> Void

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .headline) private var height: CGFloat = 46
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var fraction: Double {
        guard case .downloading(let progress) = state, progress.isFinite else { return 0 }
        return min(max(progress, 0), 1)
    }

    private var stage: Int {
        switch state {
        case .idle: 0
        case .downloading: 1
        case .finished: 2
        }
    }

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            ZStack {
                switch state {
                case .idle:
                    Text(title)
                        .font(.headline)
                        .lineLimit(1)
                        .foregroundStyle(DownloadPillProgressContrastingForeground(background: background))
                        .padding(.horizontal, 24)
                        .transition(.opacity)
                case .downloading:
                    ring.transition(.scale(scale: 0.6).combined(with: .opacity))
                case .finished:
                    Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                        .font(.headline.weight(.bold))
                        .foregroundStyle(DownloadPillProgressContrastingForeground(background: background))
                        .transition(.scale(scale: 0.4).combined(with: .opacity))
                }
            }
            .frame(minWidth: height, minHeight: height)
            .background(background, in: .capsule)
            .contentShape(.capsule)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .spring(duration: 0.4, bounce: 0.25), value: stage)
        .sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: stage) { _, new in new == 2 }
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityValue(accessibilityText)
    }

    private var background: Color {
        switch state {
        case .idle: tint
        case .downloading: tint.opacity(0.14)
        case .finished: .green
        }
    }

    private var ring: some View {
        ZStack {
            Circle().stroke(tint.opacity(0.25), lineWidth: 3.5)
            Circle()
                .trim(from: 0, to: fraction)
                .stroke(tint, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 3.5, lineCap: .round))
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
                .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .linear(duration: 0.12), value: fraction)
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 2)
                .fill(tint)
                .frame(width: height * 0.22, height: height * 0.22)
        }
        .frame(width: height * 0.62, height: height * 0.62)
    }

    private var accessibilityText: String {
        switch state {
        case .idle: "Not downloaded"
        case .downloading: "Downloading, \(fraction.formatted(.percent.precision(.fractionLength(0))))"
        case .finished: "Finished"
        }
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct DownloadPillProgressContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct DownloadPillProgressDemo: View {
    @State private var state = DownloadPillProgressState.idle
    @State private var downloadID = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 22) {
            Image(systemName: "shippingbox.fill")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, weight: .semibold))
                .imageScale(.large)
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .padding(26)
                .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.blue, .indigo], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 26, style: .continuous))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            VStack(spacing: 4) {
                Text("Field Guide")
                    .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                Text("482 MB")
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }

            DownloadPillProgress(state: state, action: tapped)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground))
        .task(id: downloadID) {
            guard state == .downloading(0) else { return }
            for step in 1...40 {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50))
                guard !Task.isCancelled, state != .idle else { return }
                state = .downloading(Double(step) / 40)
            }
            state = .finished
        }
    }

    private func tapped() {
        switch state {
        case .idle:
            state = .downloading(0)
            downloadID += 1
        case .downloading, .finished:
            state = .idle
        }
    }
}
```

## Gradient Progress Bar

```swift
import SwiftUI

/// A rounded bar whose gradient fill glows more strongly as it advances.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the fill changes without animating.
```

## Liquid Fill Progress

A circular progress view filled by a moving liquid wave drawn with an animatable shape.

Category: Progress. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Progress/LiquidFillProgress/LiquidFillProgress.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A circle filled by a moving liquid wave, with the percentage in the middle.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the surface stands still and the level changes without animating.
struct LiquidFillProgress: View {
    var progress: Double
    var color: Color = .blue
    var font: Font = .system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold)
    var label: LocalizedStringKey = "Progress"

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var level: Double {
        progress.isNaN ? 0 : min(max(progress, 0), 1)
    }

    private var percentText: Text {
        Text(level, format: .percent.precision(.fractionLength(0)))
    }

    var body: some View {
        TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval: 1.0 / 30.0, paused: reduceMotion)) { context in
            let phase = reduceMotion ? 0 : context.date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * 2.4
            let frontWave = LiquidFillWave(level: level, phase: phase)

            ZStack {
                Circle()
                    .fill(color.opacity(0.14))

                LiquidFillWave(level: level, phase: -phase * 0.8 + 1.4)
                    .fill(color.opacity(0.45))

                frontWave
                    .fill(color.gradient)

                percentLabel
                    .foregroundStyle(color)

                percentLabel
                    .foregroundStyle(LiquidFillProgressContrastingForeground(background: color))
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                    .mask(frontWave)
            }
            .clipShape(.circle)
            .overlay {
                Circle()
                    .strokeBorder(color.opacity(0.6), lineWidth: 3)
            }
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.9), value: level)
        }
        .aspectRatio(1, contentMode: .fit)
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel(label)
        .accessibilityValue(percentText)
    }

    private var percentLabel: some View {
        percentText
            .font(font)
            .monospacedDigit()
            .minimumScaleFactor(0.4)
            .lineLimit(1)
            .padding(12)
            .accessibilityRepresentation { EmptyView() }
    }
}

/// The liquid: only `level` is animatable, so a level change eases while `phase` keeps following the clock.
nonisolated private struct LiquidFillWave: Shape {
    var level: Double
    var phase: Double

    var animatableData: Double {
        get { level }
        set { level = newValue }
    }

    func path(in rect: CGRect) -> Path {
        guard !rect.isEmpty else { return Path() }

        let surface = rect.maxY - rect.height * level
        let swell = rect.height * 0.05 * min(1, min(level, 1 - level) * 6)

        var path = Path()
        path.move(to: CGPoint(x: rect.minX, y: rect.maxY))
        for x in stride(from: rect.minX, through: rect.maxX, by: 2) {
            let angle = (x - rect.minX) / rect.width * 3 * .pi + phase
            path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: x, y: surface + sin(angle) * swell))
        }
        path.addLine(to: CGPoint(x: rect.maxX, y: rect.maxY))
        path.closeSubpath()
        return path
    }
}

/// White or black, whichever reads better on `background`. Black only on a
/// light color, so the system's own colors keep white.
nonisolated struct LiquidFillProgressContrastingForeground: ShapeStyle {
    let background: Color

    func resolve(in environment: EnvironmentValues) -> Color {
        let color = background.resolve(in: environment)
        let luminance = 0.2126 * color.linearRed + 0.7152 * color.linearGreen + 0.0722 * color.linearBlue
        return luminance > 0.5 ? .black : .white
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct LiquidFillProgressDemo: View {
    @State private var progress = 0.15
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var percentSize = 64

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 28) {
            Text("Daily water")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

            LiquidFillProgress(
                progress: progress,
                color: .cyan,
                font: .system(size: percentSize, weight: .bold, design: .rounded),
                label: "Daily water"
            )
            .frame(width: 280)

            Text("Keep going, one more glass")
                .font(.body)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .task {
            let levels = [0.15, 0.45, 0.8, 1, 0.5]
            var index = 0
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.9))
                index = (index + 1) % levels.count
                progress = levels[index]
            }
        }
    }
}

    LiquidFillProgressDemo()
}
```

## Step Progress Indicator

Numbered steps joined by a line that fills as the current step advances.

Category: Progress. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Progress/StepProgressIndicator/StepProgressIndicator.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// Numbered steps joined by a line that fills as the current step advances.
///
/// `currentStep` starts at 0. Passing `steps.count` marks every step as done.
/// With Reduce Motion on, the steps change without animating.
struct StepProgressIndicator: View {
    let steps: [String]
    var currentStep: Int
    var tint: Color = .indigo

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .subheadline) private var markerSize = 36
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let lineHeight: CGFloat = 4

    private var current: Int { min(max(currentStep, 0), steps.count) }

    private var lineFraction: CGFloat {
        guard steps.count > 1 else { return 0 }
        return CGFloat(min(current, steps.count - 1)) / CGFloat(steps.count - 1)
    }

    var body: some View {
        HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(steps.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                VStack(spacing: 8) {
                    marker(index)

                    Text(steps[index])
                        .font(.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(index <= current ? .primary : .secondary)
                        .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                }
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            }
        }
        .background(alignment: .topLeading) { line }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.45), value: current)
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel("Progress")
        .accessibilityValue(accessibilityText)
    }

    private var line: some View {
        GeometryReader { proxy in
            let inset = proxy.size.width / CGFloat(max(steps.count, 1) * 2)
            let length = proxy.size.width - inset * 2

            ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Capsule()
                    .fill(Color(.systemGray5))

                Capsule()
                    .fill(tint)
                    .frame(width: length * lineFraction)
            }
            .frame(width: length, height: lineHeight)
            .offset(x: inset, y: (markerSize - lineHeight) / 2)
        }
    }

    private func marker(_ index: Int) -> some View {
        let isDone = index < current
        let isCurrent = index == current

        return ZStack {
            Circle()
                .fill(isDone || isCurrent ? tint : Color(.systemGray5))

            if isDone {
                Image(systemName: "checkmark")
                    .fontWeight(.bold)
                    .transition(.scale.combined(with: .opacity))
            } else {
                Text("\(index + 1)")
            }
        }
        .font(.subheadline.weight(.semibold))
        .foregroundStyle(isDone || isCurrent ? Color.white : Color.primary)
        .frame(width: markerSize, height: markerSize)
        .background {
            Circle()
                .fill(tint.opacity(0.25))
                .padding(-5)
                .opacity(isCurrent ? 1 : 0)
        }
    }

    private var accessibilityText: String {
        guard current < steps.count else { return "All \(steps.count) steps done" }
        return "Step \(current + 1) of \(steps.count), \(steps[current])"
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct StepProgressIndicatorDemo: View {
    @State private var step = 0

    private let steps = ["Cart", "Address", "Payment", "Review"]
    private let symbols = ["cart.fill", "house.fill", "creditcard.fill", "checkmark.seal.fill"]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 44) {
            Image(systemName: symbols[min(step, symbols.count - 1)])
                .font(.system(.largeTitle))
                .imageScale(.large)
                .foregroundStyle(.indigo.gradient)
                .contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace))
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Text("Checkout")
                .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

            StepProgressIndicator(steps: steps, currentStep: step)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .task {
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(0.9))
                step = (step + 1) % (steps.count + 1)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Auto Advance Carousel

A paged carousel that advances on a timer and pauses while the user is dragging it.

Category: Scrolling. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Scrolling/AutoAdvanceCarousel/AutoAdvanceCarousel.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A paged carousel that advances on a timer and pauses while the user is dragging it.
///
/// It stays still with Reduce Motion or VoiceOver on, and can always be swiped by hand.
struct AutoAdvanceCarousel<Item: Identifiable, Content: View>: View {
    let items: [Item]
    var interval: TimeInterval = 3
    @ViewBuilder var content: (Item) -> Content

    @State private var currentID: Item.ID?
    @State private var isUserScrolling = false

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.accessibilityVoiceOverEnabled) private var voiceOverEnabled

    private var currentIndex: Int? { items.firstIndex { $0.id == currentID } }

    private var schedule: AutoAdvanceCarouselSchedule<Item.ID> {
        AutoAdvanceCarouselSchedule(
            isRunning: !isUserScrolling && !reduceMotion && !voiceOverEnabled && items.count > 1,
            interval: max(interval, 0.5),
            itemIDs: items.map(\.id)
        )
    }

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                LazyHStack(spacing: 0) {
                    ForEach(items) { item in
                        content(item)
                            .containerRelativeFrame(.horizontal)
                    }
                }
                .scrollTargetLayout()
            }
            .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
            .scrollTargetBehavior(.paging)
            .scrollPosition(id: $currentID)
            .onScrollPhaseChange { _, phase in
                isUserScrolling = phase == .tracking || phase == .interacting || phase == .decelerating
            }

            pageIndicator
        }
        .task(id: schedule) {
            guard schedule.isRunning else { return }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(schedule.interval))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                move(to: AutoAdvanceCarouselMath.nextIndex(after: currentIndex, count: items.count))
            }
        }
    }

    private var pageIndicator: some View {
        let position = (currentIndex ?? 0) + 1

        return ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
            HStack(spacing: 7) {
                ForEach(items.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                    Capsule()
                        .fill(index == position - 1 ? AnyShapeStyle(.primary) : AnyShapeStyle(.tertiary))
                        .frame(width: index == position - 1 ? 22 : 7, height: 7)
                }
            }
            Text("\(position) / \(items.count)")
                .font(.caption.monospacedDigit())
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: position)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel("Page")
        .accessibilityValue("\(position) of \(items.count)")
        .accessibilityAdjustableAction { direction in
            let index = currentIndex ?? 0
            let target = direction == .increment ? index + 1 : index - 1
            move(to: items.indices.contains(target) ? target : nil)
        }
    }

    private func move(to index: Int?) {
        guard let index, items.indices.contains(index) else { return }
        withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.5)) {
            currentID = items[index].id
        }
    }
}

/// The timer restarts when any of this changes. The ids matter because it holds on to the items.
private struct AutoAdvanceCarouselSchedule<ID: Hashable>: Equatable {
    let isRunning: Bool
    let interval: TimeInterval
    let itemIDs: [ID]
}

enum AutoAdvanceCarouselMath {
    /// The next page, wrapping to the first. Nil when there is nowhere to go.
    static func nextIndex(after current: Int?, count: Int) -> Int? {
        guard count > 1 else { return nil }
        return ((current ?? 0) + 1) % count
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct AutoAdvanceCarouselDemo: View {
    private struct Slide: Identifiable {
        let id: String
        let symbol: String
        let colors: [Color]
    }

    private let slides = [
        Slide(id: "Summer Sale", symbol: "sun.max.fill", colors: [.orange, .pink]),
        Slide(id: "New Arrivals", symbol: "sparkles", colors: [.indigo, .purple]),
        Slide(id: "Free Shipping", symbol: "shippingbox.fill", colors: [.teal, .blue]),
        Slide(id: "Gift Cards", symbol: "gift.fill", colors: [.green, .mint]),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 18) {
            Text("Discover")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .padding(.horizontal, 20)

            AutoAdvanceCarousel(items: slides, interval: 1.5) { slide in
                ZStack(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                    LinearGradient(colors: slide.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                    Image(systemName: slide.symbol)
                        .font(.system(.largeTitle))
                        .imageScale(.large)
                        .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.85))
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    Text(slide.id)
                        .font(.title.weight(.bold))
                        .foregroundStyle(.white)
                        .padding(20)
                }
                .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 26, style: .continuous))
                .padding(.horizontal, 20)
            }
            .frame(height: 420)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
    }
}

#Preview {
    AutoAdvanceCarouselDemo()
}
```

## Cover Flow Carousel

A horizontal carousel where the centered item faces forward and its neighbours turn away in 3D as you scroll.

Category: Scrolling. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Scrolling/CoverFlowCarousel/CoverFlowCarousel.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct CoverFlowCarouselItem: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: String
    let image: Image
}

/// A horizontal carousel where the centered item faces forward and its neighbours turn away in 3D.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, items stay flat and only fade.
struct CoverFlowCarousel: View {
    let items: [CoverFlowCarouselItem]
    @Binding var selection: String?

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geometry in
            let containerWidth = geometry.size.width
            let itemWidth = max(containerWidth * 0.62, 1)
            let tilts = !reduceMotion

            ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                LazyHStack(spacing: 8) {
                    ForEach(Array(items.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, item in
                        card(for: item, position: index + 1)
                            .frame(width: itemWidth, height: min(itemWidth * 1.4, geometry.size.height))
                            .frame(maxHeight: .infinity)
                            .visualEffect { content, proxy in
                                let position = CoverFlowCarouselMath.position(midX: proxy.frame(in: .scrollView).midX, width: containerWidth)
                                return content
                                    .scaleEffect(tilts ? 1 - abs(position) * 0.14 : 1)
                                    .rotation3DEffect(.degrees(tilts ? position * -52 : 0), axis: (0, 1, 0), perspective: 0.5)
                                    .opacity(1 - abs(position) * 0.4)
                            }
                    }
                }
                .scrollTargetLayout()
            }
            .contentMargins(.horizontal, max((containerWidth - itemWidth) / 2, 0), for: .scrollContent)
            .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
            .scrollTargetBehavior(.viewAligned)
            .scrollPosition(id: $selection, anchor: .center)
        }
    }

    private func card(for item: CoverFlowCarouselItem, position: Int) -> some View {
        Color.clear
            .overlay {
                item.image
                    .resizable()
                    .scaledToFill()
                    .accessibilityRepresentation { EmptyView() }
            }
            .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                Text(item.title)
                    .font(.title3.weight(.bold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .lineLimit(2)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
                    .padding(16)
                    .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
                    .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.clear, .black.opacity(0.55)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
            }
            .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 24, style: .continuous))
            .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.25), radius: 14, y: 8)
            .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
            .accessibilityLabel(item.title)
            .accessibilityValue("\(position) of \(items.count)")
    }
}

nonisolated enum CoverFlowCarouselMath {
    /// How far an item is from the center of the carousel: 0 at the center, -1 or 1 one half width away.
    static func position(midX: Double, width: Double) -> Double {
        guard width > 0, midX.isFinite else { return 0 }
        let halfWidth = width / 2
        return min(max((midX - halfWidth) / halfWidth, -1), 1)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct CoverFlowCarouselDemo: View {
    @State private var selection: String? = "Midnight"
    /// Only for this demo: it plays by itself until someone touches it.
    @State private var isAutoPlaying = true

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let items = [
        CoverFlowCarouselItem(id: "Sunset", title: "Sunset", image: artwork([.orange, .pink], symbol: "sun.horizon.fill")),
        CoverFlowCarouselItem(id: "Forest", title: "Forest", image: artwork([.green, .teal], symbol: "tree.fill")),
        CoverFlowCarouselItem(id: "Midnight", title: "Midnight", image: artwork([.indigo, .black], symbol: "moon.stars.fill")),
        CoverFlowCarouselItem(id: "Ocean", title: "Ocean", image: artwork([.cyan, .blue], symbol: "water.waves")),
        CoverFlowCarouselItem(id: "Bloom", title: "Bloom", image: artwork([.pink, .purple], symbol: "camera.macro")),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 18) {
            Text("Albums")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)

            CoverFlowCarousel(items: items, selection: $selection)
                .frame(height: 400)

            Text(selection ?? "")
                .font(.headline)
                .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.75))
                .contentTransition(.opacity)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(.black)
        .simultaneousGesture(DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0).onChanged { _ in isAutoPlaying = false })
        .task(id: reduceMotion) {
            guard !reduceMotion else { return }
            let order = [3, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, 1, 2]
            var step = 3
            while isAutoPlaying {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.3))
                guard !Task.isCancelled, isAutoPlaying else { return }
                step = (step + 1) % order.count
                withAnimation(.smooth(duration: 0.8)) { selection = items[order[step]].id }
            }
        }
    }

    private static func artwork(_ colors: [Color], symbol: String) -> Image {
        let size = CGSize(width: 300, height: 420)
        return Image(size: size, opaque: true) { context in
            context.fill(
                Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)),
                with: .linearGradient(Gradient(colors: colors), startPoint: .zero, endPoint: CGPoint(x: size.width, y: size.height))
            )

            var icon = context.resolve(Image(systemName: symbol))
            icon.shading = .color(.white.opacity(0.85))
            let scale = 110 / max(icon.size.width, icon.size.height, 1)
            let iconSize = CGSize(width: icon.size.width * scale, height: icon.size.height * scale)
            context.draw(icon, in: CGRect(
                x: (size.width - iconSize.width) / 2,
                y: (size.height - iconSize.height) / 2,
                width: iconSize.width,
                height: iconSize.height
            ))
        }
    }
}

}
```

## Hide On Scroll Bar

A bottom bar that slides out of view while the user scrolls down and returns as soon as they scroll up.

Category: Scrolling. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Scrolling/HideOnScrollBar/HideOnScrollBar.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A scroll view with a bottom bar that hides while scrolling down and returns on scrolling up.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the bar fades instead of sliding. With VoiceOver on, it stays visible.
struct HideOnScrollBar<Content: View, Bar: View>: View {
    var threshold: Double = 16
    @ViewBuilder var content: () -> Content
    @ViewBuilder var bar: () -> Bar

    @State private var tracker = HideOnScrollBarTracker()
    @State private var isHidden = false
    @State private var barHeight: CGFloat = 0

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.accessibilityVoiceOverEnabled) private var voiceOverEnabled

    private var hidesBar: Bool { isHidden && !voiceOverEnabled }

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView(content: content)
            .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom, spacing: 0) {
                bar()
                    .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.height } action: { barHeight = $0 }
                    .offset(y: hidesBar && !reduceMotion ? barHeight + 60 : 0)
                    .opacity(hidesBar && reduceMotion ? 0 : 1)
                    .allowsHitTesting(!hidesBar)
                    .animation(reduceMotion ? .linear(duration: 0.15) : .snappy(duration: 0.3), value: hidesBar)
            }
            .onScrollGeometryChange(for: HideOnScrollBarMetrics.self) { geometry in
                HideOnScrollBarMetrics(
                    offset: geometry.contentOffset.y + geometry.contentInsets.top,
                    maxOffset: geometry.contentSize.height + geometry.contentInsets.top + geometry.contentInsets.bottom - geometry.containerSize.height
                )
            } action: { _, metrics in
                tracker.update(offset: metrics.offset, maxOffset: metrics.maxOffset, threshold: threshold)
                isHidden = tracker.isHidden
            }
    }
}

private struct HideOnScrollBarMetrics: Equatable {
    let offset: Double
    let maxOffset: Double
}

/// Decides when the bar hides, ignoring small movements and the bounce at both ends.
struct HideOnScrollBarTracker: Equatable {
    private(set) var isHidden = false
    private var lastOffset = 0.0
    private var travel = 0.0

    mutating func update(offset: Double, maxOffset: Double, threshold: Double = 16) {
        guard offset > 0, maxOffset > 0 else {
            isHidden = false
            lastOffset = max(offset, 0)
            travel = 0
            return
        }
        guard offset < maxOffset else {
            lastOffset = maxOffset
            return
        }

        let delta = offset - lastOffset
        lastOffset = offset
        guard delta != 0 else { return }

        if (delta > 0) != (travel > 0) {
            travel = 0
        }
        travel += delta

        let required = max(threshold, 0)
        if travel >= required {
            isHidden = true
        } else if travel <= -required {
            isHidden = false
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct HideOnScrollBarDemo: View {
    /// Only for this demo: it plays by itself until someone touches it.
    @State private var isAutoPlaying = true
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private let colors: [Color] = [.indigo, .teal, .orange, .pink, .blue, .green]

    var body: some View {
        ScrollViewReader { proxy in
            HideOnScrollBar {
                VStack(spacing: 12) {
                    ForEach(0..<30, id: \.self) { index in
                        row(index)
                            .id(index)
                    }
                }
                .padding(16)
            } bar: {
                HStack(spacing: 0) {
                    barButton("Home", symbol: "house.fill")
                    barButton("Search", symbol: "magnifyingglass")
                    barButton("Library", symbol: "books.vertical.fill")
                    barButton("Profile", symbol: "person.fill")
                }
                .padding(.vertical, 6)
                .padding(.horizontal, 8)
                .background(.regularMaterial, in: .capsule)
                .shadow(color: .black.opacity(0.18), radius: 14, y: 6)
                .padding(.horizontal, 28)
                .padding(.bottom, 4)
            }
            .simultaneousGesture(DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0).onChanged { _ in isAutoPlaying = false })
            .task(id: reduceMotion) {
                guard !reduceMotion else { return }
                var target = 0
                while isAutoPlaying {
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.6))
                    guard !Task.isCancelled, isAutoPlaying else { return }
                    target = target == 12 ? 4 : 12
                    withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1)) {
                        proxy.scrollTo(target, anchor: .top)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private func row(_ index: Int) -> some View {
        HStack(spacing: 14) {
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 14, style: .continuous)
                .fill(colors[index % colors.count].gradient)
                .frame(width: 56, height: 56)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
                Text("Article \(index + 1)")
                    .font(.headline)
                Text("A short line of supporting text.")
                    .font(.subheadline)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
            }
            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(12)
        .background(.quaternary.opacity(0.5), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18, style: .continuous))
    }

    private func barButton(_ title: String, symbol: String) -> some View {
        Button {} label: {
            Image(systemName: symbol)
                .font(.title3)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 44)
        }
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
    }
}
```

## Infinite Marquee Row

A row of content that scrolls forever without a visible seam.

Category: Scrolling. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Scrolling/InfiniteMarqueeRow/InfiniteMarqueeRow.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A row of content that scrolls forever without a seam.
///
/// `speed` is in points per second. With Reduce Motion on, the row stops
/// moving and becomes a normal horizontal scroll view.
struct InfiniteMarqueeRow<Content: View>: View {
    var speed: Double = 40
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12
    var reversed = false
    @ViewBuilder var content: () -> Content

    @State private var contentWidth: CGFloat = 0
    @State private var containerWidth: CGFloat = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    /// The distance after which a copy lands exactly where the previous one was.
    private var loopWidth: CGFloat { contentWidth + spacing }

    private var copies: Int {
        guard contentWidth > 0 else { return 1 }
        return Int((containerWidth / loopWidth).rounded(.up)) + 1
    }

    var body: some View {
        if reduceMotion {
            ScrollView(.horizontal) { row }
                .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
        } else {
            TimelineView(.animation) { context in
                track.offset(x: offset(at: context.date))
            }
            // A zero ideal width keeps the number of copies from feeding back into the row's own size.
            .frame(minWidth: 0, idealWidth: 0, maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .clipped()
            .onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.width } action: { containerWidth = $0 }
        }
    }

    private var row: some View {
        HStack(spacing: spacing) { content() }
            .fixedSize()
    }

    private var track: some View {
        HStack(spacing: spacing) {
            row.onGeometryChange(for: CGFloat.self) { $0.size.width } action: { contentWidth = $0 }

            ForEach(1..<copies, id: \.self) { _ in
                row.accessibilityRepresentation { EmptyView() }
            }
        }
        .fixedSize()
    }

    private func offset(at date: Date) -> CGFloat {
        guard contentWidth > 0 else { return 0 }
        let distance = CGFloat(date.timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate * speed).truncatingRemainder(dividingBy: loopWidth)
        return reversed ? distance - loopWidth : -distance
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct InfiniteMarqueeRowDemo: View {
    private let rows: [(tags: [String], tint: Color, speed: Double)] = [
        (["SwiftUI", "Layout", "Gestures", "Animation", "Scrolling"], .pink, 46),
        (["Metal", "Shaders", "Particles", "Gradients", "Glass"], .orange, 32),
        (["Haptics", "Charts", "Maps", "Widgets", "Live Activities"], .teal, 54),
        (["Swift 6", "Concurrency", "Observation", "Testing", "Macros"], .purple, 38),
        (["Accessibility", "Dynamic Type", "VoiceOver", "Reduce Motion"], .blue, 48),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            Text("Trending topics")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .padding(.bottom, 20)

            ForEach(rows.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                InfiniteMarqueeRow(speed: rows[index].speed, reversed: index.isMultiple(of: 2)) {
                    ForEach(rows[index].tags, id: \.self) { tag in
                        Text(tag)
                            .font(.system(.body, design: .rounded, weight: .semibold))
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                            .padding(.horizontal, 18)
                            .padding(.vertical, 12)
                            .background(rows[index].tint.gradient, in: .capsule)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.black, .indigo], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
    }
}
```

## Netflix Rows Scroller

A vertical stack of titled horizontal rows where each row scrolls on its own, like a streaming home screen.

Category: Scrolling. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Scrolling/NetflixRowsScroller/NetflixRowsScroller.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct NetflixRowsScrollerTitle: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let name: String
    let image: Image
}

struct NetflixRowsScrollerRow: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: String
    let items: [NetflixRowsScrollerTitle]
}

/// A vertical stack of titled horizontal rows where each row scrolls on its own.
struct NetflixRowsScroller: View {
    let rows: [NetflixRowsScrollerRow]
    var onSelect: (NetflixRowsScrollerTitle) -> Void = { _ in }

    private let posterSpacing: CGFloat = 10

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
                ForEach(rows) { row in
                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 10) {
                        Text(row.title)
                            .font(.title3.weight(.bold))
                            .padding(.horizontal, 16)
                            .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)

                        ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                            LazyHStack(spacing: posterSpacing) {
                                ForEach(row.items) { item in
                                    poster(for: item)
                                        .containerRelativeFrame(.horizontal, count: 3, span: 1, spacing: posterSpacing)
                                }
                            }
                            .scrollTargetLayout()
                        }
                        .contentMargins(.horizontal, 16, for: .scrollContent)
                        .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
                        .scrollTargetBehavior(.viewAligned)
                    }
                }
            }
            .padding(.vertical, 12)
        }
    }

    private func poster(for item: NetflixRowsScrollerTitle) -> some View {
        Button {
            onSelect(item)
        } label: {
            Color.clear
                .aspectRatio(2.0 / 3.0, contentMode: .fit)
                .overlay {
                    item.image
                        .resizable()
                        .scaledToFill()
                        .accessibilityRepresentation { EmptyView() }
                }
                .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 10, style: .continuous))
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(item.name)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct NetflixRowsScrollerDemo: View {

        [.red, .orange], [.indigo, .purple], [.teal, .blue], [.pink, .purple], [.green, .teal], [.orange, .yellow],
    ]

    private static let symbols = ["film.fill", "sparkles", "flame.fill", "bolt.fill", "moon.fill", "star.fill", "theatermasks.fill", "globe.americas.fill"]

    private let rows: [NetflixRowsScrollerRow] = ["Trending Now", "New Releases", "Because You Watched", "Top Picks"].enumerated().map { rowIndex, title in
        NetflixRowsScrollerRow(id: title, title: title, items: (0..<8).map { index in

                id: "\(title)-\(index)",
                name: "\(title) \(index + 1)",

            .foregroundStyle(.white)

                Path(CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size)),

            icon.shading = .color(.white.opacity(0.9))
            let scale = 80 / max(icon.size.width, icon.size.height, 1)
            let iconSize = CGSize(width: icon.size.width * scale, height: icon.size.height * scale)
            context.draw(icon, in: CGRect(
                x: (size.width - iconSize.width) / 2,
                y: (size.height - iconSize.height) / 2,
                width: iconSize.width,
                height: iconSize.height
            ))
        }
    }
```

## Onboarding Pager

A full-screen onboarding flow with swipeable pages, a progress indicator and a button that advances or finishes.

Category: Scrolling. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Scrolling/OnboardingPager/OnboardingPager.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct OnboardingPagerPage {
    var symbol: String
    var title: LocalizedStringResource
    var message: LocalizedStringResource
    var colors: [Color]
}

/// A full-screen onboarding flow with swipeable pages, a progress indicator and a button
/// that advances or finishes. `onFinish` runs once.
struct OnboardingPager: View {
    let pages: [OnboardingPagerPage]
    var finishTitle: LocalizedStringResource = "Get Started"
    var onFinish: () -> Void = {}

    @State private var page = 0
    @State private var didFinish = false

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var isLastPage: Bool { page >= pages.count - 1 }

    var body: some View {
        if pages.isEmpty {
            Color.clear
        } else {
            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                TabView(selection: $page) {
                    ForEach(Array(pages.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, item in
                        OnboardingPagerContent(page: item, isActive: index == page)
                            .tag(index)
                    }
                }
                .tabViewStyle(.page(indexDisplayMode: .never))

                indicator

                Button(action: advance) {
                    Text(isLastPage ? finishTitle : "Continue")
                        .font(.headline)
                        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: 50)
                }
                .buttonStyle(.plain)
                .foregroundStyle(.black)
                .background(.white, in: .capsule)
                .padding(.horizontal, 24)
                .padding(.bottom, 12)
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .background {
                LinearGradient(colors: currentColors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                    .ignoresSafeArea()
            }
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.35), value: page)
            .sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: page)
            .onChange(of: pages.count) { _, count in
                page = min(page, max(count - 1, 0))
            }
        }
    }

    private var currentColors: [Color] {
        pages.indices.contains(page) ? pages[page].colors : [.black]
    }

    private var indicator: some View {
        ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                ForEach(pages.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                    Capsule()
                        .fill(.white.opacity(index == page ? 1 : 0.4))
                        .frame(width: index == page ? 28 : 8, height: 8)
                }
            }
            Text("\(page + 1) / \(pages.count)")
                .font(.footnote.monospacedDigit())
        }
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel("Page")
        .accessibilityValue("\(min(page + 1, pages.count)) of \(pages.count)")
    }

    private func advance() {
        if isLastPage {
            guard !didFinish else { return }
            didFinish = true
            onFinish()
        } else {
            withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.4)) { page += 1 }
        }
    }
}

private struct OnboardingPagerContent: View {
    let page: OnboardingPagerPage
    let isActive: Bool

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var symbolSize: CGFloat = 96
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ViewThatFits(in: .vertical) {
            content
            ScrollView { content }
        }
    }

    private var content: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 24) {
            Image(systemName: page.symbol)
                .font(.system(size: symbolSize, weight: .semibold))
                .symbolEffect(.bounce, value: reduceMotion ? false : isActive)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            VStack(spacing: 10) {
                Text(page.title)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    .accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)
                Text(page.message)
                    .font(.body)
                    .opacity(0.85)
            }
            .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, 32)
        .padding(.vertical, 16)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct OnboardingPagerDemo: View {
    @State private var run = 0

    private let pages = [
        OnboardingPagerPage(symbol: "sparkles", title: "Welcome", message: "A calmer way to keep track of your day.", colors: [.indigo, .purple]),
        OnboardingPagerPage(symbol: "bell.badge.fill", title: "Stay on Time", message: "Gentle reminders, only when they matter.", colors: [.orange, .pink]),
        OnboardingPagerPage(symbol: "checkmark.seal.fill", title: "All Set", message: "Your first list is ready and waiting.", colors: [.teal, .blue]),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        OnboardingPager(pages: pages, onFinish: { run += 1 })
            .id(run)
    }
}

#Preview {
    OnboardingPagerDemo()
}
```

## Paged Grid Launcher

A launcher of icon grids that pages horizontally, with each page filled row by row like the iOS home screen.

Category: Scrolling. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Scrolling/PagedGridLauncher/PagedGridLauncher.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

struct PagedGridLauncherItem: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let symbol: String
    let colors: [Color]
}

/// A launcher of icon grids that pages horizontally, each page filled row by row.
struct PagedGridLauncher: View {
    let items: [PagedGridLauncherItem]
    @Binding var page: Int
    var columns: Int = 4
    var rows: Int = 5
    var onSelect: (PagedGridLauncherItem) -> Void = { _ in }

    @State private var scrolledPage: Int?

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .caption2) private var iconSize: CGFloat = 60
    private let pageDotSize: CGFloat = 8
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.dynamicTypeSize) private var dynamicTypeSize

    private var columnCount: Int {
        let requested = PagedGridLauncherLayout.clamped(columns)
        return dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize ? min(requested, 2) : requested
    }

    private var pages: [Range<Int>] {
        PagedGridLauncherLayout.pages(itemCount: items.count, columns: columnCount, rows: rows)
    }

    var body: some View {
        let pages = pages

        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            ScrollView(.horizontal) {
                LazyHStack(spacing: 0) {
                    ForEach(pages.indices, id: \.self) { index in
                        pageView(pages[index])
                            .containerRelativeFrame(.horizontal)
                    }
                }
                .scrollTargetLayout()
            }
            .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
            .scrollTargetBehavior(.paging)
            .scrollPosition(id: $scrolledPage)

            pageIndicator(count: pages.count)
        }
        .onAppear { scrolledPage = page }
        .onChange(of: scrolledPage) { _, value in
            if let value, value != page {
                page = value
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: page) { _, value in
            if value != scrolledPage {
                withAnimation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.45)) { scrolledPage = value }
            }
        }
        .onChange(of: pages.count) { _, count in
            page = min(page, max(count - 1, 0))
        }
    }

    private func pageView(_ range: Range<Int>) -> some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 10), count: columnCount), spacing: 20) {
                ForEach(items[range]) { item in
                    icon(for: item)
                }
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 18)
            .padding(.vertical, 8)
        }
        .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
        .scrollBounceBehavior(.basedOnSize)
    }

    private func icon(for item: PagedGridLauncherItem) -> some View {
        Button {
            onSelect(item)
        } label: {
            VStack(spacing: 6) {
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: iconSize * 0.24, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(LinearGradient(colors: item.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing))
                    .frame(width: iconSize, height: iconSize)
                    .overlay {
                        Image(systemName: item.symbol)
                            .font(.system(size: iconSize * 0.46, weight: .medium))
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    }
                Text(item.title)
                    .font(.caption2.weight(.medium))
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.75)
            }
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(item.title)
    }

    private func pageIndicator(count: Int) -> some View {
        ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
            HStack(spacing: 8) {
                ForEach(0..<count, id: \.self) { index in
                    Circle()
                        .fill(.primary.opacity(index == page ? 0.9 : 0.25))
                        .frame(width: pageDotSize, height: pageDotSize)
                }
            }
            Text("\(page + 1) / \(count)")
                .font(.caption.monospacedDigit())
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: page)
        .accessibilityElement(children: .ignore)
        .accessibilityLabel("Page")
        .accessibilityValue("\(min(page + 1, count)) of \(count)")
        .accessibilityAdjustableAction { direction in
            let target = direction == .increment ? page + 1 : page - 1
            if (0..<count).contains(target) {
                page = target
            }
        }
    }
}

enum PagedGridLauncherLayout {
    static func clamped(_ value: Int) -> Int {
        min(max(value, 1), 12)
    }

    /// Splits the items into page-sized ranges, filling each page before the next one.
    static func pages(itemCount: Int, columns: Int, rows: Int) -> [Range<Int>] {
        guard itemCount > 0 else { return [] }
        let perPage = clamped(columns) * clamped(rows)
        return stride(from: 0, to: itemCount, by: perPage).map { start in
            start..<(itemCount - start > perPage ? start + perPage : itemCount)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct PagedGridLauncherDemo: View {
    @State private var page = 0

    /// Only for this demo: it plays by itself until someone touches it.
    @State private var isAutoPlaying = true
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private static let palettes: [[Color]] = [
        [.blue, .cyan], [.pink, .orange], [.green, .mint], [.purple, .indigo], [.orange, .yellow], [.teal, .blue], [.red, .pink],
    ]

    private static let apps: [(String, String)] = [
        ("Mail", "envelope.fill"), ("Maps", "map.fill"), ("Music", "music.note"), ("Photos", "photo.fill"),
        ("Clock", "clock.fill"), ("Notes", "note.text"), ("Files", "folder.fill"), ("Books", "book.fill"),
        ("Camera", "camera.fill"), ("Wallet", "wallet.pass.fill"), ("Weather", "cloud.sun.fill"), ("Home", "house.fill"),
        ("Health", "heart.fill"), ("News", "newspaper.fill"), ("Stocks", "chart.line.uptrend.xyaxis"), ("Calendar", "calendar"),
        ("Phone", "phone.fill"), ("Chat", "message.fill"), ("Video", "video.fill"), ("Radio", "dot.radiowaves.left.and.right"),
    ]

    private let items: [PagedGridLauncherItem] = (0..<46).map { index in
        let app = apps[index % apps.count]
        return PagedGridLauncherItem(id: "\(index)", title: "\(app.0)", symbol: app.1, colors: palettes[index % palettes.count])
    }

    var body: some View {
        PagedGridLauncher(items: items, page: $page)
            .padding(.vertical, 12)
            .background(LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo.opacity(0.35), .teal.opacity(0.25)], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
            .simultaneousGesture(DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0).onChanged { _ in isAutoPlaying = false })
            .task(id: reduceMotion) {
                guard !reduceMotion else { return }
                while isAutoPlaying {
                    try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.3))
                    guard !Task.isCancelled, isAutoPlaying else { return }
                    page = (page + 1) % 3
                }
            }
    }
}
```

## Parallax Cards Row

A horizontal carousel whose card artwork moves in parallax using visualEffect.

Category: Scrolling. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Scrolling/ParallaxCardsRow/ParallaxCardsRow.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A horizontal carousel whose card artwork moves slower than the card, for a parallax effect.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the artwork stays still inside the card.
struct ParallaxCardsRow<Item: Identifiable, Artwork: View, Overlay: View>: View {
    let items: [Item]
    var height: CGFloat = 460
    var strength: CGFloat = 70
    @ViewBuilder var artwork: (Item) -> Artwork
    @ViewBuilder var overlay: (Item) -> Overlay

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        // `visualEffect` takes a `@Sendable` closure, so it works with a local copy.
        let shift = reduceMotion ? 0 : strength

        ScrollView(.horizontal) {
            LazyHStack(spacing: 16) {
                ForEach(items) { item in
                    artwork(item)
                        .padding(.horizontal, -strength)
                        .visualEffect { content, proxy in
                            content.offset(x: parallaxOffset(in: proxy, shift: shift))
                        }
                        .containerRelativeFrame(.horizontal) { width, _ in width * 0.85 }
                        .frame(height: height)
                        .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 30))
                        .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) { overlay(item) }
                }
            }
            .scrollTargetLayout()
        }
        .contentMargins(.horizontal, 40, for: .scrollContent)
        .scrollTargetBehavior(.viewAligned)
        .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
    }
}

// Moves against the scroll in proportion to the card's distance from the middle of the
// scroll view. It is clamped so the oversized artwork never exposes its edges.
private nonisolated func parallaxOffset(in proxy: GeometryProxy, shift: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
    // `bounds(of:)` is converted to the card's own coordinate space.
    guard let bounds = proxy.bounds(of: .scrollView(axis: .horizontal)), bounds.width > 0 else { return 0 }
    let distance = (proxy.size.width / 2 - bounds.midX) / bounds.width
    return -min(max(distance, -1), 1) * shift
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct ParallaxDemoCard: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let systemImage: String
    let colors: [Color]
}

struct ParallaxCardsRowDemo: View {
    private let cards = [
        ParallaxDemoCard(id: "Alps", systemImage: "mountain.2.fill", colors: [.blue, .indigo]),
        ParallaxDemoCard(id: "Sahara", systemImage: "sun.max.fill", colors: [.orange, .red]),
        ParallaxDemoCard(id: "Amazon", systemImage: "leaf.fill", colors: [.green, .teal]),
        ParallaxDemoCard(id: "Arctic", systemImage: "snowflake", colors: [.cyan, .purple]),
        ParallaxDemoCard(id: "Pacific", systemImage: "water.waves", colors: [.teal, .blue]),
    ]

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var symbolSize = 180.0

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color.black
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            ParallaxCardsRow(items: cards) { card in
                LinearGradient(colors: card.colors, startPoint: .leading, endPoint: .trailing)
                    .overlay {
                        Image(systemName: card.systemImage)
                            .font(.system(size: symbolSize))
                            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.35))
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    }
            } overlay: { card in
                Text(card.id)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                    .foregroundStyle(.white)
                    .padding(28)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## Peek Carousel

A paging carousel that shows the edges of its neighbours.

Category: Scrolling. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Scrolling/PeekCarousel/PeekCarousel.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A paging carousel that shows the edges of the neighbouring cards.
///
/// `peek` is how much of each neighbour stays visible. Give the cards a height.
/// With Reduce Motion on, side cards keep their size and only dim.
struct PeekCarousel<Item: Identifiable, Card: View>: View {
    let items: [Item]
    var peek: CGFloat = 28
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12
    @ViewBuilder var card: (Item) -> Card

    @State private var currentID: Item.ID?
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 18) {
            carousel
            dots
        }
    }

    private var carousel: some View {
        let scalesSideCards = !reduceMotion

        return ScrollView(.horizontal) {
            LazyHStack(spacing: spacing) {
                ForEach(items) { item in
                    card(item)
                        .containerRelativeFrame(.horizontal)
                        .scrollTransition(axis: .horizontal) { content, phase in
                            content
                                .scaleEffect(scalesSideCards && !phase.isIdentity ? 0.92 : 1)
                                .opacity(phase.isIdentity ? 1 : 0.7)
                        }
                }
            }
            .scrollTargetLayout()
        }
        .scrollIndicators(.hidden)
        .scrollTargetBehavior(.viewAligned(limitBehavior: .always))
        .scrollPosition(id: $currentID)
        .safeAreaPadding(.horizontal, peek + spacing)
    }

    private var dots: some View {
        let activeID = currentID ?? items.first?.id

        return HStack(spacing: 8) {
            ForEach(items) { item in
                Circle()
                    .fill(item.id == activeID ? AnyShapeStyle(.primary) : AnyShapeStyle(.tertiary))
                    .frame(width: 8, height: 8)
                    .scaleEffect(item.id == activeID ? 1.25 : 1)
            }
        }
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy, value: currentID)
        .accessibilityHidden(true)
    }
}

    let id: String
    let symbol: String
    let colors: [Color]
}

    private let slides = [

        DemoSlide(id: "Night", symbol: "moon.stars.fill", colors: [.indigo, .purple]),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
            Text("Explore")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                .padding(.horizontal, 40)

                VStack(spacing: 14) {

                        .font(.largeTitle)
                        .imageScale(.large)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    Text(slide.id)
                        .font(.system(.title, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
                }
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
                .frame(height: 500)
                .background(LinearGradient(colors: slide.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 32))
```
