## Dissolve Shader Transition

A custom transition that burns a view away through noise, with a glowing edge, drawn by a Metal shader.

Category: Transitions. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Transitions/DissolveShaderTransition/DissolveShaderTransition.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

nonisolated enum DissolveShaderTransitionMath {
    /// How wide the glowing edge is, as a share of the range of the noise.
    static let edgeWidth = 0.12

    /// The noise level under which a pixel is gone. It starts below every pixel and its glow,
    /// so the view begins whole, and ends above them all.
    static func threshold(progress: Double) -> Double {
        let clamped = min(max(progress, 0), 1)
        return clamped * (1 + edgeWidth) - edgeWidth
    }

    /// The function in `DissolveShaderTransition.metal`, with its arguments in the order it declares them.
    static func shader(progress: Double, grain: Double, edge: Color) -> Shader {
        ShaderLibrary.DissolveShaderTransitionBurn(
            .float(threshold(progress: progress)),
            .float(edgeWidth),
            .float(max(grain, 1)),
            .color(edge)
        )
    }
}

/// A transition that dissolves a view through noise, with a glowing edge where it burns away,
/// drawn by a Metal shader. Use it as `.transition(.dissolveShader)`.
///
/// Copy two files into the same target: `DissolveShaderTransition.swift` and `DissolveShaderTransition.metal`.
/// A shader draws what SwiftUI draws itself: a view backed by UIKit, such as a map, shows a placeholder.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the view fades instead.
struct DissolveShaderTransition: Transition {
    /// The color of the edge that burns.
    var edge: Color = .orange
    /// The size of the patches of noise, in points.
    var grain: Double = 44

    func body(content: Content, phase: TransitionPhase) -> some View {
        content.modifier(DissolveShaderTransitionEffect(progress: phase.isIdentity ? 0 : 1, edge: edge, grain: grain))
    }
}

extension Transition where Self == DissolveShaderTransition {
    static var dissolveShader: DissolveShaderTransition { DissolveShaderTransition() }

    static func dissolveShader(edge: Color, grain: Double = 44) -> DissolveShaderTransition {
        DissolveShaderTransition(edge: edge, grain: grain)
    }
}

/// `Animatable`, so the shader gets every step of the transition: a shader's arguments do not animate by themselves.
private struct DissolveShaderTransitionEffect: ViewModifier, Animatable {
    var progress: Double
    let edge: Color
    let grain: Double

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    nonisolated var animatableData: Double {
        get { progress }
        set { progress = newValue }
    }

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .colorEffect(
                DissolveShaderTransitionMath.shader(progress: progress, grain: grain, edge: edge),
                isEnabled: progress > 0 && !reduceMotion
            )
            .opacity(reduceMotion ? 1 - min(max(progress, 0), 1) : 1)
            // The first use of a shader waits for it to compile. Doing that now keeps the first frames of the transition.
            .task {
                let shader = DissolveShaderTransitionMath.shader(progress: 0, grain: grain, edge: edge)
                try? await shader.compile(as: .colorEffect)
            }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct DissolveShaderTransitionDemo: View {
    @State private var isShown = true

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color(red: 0.05, green: 0.04, blue: 0.08)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 36) {
                // An empty space of the same shape keeps the button still while the poster is gone.
                Color.clear
                    .aspectRatio(0.8, contentMode: .fit)
                    .overlay {
                        if isShown {
                            poster
                                .transition(.dissolveShader)
                        }
                    }

                Button(isShown ? "Dissolve" : "Restore") {
                    withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 1.5)) { isShown.toggle() }
                }
                .font(.headline)
                .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                .controlSize(.large)
                .tint(.orange)
                .animation(nil, value: isShown)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, 36)
        }
    }

    private var poster: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 14) {
            Image(systemName: "flame.fill")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, weight: .semibold))
                .imageScale(.large)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Text("Ember")
                .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
            Text("Gone in a breath")
                .font(.subheadline)
                .opacity(0.8)
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(
            LinearGradient(colors: [.indigo, .purple, .pink], startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing),
            in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28)
        )
        .accessibilityElement(children: .combine)
    }
}
```

Shader: Components/Transitions/DissolveShaderTransition/DissolveShaderTransition.metal

```metal
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

#include <metal_stdlib>
#include <SwiftUI/SwiftUI_Metal.h>

using namespace metal;

// A repeatable pseudo-random number from 0 to 1 for each cell of a grid.
static float DissolveShaderTransitionRandom(float2 cell) {
    uint2 seed = uint2(int2(cell));
    uint mixed = (seed.x * 0x9E3779B1u) ^ (seed.y * 0x85EBCA77u);
    mixed ^= mixed >> 15;
    mixed *= 0x2C1B3C6Du;
    mixed ^= mixed >> 12;
    return float(mixed & 0xFFFFu) / 65535.0;
}

// Smooth noise from 0 to 1: a random value at each corner of a grid, blended
// across each cell.
static float DissolveShaderTransitionNoise(float2 point) {
    float2 cell = floor(point);
    float2 inside = point - cell;
    float2 blend = inside * inside * (3.0 - 2.0 * inside);

    float bottom = mix(
        DissolveShaderTransitionRandom(cell),
        DissolveShaderTransitionRandom(cell + float2(1.0, 0.0)),
        blend.x
    );
    float top = mix(
        DissolveShaderTransitionRandom(cell + float2(0.0, 1.0)),
        DissolveShaderTransitionRandom(cell + float2(1.0, 1.0)),
        blend.x
    );
    return mix(bottom, top, blend.y);
}

// For SwiftUI's `colorEffect`. Removes the pixels whose noise is under
// `threshold`, and makes the ones within `edgeWidth` above it glow in
// `edgeColor`, so the view burns away in patches of `grain` points.
[[ stitchable ]] half4 DissolveShaderTransitionBurn(
    float2 position,
    half4 color,
    float threshold,
    float edgeWidth,
    float grain,
    half4 edgeColor
) {
    // Large patches, with a finer layer that roughens their outline.
    float2 point = position / grain;
    float noise = 0.7 * DissolveShaderTransitionNoise(point)
        + 0.3 * DissolveShaderTransitionNoise(point * 3.1 + 17.0);
    // Noise gathers around the middle. Spreading it makes the burn last the
    // whole transition.
    noise = saturate((noise - 0.5) * 1.7 + 0.5);

    // A short ramp keeps the cut from looking jagged.
    float kept = smoothstep(threshold, threshold + 0.015, noise);
    float heat = 1.0 - smoothstep(threshold, threshold + edgeWidth, noise);

    // The edge is the color of the ember, and paler where it is hottest.
    // Colors come premultiplied by their alpha.
    half3 ember = mix(edgeColor.rgb, half3(1.0), half(0.35 * heat * heat)) * color.a;
    half3 burning = mix(color.rgb, ember, half(heat));
    return half4(burning, color.a) * half(kept);
}
```

## Flip Card Transition

A two-sided card that flips in 3D without ever showing mirrored content.

Category: Transitions. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Transitions/FlipCardTransition/FlipCardTransition.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A two-sided card that flips with a 3D rotation when `isFlipped` changes.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the faces swap without rotating.
struct FlipCardTransition<Front: View, Back: View>: View {
    let isFlipped: Bool
    @ViewBuilder var front: () -> Front
    @ViewBuilder var back: () -> Back

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        FlipCardFaces(degrees: isFlipped ? 180 : 0, front: front(), back: back())
            .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.7), value: isFlipped)
    }
}

// Animatable so the visible face is chosen from the angle on every frame, at the exact
// moment the card is edge-on. A Bool would show a mirrored face for half of the flip.
private struct FlipCardFaces<Front: View, Back: View>: View, Animatable {
    nonisolated var degrees: Double
    let front: Front
    let back: Back

    nonisolated var animatableData: Double {
        get { degrees }
        set { degrees = newValue }
    }

    private var showsFront: Bool { degrees < 90 }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            front
                .opacity(showsFront ? 1 : 0)
                .accessibilityHidden(!showsFront)

            // Turned half way so it reads correctly once the card has turned the other half.
            back
                .rotation3DEffect(.degrees(180), axis: (x: 0, y: 1, z: 0))
                .opacity(showsFront ? 0 : 1)
                .accessibilityHidden(showsFront)
        }
        .rotation3DEffect(.degrees(degrees), axis: (x: 0, y: 1, z: 0), perspective: 0.5)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct FlipCardTransitionDemo: View {
    @State private var isFlipped = false
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .title) private var cardHeight = 240.0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 40) {
            FlipCardTransition(isFlipped: isFlipped) {
                face(colors: [.indigo, .purple]) {
                    Image(systemName: "creditcard.fill")
                        .font(.largeTitle)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    Text("Membership")
                        .font(.title.bold())
                    Text("Tap Flip to see the back")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                }
            } back: {
                face(colors: [.teal, .mint]) {
                    Image(systemName: "qrcode")
                        .font(.largeTitle)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    Text("No. 2026 0042")
                        .font(.title.monospacedDigit().bold())
                    Text("Valid until December")
                        .font(.subheadline)
                }
            }
            .frame(height: cardHeight)
            .padding(.horizontal, 28)

            Button("Flip", systemImage: "arrow.left.arrow.right") {
                isFlipped.toggle()
            }
            .font(.headline)
            .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
            .controlSize(.large)
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground).ignoresSafeArea())
    }

    private func face(colors: [Color], @ViewBuilder content: () -> some View) -> some View {
        VStack(spacing: 10) {
            content()
        }
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(
            LinearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing),
            in: .rect(cornerRadius: 28)
        )
    }
}
```

## Interactive Pager Transition

A page transition whose progress follows the finger during a drag and completes or cancels on release.

Category: Transitions. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Transitions/InteractivePagerTransition/InteractivePagerTransition.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum InteractivePagerTransitionMath {
    static func clampedIndex(_ index: Int, count: Int) -> Int {
        count > 0 ? min(max(index, 0), count - 1) : 0
    }

    /// Slows the drag past the first and last page.
    static func resisted(translation: CGFloat, index: Int, count: Int) -> CGFloat {
        let current = clampedIndex(index, count: count)
        let pastStart = current == 0 && translation > 0
        let pastEnd = current >= count - 1 && translation < 0
        return pastStart || pastEnd ? translation * 0.3 : translation
    }

    /// Commits when the finger went far enough, or was flicked hard enough. Otherwise cancels.
    static func targetIndex(index: Int, count: Int, translation: CGFloat, predicted: CGFloat, width: CGFloat) -> Int {
        let current = clampedIndex(index, count: count)
        guard count > 0, width > 0 else { return current }

        let decisive = abs(translation) > width * 0.4 ? translation : (abs(predicted) > width * 0.6 ? predicted : 0)
        guard decisive != 0 else { return current }
        return clampedIndex(current + (decisive < 0 ? 1 : -1), count: count)
    }

    /// `relative` is 0 for the centered page, 1 for the next one and -1 for the previous one.
    /// The page on top slides fully. The one underneath moves at a slower parallax speed.
    static func offsetX(relative: CGFloat, width: CGFloat, parallax: Bool) -> CGFloat {
        relative > 0 || !parallax ? relative * width : relative * width * 0.3
    }

    static func scale(relative: CGFloat, parallax: Bool) -> CGFloat {
        guard parallax, relative < 0 else { return 1 }
        return 1 - 0.08 * min(-relative, 1)
    }
}

/// A pager whose transition follows the finger, then completes or cancels on release.
///
/// VoiceOver can change page with a three-finger swipe or by adjusting the page dots. With
/// Reduce Motion on, pages slide plainly under the finger and settle at once.
struct InteractivePagerTransition<Page: Identifiable, PageContent: View>: View {
    let pages: [Page]
    @Binding var index: Int
    @ViewBuilder var content: (Page) -> PageContent

    @GestureState private var dragTranslation: CGFloat = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion
    @Environment(\.layoutDirection) private var layoutDirection

    /// Gestures report screen points, but layout mirrors in right-to-left layouts: 1 or -1 converts between them.
    private var forward: CGFloat { layoutDirection == .rightToLeft ? -1 : 1 }

    private var currentIndex: Int {
        InteractivePagerTransitionMath.clampedIndex(index, count: pages.count)
    }

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { proxy in
            let width = proxy.size.width
            let drag = InteractivePagerTransitionMath.resisted(translation: dragTranslation, index: currentIndex, count: pages.count)
            let position = CGFloat(currentIndex) - (width > 0 ? drag / width : 0)

            ZStack {
                ForEach(Array(pages.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { pageIndex, page in
                    if abs(pageIndex - currentIndex) <= 1 {
                        pageView(page, at: pageIndex, position: position, width: width)
                    }
                }
            }
            // The page underneath shrinks and darkens as it recedes. Black behind it reads as
            // depth; the background of the app would flash as bands above and below.
            .background { Color.black.ignoresSafeArea() }
            .contentShape(.rect)
            .gesture(dragGesture(width: width))
            // No animation while the finger is down, so the page tracks it exactly.
            .animation(dragTranslation != 0 || reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.45), value: position)
        }
        .overlay(alignment: .bottom) { pageDots }
        .accessibilityScrollAction { edge in
            if edge == .trailing { step(1) }
            if edge == .leading { step(-1) }
        }
        .onChange(of: pages.count) {
            index = currentIndex
        }
    }

    private func pageView(_ page: Page, at pageIndex: Int, position: CGFloat, width: CGFloat) -> some View {
        let relative = CGFloat(pageIndex) - position
        let parallax = !reduceMotion

        return content(page)
            .frame(width: width > 0 ? width : nil)
            .scaleEffect(InteractivePagerTransitionMath.scale(relative: relative, parallax: parallax))
            .brightness(parallax && relative < 0 ? 0.25 * max(relative, -1) : 0)
            .offset(x: InteractivePagerTransitionMath.offsetX(relative: relative, width: width, parallax: parallax))
            .zIndex(Double(pageIndex))
            .allowsHitTesting(pageIndex == currentIndex)
            .accessibilityHidden(pageIndex != currentIndex)
    }

    private func dragGesture(width: CGFloat) -> some Gesture {
        DragGesture(minimumDistance: 10)
            .updating($dragTranslation) { value, state, _ in
                state = value.translation.width * forward
            }
            .onEnded { value in
                index = InteractivePagerTransitionMath.targetIndex(
                    index: currentIndex,
                    count: pages.count,
                    translation: value.translation.width * forward,
                    predicted: value.predictedEndTranslation.width * forward,
                    width: width
                )
            }
    }

    private func step(_ delta: Int) {
        index = InteractivePagerTransitionMath.clampedIndex(currentIndex + delta, count: pages.count)
    }

    private var pageDots: some View {
        HStack(spacing: 8) {
            ForEach(pages.indices, id: \.self) { dot in
                Capsule()
                    .fill(.white.opacity(dot == currentIndex ? 1 : 0.45))
                    .frame(width: dot == currentIndex ? 22 : 8, height: 8)
            }
        }
        .padding(.bottom, 18)
        .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .snappy(duration: 0.3), value: currentIndex)
        .accessibilityElement()
        .accessibilityLabel("Page")
        .accessibilityValue(pages.isEmpty ? "None" : "\(currentIndex + 1) of \(pages.count)")
        .accessibilityAdjustableAction { direction in
            switch direction {
            case .increment: step(1)
            case .decrement: step(-1)
            @unknown default: break
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct InteractivePagerTransitionDemo: View {
    private struct Slide: Identifiable {
        let id: String
        let symbol: String
        let colors: [Color]
    }

    private let slides = [
        Slide(id: "Explore", symbol: "safari.fill", colors: [.teal, .blue]),
        Slide(id: "Collect", symbol: "square.stack.3d.up.fill", colors: [.orange, .pink]),
        Slide(id: "Share", symbol: "paperplane.fill", colors: [.purple, .indigo]),
    ]

    @State private var index = 0

    var body: some View {
        InteractivePagerTransition(pages: slides, index: $index) { slide in
            ZStack {
                LinearGradient(colors: slide.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)

                VStack(spacing: 18) {
                    Image(systemName: slide.symbol)
                        .font(.system(size: 90))
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)

                    Text(slide.id)
                        .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                }
                .foregroundStyle(.white)
            }
            .ignoresSafeArea()
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    InteractivePagerTransitionDemo()
}
```

## Matched Hero Card

A card that expands in place into a full detail view using matched geometry.

Category: Transitions. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Transitions/MatchedHeroCard/MatchedHeroCard.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A card that grows in place to fill its parent. Its icon, title and subtitle travel to their
/// new places with `matchedGeometryEffect`.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the card changes state without animating.
struct MatchedHeroCard<Detail: View>: View {
    let title: String
    let subtitle: String
    let systemImage: String
    var colors: [Color] = [.indigo, .purple]
    @ViewBuilder var detail: () -> Detail

    @State private var isExpanded = false
    @Namespace private var namespace
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var collapsedHeight = 220.0
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var iconSize = 52.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var animation: Animation? {
        reduceMotion ? nil : .smooth(duration: 0.5, extraBounce: 0.08)
    }

    var body: some View {
        // One background for both states, so the card is never see-through while it changes,
        // and it clips the detail, so the text never runs over what is below the card.
        ZStack(alignment: .top) {
            if isExpanded {
                expandedContent
            } else {
                collapsedContent
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, minHeight: collapsedHeight, maxHeight: isExpanded ? .infinity : collapsedHeight)
        .background(LinearGradient(colors: colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing))
        .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: 28, style: .continuous))
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .top)
        .foregroundStyle(.white)
    }

    private var collapsedContent: some View {
        Button {
            withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded = true }
        } label: {
            header
                .padding(24)
                .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .bottomLeading)
                .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityHint("Expands the card")
    }

    private var expandedContent: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 24) {
            header

            detail()

            Spacer(minLength: 0)
        }
        .padding(24)
        .padding(.top, 32)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
        .overlay(alignment: .topTrailing) {
            Button {
                withAnimation(animation) { isExpanded = false }
            } label: {
                Image(systemName: "xmark")
                    .font(.headline)
                    .padding(12)
                    .background(.white.opacity(0.2), in: .circle)
                    // A little bigger for a touch than it looks, up to the size of a touch target.
                    .padding(2)
                    .contentShape(.rect)
                    .padding(-2)
            }
            .buttonStyle(.plain)
            .accessibilityLabel("Close")
            .padding(16)
        }
    }

    private var header: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 6) {
            Image(systemName: systemImage)
                .font(.system(size: iconSize, weight: .semibold))
                .matchedGeometryEffect(id: "icon", in: namespace)
                .accessibilityHidden(true)

            Text(title)
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())
                .matchedGeometryEffect(id: "title", in: namespace)

            Text(subtitle)
                .font(.subheadline)
                .opacity(0.85)
                .matchedGeometryEffect(id: "subtitle", in: namespace)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct MatchedHeroCardDemo: View {
    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var rowsOffset = 240.0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 16) {
            Text("Today")
                .font(.largeTitle.bold())

            ZStack(alignment: .top) {
                VStack(spacing: 12) {
                    row("Harbor walk", systemImage: "sailboat.fill")
                    row("Lunch at the market", systemImage: "fork.knife")
                    row("Sunset viewpoint", systemImage: "sun.horizon.fill")
                }
                .padding(.top, rowsOffset)

                MatchedHeroCard(
                    title: "Lisbon",
                    subtitle: "Three days by the river",
                    systemImage: "tram.fill",
                    colors: [.orange, .pink, .purple]
                ) {
                    Text("Tiled streets, yellow trams and the best custard tarts you will ever taste. The card grew from where it was and goes back there when you close it.")
                        .font(.body)
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(20)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity, alignment: .topLeading)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground).ignoresSafeArea())
    }

    private func row(_ title: String, systemImage: String) -> some View {
        Label(title, systemImage: systemImage)
            .font(.headline)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
            .padding(18)
            .background(Color(.secondarySystemGroupedBackground), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
    }
```

## Parallax Push Transition

A custom Transition where the incoming page slides over while the outgoing page moves at a slower parallax speed.

Category: Transitions. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Transitions/ParallaxPushTransition/ParallaxPushTransition.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum ParallaxPushTransitionMath {
    /// The horizontal shift as a fraction of the page width.
    static func shift(phase: TransitionPhase, isForward: Bool, parallax: CGFloat) -> CGFloat {
        switch phase {
        case .identity: 0
        case .willAppear: isForward ? 1 : -parallax
        case .didDisappear: isForward ? -parallax : 1
        }
    }
}

/// The incoming page slides over while the outgoing page moves at a slower parallax speed.
///
/// A `Transition` cannot read the environment, so pass Reduce Motion in: with it on, the
/// pages crossfade. Give the page on top the higher `zIndex`.
struct ParallaxPushTransition: Transition {
    var isForward = true
    var reduceMotion = false
    var parallax: CGFloat = 0.3

    func body(content: Content, phase: TransitionPhase) -> some View {
        // `visualEffect` takes a `@Sendable` closure, so it works with a local copy.
        let shift = ParallaxPushTransitionMath.shift(phase: phase, isForward: isForward, parallax: parallax)

        if reduceMotion {
            content.opacity(phase.isIdentity ? 1 : 0)
        } else {
            content
                .brightness(shift < 0 ? -0.25 : 0)
                .visualEffect { effect, proxy in
                    effect.offset(x: shift * proxy.size.width)
                }
        }
    }
}

extension Transition where Self == ParallaxPushTransition {
    /// For moving forward. Moving back uses `.parallaxPop`, set before the page changes.
    static func parallaxPush(reduceMotion: Bool = false) -> ParallaxPushTransition {
        ParallaxPushTransition(isForward: true, reduceMotion: reduceMotion)
    }

    static func parallaxPop(reduceMotion: Bool = false) -> ParallaxPushTransition {
        ParallaxPushTransition(isForward: false, reduceMotion: reduceMotion)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct ParallaxPushTransitionDemo: View {
    private struct Screen {
        let title: String
        let symbol: String
        let colors: [Color]
    }

    private let screens = [
        Screen(title: "Arrive", symbol: "airplane.arrival", colors: [.indigo, .blue]),
        Screen(title: "Stay", symbol: "bed.double.fill", colors: [.orange, .pink]),
        Screen(title: "Taste", symbol: "fork.knife", colors: [.green, .teal]),
        Screen(title: "Depart", symbol: "airplane.departure", colors: [.purple, .pink]),
    ]

    // Keeps growing, so the newest page always has the highest `zIndex`.
    @State private var generation = 0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var screen: Screen { screens[generation % screens.count] }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            page(screen)
                .transition(.parallaxPush(reduceMotion: reduceMotion))
                .id(generation)
                .zIndex(Double(generation))
        }
        .overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
            Button("Next page", systemImage: "arrow.forward", action: advance)
                .font(.headline)
                .buttonStyle(.borderedProminent)
                .tint(.white.opacity(0.25))
                .padding(.bottom, 32)
        }
        .task(id: reduceMotion) {
            guard !reduceMotion else { return }
            while !Task.isCancelled {
                try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.3))
                guard !Task.isCancelled else { return }
                advance()
            }
        }
    }

    private func advance() {
        withAnimation(.smooth(duration: 0.7)) {
            generation = generation == Int.max ? 0 : generation + 1
        }
    }

    private func page(_ screen: Screen) -> some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: screen.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 18) {
                Image(systemName: screen.symbol)
                    .font(.system(size: 90))
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Text(screen.title)
                    .font(.largeTitle.bold())
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    ParallaxPushTransitionDemo()
}
```

## Slide Scale Transition

A custom transition that combines an offset with a scale, available as .slideScale.

Category: Transitions. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Transitions/SlideScaleTransition/SlideScaleTransition.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A transition that slides and scales a view: it enters from one side and leaves by the other.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the view only fades.
struct SlideScaleTransition: Transition {
    var axis: Axis = .horizontal
    var distance: CGFloat = 220
    var scale: CGFloat = 0.8

    func body(content: Content, phase: TransitionPhase) -> some View {
        content.modifier(SlideScaleEffect(axis: axis, distance: distance, scale: scale, phase: phase))
    }
}

extension Transition where Self == SlideScaleTransition {
    static var slideScale: SlideScaleTransition { SlideScaleTransition() }

    static func slideScale(axis: Axis, distance: CGFloat = 220, scale: CGFloat = 0.8) -> SlideScaleTransition {
        SlideScaleTransition(axis: axis, distance: distance, scale: scale)
    }
}

// The effect lives in a view modifier so it can read the environment.
private struct SlideScaleEffect: ViewModifier {
    let axis: Axis
    let distance: CGFloat
    let scale: CGFloat
    let phase: TransitionPhase

    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    // `phase.value` is -1 before appearing, 0 at rest and 1 after disappearing.
    private var offset: CGFloat {
        reduceMotion ? 0 : -phase.value * distance
    }

    func body(content: Content) -> some View {
        content
            .scaleEffect(phase.isIdentity || reduceMotion ? 1 : scale)
            .offset(x: axis == .horizontal ? offset : 0, y: axis == .vertical ? offset : 0)
            .opacity(phase.isIdentity ? 1 : 0)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SlideScaleTransitionDemo: View {
    @State private var index = 0

    private let cards: [(title: String, systemImage: String, colors: [Color])] = [
        ("Run", "figure.run", [.orange, .red]),
        ("Swim", "figure.pool.swim", [.cyan, .blue]),
        ("Climb", "figure.climbing", [.mint, .green]),
    ]

    private var card: (title: String, systemImage: String, colors: [Color]) {
        cards[index % cards.count]
    }

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Color(.systemGroupedBackground)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 20) {
                Image(systemName: card.systemImage)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, weight: .semibold))
                    .imageScale(.large)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Text(card.title)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .frame(height: 340)
            .background(
                LinearGradient(colors: card.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing),
                in: .rect(cornerRadius: 36)
            )
            .padding(32)
            .id(index)
            .transition(.slideScale)
        }
        .task {
            while (try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(1.3))) != nil {
                withAnimation(.smooth(duration: 0.55)) { index += 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    SlideScaleTransitionDemo()
}
```

## Staggered Appear List

A list whose rows enter one after another with a capped, testable delay.

Category: Transitions. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Transitions/StaggeredAppearList/StaggeredAppearList.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

enum StaggeredAppearListTiming {
    /// How long a row waits before it enters. The cap keeps long lists from stalling.
    static func delay(
        forIndex index: Int,
        step: Double = 0.07,
        maximum: Double = 0.6,
        reduceMotion: Bool = false
    ) -> Double {
        guard !reduceMotion else { return 0 }
        return min(max(Double(index), 0) * step, maximum)
    }
}

/// Rows that enter one after another when the list appears.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, every row fades in at once without moving.
struct StaggeredAppearList<Item: Identifiable, Row: View>: View {
    let items: [Item]
    var spacing: CGFloat = 12
    var travel: CGFloat = 28
    @ViewBuilder var row: (Item) -> Row

    @State private var isVisible = false
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: spacing) {
            ForEach(Array(items.enumerated()), id: \.element.id) { index, item in
                row(item)
                    .opacity(isVisible ? 1 : 0)
                    .offset(y: isVisible || reduceMotion ? 0 : travel)
                    .animation(
                        .smooth(duration: 0.45)
                            .delay(StaggeredAppearListTiming.delay(forIndex: index, reduceMotion: reduceMotion)),
                        value: isVisible
                    )
            }
        }
        .onAppear { isVisible = true }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct StaggeredAppearDemoRow: Identifiable {
    let id: String
    let detail: String
    let systemImage: String
    let tint: Color
}

struct StaggeredAppearListDemo: View {
    @State private var replay = 0

    private let rows = [
        StaggeredAppearDemoRow(id: "Inbox", detail: "12 new messages", systemImage: "tray.fill", tint: .blue),
        StaggeredAppearDemoRow(id: "Calendar", detail: "Standup at 9:30", systemImage: "calendar", tint: .red),
        StaggeredAppearDemoRow(id: "Music", detail: "Your weekly mix", systemImage: "music.note", tint: .pink),
        StaggeredAppearDemoRow(id: "Photos", detail: "48 added today", systemImage: "photo.fill", tint: .orange),
        StaggeredAppearDemoRow(id: "Health", detail: "6,204 steps", systemImage: "heart.fill", tint: .green),
        StaggeredAppearDemoRow(id: "Files", detail: "2 shared with you", systemImage: "folder.fill", tint: .teal),
        StaggeredAppearDemoRow(id: "Notes", detail: "Groceries, ideas", systemImage: "note.text", tint: .yellow),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            StaggeredAppearList(items: rows) { row in
                HStack(spacing: 14) {
                    Image(systemName: row.systemImage)
                        .font(.title3)
                        .foregroundStyle(row.tint)
                        .frame(width: 36)
                        .accessibilityHidden(true)

                    VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 2) {
                        Text(row.id)
                            .font(.headline)
                        Text(row.detail)
                            .font(.subheadline)
                            .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    }

                    Spacer(minLength: 0)
                }
                .padding(16)
                .background(Color(.secondarySystemGroupedBackground), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 18))
            }
            .id(replay)
            .padding(20)
        }
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground).ignoresSafeArea())
        .task {
            while (try? await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2.4))) != nil {
                replay += 1
            }
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    StaggeredAppearListDemo()
}
```

## Symbol Morph Toggle

A toggle whose SF Symbol morphs between states with the iOS 18 magic replace effect.

Category: Transitions. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Transitions/SymbolMorphToggle/SymbolMorphToggle.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A toggle whose SF Symbol morphs between two states with the magic replace effect.
/// The magic effect shows between related symbols, such as `bell.fill` and `bell.slash.fill`.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the symbols fade.
struct SymbolMorphToggle: View {
    let title: LocalizedStringResource
    let onSymbol: String
    let offSymbol: String
    @Binding var isOn: Bool
    var tint: Color = .blue

    @ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .largeTitle) private var symbolSize = 44.0
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    private var transition: ContentTransition {
        reduceMotion ? .opacity : .symbolEffect(.replace.magic(fallback: .downUp.byLayer))
    }

    var body: some View {
        Button {
            withAnimation(.smooth(duration: 0.4)) { isOn.toggle() }
        } label: {
            VStack(spacing: 12) {
                Image(systemName: isOn ? onSymbol : offSymbol)
                    .font(.system(size: symbolSize, weight: .medium))
                    .symbolRenderingMode(.hierarchical)
                    .contentTransition(transition)
                    .frame(height: symbolSize * 1.3)
                    .foregroundStyle(isOn ? tint : .secondary)

                Text(title)
                    .font(.headline)
            }
            .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
            .padding(.vertical, 28)
            .background(Color(.secondarySystemGroupedBackground), in: .rect(cornerRadius: 24))
            .contentShape(.rect)
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .accessibilityLabel(title)
        .accessibilityValue(isOn ? "On" : "Off")
        .accessibilityAddTraits(.isToggle)
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

struct SymbolMorphToggleDemo: View {
    @State private var alerts = true
    @State private var microphone = true
    @State private var camera = true
    @State private var network = true

    var body: some View {
        Grid(horizontalSpacing: 14, verticalSpacing: 14) {
            GridRow {
                SymbolMorphToggle(title: "Alerts", onSymbol: "bell.fill", offSymbol: "bell.slash.fill", isOn: $alerts, tint: .orange)
                SymbolMorphToggle(title: "Microphone", onSymbol: "mic.fill", offSymbol: "mic.slash.fill", isOn: $microphone, tint: .pink)
            }

            GridRow {
                SymbolMorphToggle(title: "Camera", onSymbol: "video.fill", offSymbol: "video.slash.fill", isOn: $camera, tint: .green)
                SymbolMorphToggle(title: "Network", onSymbol: "wifi", offSymbol: "wifi.slash", isOn: $network, tint: .blue)
            }
        }
        .padding(20)
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity)
        .background(Color(.systemGroupedBackground).ignoresSafeArea())
    }
}

#Preview {
    SymbolMorphToggleDemo()
}
```

## Zoom Hero Transition

A grid of cards that zoom into their detail screen with the native navigation zoom transition.

Category: Transitions. Minimum: iOS 18.0. Path: Components/Transitions/ZoomHeroTransition/ZoomHeroTransition.swift

```swift
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// Copyright (c) 2026 Oscar Canton and Awesome SwiftUI Components contributors

import SwiftUI

/// A grid of cards that zoom into their detail screen. Place it inside a `NavigationStack`.
///
/// With Reduce Motion on, the detail opens with the standard navigation transition.
struct ZoomHeroTransition<Item: Identifiable & Hashable, Card: View, Detail: View>: View {
    let items: [Item]
    var columns: Int = 2
    var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 24
    @ViewBuilder var card: (Item) -> Card
    @ViewBuilder var detail: (Item) -> Detail

    @Namespace private var namespace
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        ScrollView {
            LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible(), spacing: 14), count: columns), spacing: 14) {
                ForEach(items) { item in
                    NavigationLink(value: item) {
                        card(item)
                            .clipShape(.rect(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
                            .matchedTransitionSource(id: item.id, in: namespace) { source in
                                source.clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
                            }
                    }
                    .buttonStyle(.plain)
                }
            }
            .padding(16)
        }
        .navigationDestination(for: Item.self) { item in
            destination(for: item)
        }
    }

    // `.zoom` and `.automatic` are different types, so a ternary cannot choose between them on iOS 18.
    @ViewBuilder
    private func destination(for item: Item) -> some View {
        if reduceMotion {
            detail(item)
        } else {
            detail(item).navigationTransition(.zoom(sourceID: item.id, in: namespace))
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Demo

private struct ZoomHeroDemoPlace: Identifiable, Hashable {
    let id: String
    let systemImage: String
    let colors: [Color]
}

struct ZoomHeroTransitionDemo: View {
    private let places = [
        ZoomHeroDemoPlace(id: "Aurora", systemImage: "sparkles", colors: [.indigo, .teal]),
        ZoomHeroDemoPlace(id: "Dunes", systemImage: "sun.max.fill", colors: [.orange, .pink]),
        ZoomHeroDemoPlace(id: "Forest", systemImage: "leaf.fill", colors: [.green, .mint]),
        ZoomHeroDemoPlace(id: "Glacier", systemImage: "snowflake", colors: [.cyan, .blue]),
        ZoomHeroDemoPlace(id: "Volcano", systemImage: "flame.fill", colors: [.red, .orange]),
        ZoomHeroDemoPlace(id: "Night", systemImage: "moon.stars.fill", colors: [.purple, .indigo]),
    ]

    var body: some View {
        NavigationStack {
            ZoomHeroTransition(items: places) { place in
                LinearGradient(colors: place.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                    .aspectRatio(0.78, contentMode: .fit)
                    .overlay {
                        Image(systemName: place.systemImage)
                            .font(.largeTitle)
                            .imageScale(.large)
                            .foregroundStyle(.white.opacity(0.9))
                            .accessibilityHidden(true)
                    }
                    .overlay(alignment: .bottomLeading) {
                        Text(place.id)
                            .font(.headline)
                            .foregroundStyle(.white)
                            .padding(14)
                    }
            } detail: { place in
                ZoomHeroDemoDetail(place: place)
            }
            .navigationTitle("Places")
        }
    }
}

private struct ZoomHeroDemoDetail: View {
    let place: ZoomHeroDemoPlace

    @Environment(\.dismiss) private var dismiss

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            LinearGradient(colors: place.colors, startPoint: .topLeading, endPoint: .bottomTrailing)
                .ignoresSafeArea()

            VStack(spacing: 18) {
                Image(systemName: place.systemImage)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, weight: .semibold))
                    .imageScale(.large)
                    .accessibilityHidden(true)

                Text(place.id)
                    .font(.system(.largeTitle, design: .rounded, weight: .bold))

                Text("The card grew into this screen. Swipe down or tap Close to send it back.")
                    .font(.body)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)

                Button("Close") { dismiss() }
                    .buttonStyle(.bordered)
                    .tint(.white)
            }
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .padding(32)
        }
    }
}

#Preview {
    ZoomHeroTransitionDemo()
}
```
